1863–1875 cholera pandemic.headline: Četrta pandemija kolere
paragraphs: Četrta pandemija kolere v 19. stoletju se je začela v delti Gangesa v Bengalu in se z muslimanskimi romarji razširila v Meko. V prvem letu je epidemija terjala 30.000 od 90.000 romarjev. Kolera se je razširila po vsem Bližnjem vzhodu in prišla v Ruski imperij, Evropo, Afriko in Severno Ameriko, vsakič s popotniki iz pristaniških mest in po celinskih vodnih poteh.

Leta 1866 je izbruhnila krajevna epidemija v londonskem East Endu, predvsem zato, ker je bil tamkajšnji del londonske kanalizacije še v gradnji in je bil ta del Londona prenaseljen. Izbruh kolere v Severni Ameriki v 1870. letih se je iz New Orleansa s potniki razširil po Misisipiju in v pristanišča na njegovih pritokih.

source.title: 1863–1875 cholera pandemic
paragraphs: The fourth cholera pandemic of the 19th century began in the Ganges Delta of the Bengal region and traveled with Muslim pilgrims to Mecca. In its first year, the epidemic claimed 30,000 of 90,000 pilgrims. Cholera spread throughout the Middle East and was carried to the Russian Empire, Europe, Africa, and North America, in each case spreading via travelers from port cities and along inland waterways.

In 1866, there was a localized epidemic in the East End of London, primarily because the local section of the London sewerage system was still under construction and this region of London was experiencing overcrowding. The 1870s North American cholera outbreak spread from New Orleans via passengers along the Mississippi River and to ports on its tributaries.
Peta pandemija kolere (1881–1896) je bila peti velik mednarodni izbruh kolere v 19. stoletju.

Endemični izvor pandemije je bil tako kot pri prejšnjih v delti Gangesa v Zahodnem Bengalu. Bakterija Vibrio cholerae se do 19. stoletja ni mogla razširiti v zahodno Evropo, hitrejša in boljša sodobna prevozna sredstva, kot so parniki in železnice, pa so potovanja močno skrajšala in olajšala prenos kolere in drugih nalezljivih bolezni. Med četrto pandemijo kolere 1863–1875 je tretja mednarodna sanitarna konferenca, ki se je leta 1866 sestala v Carigradu, kot »najmočnejši od vseh vzrokov« kolere označila verska romanja, in tudi tokrat so bila hindujska in muslimanska romanja pomemben dejavnik širjenja bolezni.

source.title: 1881–1896 cholera pandemic
paragraphs: The fifth cholera pandemic (1881–1896) was the fifth major international outbreak of cholera in the 19th century.

The endemic origin of the pandemic, as with those of its predecessors, was in the Ganges Delta in West Bengal. While the Vibrio cholerae bacteria had not been able to spread to western Europe until the 19th century, faster and improved modes of modern transportation, such as steamships and railways, reduced the duration of the journey considerably and facilitated the transmission of cholera and other infectious diseases. During the fourth 1863–1875 cholera pandemic, the third International Sanitary Conference convened in 1866 in Constantinople had identified religious pilgrimages to be "the most powerful of all causes" of cholera and again Hindu and Muslim pilgrimages were an important factor in the spread of the disease.

1893 Franco-Siamese crisis.headline: Francosko-siamska kriza leta 1893
paragraphs: Francosko-siamska kriza leta 1893, na Tajskem znana kot incident 112. leta obdobja Rattanakosin (tajsko: วิกฤตการณ์ ร.ศ. 112,
), je bila spor med Francosko tretjo republiko in Kraljevino Siam. Auguste Pavie, francoski podkonzul v Luang Prabangu leta 1886, je bil glavni zastopnik francoskih interesov v Laosu.

Njegove spletke, ki so izkoriščale siamsko šibkost v regiji in občasne vpade vietnamskih upornikov iz Tonkina, so povečale napetosti med Bangkokom in Parizom. Spor se je končal z incidentom v Paknamu, ko so francoske topnjače priplule po reki Chao Phraya in blokirale Bangkok. Siamci so nato privolili, da Franciji odstopijo območje, ki obsega večino današnjega Laosa, s čimer se je Francoska Indokina močno razširila. Ta spor je sledil vojnam s Hawi (1865–1890), v katerih so Siamci poskušali pomiriti severni Siam in Tonkin.
notes: Vir oklepaj s tajskim imenom razdeli med odstavka; delitev je ohranjena. Izpuščena sta tajska transliteracija (RTGS) in izgovarjava (IPA).

source.title: 1893 Franco-Siamese crisis
paragraphs: The Franco-Siamese crisis of 1893, known in Thailand as the Incident of Rattanakosin Era 112 (Thai: วิกฤตการณ์ ร.ศ. 112,

RTGS: wikrittakan roso-roisipsong, [wí krít tàʔ kaːn rɔː sɔ̌ː rɔ́ːj sìp sɔ̌ːŋ]) was a conflict between the French Third Republic and the Kingdom of Siam. Auguste Pavie, French vice-consul in Luang Prabang in 1886, was the chief agent in furthering French interests in Laos.

His intrigues, which took advantage of Siamese weakness in the region and periodic invasions by Vietnamese rebels from Tonkin, increased tensions between Bangkok and Paris. The conflict concluded with the Paknam Incident, in which French gunboats sailed up the Chao Phraya River to blockade Bangkok. The Siamese subsequently agreed to cede the area that constitutes most of present-day Laos to France, an act that led to the significant expansion of French Indochina. This conflict succeeded the Haw wars (1865–1890), in which the Siamese attempted to pacify northern Siam and Tonkin.
Šesta pandemija kolere (1899–1923) je bila velik izbruh kolere, ki se je začel v Indiji, kjer je umrlo več kot 800.000 ljudi, in se razširil v zahodno Azijo, Severno Afriko, vzhodno Evropo in Rusijo.

Pandemija naj bi izbruhnila na Kumbh Meli v Haridvarju. Epidemija se je v Evropo razširila prek Pandžaba, Afganistana, Perzije in južne Rusije. Izbruh kolere v New Yorku v letih 1910–1911 naj bi bil del pandemije; razširili so ga okuženi potniki na parniku Moltke, ki je vozil potnike iz Neaplja. Leta 1913 je kolera izbruhnila med enotami romunske vojske, ki so sodelovale v vojaških operacijah druge balkanske vojne na bolgarskih območjih.

source.title: 1899–1923 cholera pandemic
paragraphs: The sixth cholera pandemic (1899–1923) was a major outbreak of cholera beginning in India, where it killed more than 800,000 people, and spreading to West Asia, North Africa, Eastern Europe, and Russia.

The outbreak of the pandemic is thought to have started at the Haridwar Kumbh Mela. The epidemic spread to Europe via Punjab, Afghanistan, Persia, and southern Russia. An outbreak of cholera in New York City from 1910 to 1911 is thought to be part of the pandemic, having spread through infected people aboard the steamship Moltke which was transporting passengers from Naples. In 1913, there was a cholera outbreak in forces of the Romanian Army which were taking part in military operations of the Second Balkan War in Bulgarian areas.

1920 Ganja revolt.headline: Upor v Gandži leta 1920
paragraphs: Upor v Gandži leta 1920 (azerbajdžansko: Gəncə üsyanı) je bil ljudska vstaja proti sovjetski okupaciji, ki je v Gandži potekala od 26. do 31. maja 1920. Cilj vstaje je bil strmoglaviti sovjetsko oblast v Azerbajdžanu. To je bil največji upor proti sovjetski oblasti v Azerbajdžanu v 20. stoletju in je terjal največ žrtev. Organizatorji in vodilna sila vstaje so bili častniki vojske nekdanje Azerbajdžanske demokratične republike.

source.title: 1920 Ganja revolt
paragraphs: The 1920 Ganja revolt (Azerbaijani: Gəncə üsyanı) was a popular uprising against the Soviet occupation that took place in Ganja on 26 to 31 May 1920. The goal of the uprising was to overthrow the Soviet government in Azerbaijan. This was the largest rebellion against Soviet rule in Azerbaijan in the 20th century, and caused the most losses. The organizers and leading force of the uprising were officers of the army of the former Azerbaijan Democratic Republic.

1958 Pakistani military coup.headline: Vojaški udar v Pakistanu leta 1958
paragraphs: Vojaški udar v Pakistanu leta 1958 je bil prvi vojaški udar v Pakistanu in se je zgodil 27. oktobra 1958. Z njim je vrhovni poveljnik pakistanske vojske Mohamed Ajub kan strmoglavil pakistanskega predsednika Iskandarja Alija Mirzo.

Mirza je 7. oktobra razveljavil pakistansko ustavo in razglasil vojno stanje. Iskandar Mirza je izgubil podporo številnih vodilnih politikov in ga je vznemiril načrt Husejna Šahida Suhravardija, da bi politično vodstvo Bengala in Pandžaba združil proti njemu. Zato se je za pomoč obrnil na Ajuba kana in vojsko.

source.title: 1958 Pakistani military coup
paragraphs: The 1958 Pakistani military coup was the first military coup in Pakistan that took place on 27 October 1958. It resulted in the toppling of Iskander Ali Mirza, the president of Pakistan, by Muhammad Ayub Khan, the commander-in-chief of the Pakistan Army.

On 7 October, Mirza abrogated the Constitution of Pakistan and declared martial law. Iskander Mirza had lost the support of many of the leading politicians and was alarmed at a plan by Huseyn Shaheed Suhrawardy to unite the political leadership of Bengal and Punjab against him. Therefore he turned to Ayub Khan and the military for help.

1960 South Vietnamese coup attempt.headline: Poskus državnega udara v Južnem Vietnamu leta 1960
paragraphs: Spodleteli poskus državnega udara proti južnovietnamskemu predsedniku Ngô Đìnhu Diệmu sta 11. novembra 1960 vodila podpolkovnik Vương Văn Đông in polkovnik Nguyễn Chánh Thi iz padalske divizije Vojske Republike Vietnam (ARVN).

Uporniki so udar sprožili kot odgovor na Diệmovo avtokratsko vladavino in škodljiv politični vpliv njegovega brata Ngô Đình Nhuja in svakinje Madame Nhu. Pritoževali so se tudi nad politizacijo vojske, v kateri so režimu zvesti člani tajne stranke Cần Lao rodbine Ngô zlahka napredovali pred sposobnejšimi častniki, ki niso bili del ožjega kroga. Đônga je v zaroti podpiral svak podpolkovnik Nguyen Trieu Hong, čigar stric je bil vidni funkcionar manjše opozicijske stranke. Glavni člen udara je bil Đôngov nadrejeni Thi, ki ga je Đông prepričal, da se je pridružil zaroti.

source.title: 1960 South Vietnamese coup attempt
paragraphs: On 11 November 1960, a failed coup attempt against President Ngô Đình Diệm of South Vietnam was led by Lieutenant Colonel Vương Văn Đông and Colonel Nguyễn Chánh Thi of the Airborne Division of the Army of the Republic of Vietnam (ARVN).

The rebels launched the coup in response to Diệm's autocratic rule and the negative political influence of his brother Ngô Đình Nhu and sister-in-law Madame Nhu. They also bemoaned the politicisation of the military, whereby regime loyalists who were members of the Ngô family's covert Cần Lao Party were readily promoted ahead of more competent officers who were not insiders. Đông was supported in the conspiracy by his brother-in-law Lieutenant Colonel Nguyen Trieu Hong, whose uncle was a prominent official in a minor opposition party. The main link in the coup was Đông's commanding officer Thi, whom he persuaded to join the plot.

1962 Burmese coup d'état.headline: Državni udar v Burmi leta 1962
paragraphs: Državni udar v Burmi leta 1962 je zaznamoval začetek enopartijske vladavine v Burmi (Mjanmaru) in politične prevlade vojske v burmanski politiki. Z udarom 2. marca 1962 je vojska civilno vlado AFPFL pod vodstvom predsednika vlade U Nuja nadomestila z Revolucionarnim svetom Unije, ki mu je predsedoval general Ne Win.

source.title: 1962 Burmese coup d'état
paragraphs: The 1962 Burmese coup d'état marked the beginning of one-party rule in Burma (Myanmar) and the political dominance of the military in Burmese politics. In the 2 March 1962 coup, the military replaced the civilian AFPFL-government headed by Prime Minister U Nu with the Union Revolutionary Council Chaired by General Ne Win.

1962 South Vietnamese Independence Palac.headline: Bombni napad na Palačo neodvisnosti leta 1962
paragraphs: Palačo neodvisnosti v Saigonu v Južnem Vietnamu sta 27. februarja 1962 bombardirala dva uporniška pilota letalstva Republike Vietnam, poročnik Nguyễn Văn Cử in nadporočnik Phạm Phú Quốc. Pilota sta napadla stavbo, uradno rezidenco južnovietnamskega predsednika, z namenom ubiti predsednika Ngô Đình Diệma in njegove najožje sorodnike, ki so mu bili politični svetovalci.

Pilota sta pozneje povedala, da sta atentat poskusila kot odgovor na Diệmovo avtokratsko vladavino, v kateri se je bolj posvečal ohranjanju oblasti kot boju proti Vietkongu (VC), marksistično-leninistični gverilski vojski, ki je grozila, da bo strmoglavila južnovietnamsko vlado. Cử in Quốc sta upala, da bo letalski napad razkril Diệmovo ranljivost in sprožil splošno vstajo, vendar se to ni zgodilo.

source.title: 1962 South Vietnamese Independence Palace bombing
paragraphs: On 27 February 1962, the Independence Palace in Saigon, South Vietnam, was bombed by two dissident Republic of Vietnam Air Force pilots, Second Lieutenant Nguyễn Văn Cử and First Lieutenant Phạm Phú Quốc. The pilots targeted the building, the official residence of the President of South Vietnam, with the aim of assassinating President Ngô Đình Diệm and his immediate family, who acted as political advisors.

The pilots later said they attempted the assassination in response to Diệm's autocratic rule, in which he focused more on remaining in power than on confronting the Viet Cong (VC), a Marxist–Leninist guerilla army who were threatening to overthrow the South Vietnamese government. Cử and Quốc hoped that the airstrike would expose Diệm's vulnerability and trigger a general uprising, but this failed to materialize.

1963 South Vietnamese coup d'état.headline: Državni udar v Južnem Vietnamu leta 1963
paragraphs: Predsednika Ngô Đình Diệma in Personalistično delavsko revolucionarno stranko Republike Vietnam (Južnega Vietnama) je 1. novembra 1963 odstavila skupina častnikov Vojske Republike Vietnam, ki jo je podpirala Cia in ki se ni strinjala z Diệmovim ravnanjem v budistični krizi in z grožnjo, ki sta jo Južnemu Vietnamu pomenila Severni Vietnam in Vietkong (VC). V poznejših letih Južnega Vietnama so udar nekateri imenovali Cách mạng 1-11-1963 (revolucija 1. novembra 1963).

source.title: 1963 South Vietnamese coup d'état
paragraphs: On November 1, 1963, President Ngô Đình Diệm and the Personalist Labor Revolutionary Party of the Republic of Vietnam (South Vietnam) were deposed by a group of CIA-backed Army of the Republic of Vietnam officers who disagreed with Diệm's handling of the Buddhist crisis and the North Vietnamese-Viet Cong (VC) threat to South Vietnam. During South Vietnam's later years, some referred to the coup as Cách mạng 1-11-1963 (The 1st November 1963 Revolution).

Državni udar v Kambodži leta 1970 (kmersko: រដ្ឋប្រហារឆ្នាំ១៩៧០; francosko: Coup d'État de 1970) je pomenil odstavitev kamboškega državnega poglavarja princa Norodoma Sihanuka po glasovanju v narodni skupščini 18. marca 1970. Predsednik vlade Lon Nol, ki je postal dejanski državni poglavar, se je nato skliceval na izredna pooblastila, kar je nazadnje privedlo do odstavitve kraljice Sisowath Kossamak in razglasitve Kmerske republike še istega leta. Udar na splošno velja za prelomnico kamboške državljanske vojne. Kambodža, ki ni bila več monarhija, se je v šestih mesecih med udarom in razglasitvijo republike polslužbeno imenovala »État du Cambodge« (Država Kambodža).
Udar je pomenil tudi spremembo vloge Kambodže v vietnamski vojni, saj je Lon Nol severnovietnamskim silam postavil ultimat, naj zapustijo Kambodžo.

source.title: 1970 Cambodian coup d'état
paragraphs: The 1970 Cambodian coup d'état (Khmer: រដ្ឋប្រហារឆ្នាំ១៩៧០, French: Coup d'État de 1970) was the removal of the Cambodian Chief of State, Prince Norodom Sihanouk, after a vote in the National Assembly on 18 March 1970. Emergency powers were subsequently invoked by the Prime Minister Lon Nol, who became effective head of state, and led ultimately to the removal of Queen Sisowath Kossamak and the proclamation of the Khmer Republic later that year. It is generally seen as a turning point in the Cambodian Civil War. No longer a monarchy, Cambodia was semi-officially called "État du Cambodge" (State of Cambodia) in the intervening six months after the coup, until the republic was proclaimed.
It also marked the change of Cambodia involvement in the Vietnam War, as Lon Nol issued an ultimatum to North Vietnamese forces to leave Cambodia.

1973 Afghan coup d'état.headline: Državni udar v Afganistanu leta 1973
paragraphs: Državni udar v Afganistanu leta 1973, doma znan kot udar 26. saratana ali narodna revolucija, sam pa se je imenoval revolucija 26. saratana 1352, je 17. julija 1973 vodil general in princ Mohamed Daud kan proti svojemu bratrancu kralju Mohamedu Zahirju Šahu; z njim je nastala Republika Afganistan z enopartijskim sistemom pod Daudovim vodstvom.

source.title: 1973 Afghan coup d'état
paragraphs: The 1973 Afghan coup d'état, locally known as the Coup of 26 Saratan, The National Revolution and self-proclaimed as the Revolution of 26 Saratan 1352, was led by Army General and prince Mohammad Daoud Khan against his cousin, King Mohammad Zahir Shah, on 17 July 1973, which resulted in the establishment of the Republic of Afghanistan under a one-party system led by Daoud Khan.

1973 Thai popular uprising.headline: Ljudska vstaja na Tajskem leta 1973
paragraphs: Ljudska vstaja 14. oktobra 1973 (tajsko: เหตุการณ์ 14 ตุลา, dobesedno »dogodek 14. oktobra«; tudi วันมหาวิปโยค, dobesedno »dan velike žalosti«) je bila prelomen dogodek v tajski zgodovini. Vstaja je končala vladajočo vojaško diktaturo protikomunističnega Thanoma Kittikachorna in spremenila tajski politični sistem. Zlasti je pokazala vse večji vpliv tajskih univerzitetnih študentov v politiki.
notes: Izpuščeni sta tajski transliteraciji (RTGS).

source.title: 1973 Thai popular uprising
paragraphs: The popular uprising of 14 October 1973 (Thai: เหตุการณ์ 14 ตุลา, RTGS: Hetkan Sip-Si Tula, lit. 'October 14 Event'; also วันมหาวิปโยค, RTGS: Wan Maha Wippayok, lit. 'Day of Great Sorrow') was a watershed event in Thailand's history. The uprising resulted in the end of the ruling military dictatorship of anti-communist Thanom Kittikachorn and altered the Thai political system. Notably, it highlighted the growing influence of Thai university students in politics.

1990 Nepalese revolution.headline: Ljudsko gibanje v Nepalu leta 1990
paragraphs: Ljudsko gibanje leta 1990 (nepalsko: २०४६ जनआन्दोलन, 2046 Jana Andolan) je bilo večstrankarsko gibanje v Nepalu, ki je končalo absolutno monarhijo in uvedlo ustavno monarhijo. Odpravilo je tudi sistem pančajatov.

Gibanje je zaznamovala enotnost različnih političnih strank. Različne komunistične stranke se niso le združile v Združeno levo fronto (ULF), temveč so sodelovale tudi s strankami, kot je Nepalski kongres (NC). Ena od posledic te enotnosti je bila ustanovitev Komunistične partije Nepala (Združene marksistično-leninistične).

source.title: 1990 Nepalese revolution
paragraphs: The 1990 People's Movement (Nepali: २०४६ जनआन्दोलन, romanized: 2046 Jana Andolan) was a multiparty movement in Nepal that brought an end to absolute monarchy and the beginning of constitutional monarchy. It also eliminated the Panchayat system.

The movement was marked by the unity between the various political parties. Not only did various Communist parties group together in the United Left Front (ULF), but they also cooperated with parties such as Nepali Congress (NC). One result of this unity was the formation of the Communist Party of Nepal (Unified Marxist-Leninist).

1991–1992 Georgian coup d'état.headline: Državni udar v Gruziji 1991–1992
paragraphs: Državni udar v Gruziji 1991–1992, znan tudi kot tbilisijska vojna ali puč 1991–1992, je bil notranji vojaški spopad v novo neodvisni Republiki Gruziji po razpadu Sovjetske zveze, od 22. decembra 1991 do 6. januarja 1992. V udaru, ki je sprožil gruzijsko državljansko vojno, so se frakcije nacionalne garde, zveste predsedniku Zviadu Gamsahurdiji, spopadle z več paravojaškimi organizacijami, ki so se konec leta 1991 združile pod vodstvom vojskovodij Tengiza Kitovanija, Džabe Ioselianija in Tengiza Sigue.

source.title: 1991–1992 Georgian coup d'état
paragraphs: The 1991–1992 Georgian coup d'état, also known as the Tbilisi War, or the Putsch of 1991–1992, was an internal military conflict that took place in the newly independent Republic of Georgia following the fall of the Soviet Union, from 22 December 1991 to 6 January 1992. The coup, which triggered the Georgian Civil War, pitted factions of the National Guard loyal to President Zviad Gamsakhurdia against several paramilitary organizations unified at the end of 1991 under the leadership of warlords Tengiz Kitovani, Jaba Ioseliani and Tengiz Sigua.

1993 Azerbaijani coup d'état.headline: Državni udar v Azerbajdžanu leta 1993
paragraphs: Državni udar v Azerbajdžanu leta 1993, znan tudi kot gandžanska vstaja, je bil vojaški udar pod vodstvom azerbajdžanskega vojaškega poveljnika Surata Husejnova. Husejnove sile so 4. junija 1993 krenile na pohod iz Gandže proti azerbajdžanski prestolnici Baku, da bi strmoglavile predsednika Abulfaza Elčibeja, izvoljenega na prvih svobodnih volitvah v neodvisnem Azerbajdžanu leta 1992.
Udar, ki ga je podpirala Rusija, je odstavil Elčibeja in na predsedniški položaj postavil Hejdarja Alijeva. Kmalu zatem je Rusija začela podpirati poskuse udara proti Alijevu, denimo udar leta 1994.
notes: Izpuščena je oznaka opombe [1].

source.title: 1993 Azerbaijani coup d'état
paragraphs: The 1993 Azeri coup d'état, also known as the Ganja Uprising, was a military coup led by Azerbaijani military commander Surat Huseynov. On June 4, 1993, Huseynov's forces led a march from the city of Ganja to the Azerbaijani capital of Baku in order to overthrow President Abulfaz Elchibey who was elected in independent Azerbaijan's first free election in 1992.
The Russia-backed coup ousted Elchibey and installed Heydar Aliyev as president. Shortly afterwards, Russia would begin supporting coup attempts against Aliyev, such as the 1994 coup.[1]

1995 Azerbaijani coup attempt.headline: Poskus državnega udara v Azerbajdžanu leta 1995
paragraphs: Poskus državnega udara v Azerbajdžanu leta 1995, znan tudi kot turški udar v Bakuju, so izvedli pripadniki azerbajdžanske vojske pod vodstvom polkovnika Rovšana Džavadova, ki je vodil odred posebne policijske enote (OPON). Skupina je hotela prevzeti oblast od predsednika Hejdarja Alijeva in znova postaviti nekdanjega predsednika Abulfaza Elčibeja. Udar je spodletel, ko je turški predsednik Süleyman Demirel izvedel, da zaroto podpirajo nekateri krogi v Turčiji, in Alijeva po telefonu posvaril. Enote azerbajdžanskih oboroženih sil so 17. marca 1995 obkolile tabor upornikov in ga napadle, pri čemer je bil ubit polkovnik Džavadov. Poročila v Turčiji po aferi Susurluk leta 1996 so podrobneje razkrila, kako so udar podpirali krogi v Turčiji.

source.title: 1995 Azerbaijani coup attempt
paragraphs: The 1995 Azerbaijani coup d'état attempt, also known as the Turkish coup in Baku, was a coup d'état attempt by members of the Azerbaijani military, led by Colonel Rovshan Javadov at the head of a detachment of Special Purpose Police Unit (OPON). The group aimed to take control of the country from president Heydar Aliyev and reinstall former president Abulfaz Elchibey. The coup was foiled when the Turkish President Süleyman Demirel became aware of elements in Turkey supporting the plot, and called Aliyev to warn him. On 17 March 1995, units of the Azerbaijani Armed Forces surrounded the insurgents' camp and assaulted it, killing Colonel Javadov. Reports in Turkey following the 1996 Susurluk scandal elaborated on support for the coup from elements in Turkey.

1999 Pakistani coup d'état.headline: Državni udar v Pakistanu leta 1999
paragraphs: Vojaški prevzem oblasti v Pakistanu leta 1999 je bil nekrvav državni udar, ki ga je sprožilo vojaško osebje v skupnem štabu pod predsednikom odbora načelnikov združenih štabov in načelnikom generalštaba kopenske vojske generalom Pervezom Mušarafom. Prevratniki so 12. oktobra 1999 prevzeli nadzor nad civilno vlado ljudsko izvoljenega predsednika vlade Navaza Šarifa. General Mušaraf je 14. oktobra kot izvršni vodja države izdal sporen začasni ukaz, s katerim je suspendiral pakistansko ustavo.

source.title: 1999 Pakistani coup d'état
paragraphs: The 1999 military takeover in Pakistan was a bloodless coup d'état initiated by the military staff at the Joint Staff HQ working under the Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff Committee and Chief of Army Staff General Pervez Musharraf. The instigators seized control of the civilian government of the popularly elected Prime Minister Nawaz Sharif on 12 October 1999. On 14 October, General Musharraf, acting as the country's Chief Executive, issued a controversial provisional order that suspended the Constitution of Pakistan.

2006 Thai coup d'état.headline: Državni udar na Tajskem leta 2006
paragraphs: Državni udar na Tajskem leta 2006 se je zgodil 19. septembra 2006, ko je kraljeva tajska vojska izvedla udar proti izvoljeni začasni vladi predsednika vlade Thaksina Shinawatre. Udar, prva neustavna menjava vlade na Tajskem v petnajstih letih od državnega udara leta 1991, je sledil enoletni politični krizi, v katero so bili vpleteni Thaksin, njegovi zavezniki in politični nasprotniki, in se je zgodil manj kot mesec dni pred načrtovanimi vsedržavnimi volitvami v spodnji dom. Na Tajskem in drugod so splošno poročali, da je bil glavni načrtovalec udara general Prem Tinsulanonda, predsednik tajnega sveta in ključna osebnost v prepletu vojske in monarhije. Vojska je odpovedala volitve, načrtovane za 15. oktober, razveljavila ustavo iz leta 1997, razpustila parlament in ustavno sodišče, prepovedala proteste in vse politične dejavnosti, zatrla in cenzurirala medije, razglasila vojno stanje po vsej državi in aretirala člane vlade.

source.title: 2006 Thai coup d'état
paragraphs: The 2006 Thai coup d'état took place on 19 September 2006, when the Royal Thai Army staged a coup d'état against the elected caretaker government of Prime Minister Thaksin Shinawatra. The coup d'état, which was Thailand's first non-constitutional change of government in fifteen years since the 1991 Thai coup d'état, followed a year-long political crisis involving Thaksin, his allies, and political opponents and occurred less than a month before nationwide House elections were scheduled to be held. It has been widely reported in Thailand and elsewhere that General Prem Tinsulanonda, a key person in the military-monarchy nexus, Chairman of the Privy Council, was the mastermind of the coup. The military cancelled the scheduled 15 October elections, abrogated the 1997 constitution, dissolved parliament and the constitutional court, banned protests and all political activities, suppressed and censored the media, declared martial law nationwide, and arrested cabinet members.

2010 Kyrgyz Revolution.headline: Kirgiška revolucija leta 2010
paragraphs: Kirgiška revolucija leta 2010, znana tudi kot druga kirgiška revolucija, melonska revolucija, aprilski dogodki ali uradno ljudska aprilska revolucija (kirgiško: Апрель Элдик революциясы), se je začela aprila 2010 z odstavitvijo kirgiškega predsednika Kurmanbeka Bakijeva v prestolnici Biškek. Sledile so ji vse večje etnične napetosti med Kirgizi in Uzbeki na jugu države, ki so junija 2010 prerasle v nasilje. Nasilje je nazadnje privedlo do utrditve novega parlamentarnega sistema v Kirgizistanu.

Izgnanci iz uzbeške manjšine trdijo, da so jih v splošnem kaosu napadali in pregnali v Uzbekistan, okoli 400.000 državljanov Kirgizistana pa je postalo notranje razseljenih. Žrtve, s katerimi so govorili novinarji in humanitarni delavci, pričajo o množičnih pobojih, skupinskih posilstvih in mučenju. Tedanja vodja začasne vlade Roza Otunbajeva je navedla, da je smrtnih žrtev desetkrat več, kot so poročali prej, s čimer se število mrtvih povzpne na 2000.
notes: Izpuščena je latinična transliteracija kirgiškega imena.

source.title: 2010 Kyrgyz Revolution
paragraphs: The 2010 Kyrgyz Revolution, also known as the Second Kyrgyz Revolution, the Melon Revolution, the April Events, or officially as the People's April Revolution (Kyrgyz: Апрель Элдик революциясы, romanized: Aprel Yeldik revolyutsiyasy), began in April 2010 with the ousting of Kyrgyz president Kurmanbek Bakiyev in the capital Bishkek. It was followed by increased ethnic tension involving Kyrgyz people and Uzbeks in the south of the country, which escalated in June 2010. The violence ultimately led to the consolidation of a new parliamentary system in Kyrgyzstan.

During the general mayhem, exiles from the Uzbek minority claim they were assaulted and driven to Uzbekistan, with some 400,000 Kyrgyzstani citizens becoming internally displaced. Victims interviewed by media and aid workers testify to mass killing, gang rape and torture. Then-head of the Interim government Roza Otunbayeva indicated that the death toll is tenfold higher than was previously reported, which brings the number of the dead to 2,000 people.

2014 Thai coup d'état.headline: Državni udar na Tajskem leta 2014
paragraphs: Kraljeve tajske oborožene sile pod vodstvom generala Prayuta Chan-o-che, vrhovnega poveljnika kraljeve tajske vojske, so 22. maja 2014 po šestih mesecih politične krize izvedle državni udar proti začasni vladi, dvanajstega od prvega udara v državi leta 1932. Vojska je za vodenje države ustanovila hunto z imenom Narodni svet za mir in red (NCPO). Udar je končal politični spopad med režimom, ki ga je vodila vojska, in demokratičnimi silami, ki je trajal od državnega udara leta 2006, znanega kot »nedokončani udar«. Sedem let pozneje je prerasel v tajske proteste 2020–2021 za reformo tajske monarhije.

source.title: 2014 Thai coup d'état
paragraphs: On 22 May 2014, the Royal Thai Armed Forces, led by General Prayut Chan-o-cha, the commander-in-chief of the Royal Thai Army, launched a coup d'état, the twelfth since the country's first coup in 1932, against the caretaker government following six months of political crisis. The military established a junta called the National Council for Peace and Order (NCPO) to govern the nation. The coup ended the political conflict between the military-led regime and democratic power, which had been present since the 2006 Thai coup d'état known as the "unfinished coup". Seven years later, it developed into the 2020–2021 Thai protests to reform the monarchy of Thailand.

2017 Nangarhar airstrike.headline: Letalski napad v Nangarharju leta 2017
paragraphs: Združene države so 13. aprila 2017 izvedle letalski napad v okrožju Ačin v provinci Nangarhar na vzhodu Afganistana blizu meje s Pakistanom. Za napad so uporabile največje nejedrsko orožje v ameriškem arzenalu, bombo GBU-43/B Massive Ordnance Air Blast (MOAB), da bi uničile sisteme predorov, ki jih je uporabljala Islamska država – provinca Horasan (IS-KP).

Bombo so odvrgli skozi zadnja tovorna vrata letala Lockheed MC-130 ameriškega vojnega letalstva. Afganistanski uradniki so 15. aprila 2017 sporočili, da je v napadu umrlo 96 borcev IS-KP, med njimi štirje poveljniki, ter indijski, pakistanski, bangladeški in filipinski državljani. Po besedah uradnika afganistanske vojske civilnih žrtev ni bilo.

source.title: 2017 Nangarhar airstrike
paragraphs: On 13 April 2017, the United States conducted an airstrike in Achin District, located in the Nangarhar Province of eastern Afghanistan, near the border with Pakistan. The airstrike was carried out using the largest non-nuclear weapon in the United States' arsenal, the GBU-43/B Massive Ordnance Air Blast (MOAB), with the goal of destroying tunnel complexes used by the Islamic State – Khorasan Province (IS-KP).

The bomb was dropped from the rear cargo door of a United States Air Force Lockheed MC-130. On 15 April 2017, Afghan officials reported that 96 IS-KP militants, including four commanders, were killed in the strike; this included Indian, Pakistani, Bangladeshi and Filipino nationals. According to an Afghan Army official, there were no civilian casualties.

2020 Nagorno-Karabakh ceasefire agreemen.headline: Sporazum o premirju v Gorskem Karabahu leta 2020
paragraphs: Sporazum o premirju v Gorskem Karabahu leta 2020 je bil sporazum o prekinitvi ognja, s katerim se je končala vojna v Gorskem Karabahu leta 2020. Podpisali so ga 9. novembra azerbajdžanski predsednik Ilham Alijev, armenski predsednik vlade Nikol Pašinjan in ruski predsednik Vladimir Putin, vse sovražnosti v Gorskem Karabahu pa so se končale 10. novembra 2020 ob 00.00 po moskovskem času. V prekinitev sovražnosti je privolil tudi predsednik odcepljene Republike Arcah Arajik Harutjunjan.
notes: Druga vojna v Gorskem Karabahu je poimenovana po glosarju (Vojna v Gorskem Karabahu leta 2020).

source.title: 2020 Nagorno-Karabakh ceasefire agreement
paragraphs: The 2020 Nagorno-Karabakh ceasefire agreement was an armistice agreement that ended the Second Nagorno-Karabakh War. It was signed on 9 November by the President of Azerbaijan Ilham Aliyev, the Prime Minister of Armenia Nikol Pashinyan and the President of Russia Vladimir Putin, and ended all hostilities in the Nagorno-Karabakh region from 00:00, on 10 November 2020 Moscow time. The president of the breakaway Republic of Artsakh, Arayik Harutyunyan, also agreed to an end of hostilities.

2020–2021 China–India skirmishes.headline: Spopadi med Kitajsko in Indijo 2020–2021
paragraphs: Od 5. maja 2020 so se kitajski in indijski vojaki na več krajih ob kitajsko-indijski meji zapletli v nasilne pretepe, soočenja in spopade, med drugim pri spornem jezeru Pangong med Ladakhom in Tibetansko avtonomno pokrajino ter ob meji med Sikimom in Tibetansko avtonomno pokrajino. Do novih spopadov je prišlo tudi na krajih v vzhodnem Ladakhu ob črti dejanskega nadzora (LAC).

Konec maja so kitajske sile ugovarjale indijski gradnji ceste v dolini reke Galvan. Po indijskih virih so v pretepu 15. in 16. junija 2020 umrli kitajski in indijski vojaki. Mediji so poročali, da so obe strani zajeli vojake in jih v naslednjih dneh izpustili, uradni viri obeh strani pa so to zanikali. Ob LAC so 7. septembra prvič po 45 letih padli streli, za kar sta druga drugo krivili obe strani. Indijski mediji so poročali tudi, da so indijski vojaki 30. avgusta proti Ljudski osvobodilni vojski izstrelili opozorilne strele.

source.title: 2020–2021 China–India skirmishes
paragraphs: Beginning on 5 May 2020, Chinese and Indian troops engaged in aggressive melee, face-offs, and skirmishes at locations along the Sino-Indian border, including near the disputed Pangong Lake in Ladakh and the Tibet Autonomous Region, and near the border between Sikkim and the Tibet Autonomous Region. Additional clashes also took place at locations in eastern Ladakh along the Line of Actual Control (LAC).

In late May, Chinese forces objected to Indian road construction in the Galwan river valley. According to Indian sources, melee fighting on 15–16 June 2020 resulted in the deaths of Chinese and Indian soldiers. Media reports stated that soldiers were taken captive on both sides and released in the coming few days while official sources on both sides went on to deny this. On 7 September, for the first time in 45 years, shots were fired along the LAC, with both sides blaming each other for the firing. Indian media also reported that Indian troops fired warning shots at the PLA on 30 August.

2021 Kyrgyzstan–Tajikistan clashes.headline: Spopadi med Kirgizistanom in Tadžikistanom leta 2021
paragraphs: Tridnevni mejni spopad med Kirgizistanom in Tadžikistanom se je začel 28. aprila 2021. Spopadi so izvirali iz dolgotrajnega spora glede vodooskrbnega objekta pri vasi Kök-Taš. Tadžikistanski mediji so pred spopadom izražali zaskrbljenost zaradi vojaških vaj v Batkenu.

source.title: 2021 Kyrgyzstan–Tajikistan clashes
paragraphs: A three-day border conflict between Kyrgyzstan and Tajikistan began on 28 April 2021. The clashes stemmed from a long-running dispute over a water supply facility near the village of Kök-Tash. Tajikistani media raised some concern over military drills in Batken prior to the conflict.

2021 Myanmar coup d'état.headline: Državni udar v Mjanmaru leta 2021
paragraphs: Državni udar v Mjanmaru se je začel zjutraj 1. februarja 2021, ko je tatmadav, mjanmarska vojska, odstavil demokratično izvoljene člane vladajoče stranke, Narodne lige za demokracijo (NLD), in oblast prenesel na vojaško hunto. Vršilec dolžnosti predsednika Mjanmara Myint Swe je razglasil enoletne izredne razmere in sporočil, da je oblast prešla na vrhovnega poveljnika obrambnih sil višjega generala Min Aung Hlainga. Vojska je razglasila izid splošnih volitev novembra 2020 za neveljaven in napovedala nove volitve ob koncu izrednih razmer. Udar se je zgodil dan pred tem, ko naj bi mjanmarski parlament zaprisegel poslance, izvoljene na volitvah leta 2020, in je to preprečil.

source.title: 2021 Myanmar coup d'état
paragraphs: A coup d'état in Myanmar began on the morning of 1 February 2021, when democratically elected members of the country's ruling party, the National League for Democracy (NLD), were deposed by the Tatmadaw, Myanmar's military, which then vested power in a military junta. Acting President of Myanmar Myint Swe proclaimed a year-long state of emergency and declared power had been transferred to Commander-in-Chief of Defence Services Senior General Min Aung Hlaing. It declared the results of the November 2020 general election invalid and stated its intent to hold a new election at the end of the state of emergency. The coup d'état occurred the day before the Parliament of Myanmar was to swear in the members elected in the 2020 election, thereby preventing this from occurring.

Bidžapurski sultanat je bil zgodnjenovoveški sultanat na jugozahodu Dekana, ki mu je vladala dinastija Adil Šahi. Bidžapur, eden od petih dekanskih sultanatov, je bil pred osamosvojitvijo leta 1490 in pred političnim zatonom kraljestva v zadnji četrtini 15. stoletja taraf (provinca) Bahmanskega sultanata. Na vrhuncu je bil Bidžapurski sultanat ena najmočnejših držav na Indijski podcelini, takoj za Mogulskim cesarstvom, ki ga je leta 1686 pod Aurangzebom osvojilo.

Jusuf Adil Šah se je po preselitvi v Bahmanski sultanat povzpel v službi in postal upravitelj province Bidžapur. Leta 1490 je ustvaril dejansko neodvisno bidžapursko državo, ki je ob propadu Bahmanskega sultanata leta 1518 postala tudi formalno neodvisna.

source.title: Bijapur Sultanate
paragraphs: The Bijapur Sultanate was an early modern sultanate located in the southwestern Deccan, ruled by the Adil Shahi dynasty. One of the five Deccan sultanates, Bijapur had originally been a taraf (province) of the Bahmani Sultanate prior to its independence in 1490 and before the kingdom's political decline in the last quarter of the 15th century. The Sultanate of Bijapur was one of the most powerful states in the Indian subcontinent at its peak, second to the Mughal Empire which conquered it in 1686 under Aurangzeb.

After emigrating to the Bahmani Sultanate, Yusuf Adil Shah rose through the ranks to be appointed governor of the province of Bijapur. In 1490, he created a de facto independent Bijapur state which became formally independent with the Bahmani collapse in 1518.

Afghan Civil War (1928–1929).headline: Afganistanska državljanska vojna (1928–1929)
paragraphs: Afganistanska državljanska vojna 1928–1929 je potekala od 14. novembra 1928 do 13. oktobra 1929. Uporniške, pozneje vladajoče sile sakavistov (Saqāwīhā) pod vodstvom Habibulaha Kalakanija so se bojevale proti različnim nasprotnim plemenom in tekmecem za prestol v Kraljevini Afganistan, med katerimi je nazadnje prevladal Mohamed Nadir kan. Kljub začetnim uspehom, kot sta bila zavzetje Kabula in poraz Amanulaha kana 17. januarja 1929 ter zavzetje Kandaharja 3. junija, so protisakavistične sile pod Nadirjevim vodstvom 13. oktobra 1929 sakaviste strmoglavile, Nadir pa je postal afganistanski kralj. Vladal je do umora 3. novembra 1933.

source.title: Afghan Civil War (1928–1929)
paragraphs: The Afghan Civil War of 1928–1929 was fought from 14 November 1928 to 13 October 1929. Rebelling, and subsequently governing Saqqawist (Saqāwīhā) forces under Habibullāh Kalakāni fought against various opposing tribes and rival monarchs in the Kingdom of Afghanistan, among whom Mohammed Nādir Khān eventually achieved a preponderant role. Despite early successes, such as the capture of Kabul and defeat of Amanullah Khan on 17 January 1929 or the capture of Kandahar on 3 June, the Saqqawists were eventually deposed by anti-Saqqawist forces led by Nadir on 13 October 1929, leading to Nadir's ascension as King of Afghanistan. He ruled until his assassination on 3 November 1933.

Afganistanska državljanska vojna 1992–1996, znana tudi kot druga afganistanska državljanska vojna, je potekala med 28. aprilom 1992, ko naj bi nova začasna afganistanska vlada nadomestila Republiko Afganistan predsednika Mohameda Nadžibulaha, in talibansko zasedbo Kabula 27. septembra 1996, s katero je nastal Islamski emirat Afganistan.

Vojna je neposredno sledila državljanski vojni 1989–1992, ki se je končala z zmago mudžahidov in razpadom Republike Afganistan aprila 1992. Hezb-e Islami Gulbudin pod vodstvom Gulbudina Hekmatjarja, ki jo je podpirala pakistanska obveščevalna služba ISI, ni hotela sodelovati v koalicijski vladi in je s pomočjo halkistov poskušala zavzeti Kabul. Dne 25. aprila 1992 so izbruhnili boji med tremi, pozneje petimi ali šestimi mudžahidskimi vojskami. Zavezništva med bojujočimi se stranmi so bila ves čas vojne začasna.

source.title: Afghan Civil War (1992–1996)
paragraphs: The 1992–1996 Afghan Civil War, also known as the Second Afghan Civil War, took place between 28 April 1992 — the date a new interim Afghan government was supposed to replace the Republic of Afghanistan of President Mohammad Najibullah—and the Taliban's occupation of Kabul establishing the Islamic Emirate of Afghanistan on 27 September 1996.

The war immediately followed the 1989–1992 civil war with the Mujahideen victory and dissolution of the Republic of Afghanistan in April 1992. Hezb-e Islami Gulbuddin, led by Gulbuddin Hekmatyar and supported by Pakistan's Inter-Services Intelligence (ISI), refused to form a coalition government and tried to seize Kabul with the help of Khalqists. On 25 April 1992 fighting broke out between three, and later five or six, mujahideen armies. Alliances between the combatants were transitory throughout the war.

Afganistanska državljanska vojna 1996–2001, znana tudi kot tretja afganistanska državljanska vojna, je potekala med talibansko osvojitvijo Kabula in ustanovitvijo Islamskega emirata Afganistan 27. septembra 1996 ter ameriško invazijo na Afganistan 7. oktobra 2001; to obdobje je bilo del afganistanskih državljanskih vojn, ki so se začele leta 1989, in del širšega spopada v Afganistanu, ki se je začel leta 1978.
Večina mednarodne skupnosti je še naprej priznavala vlado Islamske države Afganistan. Talibansko vlado Islamskega emirata pa so priznale Saudova Arabija, Pakistan in Združeni arabski emirati.

source.title: Afghan Civil War (1996–2001)
paragraphs: The 1996–2001 Afghan Civil War, also known as the Third Afghan Civil War, took place between the Taliban's conquest of Kabul and their establishing of the Islamic Emirate of Afghanistan on 27 September 1996, and the U.S. invasion of Afghanistan on 7 October 2001: a period that was part of the Afghan Civil Wars that had started in 1989, and also part of the conflict (in wider sense) in Afghanistan that had started in 1978.

The Islamic State of Afghanistan government remained the recognized government of Afghanistan by most of the international community. The Taliban's Islamic Emirate government, however, received recognition from Saudi Arabia, Pakistan and the United Arab Emirates.

Afganistanski konflikt (paštunsko: دافغانستان جنګونه; farsi oziroma dari: درگیری افغانستان) je niz dogodkov, zaradi katerih je Afganistan od 1970. let skoraj neprekinjeno v oboroženem spopadu. Prva nestabilnost je sledila propadu Kraljevine Afganistan v večinoma nenasilnem državnem udaru leta 1973, ki je v njegovi odsotnosti odstavil afganistanskega monarha Mohameda Zahirja Šaha in končal njegovo 40-letno vladavino. S hkratno ustanovitvijo Republike Afganistan pod vodstvom Mohameda Dauda kana se je končalo razmeroma mirno in stabilno obdobje v sodobni zgodovini države. Do vsesplošnih bojev pa je prišlo šele po letu 1978, ko je saurska revolucija nasilno strmoglavila Daudovo vlado in ustanovila Demokratično republiko Afganistan. Nemiri zaradi radikalnih reform, ki jih je uvajala tedaj vladajoča Ljudska demokratična stranka Afganistana (PDPA), so povzročili nasilje brez primere, zaradi česar je Sovjetska zveza leta 1979 v podporo PDPA izvedla obsežno vojaško posredovanje. V sovjetsko-afganistanski vojni, ki je sledila, so protisovjetski afganistanski mudžahidi dobivali obsežno podporo Pakistana, Združenih držav in Saudove Arabije v skupni tajni akciji z imenom operacija Ciklon.

source.title: Afghan conflict
paragraphs: The Afghan conflict (Pashto: دافغانستان جنګونه; Farsi/Dari: درگیری افغانستان) is the series of events that have kept Afghanistan in a near-continuous state of armed conflict since the 1970s. Early instability followed the collapse of the Kingdom of Afghanistan in the largely non-violent 1973 coup d'état, which deposed Afghan monarch Mohammad Zahir Shah in absentia, ending his 40-year-long reign. With the concurrent establishment of the Republic of Afghanistan, headed by Mohammad Daoud Khan, the country's relatively peaceful and stable period in modern history came to an end. However, all-out fighting did not erupt until after 1978, when the Saur Revolution violently overthrew Khan's government and established the Democratic Republic of Afghanistan. Subsequent unrest over the radical reforms that were being pushed by the then-ruling People's Democratic Party of Afghanistan (PDPA) led to unprecedented violence, prompting a large-scale pro-PDPA military intervention by the Soviet Union in 1979. In the ensuing Soviet–Afghan War, the anti-Soviet Afghan mujahideen received extensive support from Pakistan, the United States, and Saudi Arabia in a joint covert effort that was dubbed Operation Cyclone.

Afghan–Sikh Wars.headline: Afganistansko-sikhovske vojne
paragraphs: Afganistansko-sikhovske vojne so na Indijski podcelini potekale od leta 1748 do 1837 in so obsegale več faz bojev med Duranskim imperijem in Sikhovskim imperijem (ter njegovimi predhodniki), predvsem v Pandžabu in okolici. Spopad je izviral iz časov Dal Khalse in se nadaljeval tudi potem, ko je Duranski imperij nasledil Kabulski emirat.

source.title: Afghan–Sikh Wars
paragraphs: The Afghan–Sikh Wars spanned from 1748 to 1837 in the Indian subcontinent, and saw multiple phases of fighting between the Durrani Empire and the Sikh Empire (and its predecessors), mainly in and around Punjab region. The conflict's origins stemmed from the days of the Dal Khalsa, and continued after the Emirate of Kabul succeeded the Durrani Empire.

Ahmednagarski sultanat je bil zgodnjenovoveški sultanat na severozahodu Dekana, ki mu je vladala dinastija Nizam Šahi. Eden od petih dekanskih sultanatov je leta 1490 ustanovil Ahmad Nizam Šah I., sin Malika Hasana Bahrija, ki je bil kulkarnijskega porekla iz Pathrija v Marathvadi.

Malik Ahmad je po službi upravitelja Bida in drugih okrožij razglasil neodvisnost od Bahmanskega sultanata in ustanovil Ahmednagarski sultanat. Prestolnica je bila sprva v mestu Džunnar s trdnjavo, pozneje preimenovano v Šivneri. Leta 1494 so položili temelje za novo prestolnico Ahmednagar. Sedež sultanata je bila kopenska trdnjava Ahmednagar. Sultanat je ležal med Gudžaratskim in Bidžapurskim sultanatom.

source.title: Ahmadnagar Sultanate
paragraphs: The Ahmadnagar Sultanate was an early modern sultanate located in the northwestern Deccan, ruled by the Nizam Shahi dynasty. One of the five Deccan sultanates, it was established by Ahmad Nizam Shah I in 1490; Nizam Shah I was the son of Malik Hasan Bahri who was of Kulkarni origin from Pathri in Marathwada.

After serving as governor of Beed and other districts, Malik Ahmad declared independence from the Bahmani Sultanate and established Ahmadnagar Sultanate. Initially the capital was in the town of Junnar with its fort, later renamed Shivneri. In 1494, the foundation was laid for the new capital Ahmednagar. A land fort called Ahmednagar Fort was the headquarters of the Ahmednagar Sultanate. It was situated between the sultanates of Gujarat and Bijapur.

American drone strikes in Pakistan.headline: Ameriški napadi z droni v Pakistanu
paragraphs: Med letoma 2004 in 2018 je vlada Združenih držav med vojno proti terorizmu napadla na tisoče ciljev na severozahodu Pakistana z brezpilotnimi letalniki (droni), ki jih je upravljalo ameriško vojno letalstvo pod operativnim nadzorom oddelka za posebne dejavnosti Cie. Večina napadov je bila uperjena v cilje na zvezno upravljanih plemenskih območjih (danes del province Hajber Pahtunhva) ob afganistanski meji na severozahodu Pakistana.

Napadi so se začeli v času predsednika Georgea W. Busha in so se pod njegovim naslednikom Barackom Obamo močno okrepili. Nekateri mediji so jih imenovali »vojna z droni«. Busheva administracija je obseg te politike uradno zanikala; maja 2013 je Obamova administracija prvič priznala, da so v napadih umrli štirje ameriški državljani.

source.title: American drone strikes in Pakistan
paragraphs: Between 2004 and 2018, the United States government attacked thousands of targets in northwest Pakistan using unmanned aerial vehicles (drones) operated by the United States Air Force under the operational control of the Central Intelligence Agency's Special Activities Division during the war on terror. Most of these attacks were on targets in the Federally Administered Tribal Areas (now part of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province) along the Afghan border in northwest Pakistan.

These strikes began during the administration of United States President George W. Bush, and increased substantially under his successor Barack Obama. Some in the media referred to the attacks as a "drone war". The George W. Bush administration officially denied the extent of its policy; in May 2013, the Obama administration acknowledged for the first time that four US citizens had been killed in the strikes.

Anarchy of the 12 Warlords.headline: Anarhija dvanajstih vojskovodij
paragraphs: Anarhija 12 vojskovodij (vietnamsko: Loạn 12 sứ quân; chữ Nôm: 亂𨑮𠄩使君; sinovietnamsko: Thập nhị sứ quân chi loạn; chữ Hán: 十二使君之亂), imenovana tudi obdobje 12 vojskovodij, obdobje kaosa in državljanske vojne v zgodovini Vietnama, je trajala od leta 965 do 968, povzročil pa jo je nasledstveni spor v dinastiji Ngô po smrti kralja Ngô Quyềna. Obdobje včasih imenujejo preprosto Dvanajst vojskovodij (vietnamsko: Mười hai sứ quân, 𨑮𠄩使君). Za štiri vojskovodje je potrjeno, da so izvirali z današnjega kitajskega ozemlja. Obdobje se je končalo leta 968 z vojno za združitev Vietnama, ki jo je vodil Đinh Bộ Lĩnh, poznejši ustanovitelj dinastije Đinh.

source.title: Anarchy of the 12 Warlords
paragraphs: The Anarchy of the 12 Warlords (Vietnamese: Loạn 12 sứ quân, chữ Nôm: 亂𨑮𠄩使君; Sino-Vietnamese: Thập nhị sứ quân chi loạn, chữ Hán: 十二使君之亂), also the Period of the 12 Warlords, was a period of chaos and civil war in the history of Vietnam, from 965 to 968 caused by the succession of the Ngô dynasty after the death of King Ngô Quyền. This period is also sometimes simply called the Twelve Warlords (Vietnamese: Mười hai sứ quân, 𨑮𠄩使君). Four of the warlords are verified to have traced their direct lineage from what is now China today. This period ended in 968 with the unification war of Vietnam by Đinh Bộ Lĩnh, who later established the Đinh dynasty.

Anga.headline: Anga
paragraphs: Anga je bilo starodavno indoarijsko pleme vzhodne Južne Azije, katerega obstoj je izpričan v železni dobi. Pripadnike plemena Anga so imenovali Angeje.
Anga, ki jo budistična besedila, kot je Anguttara Nikaja, štejejo med »šestnajst velikih narodov«, se pojavlja tudi na seznamu starih džanapad v džainski Vjakhjapradžnapti.

source.title: Anga
paragraphs: Anga was an ancient Indo-Aryan tribe of eastern South Asia whose existence is attested during the Iron Age. The members of the Aṅga tribe were called the Āṅgeyas.
Counted among the "sixteen great nations" in Buddhist texts like the Anguttara Nikaya, Aṅga also finds mention in the Jain Vyakhyaprajnapti's list of ancient janapadas.

Anglo-Afghan Treaty of 1919.headline: Mir v Ravalpindiju
paragraphs: Angleško-afganistanska pogodba iz leta 1919, znana tudi kot mir v Ravalpindiju, je bila dvostranska pogodba, s katero se je končala tretja angleško-afganistanska vojna. Velja za največjo mirovno pogodbo po Versajski mirovni pogodbi, sklenjeni istega leta.

source.title: Anglo-Afghan Treaty of 1919
paragraphs: The Anglo-Afghan Treaty of 1919, also known as the Treaty of Rawalpindi, was a bilateral treaty which brought the Third Anglo-Afghan War to an end.This is regarded as the largest peace treaty since the Treaty of Versailles, which was enacted in the same year.

Anglo-Burmese Wars.headline: Angleško-burmanske vojne
paragraphs: Angleško-burmanske vojne, znane tudi kot indijsko-burmanske vojne, so bile oborožen spopad med dvema imperijema v vzponu, Britanskim imperijem in dinastijo Konbaung; postale so najdražja in najdaljša vojna Britanske Indije, saj so stale od 5 do 13 milijonov funtov (od 400 milijonov do 1,1 milijarde funtov po vrednosti iz leta 2019) in trajale več kot 60 let. Med letoma 1824 in 1885 so bile tri takšne vojne.

source.title: Anglo-Burmese Wars
paragraphs: The Anglo-Burmese Wars, also known as the Indo-Burmese Wars, were an armed conflict between two expanding empires, the British Empire and the Konbaung dynasty, that became British Indian Empire's most expensive and longest war, costing 5–13 million pounds sterling (£400 million – £1.1 billion as of 2019) and spanning over 60 years. There were three of these wars between 1824 and 1885.

Anglo-Mughal war (1686–1690).headline: Angleško-mogulska vojna (1686–1690)
paragraphs: Angleško-mogulska vojna, znana tudi kot Childova vojna, je bila prva angleško-indijska vojna na Indijski podcelini.

Angleška Vzhodnoindijska družba je od krone dobila monopol in številna utrjena oporišča na zahodni in jugovzhodni obali Mogulskega cesarstva, kar so dovolili krajevni upravitelji. Leta 1682 je družba poslala Williama Hedgesa na pogajanja z upraviteljem protoindustrializiranega subaha Bengal Šaisto kanom, da bi pridobil firman, cesarski odlok, ki bi angleški družbi zagotovil redne trgovske privilegije v vseh mogulskih provincah.

source.title: Anglo-Mughal war (1686–1690)
paragraphs: The Anglo-Mughal war, also known as the Child's War, was the first Anglo-Indian war on the Indian subcontinent.

The English East India Company had been given a monopoly and numerous fortified bases on the western and south-eastern coasts of the Mughal Empire by the Crown, which was permitted by the local governors. In 1682, William Hedges was sent on behalf of the Company to negotiate with the governor of the proto-industrialised Bengal Subah, Shaista Khan, and to obtain a firman, an imperial decree that would allow the English company regular trading privileges across the Mughal provinces.

Angleško-misorske vojne so bile vrsta štirih vojn v zadnjih treh desetletjih 18. stoletja med Misorskim sultanatom na eni strani ter britansko Vzhodnoindijsko družbo (ki jo je zastopala predvsem sosednja Madraška prezidentura), Marathskim imperijem, Kraljestvom Travankor in Hajderabadom na drugi. Hajdar Ali in njegov sin in naslednik Tipu Sultan sta se bojevala na štirih frontah: Britanci so napadali z zahoda, juga in vzhoda, nizamove sile pa s severa. Četrta vojna se je končala s strmoglavljenjem rodbine Hajdarja Alija in Tipuja (slednji je padel v četrti vojni leta 1799) in razkosanjem Misorja v korist Vzhodnoindijske družbe, ki je prevzela nadzor nad velikim delom Indijske podceline.

source.title: Anglo-Mysore wars
paragraphs: The Anglo-Mysore wars were a series of four wars fought during the last three decades of the 18th century between the Sultanate of Mysore on the one hand, and the British East India Company (represented chiefly by the neighbouring Madras Presidency), Maratha Empire, Kingdom of Travancore, and the Kingdom of Hyderabad on the other. Hyder Ali and his succeeding son Tipu Sultan fought the wars on four fronts: with the British attacking from the west, south and east and the Nizam's forces attacking from the north. The fourth war resulted in the overthrow of the house of Hyder Ali and Tipu (the latter was killed in the fourth war, in 1799), and the dismantlement of Mysore to the benefit of the East India Company, which took control of much of the Indian subcontinent.

Anuštegini ali dinastija Anuštegin (perzijsko: خاندان انوشتکین), znani tudi kot horezmijska dinastija (perzijsko: خوارزمشاهیان), so bili sunitska muslimanska dinastija turškega mameluškega porekla iz klana Bekdili oguških Turkov. Anuštegini so vladali Horezmijskemu cesarstvu, ki je obsegalo velik del današnje Srednje Azije, Afganistana in Irana, približno od leta 1077 do 1231, najprej kot vazali Seldžukov in Kara Kitajev (Zahodnega Ljaa), pozneje pa kot samostojni vladarji, vse do mongolske osvojitve Horezmijskega cesarstva v 13. stoletju.

Dinastijo je ustanovil poveljnik Anuštegin Garčaj, nekdanji turški suženj seldžuških sultanov, ki so ga imenovali za upravitelja Horezma. Njegov sin Kutb ad-Din Mohamed I. je postal prvi dedni horezmijski šah. Anuštegin je morda pripadal plemenu Begdili oguških Turkov ali pa Čigilom, Halajem, Kipčakom, Kanglijem ali Ujgurom.
notes: Izpuščen je prazen oklepaj (»English:«) iz vira.

source.title: Anushtegin dynasty
paragraphs: The Anushtegin dynasty or Anushteginids (English:, Persian: خاندان انوشتکین), also known as the Khwarazmian dynasty (Persian: خوارزمشاهیان) was a Sunni Muslim dynasty of Turkic mamluk origin from the Bekdili clan of the Oghuz Turks. The Anushteginid dynasty ruled the Khwarazmian Empire, consisting in large parts of present-day Central Asia, Afghanistan and Iran in the approximate period of 1077 to 1231, first as vassals of the Seljuks and the Qara Khitai (Western Liao), and later as independent rulers, up until the Mongol conquest of the Khwarazmian Empire in the 13th century.

The dynasty was founded by commander Anushtegin Gharchai, a former Turkic slave of the Seljuq sultans, who was appointed as governor of Khwarazm. His son, Qutb ad-Din Muhammad I, became the first hereditary Shah of Khwarazm. Anush Tigin may have belonged to either the Begdili tribe of the Oghuz Turks or to Chigil, Khalaj, Qipchaq, Qangly, or Uyghurs.

Armenian–Azerbaijani war (1918–1920).headline: Armensko-azerbajdžanska vojna (1918–1920)
paragraphs: Armensko-azerbajdžanska vojna (1918–1920) je bila spopad na južnem Kavkazu na območjih z mešanim armenskim in azerbajdžanskim prebivalstvom, ki v grobem obsegajo današnji Azerbajdžan in Armenijo. Začela se je v zadnjih mesecih prve svetovne vojne in se končala z vzpostavitvijo sovjetske oblasti.

Spopad je potekal v ozadju ruske državljanske vojne in delitve Osmanskega cesarstva. Medsebojne ozemeljske zahteve novoustanovljene Azerbajdžanske demokratične republike in Republike Armenije so privedle do tega, da sta državi podpirali azerbajdžanske oziroma armenske milice na spornih ozemljih. Armenija se je bojevala proti azerbajdžanskim milicam v Erivanski guberniji nekdanjega Ruskega imperija, Azerbajdžan pa se je upiral armenskim zahtevam po Karabahu. Vojno so zaznamovali izbruhi pokolov in etničnega čiščenja (denimo marčni dnevi, septembrski dnevi, pokol v Šuši in širše pokoli Azerbajdžancev v Armeniji), ki so spremenili demografsko sliko regije.

source.title: Armenian–Azerbaijani war (1918–1920)
paragraphs: The Armenian-Azerbaijani war (1918–1920) was a conflict that took place in the South Caucasus in regions with a mixed Armenian-Azerbaijani population, broadly encompassing what are now modern-day Azerbaijan and Armenia. It began during the final months of World War I and ended with the establishment of Soviet rule.

The conflict took place against the backdrop of the Russian Civil War and the partition of the Ottoman Empire. Mutual territorial claims, made by the newly formed Azerbaijan Democratic Republic and the Republic of Armenia, led to their respective support for Azerbaijani and Armenian militias in the disputed territories. Armenia fought against Azerbaijani militias in the Erivan Governorate of the former Russian Empire, while Azerbaijan fought Armenian claims to the Karabakh region. The war was characterized by outbreaks of massacres and ethnic cleansing (such as the March Days, the September Days, the Shusha massacre, and more broadly, the massacres of Azerbaijanis in Armenia), which changed the demographics of the region.

Armeno-Georgian War.headline: Armensko-gruzijska vojna
paragraphs: Armensko-gruzijska vojna je bila kratek mejni spor, ki se je decembra 1918 bil med novo neodvisno Demokratično republiko Gruzijo in Prvo republiko Armenijo, predvsem za nadzor nad nekdanjimi okraji Tifliške gubernije v Borčaliju (Loriju) in Ahalkalakiju.

Maja 1918, proti koncu prve svetovne vojne, sta Armenija in Gruzija razglasili neodvisnost in s tem razpustili kratkotrajno zvezo med njima. Obe sta zahtevali Lori in Ahalkalaki, kjer so živeli pretežno Armenci. Mejni spor je 7. decembra 1918 prerasel v odprt vojaški spopad. Armenske sile so z bliskovitimi napadi prodrle do 10 kilometrov od gruzijske prestolnice Tiflis, preden so gruzijske čete lahko organizirale protinapade. Posredovanje zaveznikov je izsililo premirje. Boji so trajali, dokler premirje ni začelo veljati ob polnoči 31. decembra.

source.title: Armeno-Georgian War
paragraphs: The Armeno-Georgian War was a short border dispute that was fought in December 1918 between the newly independent Democratic Republic of Georgia and the First Republic of Armenia, largely over the control of former districts of the Tiflis Governorate, in Borchaly (Lori) and Akhalkalaki.

In May 1918, towards the end of World War I, Armenia and Georgia both declared their independence, dissolving the short-lived union between them. Both Georgia and Armenia claimed Lori and Akhalkalaki, both of which were populated primarily by Armenians. The border dispute turned into an open military conflict on 7 December 1918. Armenian forces initiated coup de mains that brought them within 10 kilometers of the Georgian capital, Tiflis, before Georgian troops were able to organize counterattacks. Allied intervention forced a ceasefire. Battles continued until the ceasefire came into effect at midnight on December 31.

ASEAN Declaration.headline: Deklaracija ASEAN
paragraphs: Deklaracija ASEAN, splošno znana kot bangkoška deklaracija, je ustanovna listina Združenja držav jugovzhodne Azije (ASEAN). Podpisali so jo 8. avgusta 1967 v tajski prestolnici Bangkok zunanji ministri Indonezije, Malezije, Filipinov, Singapurja in Tajske; z njo so formalno ustanovili združenje, da bi spodbujalo regionalno sodelovanje na gospodarskem, družbenem, kulturnem, tehničnem in upravnem področju ter krepilo regionalni mir in stabilnost s spoštovanjem Ustanovne listine Združenih narodov in pravne države.

Deklaracija določa temeljna načela suverene enakosti, nevmešavanja in odločanja s soglasjem (musjavarah) med članicami. Čeprav je nastala med hladno vojno v strahu pred širjenjem komunizma, njeno besedilo opazno ne omenja nobenih ideoloških ali vojaških zavezništev. Dan podpisa danes vsako leto praznujejo po vsej Jugovzhodni Aziji kot dan ASEAN.

source.title: ASEAN Declaration
paragraphs: The ASEAN Declaration, commonly known as the Bangkok Declaration, is the founding charter of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN). Signed on 8 August 1967 by the foreign ministers of Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines, Singapore, and Thailand in Bangkok, the capital city of Thailand, it formally established the Association to promote regional cooperation in economic, social, cultural, technical, and administrative fields, and to foster regional peace and stability through adherence to the United Nations Charter and the rule of law.

The Declaration states the basic principles of sovereign equality, non‑interference, and consensus-based decision-making (known as Musyawarah) among members. Although conceived during the Cold War amid concerns over communist expansion, its text notably omits any direct reference to ideological or military alliances. The date of its signing is now commemorated annually as ASEAN Day throughout Southeast Asia.

Ašmaka ali Asaka je bila mahadžanapada v stari Indiji, ki je po budističnih besedilih in puranah obstajala med letom 700 pr. n. št. in letom 425 ali 345 pr. n. št. Obsegala je območja današnjih zveznih držav Telangana in Maharaštra v južni osrednji Indiji. V času Bude Gautame so mnogi Asake živeli ob reki Godavari (južno od gorovja Vindhja). Prestolnica Ašmake je bilo mesto, ki ga viri imenujejo Podana, Potali, Paudanjapura in Potana; večina raziskovalcev ga enači z današnjim Bodhanom v Telangani.
V 6. stoletju pr. n. št. je bilo v stari Indiji šestnajst mahadžanapad. Med njimi je bila Ašmaka (ali Asaka) edina v južni Indiji.

source.title: Asmaka
paragraphs: Aśmaka or Assaka was a Mahajanapada in ancient India which existed between 700 BCE and 425 or 345 BCE according to the Buddhist texts and Puranas. It included areas in present day Telangana and Maharashtra in south-central India. In Gautama Buddha's time, many of the Assakas were located on the banks of the Godavari River (south of the Vindhya mountains).The capital of Aśmaka was the city variously named Podana, Potali, Paudanyapura, and Potana. Most scholars identify it with present-day Bodhan in Telangana.
In ancient India, during the 6th century BCE, there were sixteen Mahajanapadas. Among them, Ashmaka (or Assaka) was the only Mahajanapada located in South India.

Âu Lạc.headline: Âu Lạc
paragraphs: Âu Lạc (chữ Hán: 甌貉 ali 甌駱) je bila domnevna državna tvorba, ki je obsegala dele današnjega Guangšija in severnega Vietnama. Leta 257 pr. n. št. jo je ustanovil Thục Phán (kralj An Dương) z združitvijo Nam Cươnga (Âu Việt) in Văn Langa (Lạc Việt), leta 179 pr. n. št. pa je podlegla državi Nanjue, ki jo je pozneje osvojila dinastija Han. Po drugih zgodovinskih virih je obstajala od leta 257 do 208 pr. n. št. ali od leta 208 do 179 pr. n. št. Njena prestolnica je bila Cổ Loa v današnjem Hanoju v delti Rdeče reke.
notes: Izpuščeni so zapisi v pinjinu in po Wade-Gilesu ter rekonstrukciji v srednji in stari kitajščini.

source.title: Âu Lạc
paragraphs: Âu Lạc (chữ Hán: 甌貉 or 甌駱; pinyin: Ōu Luò; Wade–Giles: Wu1-lo4 Middle Chinese (ZS): *ʔəu-*lɑk̚ < Old Chinese *ʔô-râk) was a supposed polity that covered parts of modern-day Guangxi and northern Vietnam. Founded in 257 BCE by a figure called Thục Phán (King An Dương), it was a merger of Nam Cương (Âu Việt) and Văn Lang (Lạc Việt) but succumbed to the state of Nanyue in 179 BCE, which, itself was finally conquered by the Han dynasty. Other historical sources indicate that it existed from 257 BC to 208 BC or from 208 BC to 179 BC. Its capital was in Cổ Loa, present-day Hanoi, in the Red River Delta.

August Revolution.headline: Avgustovska revolucija
paragraphs: Avgustovska revolucija (vietnamsko: Cách mạng tháng Tám), tedaj znana kot splošna vstaja (vietnamsko: Tổng khởi nghĩa cướp chính quyền, dobesedno »vsesplošna vstaja za prevzem oblasti«), je bila revolucija, ki jo je od 16. do 30. avgusta 1945 vodil Viet Minh proti japonski okupaciji Vietnama in Vietnamskemu cesarstvu. Vietnamsko cesarstvo je vodila dinastija Nguyễn, podpirala pa ga je Japonska.

Viet Minh, ustanovljen leta 1941, je deloval kot protiimperialistična fronta pod vodstvom Indokitajske komunistične partije in je okoli cilja vietnamske neodvisnosti združil široko podporo prek političnih delitev. V revoluciji so sodelovale tudi frakcije, ki niso sledile Viet Minhu.

source.title: August Revolution
paragraphs: The August Revolution (Vietnamese: Cách mạng tháng Tám), at the time known as the General Uprising (Vietnamese: Tổng khởi nghĩa cướp chính quyền, lit. 'Total uprising to seize power'), was a revolution led by the Viet Minh against the Japanese occupation of Vietnam and the Empire of Vietnam from 16 to 30 August 1945. The Empire of Vietnam was led by the Nguyễn dynasty and was backed by Japan.

Created in 1941, the Viet Minh functioned as an anti-imperialist front led by the Indochinese Communist Party, rallying wide public support across political lines around the goal of Vietnamese independence. The revolution had the participation of factions that did not follow the Viet Minh.

Avanti (region).headline: Avanti
paragraphs: Avanti je bila starodavna indijska mahadžanapada (velika džanapada), ki je približno ustrezala današnji pokrajini Malva. Po budističnih besedilih, Anguttara Nikaji, je bila Avanti ena od solasa mahadžanapad (šestnajstih velikih kraljestev) iz 6. stoletja pr. n. št. Gorovje Vindhja je džanapado delilo na dva dela: severni je imel prestolnico v Udžajiniju, južni pa središče v Mahišmatiju.

Avantije, starodavno ljudstvo tega kraljestva, Mahabharata v Udjoga Parvi (19.24) opisuje kot mahavala (zelo mogočne). Po Višnu Purani (II.3), Bhagavata Purani (XII.I.36) in Brahma Purani (XIX.17) so bili Avantiji povezani z Malavami, Sauraštrami, Abhirami oziroma Jadavami, Surami, Karušami in Arbudami in so živeli ob gorovju Parijatra (ali Paripatra), zahodnem kraku Vindhje.

source.title: Avanti (region)
paragraphs: Avanti was an ancient Indian Mahajanapada (Great Janapada), roughly corresponding to the present-day Malwa region. According to the Buddhist texts, the Anguttara Nikaya, Avanti was one of the solasa mahajanapadas (sixteen great realms) of the 6th century BCE. The janapada was divided into two parts by the Vindhyas, the northern part had its capital at Ujjayini and the southern part had its centre at Mahishmati.

The Avantis, the ancient people belonging to this realm, were described as mahavala (very powerful) in the Udyoga Parva (19.24) of the Mahabharata. According to the Vishnu Purana (II.3), the Bhagavata Purana (XII.I.36) and the Brahma Purana (XIX.17), the Avantis were associated with the Malava, the Saurashtras, the Abhiras/Yadavas, the Suras, the Karushas and the Arbudas and were described as dwelling along the Pariyatra (or Paripatra) mountains (a western branch of the Vindhyas).

Bahmansko kraljestvo ali Bahmanski sultanat je bil poznosrednjeveško perzijsko obarvano kraljestvo, ki je vladalo Dekanski planoti v Indiji. Prvi samostojni muslimanski sultanat v Dekanu je prišel na oblast leta 1347 med uporom Ismaila Mukha proti delhijskemu sultanu Mohamedu bin Tughlaku. Ismail Mukh se je nato odpovedal oblasti v korist Zafarja kana, ki je ustanovil Bahmanski sultanat.

source.title: Bahmani Kingdom
paragraphs: The Bahmani Kingdom, or the Bahmani Sultanate, was a late medieval Persianate kingdom that ruled the Deccan Plateau in India. The first independent Muslim sultanate of the Deccan, the Bahmani Kingdom came to power in 1347 during the rebellion of Ismail Mukh against Muhammad bin Tughlaq, the Sultan of Delhi. Ismail Mukh then abdicated in favour of Zafar Khan, who established the Bahmani Sultanate.

Balasagan.headline: Balasagan
paragraphs: Balasagan (iranski toponim, ki pomeni »dežela Balasa«; armensko: Bałasakan, prebivalci Bałasičkʻ; arabsko: Balāsajān/Balāšajān), znan tudi kot Bazgan, je bil pokrajina na območju rek Kura in Araks ob Kaspijskem jezeru. Na jugu je mejil na Atropateno oziroma Adurbadagan in Gilan. Približno se je ujemal z armensko provinco Pajtakaran, vendar je segal dlje proti severu. Po nekaterih domnevah se je pod Sasanidi raztezal vse do trdnjave Derbent, kar pa ostaja sporno. Osrčje Balasagana je bila ravnina Dašt i-Bałasakan (»Balasaganska ravnina«), ki ustreza Muganski ravnini. V poznem sasanidskem obdobju je bil Balasagan vključen v severni kvadrant (kust) Adurbadagana.

source.title: Balasagan
paragraphs: Balāsagān (an Iranian toponym meaning "country of Balas"; Armenian: Bałasakan, the inhabitants known as Bałasičkʻ, Arabic: Balāsajān/Balāšajān), also known as Bazgan, was a region located in the area of the Kura and Aras rivers, adjacent to the Caspian Sea. To the south, it bordered Atropatene/Adurbadagan and Gilan. It roughly corresponded to the Armenian province of Paytakaran, albeit extending farther into the north. It has been suggested that under the Sasanians the region extended as far as the stronghold of Derbent, albeit this remains disputed. The heartland of Balasagan was the Dasht i-Bałasakan ("Balasagan plain") which corresponds to the Mughan plain. During the late Sasanian era, Balasagan was included in the northern quadrant (kust) of Adurbadagan.

Bangladeška osvobodilna vojna (bengalsko: মুক্তিযুদ্ধ), znana tudi kot bangladeška vojna za neodvisnost, je bila oborožen spopad, ki ga je sprožil vzpon bengalskega nacionalističnega gibanja za samoodločbo v Vzhodnem Pakistanu in ki se je s pomočjo Indije končal z neodvisnostjo Bangladeša. Vojna se je začela, ko je pakistanska vojaška hunta s sedežem v Zahodnem Pakistanu po ukazu Jahje kana v noči na 25. marec 1971 sprožila operacijo Searchlight proti Vzhodnim Pakistancem in s tem začela bangladeški genocid.
notes: Izpuščena je izgovarjava (IPA).

source.title: Bangladesh Liberation War
paragraphs: The Bangladesh Liberation War (Bengali: মুক্তিযুদ্ধ, pronounced [mukt̪iɟud̪d̪ʱo]), also known as the Bangladesh War of Independence, was an armed conflict sparked by the rise of the Bengali nationalist and self-determination movement in East Pakistan, which resulted in the independence of Bangladesh with the help of India. The war began when the Pakistani military junta based in West Pakistan—under the orders of Yahya Khan—launched Operation Searchlight against East Pakistanis on the night of 25 March 1971, initiating the Bangladesh genocide.

Basmačijsko gibanje (rusko: Басмачество, iz uzbeškega Босмачи, dobesedno »razbojniki«) je bilo uporniško gibanje proti carski ruski in sovjetski oblasti v Srednji Aziji. Označili so ga za »verjetno najpomembnejše gibanje upora proti sovjetski oblasti v Srednji Aziji«.
notes: Izpuščeni sta latinični transliteraciji ruskega in uzbeškega imena.

source.title: Basmachi movement
paragraphs: The Basmachi movement (Russian: Басмачество, romanized: Basmachestvo, derived from Uzbek: Босмачи, romanized: Bosmachi, lit. 'bandits') was an uprising against Imperial Russian and Soviet rule in Central Asia. It has been called "probably the most important movement of opposition to Soviet rule in Central Asia".

Battle for Hill 3234.headline: Bitka za višino 3234
paragraphs: Bitka za višino 3234 (rusko: Бой у высоты 3234) je bila uspešna napadalna bitka, ki jo je v začetku januarja 1988 v Afganistanu v okviru operacije Magistral bila 9. četa 345. samostojnega gardnega padalskega polka sovjetskih zračnoprevoznih enot ob podpori 15. tankovske brigade afganistanske vojske, 8., 11., 12., 214. in 25. pehotne divizije ter 37. komandosovskega bataljona proti približno 250 uporniškim mudžahidom, ki jih je podpiralo nekaj pakistanskih plačancev. Dva padla vojaka, Vjačeslav Aleksandrov in Andrej Melnikov, sta posmrtno prejela zlato zvezdo heroja Sovjetske zveze. Vsi padalci v tej bitki so prejeli red rdeče zastave in red rdeče zvezde.
notes: Izpuščena je latinična transliteracija ruskega imena.

source.title: Battle for Hill 3234
paragraphs: The Battle for Hill 3234 (Russian: Бой у высоты 3234, romanized: Boy u vysoty 3234) was a successful attack battle fought by the 9th Company of the 345th Independent Guards Airborne Regiment, Soviet Airborne Troops, part of Operation Magistral, supported by the Afghan Army's 15th Tank Brigade, 8th, 11th, 12th, 214th, 25th Infantry Division and the 37th Commando Battalion, in Afghanistan against a force of some 250 Mujahideen rebels who were supported by several Pakistani mercenaries in early January 1988. Two of the soldiers killed, Vyacheslav Aleksandrov and Andrey Melnikov, were posthumously awarded the Gold Star of the Hero of the Soviet Union. All of the paratroopers in this battle were given the Order of the Red Banner and Order of the Red Star.

Battle of Abaran.headline: Bitka pri Abaranu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Baš Abaranu (armensko: Բաշ Աբարանի ճակատամարտ; turško: Baş-Abaran Muharebesi) je bila del kavkaške fronte prve svetovne vojne in je potekala leta 1918 v okolici Baš Abarana. Armenske zmage pri Baš Abaranu, Sardarabadu in Karakilisi so ustavile osmansko invazijo na vzhodno Armenijo in odločilno omogočile nastanek kratkotrajne Prve republike Armenije.

Turške sile so napadle 21. maja in prodirale proti Erevanu. Nasproti so jim stale armenske sile pod poveljstvom Drastamata Kanajana. Eden od treh krakov osmanskega napada, 3. polk 11. kavkaške divizije, se je spustil iz Hamamluja. V soteski Baš Abaran, približno tri ure hoda od Erevana, je naletel na armensko enoto s približno 1000 strelci pod poveljstvom Movsesa Silikjana. Po treh dneh hudih bojev so Armenci 25. maja sprožili protinapad proti Turkom. Turške sile so se nato 29. maja umaknile na sever, nazaj v Hamamlu.
notes: Izpuščena je latinična transliteracija armenskega imena.

source.title: Battle of Abaran
paragraphs: The Battle of Bash Abaran (Armenian: Բաշ Աբարանի ճակատամարտ Bash Abarani chakatamart, Turkish: Baş-Abaran Muharebesi) was part of Caucasus Campaign of World War I that took place in the vicinity of Bash Abaran, in 1918. The Armenian victories at Bash Abaran, Sardarabad and Karakilisa, halted the Ottoman invasion of Eastern Armenia and were instrumental in allowing the formation of the short-lived First Republic of Armenia.

The Turkish forces attacked on 21 May, driving towards Yerevan. They were opposed by Armenian forces under the command of Drastamat Kanayan. One prong of the three-pronged Ottoman attack, consisting of the 3rd Regiment of the 11th Caucasian Division, moved down from Hamamlu. They met an Armenian force of about 1,000 riflemen under the command of Movses Silikyan at the defile of Bash Abaran, about a three-hour march from Yerevan. After three days of fierce fighting the Armenians launched a counter-attack against the Turks on 25 May. The Turkish forces then retreated north back to Hamamlu on 29 May.

Battle of Aliwal.headline: Bitka pri Alivalu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Alivalu se je 28. januarja 1846 bila med britanskimi in sikhovskimi silami v severni Indiji (danes Pandžab v Indiji). Britance je vodil sir Harry Smith, Sikhe pa Randžodh Singh Madžithija. Britanska zmaga v bitki včasih velja za prelomnico prve angleško-sikhovske vojne.

source.title: Battle of Aliwal
paragraphs: The Battle of Aliwal was fought on 28 January 1846 between the British and Sikh forces in northern India (now Punjab, India). The British were led by Sir Harry Smith, while the Sikhs were led by Ranjodh Singh Majithia. Britain's victory in the battle is sometimes regarded as the turning point in the First Anglo-Sikh War.

Bitka za Ap Bac (Ấp Bắc) je bila velika bitka vietnamske vojne, ki se je 2. januarja 1963 bila v provinci Định Tường v Južnem Vietnamu. Ameriška obveščevalna služba je 28. decembra 1962 v zaselku Tân Thới (vietnamsko: Ấp Tân Thới) v provinci Định Tường, kjer je imela sedež 7. pehotna divizija Vojske Republike Južni Vietnam (ARVN), odkrila radijski oddajnik in precejšnjo enoto vietkongovskih (VC) vojakov, ki naj bi jih bilo okoli 120. Južni Vietnamci in njihovi ameriški svetovalci so načrtovali, da bodo Ấp Tân Thới napadli s treh smeri in z dvema pokrajinskima bataljonoma civilne garde ter deli 11. pehotnega polka 7. pehotne divizije uničili enoto VC.
