Pehotne enote naj bi podpirali topništvo, oklepni transporterji M113 in helikopterji. Sile VC pa so velik napad južnovietnamske vlade pričakovale na podlagi različnih znamenj, med njimi premikov oskrbe, prikritega agenta VC in dešifriranih radijskih sporočil ARVN. Zato so se VC pripravili na napad ameriških in južnovietnamskih sil.

source.title: Battle of Ap Bac
paragraphs: The Battle of Ấp Bắc was a major battle fought on 2 January 1963 during the Vietnam War in Định Tường Province, South Vietnam. On 28 December 1962, US intelligence detected the presence of a radio transmitter along with a sizable force of Viet Cong (VC) soldiers, reported to number around 120, in the hamlet of Tân Thới (Vietnamese: Ấp Tân Thới) in Định Tường Province, home of the Army of the Republic of South Vietnam (ARVN) 7th Infantry Division. The South Vietnamese and their US advisers planned to attack Ấp Tân Thới from three directions to destroy the VC force by using two provincial Civil Guard battalions and elements of the 11th Infantry Regiment, 7th Infantry Division. The infantry units would be supported by artillery, M113 armored personnel carriers (APCs), and helicopters. However, VC forces anticipated a major attack from the South Vietnamese government from a variety of sources including movement of supplies, an undercover VC agent, and decoded radio communications from the ARVN. Accordingly, the VC prepared for an attack by US and South Vietnamese forces.

Battle of Assaye.headline: Bitka pri Assayu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Assayu se je 23. septembra 1803 bila med drugo angleško-marathsko vojno med Britanskim in Marathskim imperijem. Številčno šibkejša britanska vojska pod vodstvom generalmajorja Arthurja Wellesleyja je pri Assayu v zahodni Indiji porazila marathsko vojsko pod poveljstvom Daulatraa Scindie in Raghodžija II. Bhonsleja. Bitka je bila Wellesleyjeva prva velika zmaga in jo je pozneje označil za svoj največji dosežek na bojišču, še večji od slavnejših zmag v polotoški vojni in zmage nad Napoleonom v bitki pri Waterlooju.

source.title: Battle of Assaye
paragraphs: The Battle of Assaye was fought on 23 September 1803 during the Second Anglo-Maratha War between the British and Maratha empires. An outnumbered British army led by Major General Arthur Wellesley defeated a Maratha army under the command of Daulatrao Scindia and Raghoji II Bhonsle near Assaye in western India. The battle was Wellesley's first major victory and one he would later describe as his finest accomplishment on the battlefield, even more so than his more famous victories in the Peninsular War and his defeat of Napoleon at the Battle of Waterloo.

Battle of Bạch Đằng (1288).headline: Bitka na reki Bạch Đằng (1288)
paragraphs: Bitka na reki Bạch Đằng je bila odločilna pomorska bitka med tretjo mongolsko invazijo na Vietnam med Đại Việtom pod poveljstvom vrhovnega poveljnika princa Trần Quốc Tuấna (princa Hưng Đạa) in ladjevjem dinastije Juan pod poveljstvom admiralov Omarja in Fan Jija na reki Bạch Đằng (danes provinca Quảng Ninh), kjer je princ Hưng Đạo pripravil zasedo, uničil juansko ladjevje in zajel njegovega generala ter s tem končal Kublajeve načrte, da bi osvojil Đại Việt in Champo. Bitka je bila taktična mojstrovina, enakovredna prejšnji bitki na reki Bạch Đằng leta 938, in velja za eno največjih zmag v vietnamski vojaški zgodovini.

source.title: Battle of Bạch Đằng (1288)
paragraphs: The Battle of Bạch Đằng was a decisive naval battle during the third Mongol invasion of Vietnam between Đại Việt commanded by Commander-in-Chief Prince Trần Quốc Tuấn (Prince Hưng Đạo), and the fleet of the Yuan dynasty, commanded by Admirals Omar and Fan Yi on the Bạch Đằng River (today Quảng Ninh province), which Prince Hưng Đạo staged an ambush that destroyed the Yuan fleet, capturing its general, ending Kublai’s intention to conquer Dai Viet and Champa. The battle was a tactical masterpiece of the same stature as a previous battle of Bạch Đằng that occurred in 938 and is considered as one of the greatest victories in Vietnamese military history.

Battle of Bạch Đằng (938).headline: Bitka na reki Bạch Đằng (938)
paragraphs: V bitki na reki Bạch Đằng konec leta 938 blizu zaliva Hạ Long na severu Vietnama je vojska Tĩnh Hải quâna, ozemlja pod vietnamsko oblastjo, pod vodstvom vietnamskega gospoda Ngô Quyềna porazila vdirajoče sile kitajske države Južni Han in končala tretje obdobje severne nadvlade (kitajske vladavine nad Vietnamom). Bitka velja za prelomnico vietnamske zgodovine.

source.title: Battle of Bạch Đằng (938)
paragraphs: At the Battle of Bạch Đằng River in late 938 near Hạ Long Bay in northern Vietnam, the military force of the Viet-ruled domain of Tĩnh Hải quân, led by Ngô Quyền, a Viet lord, defeated the invading forces of the Chinese state of Southern Han and put an end to the Third Era of Northern Domination (Chinese ruled Vietnam). It was considered the turning point in Vietnamese history.

Battle of Baku.headline: Bitka za Baku
paragraphs: Bitka za Baku (azerbajdžansko: Bakı döyüşü, turško: Bakü Muharebesi, rusko: Битва за Баку) je potekala avgusta in septembra 1918 med osmansko-azerbajdžanskimi koalicijskimi silami pod vodstvom Nuri paše in silami Bakujskega sovjeta, ki so ga sestavljali boljševiki in Armenska revolucionarna federacija, nasledile pa so jih britansko-armensko-belogardistične sile pod vodstvom Lionela Dunstervilla; v bitki je Sovjetska Rusija za kratek čas znova vstopila v vojno. Bitka je potekala med prvo svetovno vojno in je bila sklepni del kavkaške fronte, a hkrati začetek armensko-azerbajdžanske vojne.

source.title: Battle of Baku
paragraphs: The Battle of Baku (Azerbaijani: Bakı döyüşü, Turkish: Bakü Muharebesi, Russian: Битва за Баку) took place in August and September 1918 between the Ottoman–Azerbaijani coalition forces led by Nuri Pasha and Bolshevik–ARF Baku Soviet forces, later succeeded by the British–Armenian–White Russian forces led by Lionel Dunsterville, and saw Soviet Russia briefly re-enter the war. The battle took place during World War I, was a conclusive part of the Caucasus Campaign, but a beginning of the Armenian–Azerbaijani War.

Battle of Buxar.headline: Bitka pri Buksarju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Buksarju se je 22. in 23. oktobra 1764 bila med silami britanske Vzhodnoindijske družbe (EIC) pod poveljstvom majorja Hectorja Munra ter združenimi vojskami mogulskega cesarja Šaha Alama II. in njegovih zaveznikov: bengalskega navaba Mir Kasima, benareškega maharadže Balvanta Singha ter Šudža ud-Daule, navaba Avadha in cesarjevega velikega vezirja.

Bitka je potekala pri Buksarju, »močno utrjenem mestu« v Biharju na bregu Gangesa približno 130 kilometrov zahodno od Patne; za EIC je bila težko izbojevana zmaga. Poraženi indijski vladarji so se Vzhodnoindijski družbi podredili leta 1765.
notes: Izpuščena je pretvorba v milje.

source.title: Battle of Buxar
paragraphs: The Battle of Buxar was fought on 22-23 October 1764, between the forces of the British East India Company (EIC), under the command of Major Hector Munro, and the combined armies of Mughal Emperor Shah Alam II and his allies: Mir Qasim, Nawab of Bengal; Maharaja Balwant Singh of Benares; and Shuja-ud-Daula, the Nawab of Awadh and Grand Vizier to the Emperor.

The battle was fought at Buxar, a "strong fortified town" in Bihar, located on the banks of the Ganges river about 130 kilometres (81 mi) west of Patna; it was a challenging victory for the EIC. The defeated Indian rulers submitted to the EIC in 1765.

Battle of Cannanore (1506).headline: Bitka pri Kannanurju (1506)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Kannanurju se je leta 1506 bila pred pristaniščem Kannanur v Indiji med indijskim ladjevjem zamorina iz Kalikata in portugalskim ladjevjem pod poveljstvom Lourença de Almeide, sina podkralja Almeide.

Indijsko ladjevje s približno 200 ladjami, opremljenimi s topovi, izdelanimi s pomočjo dveh Italijanov iz Milana, so sestavljale hindujske, arabske in turške posadke. Spopad se je končal s portugalsko zmago. Sledil mu je še en portugalski uspeh pri obleganju Kannanurja leta 1507, nato pa portugalski poraz v bitki pri Čaulu leta 1508.

source.title: Battle of Cannanore (1506)
paragraphs: The Battle of Cannanore took place in 1506 off the harbour of Cannanore in India, between the Indian fleet of the Zamorin of Calicut and a Portuguese fleet under Lourenço de Almeida, son of the Viceroy Almeida.

The Indian fleet, consisting of about 200 ships equipped with cannons manufactured with the help of two Milanese Italians, was manned by Hindu, Arab, and Turkish crews. This encounter ended in a Portuguese victory. It was followed by another Portuguese success at the siege of Cannanore in 1507, but then a Portuguese defeat at the Battle of Chaul in 1508.

Battle of Chaul.headline: Bitka pri Čaulu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Čaulu je bila pomorska bitka med portugalskim in egiptovskim mameluškim ladjevjem leta 1508 v pristanišču Čaul v Indiji. Končala se je z mameluško zmago. Sledila je obleganju Kannanurja, v katerem je portugalska posadka uspešno odbila napad južnoindijskih vladarjev. Bil je prvi portugalski poraz na morju v Indijskem oceanu.

source.title: Battle of Chaul
paragraphs: The Battle of Chaul was a naval battle between the Portuguese and the Egyptian Mamluk fleets in 1508 in the harbour of Chaul in India. The battle ended in a Mamluk victory. It followed the Siege of Cannanore in which a Portuguese garrison successfully resisted an attack by southern Indian rulers. This was the first Portuguese defeat at sea in the Indian Ocean.

Battle of Dak To.headline: Bitka pri Dak Toju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Dak Toju (vietnamsko: Chiến dịch Đắk Tô - Tân Cảnh) v Vietnamu je bila vrsta velikih spopadov vietnamske vojne, ki so potekali od 3. do 23. novembra 1967 v provinci Kontum v Osrednjem višavju Republike Vietnam (Južnega Vietnama). Spopad pri Đắk Tôju je bil ena od ofenzivnih pobud Vietnamske ljudske armade (PAVN), ki so se začele v drugi polovici leta. Napadi PAVN pri Lộc Ninhu (v provinci Bình Long), Sông Béju (v provinci Phước Long) ter pri Con Thienu in Khe Sanhu (v provinci Quảng Trị) so bili druge akcije, ki so skupaj z Đắk Tôjem postale znane kot »mejne bitke«. Naknadno navedeni cilj sil PAVN je bil odvrniti ameriške in južnovietnamske sile od mest proti mejam v pripravah na ofenzivo Tet.

source.title: Battle of Dak To
paragraphs: The Battle of Dak To (Vietnamese: Chiến dịch Đắk Tô - Tân Cảnh) in Vietnam was a series of major engagements of the Vietnam War that took place between 3 and 23 November 1967, in Kontum Province, in the Central Highlands of the Republic of Vietnam (South Vietnam). The action at Đắk Tô was one of a series of People's Army of Vietnam (PAVN) offensive initiatives that began during the second half of the year. PAVN attacks at Lộc Ninh (in Bình Long Province), Sông Bé (in Phước Long Province) and at Con Thien and Khe Sanh, (in Quảng Trị Province), were other actions which, combined with Đắk Tô, became known as "the border battles". The post hoc purported objective of the PAVN forces was to distract American and South Vietnamese forces away from cities towards the borders in preparation for the Tet Offensive.

Battle of Dandanaqan.headline: Bitka pri Dandanakanu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Dandanakanu (perzijsko: نبرد دندانقان) se je leta 1040 bila med seldžuškimi Turkmeni in Gaznavidi pri mestu Merv (danes v Turkmenistanu). Končala se je z odločilno seldžuško zmago, ki je nato strmoglavila gaznavidsko prevlado v Velikem Horasanu.

source.title: Battle of Dandanaqan
paragraphs: The Battle of Dandanaqan (Persian: نبرد دندانقان) was fought in 1040 between the Seljuq Turkmens and the Ghaznavid Empire near the city of Merv (now in Turkmenistan). The battle ended with a decisive Seljuq victory, which subsequently brought down the Ghaznavid domination in Greater Khorasan.

Bitka pri Didgorih (gruzijsko: დიდგორის ბრძოლა) se je 12. avgusta 1121 bila med vojskama Kraljestva Gruzije in Seldžuškega cesarstva v soteski Didgori, 40 km zahodno od Tbilisija. Velika muslimanska vojska pod poveljstvom Ilgazija se ni mogla razvrstiti in je zaradi učinkovite taktike kralja Davida IV. doživela uničujoč poraz.

Bitka pri Didgorih je bila vrhunec gruzijsko-seldžuških vojn in je Gruzijcem leta 1122 omogočila ponovno osvojitev Tbilisija. Kmalu zatem je David prestolnico preselil iz Kutaisija v Tbilisi. Zmaga pri Didgorih je začela srednjeveško gruzijsko zlato dobo, Gruzijske kronike pa jo slavijo kot »čudežno zmago« (gruzijsko: ძლევაჲ საკვირველი). Današnji Gruzijci se dogodka vsako leto 12. avgusta spominjajo s praznikom Didgoroba (»[dan] Didgorov«).
notes: Izpuščeni so latinični zapisi gruzijskih imen.

source.title: Battle of Didgori
paragraphs: The Battle of Didgori (Georgian: დიდგორის ბრძოლა, romanized: didgoris brdzola) was fought between the armies of the Kingdom of Georgia and the Seljuk Empire at the narrow place of Didgori, 40 km west of Tbilisi, on August 12, 1121. The large Muslim army, under the command of Ilghazi, was unable to maneuver and suffered a devastating defeat due to King David IV's effective military tactics.

The battle at Didgori was the culmination of the entire Georgian–Seljuk wars and led to the Georgians' reconquest of Tbilisi in 1122. Soon after that David moved the capital from Kutaisi to Tbilisi. The victory at Didgori inaugurated the medieval Georgian Golden Age and is celebrated in The Georgian Chronicles as a (Georgian: ძლევაჲ საკვირველი dzlevay sak'virveli lit. 'miraculous victory'). Modern Georgians continue to remember the event as an annual August 12 festival known as Didgoroba ('[the day] of Didgori').

Battle of Geok Tepe.headline: Bitka pri Geok Tepeju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Geok Tepeju leta 1881 je bila osrednji dogodek ruskega pohoda 1880/81, s katerim so Rusi hoteli podjarmiti turkmensko pleme Teke. Z njo je Ruski imperij dobil nadzor nad večino današnjega Turkmenistana in skoraj dokončal rusko osvojitev Srednje Azije.

Bitko imenujejo tudi Denghil-Tepe ali Dangil Teppe. Viri si niso enotni, vendar je bilo Denghil-Tepe najverjetneje ime utrdbe in hkrati majhnega griča ali gomile v njenem severozahodnem kotu. Geok Tepe (»Modri grič«) se po vsem sodeč nanaša na širše območje, današnje mesto, bližnjo vas in goro na jugu. Skrine piše, da je utrdba obsegala 2,6 kvadratnega kilometra ali več, z blatnimi zidovi, debelimi 5,5 m in na notranji strani visokimi 3 m, ter 1,2 m globokim suhim jarkom na zunanji strani, čeprav drugi navajajo drugačne mere. Območje je bilo del oaze Ahal, kjer potoki s Kopet Daga omogočajo namakalno poljedelstvo.
notes: Izpuščene so pretvorbe v kvadratne milje in čevlje.

source.title: Battle of Geok Tepe
paragraphs: The Battle of Geok Tepe in 1881 was the main event in the 1880/81 Russian campaign to conquer the Teke tribe of Turkmens. Its effect was to give the Russian Empire control over most of what is now Turkmenistan, thereby nearly completing the Russian conquest of Central Asia.

The battle is also called Denghil-Tepe or Dangil Teppe. Sources are inconsistent, but Denghil-Tepe seems to have been the name of the fort and also the name of a small hill or tumulus in the northwest corner of the fort. Geok Tepe ('Blue Hill') seems to refer to the general area, the modern town, a nearby village and a mountain to the south. Skrine says that fort enclosed 2.6 square kilometres (1 sq mi) or more, with mud walls 5.5 m (18 ft) thick and 3 m (10 ft) high on the inside and a 1.2 m (4 ft) dry ditch on the outside, although other dimensions are given. The area was part of the Akhal Oasis where streams coming down from the Kopet Dagh support irrigation agriculture.

Battle of Gol-Zarriun.headline: Bitka pri Gol-Zarriunu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Gol-Zarriunu, znana tudi kot bitka pri Buhari, je potekala okoli leta 563, ko sta se Sasanidsko cesarstvo in Prvi turški kaganat povezala proti Heftalitskemu cesarstvu.

source.title: Battle of Gol-Zarriun
paragraphs: The Battle of Gol-Zarriun, also known as Battle of Bukhara, took place around 563 when the Sasanian Empire and the First Turkic Khaganate allied with each other against the Hephthalite Empire.

Battle of Haldighati.headline: Bitka pri Haldighatiju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Haldighatiju se je 18. junija 1576 bila med mevarskimi silami pod vodstvom maharane Pratapa in mogulskimi silami pod vodstvom Man Singha I. iz Ambera. Mogulske sile so zmagale in mevarskim silam prizadejale velike izgube, vendar niso zajele Pratapa, ki se je na prigovarjanje svojih poveljnikov nerad umaknil.

Z obleganjem Čitorgarha leta 1568 so Moguli zavzeli rodovitni vzhodni pas Mevarja. Preostanek gozdnatega in hribovitega kraljestva pa je ostal pod nadzorom Sisodij. Akbar je hotel prek Mevarja zagotoviti stalno pot v Gudžarat; ko je bil Pratap Singh leta 1572 kronan za kralja (rano), mu je Akbar poslal več odposlancev, ki so ga rotili, naj postane vazal kot mnogi drugi radžputski voditelji v regiji. Pratap pa ni hotel skleniti pogodbe, kar je privedlo do bitke.

source.title: Battle of Haldighati
paragraphs: The battle of Haldighati was fought on 18 June 1576 between the Mewar forces led by Maharana Pratap, and the Mughal forces led by Man Singh I of Amber. The Mughals emerged victorious after inflicting significant casualties on Mewari forces, though they failed to capture Pratap, who reluctantly retreated persuaded by his fellow commanders.

The siege of Chittorgarh in 1568 had led to the loss of the fertile eastern belt of Mewar to the Mughals. However, the rest of the wooded and hilly kingdom was still under the control of the Sisodias. Akbar was intent on securing a stable route to Gujarat through Mewar; when Pratap Singh was crowned king (Rana) in 1572, Akbar sent a number of envoys entreating the Rana to become a vassal like many other Rajput leaders in the region. However, Pratap refused to enter into a treaty, which led to the battle.

Battle of Hamburger Hill.headline: Bitka za Hamburger Hill
paragraphs: Bitka za Hamburger Hill (13.–20. maja 1969) se je bila med silami kopenske vojske Združenih držav in Vojske Republike Vietnam (ARVN) na eni ter Vietnamske ljudske armade (PAVN) na drugi strani med operacijo Apache Snow v vietnamski vojni. Čeprav je imela močno utrjena višina 937, greben gore Dong Ap Bia v osrednjem Vietnamu blizu zahodne meje z Laosom, majhno strateško vrednost, je ameriško poveljstvo ukazalo, naj jo zavzamejo s čelnim napadom, kmalu zatem pa so jo opustili. Akcija je sprožila polemike v ameriških oboroženih silah in med javnostjo doma ter pomenila prelomnico ameriškega vpletanja v vojno.

Bitka je bila predvsem pehotni spopad, v katerem so ameriški vojaki napredovali po strmem pobočju proti dobro vkopanemu nasprotniku. Obramba PAVN je napade znova in znova odbila. Operacije je oviralo tudi slabo vreme. Kljub temu so padalci višino zavzeli z neposrednim napadom ob obsežni uporabi topništva in letalskih napadov, ki so silam PAVN prizadejali velike izgube.

source.title: Battle of Hamburger Hill
paragraphs: The Battle of Hamburger Hill (13–20 May 1969) was fought by United States Army (US Army) and Army of the Republic of Vietnam (ARVN) forces against People's Army of Vietnam (PAVN) forces during Operation Apache Snow of the Vietnam War. Though the heavily fortified Hill 937, a ridge of the mountain Dong Ap Bia in central Vietnam near its western border with Laos, had little strategic value, US command ordered its capture by a frontal assault, only to abandon it soon thereafter. The action caused a controversy among both the US armed services and the public back home, and marked a turning point in the US involvement.

The battle was primarily an infantry engagement, with the US troops moving up the steeply sloped hill against well-entrenched troops. Attacks were repeatedly repelled by the PAVN defenses. Bad weather also hindered operations. Nevertheless, the Airborne troops took the hill through direct assault with heavy use of artillery and airstrikes, causing extensive casualties to the PAVN forces.

Battle of Hanoi (1946).headline: Bitka za Hanoj (1946)
paragraphs: Vojaki Viet Minha so 19. decembra 1946 v Hanoju sprožili eksplozive, bitka, ki je sledila in je znana kot bitka za Hanoj, pa je pomenila začetek prve indokitajske vojne.

source.title: Battle of Hanoi (1946)
paragraphs: On December 19, 1946, Viet Minh soldiers detonated explosives in Hanoi, and the ensuing battle, known as the Battle of Hanoi marked the opening salvo of the First Indochina War.

Battle of Huế.headline: Bitka za Huế
paragraphs: Bitka za Huế (31. januar 1968 – 2. marec 1968) je bila velika bitka ofenzive Tet, ki sta jo med vietnamsko vojno sprožila Severni Vietnam in Vietkong. Združene sile Južnega Vietnama in Združenih držav so sprva izgubile nadzor nad večino mesta Huế in okolice, nato pa so ga po nekaj več kot mesecu hudih bojev postopoma znova zavzele. Bitka je bila ena najdaljših in najbolj krvavih v vojni in je negativno vplivala na to, kako je ameriška javnost dojemala vojno. Splošno velja za eno najtežjih in najsrditejših mestnih bitk ameriških oboroženih sil.

source.title: Battle of Huế
paragraphs: The Battle of Huế (31 January 1968 – 2 March 1968) was a major battle in the Tết Offensive launched by North Vietnam and the Việt Cộng during the Vietnam War. Initially losing control of most of Huế and its surroundings, the combined forces of South Vietnam and the United States gradually recaptured the city after a little over one month of intense fighting. The battle was one of the longest and bloodiest of the war, causing it to negatively affect the American public perception of the war. The battle is widely considered to be one of the toughest and most intense urban battles fought by the United States armed forces.

Battle of Ia Drang.headline: Bitka v dolini Ia Drang
paragraphs: Bitka v dolini Ia Drang (vietnamsko: Trận Ia Đrăng) je bila prva velika bitka med kopensko vojsko Združenih držav in Vietnamsko ljudsko armado (PAVN), del pohoda Pleiku na začetku vietnamske vojne, ob vzhodnem vznožju masiva Chu Pong v osrednjem višavju Vietnama leta 1965. Znana je kot prvi obsežen zračni desant s helikopterji in prva uporaba strateških bombnikov Boeing B-52 Stratofortress za taktično podporo. Ia Drang je postala vzorec vietnamske vojne: Američani so se zanašali na zračno mobilnost, topniški ogenj in neposredno letalsko podporo, PAVN pa je to ognjeno moč nevtralizirala tako, da se je z ameriškimi silami hitro spopadla iz neposredne bližine.
Bitka pri Ia Drangu je obsegala dva glavna spopada okoli dveh helikopterskih pristajališč (LZ), najprej LZ X-Ray, nato LZ Albany, severneje v dolini Ia Drang.
notes: Izpuščena je izgovarjava (IPA).

source.title: Battle of Ia Drang
paragraphs: The Battle of Ia Drang (Vietnamese: Trận Ia Đrăng, [iə̯ ɗrăŋ]; in English ) was the first major battle between the United States Army and the People's Army of Vietnam (PAVN), as part of the Pleiku campaign conducted early in the Vietnam War, at the eastern foot of the Chu Pong Massif in the central highlands of Vietnam, in 1965. It is notable for being the first large scale helicopter air assault and also the first use of Boeing B-52 Stratofortress strategic bombers in a tactical support role. Ia Drang set the blueprint for the Vietnam War with the Americans relying on air mobility, artillery fire and close air support, while the PAVN neutralized that firepower by quickly engaging American forces at very close range.
Ia Drang comprised two main engagements, centered on two helicopter landing zones (LZs), the first known as LZ X-Ray, followed by LZ Albany, farther north in the Ia Drang Valley.

Battle of Imphal.headline: Bitka za Imphal
paragraphs: Bitka za Imphal (meitejsko: Japan Laan, dobesedno »japonska invazija«), skupaj s Kohimo znana tudi kot »Stalingrad vzhoda«, je od marca do julija 1944 potekala na območju okoli Imphala, prestolnice zvezne države Manipur na severovzhodu Indije. Japonske armade so poskušale uničiti zavezniške sile pri Imphalu in vdreti v Indijo, vendar so se morale z velikimi izgubami umakniti nazaj v Burmo. Skupaj s hkratno bitko za Kohimo na cesti, po kateri so osvobodili obkoljene zavezniške sile pri Imphalu, je bila bitka prelomnica burmanskega pohoda, dela jugovzhodnoazijskega bojišča druge svetovne vojne. Japonski poraz pri Kohimi in Imphalu je bil največji do tedaj, pri čemer je veliko Japoncev umrlo zaradi lakote, bolezni in izčrpanosti med umikom.

source.title: Battle of Imphal
paragraphs: The Battle of Imphal (Meitei: Japan Laan, lit. 'Japanese invasion'), also known as the "Stalingrad of the East" in combination with Kohima, took place in the region around the city of Imphal, the capital of the state of Manipur in Northeast India from March until July 1944. Japanese armies attempted to destroy the Allied forces at Imphal and invade India, but were driven back into Burma with heavy losses. Together with the simultaneous Battle of Kohima on the road by which the encircled Allied forces at Imphal were relieved, the battle was the turning point of the Burma campaign, part of the South-East Asian theatre of World War II. The Japanese defeat at Kohima and Imphal was the largest up until that time, with many of the Japanese deaths resulting from starvation, disease and exhaustion suffered during their retreat.

Battle of Jaxartes.headline: Bitka ob Jaksartu
paragraphs: Bitka ob Jaksartu se je leta 329 pr. n. št. bila med Aleksandrom Velikim z njegovo helensko (grško) vojsko in Saki ob reki Jaksart, danes znani kot Sirdarja. Bojišče leži na stiku današnjih meja Uzbekistana, Tadžikistana, Kirgizistana in Kazahstana, jugozahodno od starodavnega mesta Taškent (današnje prestolnice Uzbekistana) in severovzhodno od Hudžanda (mesta v Tadžikistanu).

source.title: Battle of Jaxartes
paragraphs: The Battle of Jaxartes was fought in 329 BC by Alexander the Great and his Hellenic (Greek) army against the Saka at the River Jaxartes, now known as the Syr Darya River. The site of the battle straddles the modern borders of Uzbekistan, Tajikistan, Kyrgyzstan, and Kazakhstan, just south-west of the ancient city of Tashkent (the modern capital of Uzbekistan) and north-east of Khujand (a city in Tajikistan).

Battle of Kalbajar.headline: Bitka za Kalbadžar
paragraphs: Bitka za Kalbadžar je potekala marca in aprila 1993 med prvo vojno v Gorskem Karabahu. Končala se je tako, da so armenske vojaške sile zavzele azerbajdžanski okraj Kalbadžar.

Kalbadžar leži zunaj sporne enklave nekdanje Avtonomne pokrajine Gorski Karabah (NKAO). Z ofenzivo so armenske sile iz Gorskega Karabaha prvič prodrle čez meje enklave (če izvzamemo zavzetje Lačina leta 1992). Okraj Kalbadžar med Armenijo in zahodno mejo nekdanje NKAO je obsegal več deset vasi in okrajno središče, prav tako imenovano Kalbadžar. Armenska stran je napadla s štirih smeri, tudi iz same Armenije. Po začetnem hudem odporu se je azerbajdžanska obramba hitro sesula in okrajno središče je padlo 3. aprila 1993. Armenske sile so zavzele več kot 1900 kvadratnih kilometrov ozemlja in vzpostavile drugo kopensko povezavo med Armenijo in Gorskim Karabahom.

source.title: Battle of Kalbajar
paragraphs: The Battle of Kalbajar took place in March and April 1993, during the First Nagorno-Karabakh War. It resulted in the capture of the Kalbajar District of Azerbaijan by Armenian military forces.

Kalbajar lies outside the contested enclave of the former Nagorno-Karabakh Autonomous Oblast (NKAO). The offensive was the first time Armenian forces from Nagorno-Karabakh had advanced beyond the boundaries of the enclave (besides the capture of Lachin in 1992). Kalbajar District, located between Armenia and the western border of the former NKAO, was composed of several dozen villages and its provincial capital, also named Kalbajar. The Armenian side launched an attack from four directions, including Armenia proper. After initial heavy resistance, the Azerbaijani defence quickly collapsed and the provincial capital fell on April 3, 1993. Armenian forces captured an area of more than 1,900 square kilometres, establishing a second overland link between Armenia and Nagorno-Karabakh.

Battle of Kamdesh.headline: Bitka pri Kamdešu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Kamdešu je potekala med vojno v Afganistanu. Do nje je prišlo 3. oktobra 2009, ko je 300 talibanov napadlo ameriško bojno postojanko (COP) Keating pri mestu Kamdeš v provinci Nuristan na vzhodu Afganistana. Napad je bil za ameriške sile najbolj krvava bitka po bitki pri Vanatu julija 2008, ki je potekala 32 km od Kamdeša. V napadu na postojanko Keating je umrlo 8 Američanov, 27 jih je bilo ranjenih, talibani pa so imeli od 150 do 200 ranjenih ali mrtvih.
notes: Izpuščena je navedba v miljah.

source.title: Battle of Kamdesh
paragraphs: The Battle of Kamdesh took place during the War in Afghanistan. It occurred on October 3, 2009, when a force of 300 Taliban assaulted the American Combat Outpost ("COP") Keating near the town of Kamdesh in Nuristan Province in eastern Afghanistan. The attack was the bloodiest battle for US forces since the Battle of Wanat in July 2008, which occurred 20 miles (32 km) away from Kamdesh. The attack on COP Keating resulted in 8 Americans killed and 27 wounded while the Taliban suffered 150–200 wounded or killed.

Battle of Karakilisa.headline: Bitka pri Karakilisi
paragraphs: Bitka pri Karakilisi (armensko: Ղարաքիլիսայի ճակատամարտ; turško: Karakilise Muharebesi ali Karakilise Muharebeleri) je potekala od 25. do 28. maja 1918 na kavkaški fronti prve svetovne vojne v okolici Karakilise (današnjega Vanadzorja).
notes: Izpuščena je latinična transliteracija armenskega imena.

source.title: Battle of Karakilisa
paragraphs: The Battle of Karakilisa (Armenian: Ղարաքիլիսայի ճակատամարտ Gharakilisayi chakatamart, Turkish: Karakilise Muharebesi or Karakilise Muharebeleri) took place during the Caucasus Campaign of World War I in the vicinity of Karakilisa (now Vanadzor), on May 25–28, 1918.

Battle of Karnal.headline: Bitka pri Karnalu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Karnalu (perzijsko: نبرد کرنال; 24. februar 1739) je bila odločilna zmaga Nader Šaha, ustanovitelja iranske afšaridske dinastije, med njegovim vpadom v Indijo. Naderjeve sile so v treh urah porazile vojsko mogulskega cesarja Mohameda Šaha in odprle pot iranskemu plenjenju Delhija. Spopad velja za vrhunec Naderjeve vojaške kariere in za taktično mojstrovino. Bitka je potekala pri Karnalu v Harjani, 110 kilometrov severno od Delhija v Indiji. Zaradi porazne izgube Mogulskega cesarstva pri Karnalu je že propadajoča mogulska dinastija tako oslabela, da se je njen propad pospešil. Po Axworthyju je tudi mogoče, da bi brez uničujočih posledic Naderjevega vpada v Indijo evropska kolonialna prevlada nad Indijsko podcelino prišla v drugačni obliki ali morda sploh ne.
notes: Izpuščena je pretvorba v milje.

source.title: Battle of Karnal
paragraphs: The Battle of Karnal (Persian: نبرد کرنال) (24 February 1739) was a decisive victory for Nader Shah, the founder of the Afsharid dynasty of Iran, during his invasion of India. Nader's forces defeated the army of Mughal emperor Muhammad Shah within three hours, paving the way for the Iranian sack of Delhi. The engagement is considered the crowning jewel in Nader's military career as well as a tactical masterpiece. The battle took place near Karnal in Haryana, 110 kilometres (68 mi) north of Delhi, India. As a result of the overwhelming defeat of the Mughal Empire at Karnal, the already-declining Mughal dynasty was critically weakened to such an extent as to hasten its demise. According to Axworthy, it is also possible that without the ruinous effects of Nader's invasion of India, European colonial takeover of the Indian subcontinent would have come in a different form or perhaps not at all.

Battle of Khanwa.headline: Bitka pri Khanvi
paragraphs: Bitka pri Khanvi se je 16. marca 1527 v današnjem Radžastanu bila med Mogulskim cesarstvom pod vodstvom Baburja in Kraljestvom Mevar pod vodstvom rane Sange za prevlado nad severno Indijo. Končala se je z mogulsko zmago in je bila pomemben dogodek srednjeveške indijske zgodovine. Kraljestvo Mevar je pod vladavino rane Sange postalo ena najmočnejših sil v severni Indiji. Bitka je bila med najodločilnejšimi v mogulski osvojitvi severne Indije in ena prvih bitk v severni Indiji, v katerih so uporabili smodnik. Timuridi in Radžputi so v njej utrpeli velike izgube.

source.title: Battle of Khanwa
paragraphs: The Battle of Khanwa was fought at Khanwa in modern-day Rajasthan on 16 March 1527, between the Mughal Empire, led by Babur, and the Kingdom of Mewar, led by Rana Sanga for supremacy of Northern India. The battle ended in a Mughal victory and was a major event in medieval Indian history. The Kingdom of Mewar under the rule of Rana Sanga, had turned into one of the strongest powers in northern India. The battle was among the most decisive battles in the Mughal conquest of northern India. It was one of the first battles in Northern India where gunpowder was used. The battle resulted in heavy casualties for both Timurids and Rajputs.

Battle of Ko Chang.headline: Bitka pri Ko Changu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Ko Changu je potekala 17. januarja 1941 med francosko-tajsko vojno. Flotilja francoskih vojnih ladij je napadla manjše tajske sile, med njimi obalno obrambno ladjo. Bitka se je končala s taktično zmago francoske mornarice nad kraljevo tajsko mornarico, strateški izid pa je vprašljiv. Dve tajski ladji sta bili potopljeni, ena pa hudo poškodovana, Francozi pa niso imeli izgub. Bitka je Japonsko spodbudila, da je diplomatsko posredovala in dosegla premirje, s katerim je Tajski ostal nadzor nad spornimi območji Francoske Indokine. V mesecu po spopadu sta Vichyjska Francija in Tajska izpogajali mir, ki je končal vojno.

source.title: Battle of Ko Chang
paragraphs: The Battle of Ko Chang took place on 17 January 1941 during the Franco-Thai War. A flotilla of French warships attacked a smaller force of Thai vessels, including a coastal defence ship. The battle resulted in a tactical victory by the French Navy over the Royal Thai Navy, although the strategic result is dubious. Two Thai ships were sunk and one was heavily damaged, with no French losses. The battle prompted Japan to intervene diplomatically and mediate a ceasefire, which left Thailand in control of the contested areas of French Indochina. Within a month of the engagement, Vichy France and Thailand negotiated a peace that ended the war.

Battle of Kohima.headline: Bitka za Kohimo
paragraphs: Bitka za Kohimo je bila leta 1944 med drugo svetovno vojno prelomnica japonske ofenzive U-Go na Britansko Indijo. Potekala je v treh fazah od 4. aprila do 22. junija 1944 okoli mesta Kohima, danes prestolnice zvezne države Nagaland na severovzhodu Indije. Od 3. do 16. aprila so Japonci poskušali zavzeti greben Kohima, ki je obvladoval cesto, po kateri so oskrbovali obkoljene britanske in indijske čete IV. korpusa pri Imphalu. Do sredine aprila so male britanske in britansko-indijske sile pri Kohimi osvobodili.

Od 18. aprila do 13. maja so britanske in britansko-indijske okrepitve prešle v protinapad, da bi Japonce pregnale s položajev, ki so jih zavzeli. Japonci so tedaj greben zapustili, vendar so še naprej zapirali cesto Kohima–Imphal. Od 16. maja do 22. junija so britanske in britansko-indijske čete zasledovale umikajoče se Japonce in znova odprle cesto. Bitka se je končala 22. junija, ko so se britanske in britansko-indijske čete iz Kohime in Imphala srečale pri 109. miljniku in s tem končale obleganje Imphala.

source.title: Battle of Kohima
paragraphs: The Battle of Kohima was the turning point of the Japanese U-Go offensive into British India in 1944 during the Second World War. It took place in three stages from 4 April to 22 June 1944 around the town of Kohima, now the capital city of the state of Nagaland in Northeast India. From 3 to 16 April, the Japanese attempted to capture Kohima ridge, a feature which dominated the road by which the besieged British and Indian troops of IV Corps at Imphal were supplied. By mid-April, the small British and British Indian force at Kohima was relieved.

From 18 April to 13 May British and British Indian reinforcements counter-attacked to drive the Japanese from the positions they had captured. The Japanese abandoned the ridge at this point but continued to block the Kohima–Imphal road. From 16 May to 22 June the British and British Indian troops pursued the retreating Japanese and reopened the road. The battle ended on 22 June when British and British Indian troops from Kohima and Imphal met at Milestone 109, ending the Siege of Imphal.

Battle of Koregaon.headline: Bitka pri Koregaonu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Koregaonu se je 1. januarja 1818 pri Koregaon Bhimi bila med Vzhodnoindijsko družbo in pešvovo frakcijo Marathskega imperija.

Vojska z 28.000 možmi pod vodstvom pešve Badži Raa II. je bila na poti, da bi napadla Pune, ki ga je imela v rokah družba, ko je nepričakovano naletela na 800 mož družbe, ki so bili namenjeni na pomoč britanskim četam v Punu. Pešva je nad to enoto, ki se je vkopala v Koregaonu, poslal okoli 2000 vojakov. Čete družbe pod vodstvom stotnika Francisa Stauntona so položaj branile skoraj 12 ur, dokler se pešvove čete nazadnje niso umaknile, ker so se bale skorajšnjega prihoda večje britanske vojske.

Bitka je bila del tretje angleško-marathske vojne, vrste bitk, ki so se končale s porazom pešvove oblasti in nato z vladavino britanske Vzhodnoindijske družbe v skoraj vsej zahodni, osrednji in južni Indiji. V Koregaonu stoji »steber zmage« (obelisk) v spomin na bitko.

source.title: Battle of Koregaon
paragraphs: The Battle of Koregaon was fought on 1 January 1818 between the East India Company and the Peshwa faction of the Maratha Empire, at Koregaon Bhima.

A 28,000-strong force led by Peshwa Baji Rao II whilst on their way to attack the company-held Pune, were unexpectedly met by an 800-strong Company force that was on its way to reinforce the British troops in Pune. The Peshwa dispatched around 2,000 soldiers to attack the force which sought entrenchment in Koregaon. Led by Captain Francis Staunton, the Company troops defended their position for nearly 12 hours, before the Peshwa's troops ultimately withdrew, fearing the imminent arrival of a larger British force.

The battle was part of the Third Anglo-Maratha War, a series of battles that culminated in the defeat of the Peshwa rule and subsequent rule of the British East India Company in nearly all of Western, Central and Southern India. There is a "victory pillar" (obelisk) in Koregaon commemorating the battle.

Battle of Korsakov.headline: Bitka pri Korsakovu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Korsakovu, pomorski spopad rusko-japonske vojne, se je bila 20. avgusta 1904 pred južno obalo otoka Sahalin. Bitka je preprečila poskus zaščitene križarke Novik ruske cesarske mornarice, da bi se iz Port Arthurja prebila do ruske eskadre križark v Vladivostoku, potem ko se je ruska pacifiška eskadra v bitki v Rumenem morju razkropila.

source.title: Battle of Korsakov
paragraphs: The Battle of Korsakov, a naval engagement of the Russo-Japanese War, was fought on 20 August 1904 off the southern coast of Sakhalin island. The battle foiled an attempt by the Imperial Russian Navy protected cruiser Novik at escaping Port Arthur to join the Russian cruiser squadron at Vladivostok, Russia, after the Russian Pacific Squadron was scattered in the Battle of the Yellow Sea.

Battle of Krtsanisi.headline: Bitka pri Krcanisiju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Krcanisiju (gruzijsko: კრწანისის ბრძოლა; perzijsko: نبرد کرتسانیسی) se je od 8. do 11. septembra 1795 bila med vojsko kadžarskega Irana (Perzije) ter gruzijskimi vojskami Kraljestva Kartli-Kahetija in Kraljevine Imereti pri Krcanisiju blizu Tbilisija v Gruziji. Bila je del vojne, s katero je Aga Mohamed kan Kadžar odgovoril na zavezništvo gruzijskega kralja Herakleja II. z Ruskim imperijem. Bitka se je končala z odločilnim porazom Gruzijcev, zavzetjem in popolnim uničenjem njihove prestolnice Tbilisija ter začasno priključitvijo vzhodne Gruzije iranskemu cesarstvu.
notes: Izpuščena je latinična transliteracija gruzijskega imena.

source.title: Battle of Krtsanisi
paragraphs: The Battle of Krtsanisi (Georgian: კრწანისის ბრძოლა, romanized: k'rts'anisis brdzola, Persian: نبرد کرتسانیسی) was fought between the army of Qajar Iran (Persia) and the Georgian armies of the Kingdom of Kartli-Kakheti and Kingdom of Imereti at the place of Krtsanisi near Tbilisi, Georgia, from September 8 to September 11, 1795, as part of Agha Mohammad Khan Qajar's war in response to King Heraclius II of Georgia’s alliance with the Russian Empire. The battle resulted in the decisive defeat of the Georgians, capture, and complete destruction of their capital Tbilisi, as well as the temporary absorption of eastern Georgia into the Iranian empire.

Battle of Kunduz (2015).headline: Bitka za Kunduz (2015)
paragraphs: Bitka za Kunduz je od aprila do oktobra 2015 potekala za nadzor nad mestom Kunduz na severu Afganistana, ki so ga talibski borci poskušali zavzeti in iz njega pregnati afganistanske varnostne sile. Talibske sile so 28. septembra 2015 mesto nenadoma zavzele, vladne sile pa so se umaknile iz mesta. Talibani so tedaj prvič po letu 2001 prevzeli nadzor nad kakim večjim mestom v Afganistanu. Afganistanska vlada je trdila, da je s protinapadom do 1. oktobra 2015 Kunduz večinoma znova zavzela, vendar so krajevni viri v mestu trditve vladnih uradnikov izpodbijali.

V dolgotrajni seriji ameriških letalskih napadov na travmatološki center v Kunduzu, bolnišnico za nujno pomoč, ki so jo vodili Zdravniki brez meja (Médecins Sans Frontières), je 3. oktobra umrlo dvanajst zaposlenih in deset bolnikov, med njimi trije otroci. Ranjenih je bilo sedemintrideset ljudi, med njimi devetnajst zaposlenih.

source.title: Battle of Kunduz (2015)
paragraphs: The Battle of Kunduz took place from April to October 2015 for control of the city of Kunduz, located in northern Afghanistan, with Taliban fighters attempting to seize the city and displace Afghan security forces. On 28 September 2015, the Taliban forces suddenly overran the city, with government forces retreating outside the city. The capture marked the first time since 2001 that the Taliban had taken control of a major city in Afghanistan. The Afghan government claimed to have largely recaptured Kunduz by 1 October 2015 in a counterattack, although local sources in the city disputed the claim made by government officials.

Twelve hospital staff of Médecins Sans Frontières (Doctors Without Borders) and ten patients, including three children, were killed on October 3 by a prolonged series of US airstrikes on Kunduz Trauma Centre, an emergency trauma hospital run by the agency. Thirty-seven people were injured including nineteen staff members.

Bitka pri Hasanskem jezeru (rusko: Хасанские бои), znana tudi kot incident Čangkufeng (kitajsko in japonsko: 張鼓峰事件), je bila poskus vojaškega vdora Mandžukua, japonske marionetne države, na ozemlje, ki ga je zahtevala in nadzorovala Sovjetska zveza. Vdor, do katerega je prišlo od 29. julija do 11. avgusta 1938, je izhajal iz japonskega prepričanja, da je Sovjetska zveza napačno razlagala razmejitev po pekinški pogodbi med carsko Rusijo in čingovsko Kitajsko ter nato premaknila mejnike. Japonske sile so zasedle sporno območje, vendar so se po hudih bojih in diplomatskem dogovoru umaknile.
notes: Izpuščena sta zapisa v pinjinu in romadžiju.

source.title: Battle of Lake Khasan
paragraphs: The Battle of Lake Khasan (Russian: Хасанские бои), also known as the Changkufeng Incident (Chinese and Japanese: 張鼓峰事件; Chinese pinyin: Zhānggǔfēng Shìjiàn; Japanese romaji: Chōkohō Jiken), was an attempted military incursion by Manchukuo, a Japanese puppet state, into territory claimed and controlled by the Soviet Union. The incursion, which occurred from 29 July to 11 August 1938, was founded in the Japanese belief that the Soviet Union had misinterpreted the demarcation of the boundary based on the Treaty of Peking between Imperial Russia and Qing China, and had subsequently tampered with the demarcation markers. Japanese forces occupied the disputed area but withdrew after heavy fighting and a diplomatic settlement.

Battle of Long Tan.headline: Bitka pri Long Tanu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Long Tanu (18.–21. avgusta 1966) je med vietnamsko vojno potekala na plantaži kavčukovcev pri Long Tânu v provinci Phước Tuy v Južnem Vietnamu. Spopadle so se enote Vietkonga (VC) in Vietnamske ljudske armade (PAVN) na eni ter deli 1. avstralske delovne skupine (1 ATF) na drugi strani.

Avstralska signalna obveščevalna služba (SIGINT) je spremljala premik 275. polka in bataljona D445 VC na položaj tik severno od Long Tana. Do 16. avgusta je bil polk nameščen blizu Long Tana zunaj dosega topništva 1 ATF v Nui Datu. VC je v noči s 16. na 17. avgust z minometi in netrzajnimi topovi (RCL) s položaja 2 kilometra vzhodno napadal Nui Dat, dokler ga protibaterijski ogenj ni ustavil. Naslednje jutro je četa D 6. bataljona Kraljevega avstralskega polka (6 RAR) odšla iz Nui Data, da bi odkrila strelne položaje in ugotovila smer umika VC. Četa D je našla zaklone za orožje in strelne položaje minometov in RCL, okoli poldneva 18. avgusta pa je naletela na enote VC.
notes: Izpuščena je pretvorba v milje.

source.title: Battle of Long Tan
paragraphs: The Battle of Long Tan (18–21 August 1966) took place in a rubber plantation near Long Tân, in Phước Tuy Province, South Vietnam, during the Vietnam War. The action was fought between Viet Cong (VC) and People's Army of Vietnam (PAVN) units on one side and elements of the 1st Australian Task Force (1 ATF) on the other.

Australian signals intelligence (SIGINT) had tracked the VC 275th Regiment and D445 Battalion moving to a position just north of Long Tan. By 16 August, it was positioned near Long Tan outside the range of the one ATF artillery at Nui Dat. Using mortars and recoilless rifles (RCLs), on the night of 16–17 August, the VC attacked Nui Dat from a position 2 kilometres (1.2 mi) to the east, until counter-battery fire made it stop. The next morning D Company, 6th Battalion, Royal Australian Regiment (6 RAR), departed Nui Dat to locate the firing positions and determine the direction of the VC withdrawal. D Company found weapon pits and firing positions for mortars and RCLs, and around midday on 18 August made contact with VC elements.

Battle of Maiwand.headline: Bitka pri Majvandu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Majvandu se je 27. julija 1880 bila med drugo angleško-afganistansko vojno. V bitki pri vasi Majvand v provinci Kandahar je afganistanska vojska z 12.000 možmi, 9000 pešci in 3000 konjeniki, pod poveljstvom Mohameda Ajuba kana porazila 2500 britanskih in indijskih vojakov pod poveljstvom brigadnega generala Georgea Burrowsa. Afganistanci so imeli od 2500 do 3000 mrtvih in ranjenih, Burrowsove sile pa morda celo 1200 mrtvih. Čeprav je bila bitka za Britance hud poraz, so 1. septembra Ajuba kana odločilno porazili v bitki pri Kandaharju.

source.title: Battle of Maiwand
paragraphs: The Battle of Maiwand was fought on 27 July 1880 during the Second Anglo-Afghan War. Fought near the village of Maiwand in Kandahar Province, the battle resulted in an Afghan army of 12,000 composed of 9,000 infantry and 3,000 cavalry under Mohammad Ayub Khan defeating a force of 2,500 British and Indian troops under Brigadier-general George Burrows. The Afghans suffered between 2,500 and 3,000 men killed and wounded while Burrows' force suffered possibly as high as 1,200 killed. Though the battle proved to be a major setback for the British, they would go on to decisively defeat Ayub Khan at the Battle of Kandahar on 1 September.

Battle of Merv.headline: Bitka pri Mervu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Mervu (perzijsko: نبرد مرو) je potekala 2. decembra 1510, ko je šah Ismail I. s safavidsko vojsko vdrl v uzbeški Horasan. Končala se je s safavidsko priključitvijo Horasana.

source.title: Battle of Merv
paragraphs: The Battle of Merv (Persian: نبرد مرو) occurred on 2 December 1510 as a result of Shah Ismail I's Safavid invasion of the Khorasan region of Uzbek. It ended with Safavid annexation of the Khorasan region.

Battle of Mudki.headline: Bitka pri Mudkiju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Mudkiju se je 18. decembra 1845 bila med silami britanske Vzhodnoindijske družbe in delom sikhovske vojske Khalsa, vojske Sikhovskega imperija. Britanska vojska je bitko dobila, čeprav je pri tem utrpela velike izgube.

source.title: Battle of Mudki
paragraphs: The Battle of Mudki was fought on 18 December 1845, between the forces of the British East India Company and a part of the Sikh Khalsa Army, the army of the Sikh Empire. The British army were able to win the battle, despite suffering heavy casualties in the process.

Battle of Musa Qala.headline: Bitka za Musa Kalo
paragraphs: Bitka za Musa Kalo (tudi Kaleh ali Kal'eh) je bila vojaška akcija pod britanskim vodstvom v provinci Helmand na jugu Afganistana, ki sta jo afganistanska narodna vojska in Mednarodne sile za varnostno pomoč (ISAF) 7. decembra 2007 sprožili proti talibanom. Po treh dneh hudih bojev so se talibani 10. decembra umaknili v gore. Uradno so Musa Kalo razglasili za zavzeto 12. decembra, ko so čete afganistanske vojske prodrle v središče mesta.

Operacija je imela kodno ime kačje gnezdo (paštunsko: Mar Kardad). Višji častniki ISAF, med njimi ameriški general Dan K. McNeill, vrhovni poveljnik ISAF, so napad odobrili 17. novembra 2007. Pred tem so talibani mesto, največje, ki so ga uporniki tedaj nadzorovali, zasedali več kot devet mesecev. Sile ISAF so mesto že zasedale, dokler se iz njega konec leta 2006 niso sporno umaknile.

source.title: Battle of Musa Qala
paragraphs: The Battle of Musa Qala (also Qaleh or Qal'eh) was a British-led military action in Helmand Province, southern Afghanistan, launched by the Afghan National Army and the International Security Assistance Force (ISAF) against the Taliban on 7 December 2007. After three days of intense fighting, the Taliban retreated into the mountains on 10 December. Musa Qala was officially reported captured on 12 December, with Afghan Army troops pushing into the town centre.

The operation was codenamed snakepit (Pashto: Mar Kardad). Senior ISAF officers, including U.S. general Dan K. McNeill, the overall ISAF commander, agreed to the assault on 17 November 2007. It followed more than nine months of Taliban occupation of the town, the largest the insurgents controlled at the time of the battle. ISAF forces had previously occupied the town, until a controversial withdrawal in late 2006.

Battle of Parwan.headline: Bitka pri Parvanu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Parvanu se je septembra 1221 med mongolsko invazijo na Horezmijsko cesarstvo bila pri Parvanu severno od Kabula v današnjem Afganistanu med horezmijskim sultanom Džalalom al-Dinom Mangburnijem in Mongoli, ki jim je vladal Džingis-kan. Džalal ad-Din je pred tem napadel mongolski odred pri Vilanu (Valijanu), zato je Džingis-kan proti njemu poslal vojsko s 30.000 možmi pod vodstvom Šigija Kutuguja. Zaradi taktike, ki jo je izbral Džalal ad-Din, je bila mongolska vojska v dvodnevni bitki uničena. Ko se je novica o mongolskem porazu razširila, se je uprlo več mest, med njimi Merv in Herat, ki so se prej predala in sprejela mongolsko oblast. Džingis-kan se je nato sam odpravil v boj proti Džalalu ad-Dinu, ki je zaradi spora o delitvi plena po bitki z dezertiranjem izgubil polovico vojske in se je moral umakniti v Gazni, da bi se pripravil na umik v Indijo. Džingis-kan je Džalalovo vojsko prestregel, ko se je ta pripravljala na prečkanje Inda; v bitki, ki je sledila, je Džalal izgubil vojsko, zakladnico in družino, a je preživel in si pozneje ustvaril oporišče moči v Pandžabu in Sindu.

source.title: Battle of Parwan
paragraphs: The Battle of Parwan was fought between Sultan Jalal al-Din Mangburni of the Khwarazmian Empire and the Mongols ruled by Genghis Khan in September 1221 AD during the Mongol invasion of the Khwarazmian Empire at Parwan, north of Kabul, in present-day Afghanistan. Jalal ad-Din had previously attacked a detachment of Mongols near Wilan (Waliyan), which provoked Genghis Khan into sending an army of 30,000 troops under Shigi Qutuqu. As a result of the tactics adopted by Jalal ad-Din, the Mongol army was destroyed in a two-day battle. As news of the Mongol defeat spread, several cities, including Merv and Herat, which had previously surrendered and accepted Mongol rule, rebelled. In response, Genghis Khan moved to battle Jalal ad-Din, who had lost half of his troops to desertion due to a quarrel over the division of spoils after the battle, and was forced to move to Ghazni to prepare to retreat to India. Genghis Khan intercepted Jalal ad-Din's army as he was preparing to cross the Indus River, and in the ensuing battle he lost his army, treasury and family, but survived to eventually establish a power base in Punjab and Sindh.

Battle of Peshawar (1001).headline: Bitka pri Pešavarju (1001)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Pešavarju se je 27. novembra 1001 pri Pešavarju bila med gaznavidsko vojsko Mahmuda Gaznavija in hindujsko šahijsko vojsko Džajapale. Džajapala je bil poražen in ujet, zaradi ponižanja ob porazu pa se je pozneje sežgal na grmadi. To je bila prva od številnih velikih bitk, v katerih je Mahmud širil Gaznavidsko cesarstvo na Indijsko podcelino.

source.title: Battle of Peshawar (1001)
paragraphs: The Battle of Peshawar was fought on 27 November 1001 between the Ghaznavid army of Mahmud of Ghazni and the Hindu Shahi army of Jayapala, near Peshawar. Jayapala was defeated and captured, and as a result of the humiliation of the defeat, he later immolated himself in a funeral pyre. This is the first of many major battles in the expansion of the Ghaznavid Empire into the Indian subcontinent by Mahmud.

Battle of Plassey.headline: Bitka pri Plaseju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Plaseju je bila 23. junija 1757 odločilna zmaga britanske Vzhodnoindijske družbe pod vodstvom Roberta Clivea nad bengalskim navabom in njegovimi francoskimi zavezniki. Zmago sta omogočila izdaja Mir Džafarja, vrhovnega poveljnika navaba Siradž ud-Daule, in dejstvo, da je bil velik del vojske subaha Bengal pred tem zaposlen z odbijanjem afganistanskega vpada Ahmada Šaha Duranija v Mogulsko cesarstvo. Bitka je britanski Vzhodnoindijski družbi pomagala, da je leta 1773 prevzela popoln nadzor nad Bengalom. V naslednjih sto letih je svoj nadzor širila na obsežna ozemlja v preostalem delu Indijske podceline in v Burmi.

source.title: Battle of Plassey
paragraphs: The Battle of Plassey was a decisive victory of the British East India Company, under the leadership of Robert Clive, over the Nawab of Bengal and his French allies on 23 June 1757. The victory was made possible by the betrayal of Mir Jafar, Nawab Siraj-ud-Daulah's commander in chief, as well as much of the Bengal Subah's armies being earlier committed against an Afghan invasion led by Ahmad Shah Durrani against the Mughal Empire. The battle helped the British East India Company take complete control of Bengal in 1773. Over the next hundred years, they continued to expand their control over vast territories in the rest of the Indian subcontinent and Burma.

Battle of Pondicherry.headline: Bitka pri Pondicherryju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Pondicherryju je bila pomorska bitka med britansko eskadro pod poveljstvom viceadmirala Georgea Pococka in francosko eskadro pod poveljstvom grofa d'Achéja 10. septembra 1759 pred Karnatsko obalo Indije blizu Pondicherryja med sedemletno vojno. Pocock je poskušal prestreči d'Achéja, čigar eskadra je vozila okrepitve in denar za francoske sile v Pondicherryju. Bitka je bila neodločena, vendar je d'Aché nalogo uspešno izpolnil, ko je njegovo ladjevje 15. septembra prispelo v Pondicherry. Te sile pa niso zadoščale, da bi obrnile slabšajoči se francoski položaj v Karnatiku.

source.title: Battle of Pondicherry
paragraphs: The Battle of Pondicherry was a naval battle between a British squadron under Vice-Admiral George Pocock and French squadron under Comte d'Aché on 10 September 1759 off the Carnatic coast of India near Pondicherry during the Seven Years' War. Pocock attempted to intercept d'Aché, whose squadron was carrying reinforcements and money for the French forces in Pondicherry. The battle was indecisive, but d'Aché successfully completed his mission when his fleet arrived in Pondicherry on 15 September. However, these forces were insufficient to reverse the declining French situation in the Carnatic.

Battle of Qala-i-Jangi.headline: Bitka za Kala-i-Džangi
paragraphs: Bitka za Kala-i-Džangi v Afganistanu (včasih imenovana tudi »bitka za Mazar-i-Šarif«) je bila šestdnevni vojaški spopad po uporu vojnih ujetnikov, ki so jih 25. novembra 2001 prijele koalicijske sile pod vodstvom ZDA. Bitka je potekala od 25. novembra do 1. decembra na severu Afganistana. Sledila je posredovanju koalicijskih sil pod vodstvom ZDA, ki so hotele strmoglaviti talibanski Islamski emirat Afganistan, ki je dajal zatočišče pripadnikom Al Kaide.

source.title: Battle of Qala-i-Jangi
paragraphs: The Battle of Qala-i-Jangi in Afghanistan (sometimes also referred to as the "Battle of Mazar-i-Sharif") was a six-day military engagement following an uprising of prisoners of war who had been taken into custody by U.S.-led coalition forces on 25 November 2001. The battle took place from 25 November to 1 December, in northern Afghanistan. It followed the intervention by United States-led coalition forces to overthrow the Taliban's Islamic Emirate of Afghanistan, which had been harboring al-Qaeda operatives.

Battle of Ramree Island.headline: Bitka za otok Ramree
paragraphs: Bitka za otok Ramree (burmansko: ရမ်းဗြဲကျွန်း တိုက်ပွဲ), znana tudi kot operacija Matador, je v drugi svetovni vojni potekala od 14. januarja do 22. februarja 1945 v okviru ofenzive na južni fronti burmanskega pohoda, izvedel pa jo je XV. indijski korpus.

Otok Ramree, del Arakana (danes zvezne države Rakhine), meri 1350 km², od celine pa ga loči preliv s povprečno širino okoli 150 m; otok leži 110 km južno od Akjaba (danes Sittwe). Med japonsko invazijo na Burmo v začetku leta 1942 so otok zavzeli Japonci. Januarja 1945 so se sile XV. indijskega korpusa izkrcale na Ramreeju in sosednjem otoku Čeduba, da bi uredile letališča za oskrbo pohoda na celini.

Bitka je znana po trditvah, da so v mangrovih močvirjih Ramreeja krokodili ubili več sto japonskih vojakov. Nekatere izdaje Guinnessove knjige rekordov so to opisale kot največje število smrtnih žrtev v napadu živali; zoologi in sodobni vojaški zgodovinarji pa so te trditve zavrnili.
notes: Izpuščene so pretvorbe v kvadratne milje, čevlje in milje.

source.title: Battle of Ramree Island
paragraphs: The Battle of Ramree Island (Burmese: ရမ်းဗြဲကျွန်း တိုက်ပွဲ), also known as Operation Matador, took place from 14 January to 22 February 1945, in the Second World War as part of the offensive on the Southern Front in the Burma campaign and was conducted by the XV Indian Corps.

Ramree Island, part of Arakan (now Rakhine State), has an area of 520 sq mi (1,350 km2) and is separated from the mainland by a strait with an average width of about 490 ft (150 m); the island is 70 mi (110 km) south of Akyab (now Sittwe). During the Japanese invasion of Burma in early 1942, the Island had been captured. In January 1945, forces of the Indian XV Corps landed on Ramree and the neighbouring island of Cheduba, to establish airfields for the supply of the mainland campaign.

The battle is known for claims that hundreds of Japanese soldiers were killed by crocodiles in the mangrove swamps of Ramree. Some editions of the Guinness Book of World Records have described this as the highest number of fatalities in an animal attack; zoologists and modern military historians have dismissed these claims.

Battle of Route Coloniale 4.headline: Bitka na cesti Route Coloniale 4
paragraphs: Bitka na cesti Route Coloniale 4, ki jo je Viet Minh imenoval jesensko-zimski obmejni pohod (Chiến Dịch Biên Giới Thu Đông), je bila bitka prve indokitajske vojne. Potekala je ob cesti Route Coloniale 4 (RC4, imenovani tudi cesta 4), po kateri so oskrbovali francosko vojaško oporišče v Cao Bằngu. Francoski vojaški promet po cesti je bil že v letih 1947–1949 tarča nenehnih zased.

Cilj Viet Minha v obmejnem pohodu leta 1950 je bil odpreti pot do vietnamsko-kitajske meje za oskrbo iz novoustanovljene Ljudske republike Kitajske. Viet Minh je v tem pohodu poskušal preizkusiti tudi nove taktike in pridobiti izkušnje v obsežni bitki, kakršne dotlej še ni bojeval.

Bitka je trajala od 30. septembra do 18. oktobra 1950 in se je končala s francoskim porazom, ko je Viet Minh dobil kitajsko pomoč. Viet Minh je več enot francoske vojske, med njimi nekaj bataljonov francoske tujske legije, tako razbil, da kot bojne enote praktično niso več obstajale.

source.title: Battle of Route Coloniale 4
paragraphs: The Battle of Route Coloniale 4, also called the Autumn-Winter Border Campaign (Chiến Dịch Biên Giới Thu Đông) by the Viet Minh, was a battle of the First Indochina War. It took place along Route Coloniale 4 (RC4, also known as Highway 4), a road used to supply the French military base at Cao Bằng. French military traffic along the road had previously been subject to an ongoing series of ambushes during 1947–1949.

The aim of Việt Minh in the 1950 Border Campaign was clearing the way to the Vietnam-China border for the supply flow from the newly formed People's Republic of China. In this campaign the Việt Minh also tried to test new tactics and gain new experiences in a large scale battle which the Việt Minh had not previously used.

The battle lasted from 30 September to 18 October 1950 and resulted in a French defeat when the Việt Minh got Chinese help. Several units of the French army, including some battalions of the French Foreign Legion, were devastated by the Việt Minh and essentially ceased to exist as fighting units.

Battle of Saragarhi.headline: Bitka pri Saragarhiju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Saragarhiju je bila bitka do zadnjega moža, ki se je bila pred pohodom v Tirah med Britansko Indijo in afganistanskimi plemeni. Dne 12. septembra 1897 so pri Gogri, v Samana Suku in okoli Saragarhija opazili po ocenah od 12.000 do 24.000 pripadnikov plemen Orakzai in Afridi, ki so trdnjavo Gulistan odrezali od trdnjave Lockhart. Afganistanci so napadli postojanko Saragarhi, kjer jih je na tisoče obkolilo utrdbo in se pripravljalo na naskok. Pod vodstvom havildarja Išarja Singha se 21 vojakov v utrdbi, vsi Sikhi, ni hotelo vdati in so v boju do zadnjega moža vsi padli. Postojanko je dva dni pozneje znova zavzel drug britansko-indijski kontingent.

Vseh 21 vojakov, ki so sodelovali v bitki, je posmrtno prejelo indijski red za zasluge, najvišje odlikovanje za hrabrost, ki ga je tedaj lahko dobil indijski vojak. Bitke se vsako leto 12. septembra kot dneva Saragarhija spominja 4. bataljon sikhovskega polka indijske vojske.

source.title: Battle of Saragarhi
paragraphs: The Battle of Saragarhi was a last-stand battle fought before the Tirah Campaign between the British Indian Empire and Afghan tribesmen. On 12 September 1897, an estimated 12,000–24,000 Orakzai and Afridi tribesmen were seen near Gogra, at Samana Suk, and around Saragarhi, cutting off Fort Gulistan from Fort Lockhart. The Afghans attacked the outpost of Saragarhi where thousands of them swarmed and surrounded the fort, preparing to assault it. Led by Havildar Ishar Singh, the 21 soldiers in the fort—all of whom were Sikhs—refused to surrender and were wiped out in a last stand. The post was recaptured two days later by another British Indian contingent.

All of the 21 soldiers involved in the battle were posthumously awarded the Indian Order of Merit, which was the highest gallantry award that an Indian soldier could receive at the time. The Indian Army's 4th Battalion of the Sikh Regiment commemorates the battle every year on 12 September as Saragarhi Day.

Battle of Sasireti.headline: Bitka pri Sasiretiju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Sasiretiju (gruzijsko: სასირეთის ბრძოლა) je potekala leta 1042 pri vasi Sasireti v današnji pokrajini Šida Kartli, nedaleč od mesta Kaspi, med državljansko vojno v Kraljestvu Gruziji. Uporni fevdalec Liparit IV. Kldekarski je v njej odločilno porazil vojsko kralja Bagrata IV.

source.title: Battle of Sasireti
paragraphs: The Battle of Sasireti (Georgian: სასირეთის ბრძოლა) took place in 1042 at the village of Sasireti in the present day Shida Kartli region, not far from the town of Kaspi, during the civil war in the Kingdom of Georgia. It resulted in a decisive defeat of the army of King Bagrat IV by the rebel feudal lord Liparit IV of Kldekari.

Battle of Shumshu.headline: Bitka za Šumšu
paragraphs: Bitka za Šumšu, sovjetska invazija na Šumšu na Kurilskih otokih, je bila prva faza sovjetske invazije na Kurilske otoke avgusta in septembra 1945 v drugi svetovni vojni. Potekala je od 18. do 23. avgusta 1945 in je bila edina večja bitka sovjetskega pohoda na Kurilske otoke ter verjetno sploh zadnja bitka druge svetovne vojne.

source.title: Battle of Shumshu
paragraphs: The Battle of Shumshu, the Soviet invasion of Shumshu in the Kuril Islands, was the first stage of the Soviet Union's Invasion of the Kuril Islands in August–September 1945 during World War II. It took place from 18 to 23 August 1945, and was the only major battle of the Soviet campaign in the Kuril Islands and arguably the very last battle of World War II.

Battle of Shusha (1992).headline: Bitka za Šušo (1992)
paragraphs: Bitka za Šušo (armensko: Շուշի, Šuši; kodno ime operacija Poroka v gorah, armensko: Հարսանիք լեռներում, rusko: Свадьба в горах) je bila prva pomembna vojaška zmaga armenskih sil v prvi vojni v Gorskem Karabahu. Bitka se je začela zvečer 8. maja 1992 v strateško pomembnem gorskem mestu Šuša, boji pa so se hitro končali naslednji dan, ko so armenske sile mesto zavzele in pregnale azerbajdžanske branilce. Armenski vojaški poveljniki s sedežem v Stepanakertu, prestolnici Gorskega Karabaha, so zavzetje mesta pretehtavali, potem ko je azerbajdžansko obstreljevanje Stepanakerta iz Šuše pol leta terjalo več sto armenskih civilnih žrtev in povzročilo veliko razdejanje v Stepanakertu.

Zavzetje mesta se je izkazalo za odločilno. Šuša je bila najpomembnejše vojaško oporišče, ki ga je imel Azerbajdžan v Gorskem Karabahu – z njeno izgubo se je vojna obrnila, armenske sile pa so v nadaljevanju spopada dosegle vrsto vojaških zmag.
notes: Izpuščeni sta latinični transliteraciji armenskega in ruskega kodnega imena.

source.title: Battle of Shusha (1992)
paragraphs: The Battle of Shusha (Codenamed: Operation Wedding in The Mountains; Armenian: Հարսանիք լեռներում, Harsaniq lernerum; Russian: Свадьба в горах, Svadba v gorakh) (Armenian: Շուշի, Shushi) was the first significant military victory by Armenian forces during the First Nagorno-Karabakh War. The battle took place in the strategically important mountain town of Shusha on the evening of 8 May 1992, and fighting swiftly concluded the next day after Armenian forces captured it and drove out the defending Azerbaijanis. Armenian military commanders based in Nagorno-Karabakh's capital of Stepanakert had been contemplating capturing the town after Azerbaijani shelling of Stepanakert from Shusha for half a year had led to hundreds of Armenian civilian casualties and mass destruction in Stepanakert.

The capture of the town proved decisive. Shusha was the most important military stronghold that Azerbaijan held in Nagorno-Karabakh – its loss marked a turning point in the war, and led to a series of military victories by Armenian forces in the course of the conflict.

Battle of Shusha (2020).headline: Bitka za Šušo (2020)
paragraphs: Bitka za Šušo (azerbajdžansko: Şuşa döyüşü ali Şuşa uğrunda döyüş; armensko: Շուշիի ճակատամարտ) je bila zadnja in odločilna bitka vojne v Gorskem Karabahu leta 2020, v kateri so se oborožene sile Azerbajdžana in samooklicane Republike Arcah, ki jo je vojaško podpirala Armenija, bojevale za nadzor nad mestom Šuša. Velja za eno najbolj krvavih bitk te vojne.

Šuša, ki jo Armenci imenujejo Šuši, je skupaj z gorato okolico eden strateško najpomembnejših krajev v spornem Gorskem Karabahu in jo navadno imenujejo »utripajoče srce« regije. Do sredine 19. stoletja je mesto veljalo za kulturno in politično središče tamkajšnjega azerbajdžanskega prebivalstva, za Armence pa je bilo eno od dveh glavnih mest Zakavkazja in od srednjega veka do 1750. let središče samoupravne armenske kneževine.
notes: Izpuščena je latinična transliteracija armenskega imena.

source.title: Battle of Shusha (2020)
paragraphs: The Battle of Shusha (Azerbaijani: Şuşa döyüşü or Şuşa uğrunda döyüş; Armenian: Շուշիի ճակատամարտ, romanized: Shushii chakatamart) was the final and decisive battle of the Second Nagorno-Karabakh War, fought between the armed forces of Azerbaijan and the self-proclaimed Republic of Artsakh, militarily supported by Armenia, over the control of the city of Shusha. The battle is considered one of the bloodiest battles of the war.

Shusha, known to Armenians as Shushi, and the surrounding mountainous terrain, is one of the most strategically important locations in the disputed Nagorno-Karabakh region, and is usually referred to as the "beating heart" of the region. Until the middle of the 19th century, the city was considered the cultural and political centre of the regional Azerbaijani population, as well as one of the two main cities of the Transcaucasus for Armenians and the center of a self-governing Armenian principality from medieval times through the 1750s.

Battle of Sobraon.headline: Bitka pri Sobraonu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Sobraonu se je 10. februarja 1846 bila med silami Vzhodnoindijske družbe in sikhovsko vojsko Khalsa. Sikhi so bili popolnoma poraženi, zato je bila to odločilna bitka prve angleško-sikhovske vojne. Za Sikhe je bila bitka katastrofa, saj je umrlo 10.000 mož, med njimi njihov general Šam Singh Atarivala.

source.title: Battle of Sobraon
paragraphs: The Battle of Sobraon was fought on 10 February 1846, between the forces of the East India Company and the Sikh Khalsa Army. The Sikhs were completely defeated, making this the decisive battle of the First Anglo-Sikh War. The battle was a disaster for the Sikhs, with 10,000 deaths, including their general Sham Singh Attariwala.

Battle of Talas.headline: Bitka ob Talasu
paragraphs: Bitka ob Talasu (kitajsko: 怛羅斯戰役; arabsko: معركة نهر طلاس) je bila oborožen spopad med Abasidskim kalifatom in Tibetanskim imperijem na eni strani ter dinastijo Tang in njenimi zavezniki na drugi leta 751. Julija tega leta sta se tangovska in abasidska vojska spopadli ob reki Talas za nadzor nad območji ob Sirdarji. Abasidska vojska pod poveljstvom Zijada ibn Saliha in karluški plačanci so porazili tangovsko vojsko pod poveljstvom Gao Šjendžija. Viri si niso enotni, ali so Karluki prestopili k Abasidom ali pa so bili njihovi zavezniki že od začetka. Poraz je pomenil konec tangovskega vpliva v Transoksaniji in ustavil širjenje dinastije Tang proti zahodu.

Po bitki je kalif poslal k cesarju odposlanca, ki je decembra 752 prispel na pogajanja o obnovi diplomatskih odnosov. Kitajski ujetniki, zajeti pri Talasu leta 751, naj bi ljudstvom zahodne Azije prinesli izdelovanje papirja, čeprav to poročilo izpodbijajo številne ugotovitve.
notes: Izpuščena sta zapis v pinjinu in latinična transliteracija arabskega imena.

source.title: Battle of Talas
paragraphs: The Battle of Talas (Chinese: 怛羅斯戰役; pinyin: Dáluósī Zhànyì; Arabic: معركة نهر طلاس, romanized: Maʿrakat nahr Ṭalās) was an armed confrontation between the Abbasid Caliphate along with the Tibetan Empire against the Tang dynasty and its allies in 751. In July of that year, the Tang and Abbasid armies clashed at the Talas River over control of the regions surrounding the Syr Darya. The Tang army under Gao Xianzhi was defeated by the Abbasid army under Ziyad ibn Salih and Karluk mercenaries. Sources differ on whether the Karluks defected to the Abbasids or if they were Abbasid allies from the start. The defeat marked the end of Tang influence in Transoxiana and halted Tang westward expansion.

After the battle, the caliph dispatched an envoy to the emperor, who arrived in December 752 to negotiate the restoration of diplomatic relations. Chinese prisoners captured at Talas in 751 are said to have introduced papermaking to the peoples of West Asia, although this account is disputed by several findings.

Battle of Talikota.headline: Bitka pri Talikoti
paragraphs: Bitka pri Talikoti, znana tudi kot bitka pri Rakšasi-Tangadiju (23. januar 1565), je bila prelomna bitka med Vidžajanagarskim imperijem in zvezo dekanskih sultanatov. Končala se je s porazom Alije Rame Raje, kar je privedlo do propada imperija in preoblikovalo politiko v Dekanu.

Podrobnosti bitke in njenih neposrednih posledic je izjemno težko rekonstruirati, saj si pripovedi v primarnih virih izrazito nasprotujejo. Poraz navadno pripisujejo razliki v vojaški moči. Orientalistični in nacionalistični zgodovinarji so bitko prikazovali kot spopad civilizacij med hindujci in muslimani; sodobni raziskovalci takšne oznake zavračajo kot zgrešene.

source.title: Battle of Talikota
paragraphs: The Battle of Talikota, also known as that of Rakshasi-Tangadi, (23 January 1565) was a watershed battle fought between the Vijayanagara Empire and an alliance of the Deccan sultanates. The battle resulted in the defeat of Aliya Rama Raya which led to the eventual collapse of the polity and reconfigured Deccan politics.

The specific details of the battle and its immediate aftermath are notoriously difficult to reconstruct in light of the distinctly contrarian narratives present across primary sources. Defeat is usually blamed on the gap in relative military prowess. Orientalist and nationalist historians asserted of the battle to be a clash of civilizations between Hindus and Muslims; Contemporary scholars reject such characterizations as flawed.

Battle of the Defile.headline: Bitka v soteski
paragraphs: Bitka v soteski ali bitka na prelazu (arabsko: وقعة الشعب) se je julija 731 n. št. tri dni bila na prelazu Tahtakarača (v današnjem Uzbekistanu) med veliko vojsko Omajadskega kalifata in Turgeškim kaganatom. Turgeši so oblegali Samarkand, samarkandski poveljnik Savra ibn al-Hurr al-Abani pa je novoimenovanega upravitelja Horasana Džunajda ibn Abd al-Rahmana al-Murrija zaprosil za pomoč. Turgeši so Džunajdovo vojsko z 28.000 možmi napadli na prelazu; omajadska vojska se je sicer izvila in prišla do Samarkanda, vendar je utrpela ogromne izgube, Savrovih 12.000 mož, ki so dobili ukaz, naj Turgeše napadejo od zadaj, pa je bilo skoraj povsem uničenih.
notes: Izpuščena je latinična transliteracija arabskega imena.

source.title: Battle of the Defile
paragraphs: The Battle of the Defile or Battle of the Pass (Arabic: وقعة الشعب, romanized: Waqʿat al-Shʿib) was fought in the Takhtakaracha Pass (in modern Uzbekistan) between a large army of the Umayyad Caliphate and the Turkic Türgesh khaganate over three days in July 731 CE. The Türgesh had been besieging Samarkand, and Samarkand's commander, Sawra ibn al-Hurr al-Abani, had sent a request for relief to the newly appointed governor of Khurasan, Junayd ibn Abd al-Rahman al-Murri. Junayd's 28,000-strong army was attacked by the Türgesh in the pass, and although the Umayyad army managed to extricate itself and reach Samarkand, it suffered enormous casualties; Sawra's 12,000 men, who had been commanded to attack the Türgesh from the rear in a relief effort, were almost annihilated.

Battle of the Hydaspes.headline: Bitka ob Hidaspu
paragraphs: Bitka ob Hidaspu, znana tudi kot bitka ob Dželumu ali prva bitka ob Dželumu, se je maja 326 pr. n. št. bila med Makedonskim imperijem pod vodstvom Aleksandra Velikega in Pauravi pod vodstvom Pora. Potekala je na bregovih reke Hidasp v današnji pakistanski provinci Pandžab, v okviru Aleksandrovega indijskega pohoda. V morda najdražjem spopadu je makedonska vojska odločilno premagala Paurave in zajela Pora. Velika območja Pandžaba so nato prišla pod Makedonski imperij; Aleksander je Pora pomilostil in ga imenoval za satrapa, s čimer ga je dejansko znova postavil za vladarja pokrajine.

source.title: Battle of the Hydaspes
paragraphs: The Battle of the Hydaspes also known as Battle of Jhelum, or First Battle of Jhelum, was fought between the Macedonian Empire under Alexander the Great and the Pauravas under Porus in May of 326 BC. It took place on the banks of the Hydaspes River in what is now the Punjab province of Pakistan, as part of Alexander's Indian campaign. In what was possibly their most costly engagement, the Macedonian army secured a decisive victory over the Pauravas and captured Porus. Large areas of Punjab were subsequently absorbed into the Macedonian Empire; Alexander spared Porus and made him a satrap, effectively reinstating him as the region's ruler.

Battle of the Indus.headline: Bitka ob Indu
paragraphs: Bitka ob Indu se je 24. novembra 1221 na bregovih reke Ind bila med vojskama, ki sta jima poveljevala Džalal al-Din iz Horezmijskega cesarstva in Džingis-kan iz Mongolskega cesarstva. Bitka, ki se je končala s prepričljivo mongolsko zmago, je bila zadnji spopad mongolske invazije na Horezmijsko cesarstvo.

Potem ko je njegov oče Mohamed II. umrl na otoku v Kaspijskem jezeru, je Džalal al-Din prevzel naslov horezmšah in se odpravil proti vzhodu. Mongolom je večkrat ušel, prišel do Gaznija in začel zbirati veliko vojsko; nato je v bitki pri Parvanu porazil mongolskega poveljnika Šigija Kutuguja. Ta nepričakovana zmaga je pritegnila pozornost in jezo Džingis-kana, ki je zbral vojsko z najmanj 50.000 možmi in krenil nad šaha, ta pa je zaradi spora o plenu izgubil velik del vojske. Ker se kanu ni mogel več uspešno upirati, se je umaknil proti vzhodu k reki Ind; Mongoli so Horezmijce dohiteli tisto jutro, ko naj bi prečkali Ind.

source.title: Battle of the Indus
paragraphs: The Battle of the Indus was fought on the banks of the Indus River, on 24 November 1221, between the armies commanded by Jalal al-Din of the Khwarazmian Empire, and Genghis Khan of the Mongol Empire. The battle, which resulted in an overwhelming Mongol victory, was the concluding engagement in the Mongol invasion of the Khwarazmian Empire.

After his father Muhammad II had died on an island in the Caspian Sea, Jalal al-Din assumed the title of Khwarazmshah and travelled eastwards. Escaping the Mongols several times, he reached Ghazni and started assembling a large force; he then defeated the Mongol commander Shigi Qutuqu at the Battle of Parwan. This upset victory drew the attention and ire of Genghis Khan, who gathered a force of at least 50,000 and moved towards the Shah, who had lost a large proportion of his force because of a dispute over plunder. Now unable to effectively combat the Khan, he retreated eastwards towards the Indus river; the Mongols caught up to the Khwarazmians on the morning they were due to cross the Indus.

Battle of Tora Bora.headline: Bitka pri Tora Bori
paragraphs: Bitka pri Tora Bori je potekala od 30. novembra do 17. decembra 2001 v okviru ameriške invazije na Afganistan med vojno v Afganistanu. Bojevali so se okoli kompleksa jam Tora Bora v gorovju Safed Koh blizu vzhodne meje Afganistana s Pakistanom. Ameriške, britanske, nemške in zavezniške afganistanske čete so se v bitki bojevale proti Al Kaidi, talibanom, ki so nadzorovali vlado države, in drugim islamskim skrajnežem.

Al Kaida pod vodstvom Osame bin Ladna je 11. septembra 2001 izvedla teroristične samomorilske napade na ZDA. ZDA so hitro začele svetovno »vojno proti terorizmu«, ki je vključevala lov na bin Ladna in invazijo na Afganistan, kjer so talibani Al Kaidi dovolili, da je imela tam sedež.
