Invazija se je začela 7. oktobra; ZDA je podprla mednarodna koalicija.

source.title: Battle of Tora Bora
paragraphs: The Battle of Tora Bora occurred from 30 November to 17 December 2001, as part of the United States invasion of Afghanistan during the war in Afghanistan. It took place around the cave complex of Tora Bora in the Safed Koh mountain range, near Afghanistan's eastern border with Pakistan. In the battle, the U.S., British, German, and allied Afghan troops fought al-Qaeda; the Taliban, who controlled the country's government; and other Islamic extremists.

Led by Osama bin Laden, al-Qaeda conducted terrorist suicide attacks against the U.S. on September 11, 2001. The U.S. quickly launched a global "war on terror", which included a manhunt for bin Laden, and the invasion of Afghanistan, where the Taliban had allowed al-Qaeda to headquarter. The invasion began on October 7; the U.S. was supported by a multinational coalition.

Battle of Tskhinvali.headline: Bitka za Chinvali
paragraphs: Bitka za Chinvali (2008) (gruzijsko: ცხინვალის ბრძოლა; rusko: Бои за Цхинвали) je bila boj za mesto Chinvali, prestolnico samooklicane Republike Južna Osetija. Bila je edina večja bitka rusko-gruzijske vojne. Gruzijske kopenske čete so v mesto vstopile zgodaj zjutraj 8. avgusta 2008. Po treh dneh hudih bojev z južnoosetijsko milico in ruskimi četami so se gruzijske čete zvečer 10. avgusta dokončno umaknile iz mesta. Do 11. avgusta so vse gruzijske čete zapustile Južno Osetijo, ruske sile pa so brez odpora prodrle na nesporno gruzijsko ozemlje.

source.title: Battle of Tskhinvali
paragraphs: The Battle of Tskhinvali (2008) (Georgian: ცხინვალის ბრძოლა; Russian: Бои за Цхинвали) was a fight for the city of Tskhinvali, the capital of the self-proclaimed Republic of South Ossetia. It was the only major battle in the Russo-Georgian War. Georgian ground troops entered the city on early 8 August 2008. After the three-day fierce fighting with South Ossetian militia and Russian troops, Georgian troops finally withdrew from the city on the evening of 10 August. By 11 August, all Georgian troops had left South Ossetia and Russian forces advanced into undisputed Georgia facing no resistance.

Battle of Wandiwash.headline: Bitka pri Vandivašu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Vandivašu je bila bitka v Indiji med Francozi in Britanci leta 1760. Bila je del tretje karnatske vojne med francoskim in britanskim kolonialnim imperijem, ki je bila sama del svetovne sedemletne vojne. Potekala je pri Vandavasiju (Wandiwash je poangležena izgovarjava) v Tamil Naduju. Britanci, ki so dosegli velike pridobitve v Bengalu in Hajderabadu in zbrali velike prihodke, so bili dobro opremljeni za spopad s Francozi pri Vandivašu in so jih porazili.

source.title: Battle of Wandiwash
paragraphs: The Battle of Wandiwash was a battle in India between the French and the British in 1760. The battle was part of the Third Carnatic War fought between the French and British colonial empires, which itself was a part of the global Seven Years' War. It took place at Vandavasi (Wandiwash being the Anglicised pronunciation) in Tamil Nadu. Having made substantial gains in Bengal and Hyderabad, the British, after collecting a large amount of revenue, were fully equipped to face the French in Wandiwash, whom they defeated.

Battle of Xuân Lộc.headline: Bitka pri Xuân Lộcu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Xuân Lộcu (vietnamsko: Trận Xuân Lộc) je bila zadnja velika bitka vietnamske vojne in je potekala pri Xuân Lộcu v provinci Biên Hòa (danes provinca Đồng Nai). Številčno šibkejši Južni Vietnamci so 12 dni, od 9. do 21. aprila 1975, poskušali preprečiti severnovietnamskim silam, da bi zavzele mesto in prodrle proti južnovietnamski prestolnici Saigonu. Vojska Republike Vietnam (ARVN) je za obrambo strateškega križišča Xuân Lộc namenila skoraj vse preostale mobilne sile, zlasti 18. divizijo pod poveljstvom brigadnega generala Lê Minh Đảa, v upanju, da bo zaustavila prodiranje Vietnamske ljudske armade (PAVN). Bitka se je končala, ko je mesto Xuân Lộc zavzel 4. armadni korpus PAVN pod vodstvom generalmajorja Hoàng Cầma.

source.title: Battle of Xuân Lộc
paragraphs: The Battle of Xuân Lộc (Vietnamese: Trận Xuân Lộc) was the last major battle of the Vietnam War that took place at Xuân Lộc, Biên Hòa Province (today Đồng Nai Province). Over a period of 12 days between 9 and 21 April 1975, the outnumbered South Vietnamese attempted to stop the North Vietnamese forces from overrunning the town and breaking through towards South Vietnam's capital, Saigon. The Army of the Republic of Vietnam (ARVN) committed almost all their remaining mobile forces, especially the 18th Division, under Brigadier general Lê Minh Đảo, to the defence of the strategic crossroads town of Xuân Lộc, hoping to stall the People's Army of Vietnam (PAVN) advance. The battle ended when the town of Xuân Lộc was captured by the PAVN 4th Army Corps led by Major general Hoàng Cầm.

Battle of Zhizhi.headline: Bitka z Džidžijem
paragraphs: Bitka z Džidžijem (郅支之戰) se je leta 36 pr. n. št. bila med dinastijo Han in poglavarjem ljudstva Šiungnu Džidži čanjüjem. Džidži je bil poražen in ubit. Bitka se je najverjetneje bila pri Talasu ob reki Talas na kazahstansko-kirgiški meji, kar jo uvršča med najzahodnejše točke, do katerih je kdaj prišla kitajska vojska. Na istem območju je leta 751 n. št. potekala bitka ob Talasu.

source.title: Battle of Zhizhi
paragraphs: The Battle of Zhizhi (郅支之戰) was fought in 36 BC between the Han dynasty and the Xiongnu chieftain Zhizhi Chanyu. Zhizhi was defeated and killed. The battle was probably fought near Talas on the Talas River on the Kazakhstan–Kyrgyzstan border, which makes it one of the westernmost points reached by a Chinese army. The Battle of Talas in 751 AD was fought in the same area.

Bengalski sultanat (srednja bengalščina: শাহী বাঙ্গালা, dobesedno »kraljevi oziroma cesarski Bengal«) je bil poznosrednjeveški sultanat s središčem v pokrajini Bengal na vzhodu Južne Azije med 14. in 16. stoletjem. Bil je prevladujoča sila v delti Gangesa in Brahmaputre, z mrežo mest s kovnicami po vsej regiji. Bengalski sultanat je imel na Indijski podcelini in v Jugovzhodni Aziji vrsto vazalnih držav, med njimi dele Odiše na jugozahodu, dele Biharja na severozahodu, dele Asama na severovzhodu, Arakan na jugovzhodu in Tripuro na vzhodu.
notes: Izpuščena je latinična transliteracija bengalskega imena.

source.title: Bengal Sultanate
paragraphs: The Bengal Sultanate (Middle Bengali: শাহী বাঙ্গালা, romanization: Śāhī Bāṅgālā, lit. 'Royal/Imperial Bengal') was a late medieval sultanate based in the Bengal region in eastern South Asia between the 14th and 16th centuries. It was the dominant power of the Ganges-Brahmaputra Delta, with a network of mint towns spread across the region. The Bengal Sultanate had a circle of vassal states in the Indian subcontinent and Southeast Asia, including parts of Odisha in the southwest, parts of Bihar in the northwest, parts of Assam in the northeast, Arakan in the southeast, and Tripura in the east.

Berar Sultanate.headline: Berarski sultanat
paragraphs: Berarski sultanat je bil zgodnjenovoveški sultanat v Dekanu, ki mu je vladala dinastija Imad Šahi. Enega od petih dekanskih sultanatov je leta 1490 po razpadu Bahmanskega sultanata ustanovil Fathulah Imad-ul-Mulk, ki je bil kanareškega porekla. Leta 1574 si ga je po vdoru priključil Ahmednagarski sultanat.

source.title: Berar Sultanate
paragraphs: The Berar Sultanate was an early modern sultanate located in the Deccan, ruled by the Imad Shahi dynasty. One of the five Deccan sultanates, it was established in 1490 following the disintegration of the Bahmani Sultanate by Fathullah Imad-ul-Mulk, who was of Kanarese origin. It was annexed by the Ahmadnagar Sultanate in 1574 following an invasion.

Bidarski sultanat je bil zgodnjenovoveški sultanat v osrednjem Dekanu, ki mu je vladala dinastija Barid Šahi. Prvotno ozemlje enega od petih dekanskih sultanatov je ustrezalo eni od petih provinc Bahmanskega sultanata, pod vladavino Kasima Barida I. pa je leta 1492 dejansko prevzel državne zadeve Bahmanskega sultanata.

Vodstvo sta prevzela njegova sinova, leta 1504 Amir Barid I. in leta 1542 Ali Barid Šah I. Od 1580. let, po Alijevi smrti, se je na prestolu dinastije zvrstil val naslednikov, ki se je končal leta 1609 z zadnjim sultanom Amirjem Baridom III. Tega je leta 1619 dokončno porazil Ibrahim Adil Šah II. iz Bidžapurskega sultanata in si priključil ozemlje Bidarskega sultanata.

source.title: Bidar Sultanate
paragraphs: The Bidar Sultanate was an early modern sultanate located in the central Deccan, ruled by the Barid Shahi dynasty. One of the five Deccan sultanates, its initial territory corresponded to that of one of the five provinces of the Bahmani Sultanate, and under the rule of Qasim Barid I in 1492 assumed de facto control of state affairs of the Bahmani Sultanate.

Leadership passed to his sons; Amir Barid I in 1504 and Ali Barid Shah I in 1542. Starting from the 1580s as a result of Ali's death, a wave of successions occurred in the rulership of the dynasty which ended in 1609 under the last sultan, Amir Barid III. He was eventually defeated in 1619 by Ibrahim Adil Shah II of the Bijapur Sultanate, who annexed the territory of the Bidar Sultanate into his realm.

Black January.headline: Črni januar
paragraphs: Črni januar (azerbajdžansko: Qara Yanvar), znan tudi kot črna sobota ali januarski pokol, je bil nasilen obračun s protisovjetskimi in protiarmenskimi razpoloženji, azerbajdžanskim nacionalizmom in iredentizmom v Bakuju 19. in 20. januarja 1990, v okviru izrednih razmer med razpadom Sovjetske zveze.

Generalni sekretar Komunistične partije Sovjetske zveze Mihail Gorbačov in obrambni minister Dmitrij Jazov sta trdila, da je bilo vojno stanje nujno, da bi preprečili poskuse azerbajdžanskega osamosvojitvenega gibanja, ki je hotelo strmoglaviti sovjetsko azerbajdžansko vlado. Po uradnih azerbajdžanskih ocenah je bilo ubitih 147 civilistov, 800 ljudi ranjenih, pet pa jih je izginilo.

Vrhovni sovjet Azerbajdžanske SSR je v resoluciji 22. januarja 1990 razglasil, da je odlok predsedstva Vrhovnega sovjeta ZSSR z 19. januarja, s katerim so v Bakuju uvedli izredne razmere in napotili vojsko, pomenil dejanje agresije.

source.title: Black January
paragraphs: Black January (Azerbaijani: Qara Yanvar), also known as Black Saturday or the January Massacre, was a violent crackdown on anti-Soviet and anti-Armenian sentiments, Azerbaijani nationalism, and irredentism in Baku on 19 and 20 January 1990, as part of a state of emergency during the dissolution of the Soviet Union.

General Secretary of the Soviet Communist Party Mikhail Gorbachev and Defence Minister Dmitry Yazov asserted that military law was necessary to thwart efforts by the Azerbaijani independence movement to overthrow the Soviet Azerbaijani government. According to official estimates of Azerbaijan, 147 civilians were killed, 800 people were injured, and five people went missing.

In a resolution of 22 January 1990, the Supreme Soviet of Azerbaijan SSR declared that the decree of the Presidium of the Supreme Soviet of the USSR of 19 January, used to impose emergency rule in Baku and military deployment, constituted an act of aggression.

Izraz Britanski Cejlon označuje posesti Združenega kraljestva na otoku Cejlon, današnji Šrilanki, med letom 1796 in 4. februarjem 1948. Sprva območje ni obsegalo Kraljestva Kandi, ki je bilo protektorat, od leta 1817 do 1948 pa so britanske posesti obsegale ves otok. Obdobje Britanskega Cejlona je zgodovina Šrilanke med letoma 1815 in 1948. Sledilo je padcu Kraljestva Kandi v roke Britanskega imperija, s katerim se je končala več kot 2300 let stara sinhalska monarhija. Britanska oblast na otoku je trajala do leta 1948, ko je država po šrilanškem osamosvojitvenem gibanju znova dobila neodvisnost.

source.title: British Ceylon
paragraphs: British Ceylon refers to the imperial possessions of the United Kingdom in the island of Ceylon, present-day Sri Lanka, between 1796 and 4 February 1948. Initially, the area it covered did not include the Kingdom of Kandy, which was a protectorate, but from 1817 to 1948 the British possessions included the whole island. The British Ceylon period is the history of Sri Lanka between 1815 and 1948. It follows the fall of the Kandyan Kingdom into the hands of the British Empire, ending over 2300 years of Sinhalese monarchy. The British rule on the island lasted until 1948 when the country regained independence following the Sri Lankan independence movement.

British expedition to Tibet.headline: Britanska odprava v Tibet
paragraphs: Britanska odprava v Tibet, znana tudi kot Younghusbandova odprava, se je začela decembra 1903 in trajala do septembra 1904. Odprava je bila dejansko začasna invazija britansko-indijskih oboroženih sil pod okriljem Komisije za tibetansko mejo, katere domnevna naloga je bila vzpostaviti diplomatske odnose in razrešiti spor o meji med Tibetom in Sikimom. Britanci so v 19. stoletju osvojili Burmo in Sikim, s čimer je ves južni bok Tibeta prišel pod nadzor Britanske Indije. Tibetu je vladal 13. dalajlama z vlado Ganden Phodrang kot himalajski državi, ki je bila nominalno pod protektoratom (ali nadoblastjo) kitajske dinastije Čing do revolucije leta 1911, nato pa je sledilo obdobje dejanske tibetanske neodvisnosti (1912–1951).

source.title: British expedition to Tibet
paragraphs: The British expedition to Tibet, also known as the Younghusband expedition, began in December 1903 and lasted until September 1904. The expedition was effectively a temporary invasion by British Indian Armed Forces under the auspices of the Tibet Frontier Commission, whose purported mission was to establish diplomatic relations and resolve the dispute over the border between Tibet and Sikkim. In the nineteenth century, the British had conquered Burma and Sikkim, with the whole southern flank of Tibet coming under the control of the British Indian Empire. Tibet was ruled by the 13th Dalai Lama under the Ganden Phodrang government as a Himalayan state nominally under the protectorate (or suzerainty) of the Chinese Qing dynasty until the 1911 Revolution, after which a period of de facto Tibetan independence (1912–1951) followed.

Burmese–Siamese War (1765–1767).headline: Burmansko-siamska vojna (1765–1767)
paragraphs: Burmansko-siamska vojna 1765–1767, znana tudi kot vojna drugega padca Ayutthaye (tajsko: สงครามคราวเสียกรุงศรีอยุธยาครั้งที่สอง), je bila drugi vojaški spopad med Burmo pod dinastijo Konbaung in Kraljestvom Ayutthaya pod siamsko dinastijo Ban Phlu Luang, ki je trajal od leta 1765 do 1767; vojna je končala 417 let staro Kraljestvo Ayutthaya.

source.title: Burmese–Siamese War (1765–1767)
paragraphs: The Burmese–Siamese War of 1765–1767, also known as the War of the Second Fall of Ayutthaya (Thai: สงครามคราวเสียกรุงศรีอยุธยาครั้งที่สอง) was the second military conflict between Burma under the Konbaung dynasty and Ayutthaya Kingdom under the Siamese Ban Phlu Luang dynasty that lasted from 1765 until 1767; the war ended the 417-year-old Ayutthaya Kingdom.

Kamboška državljanska vojna (kmersko: សង្គ្រាមស៊ីវិលកម្ពុជា) je bila državljanska vojna v Kambodži, v kateri so se Rdeči Kmeri bojevali proti vladi Kraljevine Kambodže. Po državnem udaru marca 1970 se je spopad spremenil: Rdeči Kmeri in sile, zveste Norodomu Sihanuku, ki sta jih zdaj podpirala Severni Vietnam in Kitajska, so se bojevali proti Kmerski republiki, ki so jo podpirale Združene države in Južni Vietnam.

Spopad je bil del vietnamske vojne. Severnovietnamska Vietnamska ljudska armada (PAVN) je sodelovala, da bi zaščitila svoja oporišča na vzhodu Kambodže, ki so bila ključna za njeno vojaško delovanje v Južnem Vietnamu. Kamboški državni poglavar princ Norodom Sihanuk je to navzočnost sprva toleriral, toda domači odpor in pomoč Kitajske in Severnega Vietnama protivladnim Rdečim Kmerom sta ga pripravila do tega, da je za pomoč pri zaustavitvi tega zaprosil Sovjetsko zvezo.
notes: Izpuščena je latinična transliteracija (UNGEGN).

source.title: Cambodian Civil War
paragraphs: The Cambodian Civil War (Khmer: សង្គ្រាមស៊ីវិលកម្ពុជា, UNGEGN: Sângkréam Sĭvĭl Kâmpŭchéa) was a civil war in Cambodia fought by the Khmer Rouge against the government of the Kingdom of Cambodia. Following the March 1970 coup, the conflict shifted as the Khmer Rouge and forces loyal to Norodom Sihanouk, now supported by North Vietnam and China, fought against the Khmer Republic, which was supported by the United States and South Vietnam.

The conflict was part of the Vietnam War. The North Vietnamese People's Army of Vietnam (PAVN) was involved to protect its bases in eastern Cambodia, which were crucial to its military effort in South Vietnam. This presence was initially tolerated by Prince Norodom Sihanouk, the Cambodian head of state, but domestic resistance combined with China and North Vietnam aiding the anti-government Khmer Rouge caused him to request help from the Soviet Union to stop this.

Cambodian–Dutch War.headline: Kamboško-nizozemska vojna
paragraphs: Kamboško-nizozemsko vojno (nizozemsko: Cambodjaans-Nederlandse Oorlog; kmersko: សង្គ្រាមកម្ពុជា-ហូឡង់) v letih 1642–1644 je sprožil državni udar, s katerim je na prestol prišel nov kamboški kralj, ki je s pomočjo malajskih trgovcev, živečih v državi, prestopil v islam. Novi kralj je ukazal pokol uslužbencev Nizozemske vzhodnoindijske družbe in nato porazil nizozemske sile, poslane, da bi se Kambodžanom maščevale.

source.title: Cambodian–Dutch War
paragraphs: The Cambodian–Dutch War (Dutch: Cambodjaans-Nederlandse Oorlog; Khmer: សង្គ្រាមកម្ពុជា-ហូឡង់) from 1642–1644 was a conflict sparked by a coup which brought a new Cambodian King to the throne who converted to Islam with the help of Malay traders resident in the country. The new King initiated a massacre of Dutch East India Company employees and subsequently defeated the Dutch forces sent to extract retribution from the Cambodians.

Kamboško-vietnamska vojna je bila oborožen spopad med Demokratično Kampučijo in Socialistično republiko Vietnam ter njunimi zavezniki od leta 1978 do 1989. Začela se je decembra 1978 z vietnamsko invazijo na Kambodžo, ki je strmoglavila režim Rdečih Kmerov, končala pa leta 1989 z umikom vietnamskih sil iz Kambodže. Ta spopad hladne vojne je bil del tretje indokitajske vojne in kitajsko-sovjetskega razkola, pri čemer je Sovjetska zveza podpirala Vietnam, Kitajska pa Kampučijo.

source.title: Cambodian–Vietnamese War
paragraphs: The Cambodian–Vietnamese War was an armed conflict from 1978 to 1989 between Democratic Kampuchea and the Socialist Republic of Vietnam, and their respective allies. It began in December 1978, with a Vietnamese invasion of Cambodia which toppled the Khmer Rouge regime and ended in 1989 with the withdrawal of Vietnamese forces from Cambodia. This Cold War conflict was part of the Third Indochina War and Sino-Soviet split with the Soviet Union supporting Vietnam and China supporting Kampuchea.

Karnatski sultanat, znan tudi kot Karnatska država ali država Arkot, je bil kraljestvo v južni Indiji od približno leta 1690 do 1855, ki mu je vladal muslimanski navab pod pravno pristojnostjo hajderabadskega nizama, vse do njihovega propada. Prestolnica je bila sprva v Arkotu v današnji indijski zvezni državi Tamil Nadu. Njihova vladavina je pomembno obdobje v zgodovini Karnatika in Koromandelske obale, v katerem je Mogulsko cesarstvo popustilo pred vse večjim vplivom Marathov, pozneje pa je nastala Britanska Indija.

source.title: Carnatic Sultanate
paragraphs: The Carnatic Sultanate, also known as Carnatic State or Arcot State, was a kingdom in southern India between about 1690 and 1855, ruled by a Muslim nawab under the legal purview of the Nizam of Hyderabad, until their demise. They initially had their capital at Arcot in the present-day Indian state of Tamil Nadu. Their rule is an important period in the history of the Carnatic and Coromandel Coast regions, in which the Mughal Empire gave way to the rising influence of the Maratha India, and later the emergence of the British India.

Carnatic wars.headline: Karnatske vojne
paragraphs: Karnatske vojne so bile vrsta vojaških spopadov sredi 18. stoletja v indijski obalni pokrajini Karnatik, ki je bila odvisna od Hajderabada. Prve karnatske vojne so se bile med letoma 1740 in 1748.

V spopade so bili vpleteni številni nominalno neodvisni vladarji in njihovi vazali, šlo je za boje za nasledstvo in ozemlje, vključevali pa so tudi diplomatski in vojaški boj med Francosko vzhodnoindijsko družbo in britansko Vzhodnoindijsko družbo. Bojevali so se predvsem na ozemljih mogulske Indije s pomočjo različnih razdrobljenih tvorb, zvestih »velikemu mogulu«.

Zaradi teh vojaških spopadov je britanska Vzhodnoindijska družba vzpostavila prevlado med evropskimi trgovskimi družbami v Indiji. Francoska družba je bila potisnjena v kot in omejena predvsem na Pondicherry. Prevlada Vzhodnoindijske družbe je nazadnje privedla do tega, da je britanska družba nadzorovala večino Indije, in nazadnje do vzpostavitve Britanske Indije.

source.title: Carnatic wars
paragraphs: The Carnatic wars were a series of military conflicts in the middle of the 18th century in India's coastal Carnatic region, a dependency of Hyderabad State, India. The first Carnatic wars were fought between 1740 and 1748.

The conflicts involved numerous nominally independent rulers and their vassals, struggles for succession and territory, and furthermore included a diplomatic and military struggle between the French East India Company and the British East India Company. They were mainly fought within the territories of Mughal India with the assistance of various fragmented polities loyal to the "Great Moghul".

As a result of these military contests, the British East India Company established its dominance among the European trading companies within India. The French company was pushed to a corner and was confined primarily to Pondicherry. The East India Company's dominance eventually led to control by the British Company over most of India and eventually to the establishment of the British Raj.

Cedī (tribe).headline: Čedi
paragraphs: Čedi (sanskrtsko: Cedī) je bilo starodavno indoarijsko pleme osrednje Indije, katerega obstoj je izpričan v železni dobi. Pripadnike plemena Čedi so imenovali Čaidje in so bili organizirani v kraljestvo, ki se je prav tako imenovalo Čedi.

source.title: Cedī (tribe)
paragraphs: Cedī (Sanskrit: Cedī) was an ancient Indo-Aryan tribe of central India whose existence is attested during the Iron Age. The members of the Cedī tribe were named the Caidyas, and were organised into a kingdom, itself also called Cedī.

Dinastija Čalukja je bila klasična indijska dinastija, ki je med 6. in 12. stoletjem vladala velikemu delu južne in osrednje Indije. V tem obdobju so vladale tri sorodne, a ločene dinastije. Najstarejša, znana kot »badamijski Čalukje«, je od sredine 6. stoletja vladala iz Vatapija (današnjega Badamija). Badamijski Čalukje so začeli uveljavljati neodvisnost, ko je propadalo kraljestvo Kadamba iz Banavasija, in se hitro povzpeli v času vladanja Pulakešina II. Po njegovi smrti so vzhodni Čalukje postali samostojno kraljestvo na vzhodu Dekana in so do približno 11. stoletja vladali iz Vengija. Na zahodu Dekana je vzpon Raštrakut sredi 8. stoletja zasenčil badamijske Čalukje, ki so jih konec 10. stoletja obnovili njihovi potomci, zahodni Čalukje. Ti so do konca 12. stoletja vladali iz Kaljanija (današnjega Basavakaljana).
notes: Izpuščena je izgovarjava (IPA).

source.title: Chalukya dynasty
paragraphs: The Chalukya dynasty (Kannada: [tʃaːlukjɐ]) was a Classical Indian dynasty that ruled large parts of southern and central India between the 6th and the 12th centuries. During this period, they ruled as three related yet individual dynasties. The earliest dynasty, known as the "Badami Chalukyas", ruled from Vatapi (modern Badami) from the middle of the 6th century. The Badami Chalukyas began to assert their independence at the decline of the Kadamba kingdom of Banavasi and rapidly rose to prominence during the reign of Pulakeshin II. After the death of Pulakeshin II, the Eastern Chalukyas became an independent kingdom in the eastern Deccan. They ruled from Vengi until about the 11th century. In the western Deccan, the rise of the Rashtrakutas in the middle of the 8th century eclipsed the Chalukyas of Badami before being revived by their descendants, the Western Chalukyas, in the late 10th century. These Western Chalukyas ruled from Kalyani (modern Basavakalyan) until the end of the 12th century.

Champasak.headline: Champasak
paragraphs: Champasak se lahko nanaša na naslednje v Laosu:
provinco Champasak na jugozahodu Laosa,
mesto Champasak.
notes: Zapis je povezan z razločitveno stranjo; prevedeno je kot seznam, kot stoji.

source.title: Champasak
paragraphs: Champasak may refer to these in Laos:
Champasak province, a province in southwestern Laos
Champasak (town)

Čandele (imperij Čandela) so bili indijska dinastija v osrednji Indiji. Čandele so med 9. in 13. stoletjem vladali velikemu delu pokrajine Bundelkhand (tedaj imenovane Džedžakabhukti). Pripadali so radžputskemu klanu Čandel.

Čandele so sprva vladali kot fevdalni podložniki Gurdžara-Pratihar iz Kanjakubdže (Kannaudža). Čandelski vladar iz 10. stoletja Jašovarman je postal praktično neodvisen, čeprav je še naprej priznaval pratiharsko nadoblast. Do časa njegovega naslednika Dhange so Čandele postali suverena sila. Njihova moč je naraščala in upadala v bojih s sosednjimi dinastijami, zlasti s Paramarami iz Malve in Kalačuriji iz Tripurija. Od 11. stoletja so se Čandele soočali z vpadi severnih muslimanskih dinastij, med njimi Gaznavidov in Guridov. Čandelska moč se je dejansko končala okoli začetka 13. stoletja po vpadih Čahaman in Guridov.

source.title: Chandela Empire
paragraphs: The Chandela Empire was an Indian dynasty in Central India. The Chandelas ruled much of the Bundelkhand region (then called Jejakabhukti) between the 9th and the 13th centuries. They belonged to the Chandel clan of the Rajputs.

The Chandelas initially ruled as feudatories of the Gurjara-Pratiharas of Kanyakubja (Kannauj). The 10th century Chandela ruler Yashovarman became practically independent, although he continued to acknowledge the Pratihara suzerainty. By the time of his successor Dhanga, the Chandelas had become a sovereign power. Their power rose and declined as they fought battles with the neighbouring dynasties, especially the Paramaras of Malwa and the Kalachuris of Tripuri. From the 11th century onwards, the Chandelas faced raids by the northern Muslim dynasties, including the Ghaznavids and the Ghurids. The Chandela power effectively ended around the beginning of the 13th century, following Chahamana and Ghurid invasions.

Chandra dynasty.headline: Dinastija Čandra
paragraphs: Dinastija Čandra je bila budistična dinastija iz jugovzhodnega Bengala na Indijski podcelini, ki je vladala območju Samatata v Bengalu in delom Arakana. Pozneje je na severu mejila na imperij Pala. Vladarji kraljestva Čandra so bili budisti. Tirumulajski napis dinastije Čola omenja kralje dinastije Čandra kot kralje Vangaladeše. Dinastija je nastala okoli 4. stoletja n. št.

source.title: Chandra dynasty
paragraphs: The Chandra dynasty was a Buddhist dynasty, originating from the South-east Bengal region of Indian subcontinent, which ruled the Samatata area of Bengal, as well as parts of Arakan Later it was a neighbour to the Pala Empire to the north. Rulers of Chandra kingdom were adherents of Buddhism. The Kings of Chandra dynasty were identified as the kings of Vangaladesha in the Tirumulai inscription of Chola dynasty. The dynasty was founded around the 4th century AD.

Chauhan Dynasty.headline: Dinastija Čauhan
paragraphs: Dinastija Čauhan je dinastija, povezana z različnimi vladajočimi radžputskimi rodbinami v današnji indijski zvezni državi Radžastan od 7. stoletja naprej.

source.title: Chauhan dynasty
paragraphs: The Chauhan dynasty are a dynasty associated with various ruling Rajput families in the present-day Indian state of Rajasthan from seventh century onwards.

Chaulukya dynasty.headline: Dinastija Čaulukja
paragraphs: Dinastija Čaulukja (IAST: Caulukya), imenovana tudi dinastija Solanki, je bila dinastija, ki je med približno letoma 940 in 1244 n. št. vladala delom današnjega Gudžarata in Radžastana na severozahodu Indije. Prestolnica je bila Anahilavada (današnji Patan). Občasno je njena oblast segala tudi v pokrajino Malva v današnjem Madhja Pradešu. V ljudski književnosti rodbino poznajo tudi kot »dinastijo Solanki«. Pripadali so radžputskemu klanu Solanki.

source.title: Chaulukya dynasty
paragraphs: The Chaulukya dynasty (IAST: Caulukya), also Solanki dynasty, was a dynasty that ruled parts of what are now Gujarat and Rajasthan in north-western India, between c. 940 CE and c. 1244 CE. Their capital was located at Anahilavada (modern Patan). At times, their rule extended to the Malwa region in present-day Madhya Pradesh. The family is also known as the "Solanki dynasty" in the vernacular literature. They belonged to the Solanki clan of Rajputs.

Chenla.headline: Čenla
paragraphs: Čenla ali Ženla (kitajsko: 真臘; kmersko: ចេនឡា) je kitajsko ime za vazala kraljestva Funan in predhodnika Kmerskega imperija, ki je obstajal od približno konca 6. do začetka 9. stoletja v Indokini. Ime je v 13. stoletju še uporabljal kitajski odposlanec Džov Daguan, avtor dela Šege Kambodže. Pojavlja se tudi na zemljevidu Mao Kun. Sodobno zgodovinopisje pa ime uporablja izključno za obdobje od konca 6. do začetka 9. stoletja, ki ga zgodovinarji imenujejo predangkorsko obdobje kamboške zgodovine. Ni jasno, ali je Čenla sploh kdaj obstajala kot enotno kraljestvo ali pa gre za napačno predstavo kitajskih kronistov. Večina sodobnih zgodovinarjev meni, da je bila »Čenla« v resnici le vrsta ohlapnih in začasnih zvez kneževin iz predangkorskega obdobja.
notes: Izpuščeni so zapisi v pinjinu in po Wade-Gilesu, kmerska transliteracija in izgovarjava (IPA).

source.title: Chenla
paragraphs: Chenla or Zhenla (Chinese: 真臘; pinyin: Zhēnlà; Wade–Giles: Chen-la; Khmer: ចេនឡា, romanized: Chénla, Khmer pronunciation: [ceːnlaː]) is the Chinese designation for the vassal of the kingdom of Funan preceding the Khmer Empire that existed from around the late 6th to the early 9th century in Indochina. The name was still used in the 13th century by the Chinese envoy Zhou Daguan, author of The Customs of Cambodia. It appears on the Mao Kun map. However, modern historiography applies the name exclusively to the period from the late 6th to the early 9th century. This period of Cambodian history is known by historians as the Pre-Angkor period. It is doubted whether Chenla ever existed as a unitary kingdom, or if this is a misconception by Chinese chroniclers. Most modern historians assert that "Chenla" was in fact just a series of loose and temporary confederations of principalities in the pre-Angkor period.

Chera dynasty.headline: Dinastija Čera
paragraphs: Dinastija Čera (ali Cēra), znana tudi kot Keralaputra ali Kedalaputho, je iz zgodnjega zgodovinskega oziroma sangamskega obdobja južne Indije vladala delom današnjih zveznih držav Kerala in Tamil Nadu. Čere, ki jih poleg Čol in Pandj štejejo med mu-ventar (tri kronane kralje) Tamilakama (tamilske dežele), omenjajo viri že v 3. stoletju pr. n. št. Dežela Čer je ležala geografsko ugodno na konici Indijskega polotoka in je lahko imela korist od pomorske trgovine po obsežnih mrežah Indijskega oceana. Več virov izpričuje izmenjavo začimb, zlasti črnega popra, z bližnjevzhodnimi ali grško-rimskimi trgovci. Vpliv Čer je do konca zgodnjega zgodovinskega obdobja v južni Indiji segal čez osrednjo Keralo in zahodni Tamil Nadu.
notes: Izpuščena je izgovarjava (IPA).

source.title: Chera dynasty
paragraphs: The Chera dynasty (or Cēra, IPA: [t͡ʃeːɾɐ]), also known as Keralaputra, Kedalaputho, from the early historic or the Sangam period in southern India, ruled over parts of present-day states Kerala and Tamil Nadu. The Cheras, known as one of the mu-ventar (the Three Crowned Kings) of Tamilakam (the Tamil country) alongside the Cholas and Pandyas, have been documented as early as the third century BCE. The Chera country was geographically well placed at the tip of the Indian peninsula to profit from maritime trade via the extensive Indian Ocean networks. Exchange of spices, especially black pepper, with Middle Eastern or Graeco-Roman merchants is attested to in several sources. Chera influence extended over central Kerala and western Tamil Nadu until the end of the early historic period in southern India.

Kitajska državljanska vojna se je bila med vlado Republike Kitajske (ROC), ki jo je vodil Kuomintang (KMT), in Komunistično partijo Kitajske (KPK). Oborožen spopad je s presledki trajal od 1. avgusta 1927 do zmage komunistov, po kateri se je Kuomintang 7. decembra 1949 umaknil na Tajvan.

Vojno navadno delimo na dve fazi s premorom vmes. V letih 1926 in 1927 sta KMT in KPK, povezana v prvi enotni fronti, izvedla zelo uspešen pohod proti vojskovodjem v osrednji Kitajski, severno ekspedicijo. KPK ga imenuje prva revolucionarna državljanska vojna. Enotna fronta je razpadla in 1. avgusta 1927 je izbruhnila vojna med KMT in KPK. KPK jo imenuje druga revolucionarna državljanska vojna; trajala je do leta 1937. Od leta 1937 do 1945 so sovražnosti večinoma mirovale, saj se je druga enotna fronta, nazadnje s pomočjo zaveznikov iz druge svetovne vojne, bojevala proti japonski invaziji na Kitajsko. Oboroženi spopadi med skupinama pa so bili še vedno pogosti.

source.title: Chinese Civil War
paragraphs: The Chinese Civil War was fought between the government of the Republic of China (ROC), led by the Kuomintang (KMT), and the Chinese Communist Party (CCP). Armed conflict continued intermittently from 1 August 1927 until Communist victory that led to the Kuomintang's retreat to Taiwan on 7 December 1949.

The war is generally divided into two phases with an interlude. In 1926 and 1927, the KMT and the CCP, allied with one another in the First United Front, had carried out a very successful campaign, the Northern Expedition, against warlords in central China. The CCP calls this the First Revolutionary Civil War. The united front broke up and war broke out between the KMT and the CCP on 1 August 1927. The CCP calls this the Second Revolutionary Civil War; it lasted until 1937. From 1937 to 1945, hostilities were mostly put on hold as the Second United Front fought the Japanese invasion of China with eventual help from the Allies of World War II. However, armed clashes between the groups remained common.

Čolski imperij, pogosto imenovan tudi cesarski Čole, je bil srednjeveški talasokratski imperij s središčem v južni Indiji, ki mu je vladala dinastija Čola in ki je obsegal čezmorska ozemlja, protektorate in vplivna območja v Jugovzhodni Aziji.

Moč in ugled, ki so ju imeli Čole na vrhuncu med silami Južne, Jugovzhodne in Vzhodne Azije, izpričujejo njihovi pohodi do Gangesa, pomorski napadi na mesta imperija Srividžaja na Sumatri in ponavljajoča se poslanstva na Kitajsko. Čolsko ladjevje je pomenilo vrhunec pomorskih zmogljivosti stare Indije. Okoli leta 1070 so Čole izgubili skoraj vsa čezmorska ozemlja, poznejši Čole (1070–1279) pa so še naprej vladali delom južne Indije. Čolski imperij je začel propadati v začetku 13. stoletja z vzponom dinastije Pandja, ki je nazadnje povzročila njegov padec.
notes: Izpuščena je izgovarjava (IPA).

source.title: Chola Empire
paragraphs: The Chola Empire (Tamil: [t͡ʃoːɻɐɾ, soːɻɐɾ]), which is often referred to as the Imperial Cholas, was a medieval thalassocratic empire based in southern India that was ruled by the Chola dynasty, and comprised overseas dominions, protectorates and spheres of influence in southeast Asia.

The power and the prestige the Cholas had among political powers in South, Southeast, and East Asia at its peak is evident in their expeditions to the Ganges, naval raids on cities of the Srivijaya Empire on the island of Sumatra, and their repeated embassies to China. The Chola fleet represented the peak of ancient Indian maritime capacity. Around 1070, the Cholas began to lose almost all of their overseas territories but the later Cholas (1070–1279) continued to rule portions of southern India. The Chola Empire went into decline at the beginning of the 13th century with the rise of the Pandyan dynasty, which ultimately caused the Chola's downfall.

Kampanja v Kočinčini je bila vrsta vojaških operacij med letoma 1858 in 1862, ki jih je skupna pomorska ekspedicijska sila v imenu Francoskega cesarstva in Kraljevine Španije izvedla proti vietnamski državi iz obdobja dinastije Nguyễn. Bila je uvodni spopad francoske osvojitve Vietnama.

Sprva je bila omejena kazenska odprava zaradi usmrtitve dveh španskih katoliških misijonarjev v Đại Namu, a je častihlepni francoski cesar Napoleon III. odobril pošiljanje vse večjih kontingentov, ki so si podredili ozemlje Đại Nama in vzpostavili francosko gospodarsko in vojaško prevlado. Vojna se je končala z ustanovitvijo francoske kolonije Kočinčina in začela skoraj stoletje francoske kolonialne vladavine v Vietnamu in sploh v Indokini.

source.title: Cochinchina campaign
paragraphs: The Cochinchina campaign was a series of military operations between 1858 and 1862, launched by a joint naval expedition force on behalf of the French Empire and the Kingdom of Spain against the Nguyễn period Vietnamese state. It was the opening conflict of the French conquest of Vietnam.

Initially a limited punitive expedition against the execution of two Spanish Catholic missionaries in Đại Nam, the ambitious French emperor Napoleon III however, authorized the deployment of increasingly larger contingents, that subdued Đại Nam territory and established French economic and military dominance. The war concluded with the founding of the French colony of Cochinchina and inaugurated nearly a century of French colonial rule in Vietnam in particular and Indochina in general.

Convention on the legal status of the Ca.headline: Konvencija o pravnem statusu Kaspijskega jezera
paragraphs: Konvencija o pravnem statusu Kaspijskega jezera je pogodba, ki so jo 12. avgusta 2018 v Aktauu v Kazahstanu podpisali predsedniki Rusije, Kazahstana, Azerbajdžana, Irana in Turkmenistana.

source.title: Convention on the legal status of the Caspian Sea
paragraphs: The Convention on the legal status of the Caspian Sea is a treaty signed in Aktau, Kazakhstan, on 12 August 2018 by the presidents of Russia, Kazakhstan, Azerbaijan, Iran and Turkmenistan.

Danish India.headline: Danska Indija
paragraphs: Z imenom Danska Indija (dansko: Dansk Ostindien, dobesedno »Danska vzhodna Indija«) so označevali utrdbe in trgovske postojanke Danske-Norveške (po letu 1814 Danske) na Indijski podcelini, ki so bile del danskih čezmorskih kolonij. Danska je imela kolonialne posesti v Indiji več kot 200 let, med njimi mesto Tharangambadi v današnji zvezni državi Tamil Nadu, Serampore v današnjem Zahodnem Bengalu in Nikobarske otoke, ki so danes del indijskega zveznega ozemlja Andamanski in Nikobarski otoki. Danska navzočnost v Indiji je bila za velike evropske sile nepomembna, saj ni pomenila ne vojaške ne trgovske grožnje. Danski podvigi v Indiji so imeli, kot drugod, praviloma premalo kapitala in nikoli niso mogli obvladovati ali monopolizirati trgovskih poti, kot so to zmogli britanski, francoski in portugalski.

source.title: Danish India
paragraphs: Danish India (Danish: Dansk Ostindien, lit. 'Danish East India') was the name given to the forts and factories of Denmark–Norway (Denmark after 1814) in the Indian subcontinent, forming part of the Danish overseas colonies. Denmark held colonial possessions in India for more than 200 years, including the town of Tharangambadi in present-day Tamil Nadu state, Serampore in present-day West Bengal, and the Nicobar Islands, currently part of India's union territory of the Andaman and Nicobar Islands. The Danish presence in India was of little significance to the major European powers as they presented neither a military nor a mercantile threat. Danish ventures in India, as elsewhere, were typically undercapitalized and never able to dominate or monopolize trade routes in the same way that British, French, and Portuguese ventures could.

Day of Thirst.headline: Dan žeje
paragraphs: »Dan žeje« (arabsko: ﻳﻮﻢ ﺍلعطش) je ime, ki ga arabsko zgodovinopisje tradicionalno daje bitki leta 724 med Turgeškim kaganatom in Omajadskim kalifatom na bregovih Sirdarje v Transoksaniji (v današnjem Tadžikistanu v Srednji Aziji). Omajadska vojska pod poveljstvom Muslima ibn Saida al-Kilabija je bila na pohodu v Ferganski dolini, ko je izvedela, da Turgeši napredujejo. Arabci so se takoj začeli naglo umikati proti Sirdarji, turgeška konjenica pa jih je zasledovala in nadlegovala. Po 11 dneh je omajadska vojska nazadnje prišla do reke, kjer se je znašla ujeta med Turgeši in silami domačih transoksanskih kneževin. Arabcem se je vseeno uspelo prebiti in prečkati reko do Hudžanda. Omajadski poraz je privedel do zloma muslimanske oblasti nad velikim delom regije, ki je do okoli leta 740 ostala sporno ozemlje, za katero so se bojevali Arabci in Turgeši.
notes: Izpuščena je latinična transliteracija arabskega imena.

source.title: Day of Thirst
paragraphs: The "Day of Thirst" (Arabic: ﻳﻮﻢ ﺍلعطش, romanized: Yawm al-aṭash) is the name traditionally given in Arabic historiography to a battle fought in 724 between the Turkic Türgesh Khaganate and the Umayyad Caliphate on the banks of the Syr Darya river, in Transoxiana (in modern Tajikistan, Central Asia). The Umayyad army, under Muslim ibn Sa'id al-Kilabi, was campaigning in the Ferghana Valley when it learned of the Türgesh advance. Immediately, the Arabs began a hasty retreat to the Syr Darya, pursued and harassed by the Türgesh cavalry. Finally, after 11 days, the Umayyad army reached the river, where it was caught between the Türgesh and the forces of the native Transoxianian principalities. Nevertheless, the Arabs managed to break through and cross the river to Khujand. The Umayyad defeat led to the collapse of Muslim rule over much of the region, which until c. 740 remained disputed territory, with both the Arabs and the Türgesh fighting for control over it.

Duransko dinastijo, imenovano tudi dinastija Sadozaj, je leta 1747 v Kandaharju v Afganistanu ustanovil Ahmad Šah Durani. Združil je vsa paštunska plemena in ustvaril Duranski imperij, ki je na vrhuncu obsegal današnji Afganistan in Pakistan ter dele severovzhodnega Irana, vzhodnega Turkmenistana in severozahodne Indije, vključno s Kašmirsko dolino. Duranije je leta 1823 zamenjala dinastija Barakzaj.

Ahmad Šah in njegovi potomci so izhajali iz podklana Sadozaj veje Popalzaj Duranijev (nekoč znanih kot Abdali), zato so bili drugi paštunski vladarji Kandaharja za dinastijo Hotaki. Durani so v drugi polovici 18. stoletja izstopali predvsem zaradi vodstva Ahmada Šaha Duranija.

source.title: Durrani dynasty
paragraphs: The Durrani dynasty, also called the Sadozai dynasty, was founded in 1747 by Ahmad Shah Durrani at Kandahar, Afghanistan. He united all Pashtun tribes and created the Durrani Empire. which at its peak included the modern-day Afghanistan, Pakistan, as well as some parts of northeastern Iran, eastern Turkmenistan, and northwestern India, including the Kashmir Valley. The Durranis were replaced by the Barakzai dynasty in 1823.

Ahmad Shah and his descendants were from the Sadozai subclan of Popalzai line of the Durranis (formerly known as Abdalis), making them the second Pashtun rulers of Kandahar after the Hotak dynasty. The Durranis were notable in the second half of the 18th century mainly due to the leadership of Ahmad Shah Durrani.

Duranski imperij, pogovorno znan tudi kot Kraljevina Afganistan, Afganski imperij ali Sadozajsko kraljestvo, je bil afganski imperij, ki ga je leta 1747 ustanovil Ahmad Šah Durani iz paštunskega plemena Durani. Segal je čez dele Srednje Azije, Iranske planote in Indijske podceline. Na vrhuncu je obsegal današnji Afganistan, velik del Pakistana, dele severovzhodnega in jugovzhodnega Irana, vzhodni Turkmenistan in severozahodno Indijo. Duranski imperij velja ob Osmanskem cesarstvu za enega najpomembnejših islamskih imperijev druge polovice 18. stoletja.

source.title: Durrani Empire
paragraphs: The Durrani Empire, colloquially known as the Kingdom of Afghanistan, the Afghan Empire, or the Sadozai Kingdom, was an Afghan empire founded in 1747 by Ahmad Shah Durrani, of the Pashtun Durrani tribe. The empire spanned parts of Central Asia, the Iranian plateau, and the Indian subcontinent. At its peak, it ruled over present-day Afghanistan, much of Pakistan, parts of northeastern and southeastern Iran, eastern Turkmenistan, and northwestern India. Alongside the Ottoman Empire, the Durrani Empire is considered one of the most significant Islamic empires of the second half of the 18th century.

Early Cholas.headline: Zgodnji Čole
paragraphs: Zgodnji Čole so bili tamilsko kraljestvo dinastije Čola v predsangamskem in posangamskem obdobju (600 pr. n. št.–300 n. št.). Bilo je eno od treh glavnih kraljestev Tamilakama. Njihovi zgodnji prestolnici sta bili Urajur oziroma Tiručirapali in Kaveripatinam. Tako kot zgodovina Pandj in Čer sega tudi zgodovina Čol v čas, ko je bilo pisnih zapisov malo.

source.title: Early Cholas
paragraphs: The Early Cholas were a Tamil kingdom of the Chola dynasty - pre and post Sangam period (600 BCE–300 CE). It was one of the three main kingdoms of Tamilakam. Their early capitals were Urayur or Tiruchirapalli and Kaveripattinam. Along with the Pandyas and the Cheras, the Chola history goes back to the period when written records were scarce.

Early Lý dynasty.headline: Zgodnja dinastija Lý
paragraphs: Zgodnja dinastija Lý (vietnamsko: nhà Tiền Lý; chữ Nôm: 茹前李), v zgodovinopisju znana tudi kot prejšnja ali prvotna dinastija Lý, uradno Vạn Xuân (chữ Hán: 萬春; »neštete pomladi«) ali Nam Việt (chữ Hán: 南越; »južni Việt«), je bila vietnamska dinastija, ki je obstajala od leta 544 do 602. Njen ustanovitelj Lý Bí je prevzel naslov »cesar južnega Vieta«, ki so ga pozneje skrajšali v »južni cesar« (Lý Nam Đế). Prestolnica je bila Long Biên na območju današnjega Hanoja.

source.title: Early Lý dynasty
paragraphs: The Early Lý dynasty (Vietnamese: nhà Tiền Lý; chữ Nôm: 茹前李), also known in historiography as the Former Lý dynasty or Anterior Lý dynasty, officially Vạn Xuân (chữ Hán: 萬春; "Myriad Spring") or Nam Việt (chữ Hán: 南越; "Southern Việt"), was a dynasty of Vietnam that existed from AD 544 to 602. Its founder Lý Bí assumed the title of "Emperor of Southern Việt", which was later shortened to "Southern Emperor" (Lý Nam Đế). The capital was located at Long Biên within modern-day Hanoi.

Early Pandyas.headline: Zgodnji Pandje
paragraphs: Zgodnji Pandje iz sangamskega obdobja so bili eno od treh glavnih tamilskih kraljestev, poleg Čol in dinastije Čera. Tako kot o mnogih drugih kraljestvih iz tega obdobja (pred letom 200 pr. n. št.) večina podatkov o zgodnjih Pandjah prihaja do sodobnih zgodovinarjev predvsem iz književnih virov ter nekaj epigrafskih, arheoloških in numizmatičnih dokazov. Prestolnica zgodnjega pandjanskega kraljestva je bila sprva Korkai v Thuthukudiju, pod vladavino Nedundželijana I. pa so jo preselili v Kudal (današnji Madurai).

source.title: Early Pandyan kingdom
paragraphs: The Early Pandyas of the Sangam period were one of the three main kingdoms of the Tamils, the other two being the Cholas, and Cheras dynasty. As with many other kingdoms around this period (earlier than 200 BCE), most of the information about the Early Pandyas come to modern historians mainly through literary sources and some epigraphic, archaeological and numismatic evidence. The capital of the Early Pandyan kingdom was initially Korkai, Thoothukudi and was later moved to Koodal (now Madurai) during the reign of Nedunjeliyan I.

Vzhodni Turkestan (ujgursko: شەرقىي تۈركىستان, Шәрқий Туркистан) je ohlapno opredeljena geografska regija na severozahodu Ljudske republike Kitajske, na stičišču Vzhodne in Srednje Azije. Izraz so v 19. stoletju skovali ruski turkologi, med njimi Nikita Bičurin, ki so z njim hoteli nadomestiti običajni zahodni izraz za regijo, »Kitajski Turkestan«, ki se je nanašal na Tarimsko kotlino na jugu Šinjianga. Od 17. stoletja je bilo ujgursko ime za Tarimsko kotlino Altišahr, kar v ujgurščini pomeni »šest mest«. Ujguri so Tarimsko kotlino imenovali tudi »Yettishar« (»sedem mest«) in celo »Sekkizshahr« (»osem mest«). Kitajske dinastije od dinastije Han do dinastije Tang so delno prekrivajoče se območje imenovale »Zahodne pokrajine«.
notes: Izpuščen je latinični zapis ujgurskega imena (ULY).

source.title: East Turkestan
paragraphs: East Turkestan or East Turkistan (Uyghur: شەرقىي تۈركىستان, ULY: Sherqiy Türkistan, UKY: Шәрқий Туркистан) is a loosely defined geographical region in the northwestern part of the People's Republic of China, on the cross roads of East and Central Asia. The term was coined in the 19th century by Russian Turkologists, including Nikita Bichurin, who intended the name to replace the common Western term for the region, "Chinese Turkestan", which referred to the Tarim Basin in Southern Xinjiang. Beginning in the 17th century, Altishahr, which means "Six Cities" in Uyghur, became the Uyghur name for the Tarim Basin. Uyghurs also called the Tarim Basin "Yettishar," which means "Seven Cities," and even "Sekkizshahr", which means "Eight Cities" in Uyghur. Chinese dynasties from the Han dynasty to the Tang dynasty had called an overlapping area the "Western Regions".

Eastern Ganga dynasty.headline: Vzhodna dinastija Ganga
paragraphs: Vzhodna dinastija Ganga (znana tudi kot Purba Ganga, Rudhi Ganga ali Pračja Ganga) je bila velika srednjeveška dinastija, ki je iz Kalinge vladala od 5. stoletja do sredine 20. stoletja. Vzhodni Gange jih imenujejo, da bi jih ločili od zahodnih Gang, ki so vladali v Karnataki. Ozemlje dinastije je obsegalo vso današnjo indijsko zvezno državo Odišo ter velik del severnega Andhra Pradeša, dele Čatisgarha in nekaj južnih okrožij Zahodnega Bengala. Vzhodni Gange so vladali velikemu delu današnje Odiše v treh obdobjih: kot zgodnji vzhodni Gange (493–1077), cesarski vzhodni Gange (1077–1436) in khemundijski Gange (1436–1947). Uradni in dvorni jezik vzhodnih Gang je postala orijščina. Zgodnji vladarji dinastije so vladali iz Dantapure (današnjega Dantapurama v okrožju Srikakulam v Andhra Pradešu), prestolnico pa so pozneje preselili v Kalinganagaro (današnjo Mukhilingo v Andhra Pradešu), nato v Katako (današnji Kattak v Odiši) in nazadnje v Paralakhemundi (v Odiši).

source.title: Eastern Ganga dynasty
paragraphs: The Eastern Ganga dynasty (also known as Purba Gangas, Rudhi Gangas or Prachya Gangas) were a large medieval era dynasty that reigned from Kalinga from as early as the 5th century to the mid 20th century. They are known as "Eastern Gangas" to distinguish them from the Western Gangas who ruled over Karnataka. The territory ruled by the dynasty consisted of the whole of the modern-day Indian state of Odisha, as well as major parts of north Andhra Pradesh, parts of Chhattisgarh and some southern districts of West Bengal. Eastern Gangas ruled much of the modern region of Odisha in three different phases by the passage of time, known as Early Eastern Gangas (493–1077), Imperial Eastern Gangas (1077–1436) and Khemundi Gangas (1436–1947). Odia language became the official and court language of Eastern Gangas. The early rulers of the dynasty ruled from Dantapura (modern Dantapuram in the Srikakulam district in Andhra Pradesh), the capital was later moved to Kalinganagara (modern Mukhilinga in Andhra Pradesh), and ultimately to Kataka (modern Cuttack in Odisha) and then to Paralakhemundi (in Odisha).

Afganistanski emirat, do leta 1834 znan kot Kabulska kneževina in do leta 1855 kot Kabulski emirat, imenovan pa tudi Varovane dežele Afganistana, Vzvišena država Afganistan in Od Boga dana država Afganistan, je bil emirat v Srednji Aziji, ki je obsegal današnji Afganistan ter dele današnjega Irana, Pakistana, Turkmenistana in Tadžikistana. Emirat je nastal iz svojega predhodnika, Duranskega imperija, potem ko je v Kabulu prevladala dinastija Barakzaj.

source.title: Emirate of Afghanistan
paragraphs: The Emirate of Afghanistan, known as the Principality of Kabul before 1834, and as the Emirate of Kabul until 1855, and also referred to as the Guarded Domains of Afghanistan, the Sublime State of Afghanistan, and the God-Given State of Afghanistan, was an emirate in Central Asia that encompassed present-day Afghanistan, as well as parts of present-day Iran, Pakistan, Turkmenistan and Tajikistan. The emirate emerged from its predecessor, the Durrani Empire, after the Barakzai dynasty prevailed in Kabul.

Kabul, prestolnica Afganistana, je novembra 2001 med vojno v Afganistanu padel v roke sil Severnega zavezništva. Sile Severnega zavezništva so napad na mesto začele 13. novembra in hitro napredovale proti talibanskim silam in silam Al Kaide, ki so jih ameriški in britanski letalski napadi močno oslabili. Prodor je bil hitrejši od načrtov in naslednji dan so sile Severnega zavezništva (ob podpori operativnega odreda Alpha 555 specialnih sil kopenske vojske ZDA) vstopile v Kabul, kjer niso naletele na odpor. Talibanske sile so se umaknile v Kandahar na jugu.

Skupaj s padcem Mazar-i-Šarifa pet dni prej je bil zavzem Kabula hud udarec za talibanski nadzor nad Afganistanom. Zaradi vseh teh izgub so se preživeli pripadniki talibanov in Al Kaide, med njimi Osama bin Laden, umaknili proti Kandaharju, duhovnemu rojstnemu kraju in domu talibanskega gibanja, ter proti Tora Bori.

source.title: Fall of Kabul (2001)
paragraphs: Kabul, capital of Afghanistan, fell in November 2001 to the Northern Alliance forces during the war in Afghanistan. Northern Alliance forces began their attack on the city on 13 November and made swift progress against Taliban and al-Qaeda forces that were heavily weakened by American and British air strikes. The advance moved ahead of plans, and the next day the Northern Alliance forces (supported by Operational Detachment Alpha 555 of the U.S. Army Special Forces) entered Kabul and met no resistance inside the city. Taliban forces retreated to Kandahar in the south.

Coupled with the fall of Mazar-i-Sharif five days earlier, the capture of Kabul was a significant blow to Taliban control of Afghanistan. As a result of all the losses, surviving members of the Taliban and al-Qaeda, including Osama bin Laden, retreated toward Kandahar, the spiritual birthplace and home of the Taliban movement, and Tora Bora.

Afganistansko prestolnico Kabul so talibani 15. avgusta 2021 zavzeli po veliki uporniški ofenzivi, ki se je začela maja 2021. To je bila zadnja akcija vojne v Afganistanu in je pomenila popolno zmago talibanov. Posledica je bila strmoglavljenje Islamske republike Afganistan pod predsednikom Ašrafom Ganijem in ponovna vzpostavitev Islamskega emirata Afganistan pod nadzorom talibanov.

Sporazum med Združenimi državami in talibani, podpisan 29. februarja 2020, velja za enega najpomembnejših dejavnikov, ki so povzročili zlom afganistanskih narodnih varnostnih sil (ANSF). Po sporazumu so ZDA močno zmanjšale število letalskih napadov in ANSF odvzele odločilno prednost v boju proti talibanskim upornikom.

source.title: Fall of Kabul (2021)
paragraphs: On 15 August 2021, Afghanistan's capital city of Kabul was captured by the Taliban after a major insurgent offensive that began in May 2021. It was the final action of the War in Afghanistan, and marked a total victory for the Taliban. This led to the overthrowing of the Islamic Republic of Afghanistan under President Ashraf Ghani and the reinstatement of the Islamic Emirate of Afghanistan under the control of the Taliban.

The United States–Taliban deal, signed on 29 February 2020, is considered one of the most critical factors that caused the collapse of the Afghan National Security Forces (ANSF). Following the deal, the US dramatically reduced the number of air attacks and deprived the ANSF of a critical edge in fighting the Taliban insurgency.

Fall of Mazar-i-Sharif.headline: Padec Mazar-i-Šarifa
paragraphs: Padec Mazar-i-Šarifa (ali Mazar-e-Šarifa) novembra 2001 je bil posledica prve velike ofenzive afganistanske vojne po ameriškem posredovanju. Prodor Združene islamske fronte za rešitev Afganistana (Severnega zavezništva) v mesto Mazar-i-Šarif v provinci Balh, skupaj z letalskim bombardiranjem s pomočjo specialnih sil kopenske vojske ZDA, je privedel do umika talibanskih sil, ki so mesto držale od leta 1998. Po padcu okoliških vasi in silovitem bombardiranju so se talibanske sile in sile Al Kaide umaknile iz mesta. Ubitih je bilo približno 300 talibanskih borcev, 250 so jih zajeli, okoli 1000 pa naj bi jih prestopilo na drugo stran. Zavzetje Mazar-i-Šarifa je bilo prvi velik poraz talibanov.

source.title: Fall of Mazar-i-Sharif
paragraphs: The fall of Mazar-i-Sharif (or Mazar-e-Sharif) in November 2001 resulted from the first major offensive of the Afghanistan War after American intervention. A push into the city of Mazar-i-Sharif in Balkh Province by the United Islamic Front for the Salvation of Afghanistan (Northern Alliance), combined with U.S. Army Special Forces aerial bombardment, resulted in the withdrawal of Taliban forces who had held the city since 1998. After the fall of outlying villages, and an intensive bombardment, the Taliban and al-Qaeda forces withdrew from the city. Approximately 300 Taliban fighters were killed and 250 were captured, and around 1,000 reportedly defected. The capture of Mazar-i-Sharif was the first major defeat for the Taliban.

Fall of Phnom Penh.headline: Padec Pnom Pena
paragraphs: Padec Pnom Pena je bil zavzem Pnom Pena, prestolnice Kmerske republike (v današnji Kambodži), ki so ga Rdeči Kmeri izvedli 17. aprila 1975 in s tem dejansko končali kamboško državljansko vojno. Na začetku meseca so Rdeči Kmeri obkolili Pnom Pen, eno zadnjih preostalih oporišč Kmerske republike, ki je bilo povsem odvisno od oskrbe po zraku prek letališča Pochentong.

Ker je bila zmaga Rdečih Kmerov neizbežna, je vlada Združenih držav 12. aprila evakuirala ameriške državljane in zavezniške Kambodžane. Vlada Kmerske republike je 17. aprila izpraznila mesto, da bi blizu tajske meje ustanovila novo vladno središče in nadaljevala odpor. Pozneje istega dne so padle zadnje obrambne črte okoli Pnom Pena in Rdeči Kmeri so zasedli mesto.

source.title: Fall of Phnom Penh
paragraphs: The Fall of Phnom Penh was the capture of Phnom Penh, capital of the Khmer Republic (in present-day Cambodia), by the Khmer Rouge on 17 April 1975, effectively ending the Cambodian Civil War. At the beginning of the month, Phnom Penh, one of the last remaining strongholds of the Khmer Republic, was surrounded by the Khmer Rouge and totally dependent on aerial resupply through Pochentong Airport.

With a Khmer Rouge victory imminent, the United States government evacuated US nationals and allied Cambodians on 12 April. On 17 April, the Khmer Republic government evacuated the city, intending to establish a new government center close to the Thai border to continue resistance. Later that day, the last defences around Phnom Penh were overrun and the Khmer Rouge occupied Phnom Penh.

Fall of Saigon.headline: Padec Saigona
paragraphs: Saigon, prestolnico Južnega Vietnama, je 30. aprila 1975 zavzel Severni Vietnam. Zaradi tega so evakuirali na tisoče civilistov in ameriškega osebja, vietnamska vojna pa se je končala. Sledilo je prehodno obdobje pod Začasno revolucionarno vlado Republike Južni Vietnam do formalne ponovne združitve leta 1976.

V okviru pomladanske ofenzive leta 1975 sta Vietnamska ljudska armada (PAVN) in pomožne enote Vietkonga (VC) pod poveljstvom generala Văn Tiến Dũnga 29. aprila 1975 začeli zadnji napad na Saigon, pri čemer je Vojska Republike Vietnam (ARVN) pod poveljstvom generala Nguyễn Văn Toàna utrpela hudo topniško obstreljevanje. Do naslednjega dne se je predsednik Minh vdal, PAVN in VC pa sta zasedla pomembne točke mesta in nad južnovietnamsko predsedniško palačo izobesila zastavo VC, s čimer je prenehal obstajati Južni Vietnam s svojim predhodnikom (1949–1975). Vietnam je bil prvič po letu 1954 združen pod enim režimom.

source.title: Fall of Saigon
paragraphs: Saigon, the capital of South Vietnam, was captured by North Vietnam on 30 April 1975. This caused the evacuation of thousands of civilians and U.S. personnel, and ended the Vietnam War. The aftermath ushered in a transition period under the Provisional Revolutionary Government of the Republic of South Vietnam until the formal reunification in 1976.

As part of the 1975 spring offensive, the People's Army of Vietnam (PAVN) and the Viet Cong (VC) auxiliaries, under the command of General Văn Tiến Dũng, began their final attack on Saigon on 29 April 1975, with the Army of the Republic of Vietnam (ARVN) commanded by General Nguyễn Văn Toàn suffering a heavy artillery bombardment. By the next day, President Minh had surrendered while the PAVN/VC had occupied the important points of the city and raised the VC flag over the South Vietnamese Presidential Palace, ending the existence of South Vietnam and its predecessor (1949–1975). For the first time since 1954, Vietnam was unified under a single regime.

Prva angleško-afganistanska vojna se je od leta 1838 do 1842 bila med Duraniji, ki sta jih podpirala Britanski imperij in Sikhovski imperij, ter Barakzaji iz Kabula in Kandaharja z njihovimi regionalnimi zavezniki. Britanci so posegli v nasledstveni spor, ki je izhajal iz duranskega boja za nasledstvo, in podprli nekdanjega kralja Šudža Šaha Duranija, ki so ga po zasedbi Kabula avgusta 1839 znova postavili na prestol. Bila je eden prvih velikih spopadov velike igre, tekmovanja med Veliko Britanijo in Rusijo za moč in vpliv v Srednji Aziji v 19. stoletju.

source.title: First Anglo-Afghan War
paragraphs: The First Anglo-Afghan War was fought between the Durranis backed by the British Empire and the Sikh Empire, and the Barakzais of Kabul and Kandahar, alongside their regional allies, from 1838 to 1842. The British intervened in a succession dispute stemming from the Durrani succession struggle and backed former king Shuja Shah Durrani, whom they restored to the throne after occupying Kabul in August 1839. It was one of the first major conflicts during the Great Game, the 19th century competition for power and influence in Central Asia between Britain and Russia.

First Anglo-Burmese War.headline: Prva angleško-burmanska vojna
paragraphs: Prva angleško-burmanska vojna (burmansko: ပထမအင်္ဂလိပ်-မြန်မာစစ်; 5. marec 1824 – 24. februar 1826), v angleških virih znana tudi kot prva burmanska vojna, v burmanskih pa kot prva angleška osvajalna vojna (burmansko: ပထမအင်္ဂလိပ်ကျူးကျော်စစ်), je bila prva od treh vojn med Britanskim in Burmanskim imperijem v 19. stoletju. Vojna, ki se je začela predvsem zaradi nadzora nad današnjo severovzhodno Indijo, se je končala z drago, a odločilno britansko zmago, s katero so Britanci dobili popoln nadzor nad Asamom, Kačarjem, Manipurjem in Džaintijo ter provincama Arakan in Tenaserim. Burmanci so pristali na britansko zahtevo, da plačajo odškodnino v višini milijona funtov, in podpisali trgovinsko pogodbo.
notes: Izpuščena je izgovarjava (IPA).

source.title: First Anglo-Burmese War
paragraphs: The First Anglo-Burmese War (Burmese: ပထမအင်္ဂလိပ်-မြန်မာစစ်; [pətʰəma̰ ɪ́ɰ̃ɡəleiʔ-mjəmà sɪʔ]; 5 March 1824 – 24 February 1826), also known as the First Burma War in English language accounts and First English Invasion War (Burmese: ပထမအင်္ဂလိပ်ကျူးကျော်စစ်) in Burmese language accounts, was the first of three wars fought between the British and Burmese empires in the 19th century. The war, which began primarily over the control of what is now Northeastern India, ended in a costly but decisive British victory, giving the British total control of Assam, Cachar, Manipur and Jaintia as well as Arakan Province and Tenasserim. The Burmese submitted to a British demand to pay an indemnity of one million pounds sterling, and signed a commercial treaty.

First Anglo-Maratha War.headline: Prva angleško-marathska vojna
paragraphs: Prva angleško-marathska vojna (1775–1782) je bila prvi spopad med britansko Vzhodnoindijsko družbo in Marathskim imperijem v Indiji. Vojna, ki se je bila med Suratom in Puno, se je začela s suratsko pogodbo leta 1775, potem ko je Vzhodnoindijska družba privolila, da bo podprla zahtevo nedavno odstavljenega Raghunathraa po položaju pešve Marathskega imperija. Sledilo je več let občasnih in večinoma neodločenih pohodov, v katerih Vzhodnoindijska družba zelo gibljivih Marathov ni uspela odločilno poraziti. Vojna se je končala leta 1782 z mirom v Salbaiju. Po njej sta si strani vrnili zavzeta ozemlja, Britanci pa so umaknili podporo Raghunathrau. Britanci in Marathi so se znova spopadli šele 20 let pozneje v drugi angleško-marathski vojni.

source.title: First Anglo-Maratha War
paragraphs: The First Anglo-Maratha War (1775–1782) was the first conflict fought between the British East India Company and Maratha Empire in India. The war, fought in between Surat and Poona, began with the 1775 Treaty of Surat after the East India Company agreed to support the recently-deposed Raghunathrao's claim as Peshwa of the Maratha Empire. Several years of intermittent and largely inconclusive campaigning followed, in which the East India Company failed to decisively defeat the highly mobile Marathas. The war ended in 1782 following the Treaty of Salbai. As per the treaty, both sides returned each other's captured territory, and the British withdrew their support for Raghunathrao. The British and Marathas would not fight against each other again until the Second Anglo-Maratha War 20 years later.

Prva angleško-misorska vojna (1767–1769) je bila spopad v Indiji med Misorskim sultanatom in Vzhodnoindijsko družbo. Vojno so deloma sprožile spletke Asafa Džaha II., hajderabadskega nizama, ki je hotel sredstva družbe odvrniti od poskusov, da bi prevzela nadzor nad Severnimi okraji (Northern Circars).

source.title: First Anglo-Mysore War
paragraphs: The First Anglo-Mysore War (1767–1769) was a conflict in India between the Sultanate of Mysore and the East India Company. The war was instigated in part by the machinations of Asaf Jah II, the Nizam of Hyderabad, who sought to divert the company's resources from attempts to gain control over the Northern Circars.

First Anglo-Sikh War.headline: Prva angleško-sikhovska vojna
paragraphs: Prva angleško-sikhovska vojna se je od leta 1845 do 1846 bila med Sikhovskim imperijem in Britanskim imperijem v okrožju Firozpur v Pandžabu in okolici. Končala se je s porazom in delno podreditvijo Sikhovskega imperija ter z odstopom Džamuja in Kašmirja, ki je postal samostojna kneževska država pod britansko nadoblastjo.

source.title: First Anglo-Sikh War
paragraphs: The First Anglo-Sikh War was fought between the Sikh Empire and the British Empire from 1845 to 1846 around the Firozpur district of Punjab. It resulted in the defeat and partial subjugation of the Sikh Empire and cession of Jammu and Kashmir as a separate princely state under British suzerainty.

First Battle of Panipat.headline: Prva bitka pri Panipatu
paragraphs: Prva bitka pri Panipatu se je 21. aprila 1526 v severni Indiji bila med vdirajočo vojsko Baburja in delhijskim sultanom Ibrahimom kanom Lodijem. Baburjeva vojska, ki je uporabljala smodniško strelno orožje in topove, je Ibrahima porazila. Bila je ena najzgodnejših bitk na Indijski podcelini, v katerih so uporabili smodniško orožje. Zmaga je pomenila začetek mogulske vladavine v Indiji.

source.title: First Battle of Panipat
paragraphs: The First Battle of Panipat, on 21 April 1526 was fought between the invading forces of Babur against Ibrahim Khan Lodi, the Sultan of Delhi, in North India. Babur's forces, employing gunpowder firearms and cannons, defeated Ibrahim. This was one of the earliest battles involving gunpowder arms on the Indian subcontinent. The victory marked the beginning of Mughal rule in India.

First Carnatic War.headline: Prva karnatska vojna
paragraphs: Prva karnatska vojna (1744/1746–1748) je bila indijsko bojišče avstrijske nasledstvene vojne in prva v vrsti karnatskih vojn, s katerimi so Britanci vzpostavili zgodnjo prevlado na vzhodni obali Indijske podceline. V tem spopadu sta se britanska in francoska vzhodnoindijska družba na kopnem bojevali za nadzor nad trgovskimi postojankami v Madrasu, Pondicherryju in Cuddaloreju, francoske in britanske pomorske sile pa so se spopadale pred obalo. Vojna je pripravila teren za hitro rast francoske prevlade v južni Indiji pod poveljstvom francoskega generalnega guvernerja Josepha Françoisa Dupleixa v drugi karnatski vojni.

source.title: First Carnatic War
paragraphs: The First Carnatic War (1744/1746–1748) was the Indian theatre of the War of the Austrian Succession and the first of a series of Carnatic Wars that established early British dominance on the east coast of the Indian subcontinent. In this conflict the British and French East India Companies vied with each other on land for control of their respective trading posts at Madras, Pondicherry, and Cuddalore, while naval forces of France and Britain engaged each other off the coast. The war set the stage for the rapid growth of French hegemony in southern India under the command of French Governor-General Joseph François Dupleix in the Second Carnatic War.

Prva indokitajska vojna, znana tudi kot francoska indokitajska vojna, se je od 19. decembra 1946 do 11. avgusta 1954 v Francoski Indokini bila med Francosko unijo in Viet Minhom ter njunimi zavezniki. Večina spopadov te vojne je potekala v Vietnamu.

source.title: First Indochina War
paragraphs: The First Indochina War, known alternatively as the French Indochina War, was fought in French Indochina between the French Union and the Viet Minh and their respective allies, from 19 December 1946 until 11 August 1954. Most of the engagements of this conflict occurred in Vietnam.

Prvi mongolski vpad v Burmo (burmansko: မွန်ဂို–မြန်မာ စစ် (၁၂၇၇–၁၂၈၇); kitajsko: 元緬戰爭) je bil vrsta vojaških spopadov med dinastijo Juan Kublaj kana, delom Mongolskega cesarstva, in Paganskim cesarstvom, ki so potekali med letoma 1277 in 1287. Vpadi so strmoglavili 250 let staro Pagansko cesarstvo, mongolska vojska pa je zasedla pagansko ozemlje v današnjem Dehongu v Junanu in v severni Burmi do Tagaunga. Vpadi so v Burmi sprožili 250 let politične razdrobljenosti in vzpon etničnih tajsko-šanskih držav po vsej celinski Jugovzhodni Aziji.

source.title: First Mongol invasion of Burma
paragraphs: The first Mongol invasion of Burma (Burmese: မွန်ဂို–မြန်မာ စစ် (၁၂၇၇–၁၂၈၇); Chinese: 元緬戰爭) was a series of military conflicts between Kublai Khan's Yuan dynasty, a division of the Mongol Empire, and the Pagan Empire that took place between 1277 and 1287. The invasions toppled the 250-year-old Pagan Empire, and the Mongol army seized Pagan territories in present-day Dehong, Yunnan and northern Burma to Tagaung. The invasions ushered in 250 years of political fragmentation in Burma and the rise of ethnic Tai-Shan states throughout mainland Southeast Asia.

Prva vojna v Gorskem Karabahu je bila etnični in ozemeljski spopad, ki je od februarja 1988 do maja 1994 potekal v enklavi Gorski Karabah na jugozahodu Azerbajdžana med večinskimi etničnimi Armenci Gorskega Karabaha, ki jih je podpirala Armenija, in Republiko Azerbajdžan, ki jo je podpirala Turčija. Ko se je vojna razvijala, sta se Armenija in Azerbajdžan, nekdanji sovjetski republiki, zapletla v dolgotrajno, nenapovedano gorsko vojskovanje na karabaških višinah, saj je Azerbajdžan poskušal zatreti karabaško gibanje.

source.title: First Nagorno-Karabakh War
paragraphs: The First Nagorno-Karabakh War was an ethnic and territorial conflict that took place from February 1988 to May 1994 in the enclave of Nagorno-Karabakh in southwestern Azerbaijan between the majority ethnic Armenians of Nagorno-Karabakh backed by Armenia, and the Republic of Azerbaijan with support from Turkey. As the war progressed, Armenia and Azerbaijan, both former Soviet republics, entangled themselves in protracted, undeclared mountain warfare in the mountainous heights of Karabakh as Azerbaijan attempted to curb the Karabakh Movement.

First Toungoo Empire.headline: Prvo taungujsko cesarstvo
paragraphs: Prvo taungujsko cesarstvo (burmansko: တောင်ငူခေတ်, dobesedno »taungujsko obdobje«), v tradicionalnem zgodovinopisju znano tudi kot drugo burmansko cesarstvo ali preprosto dinastija Taungu, je bilo v drugi polovici 16. stoletja prevladujoča sila v celinski Jugovzhodni Aziji. Na vrhuncu je Taungu »izvajal suverenost od

Manipurja do kamboških mejnih pokrajin in od meja Arakana do Junana« in je bil »največji imperij v zgodovini Jugovzhodne Azije«. »Najbolj drzna in vojaško najuspešnejša« dinastija v burmanski zgodovini je bila tudi »najkrajša«.
notes: Izpuščena sta angleški zapis izgovarjave in izgovarjava (IPA). Vir razdeli navedek med odstavka; delitev je ohranjena.

source.title: First Toungoo Empire
paragraphs: The First Toungoo Empire (TOW-NG-oo; Burmese: တောင်ငူခေတ်, [tàʊɴŋù kʰɪʔ], lit. "Toungoo Period"), also known as the Second Burmese Empire in traditional historiography, or simply the Taungoo dynasty, was the dominant power in mainland Southeast Asia in the second half of the 16th century. At its peak, Toungoo "exercised suzerainty from

Manipur to the Cambodian marches and from the borders of Arakan to Yunnan" and was "the largest empire in the history of Southeast Asia." The "most adventurous and militarily successful" dynasty in Burmese history was also the "shortest-lived."

Četrta angleško-misorska vojna je bila spopad v južni Indiji, v katerem se je Misorska država v letih 1798–1799 bojevala proti Vzhodnoindijski družbi, Marathskemu imperiju in Hajderabadu (pod marathsko nadoblastjo).

To je bila zadnja angleško-misorska vojna. Čeprav so Marathi Misorju obljubili ozemlje Utara Kanade, so se v zadnjem trenutku postavili na stran družbe, kar je privedlo do tega, da je družba zavzela prestolnico Misor, vladar Tipu Sultan pa je padel v boju. Velika Britanija je skupaj z Marathi prevzela posredni nadzor nad Misorjem in na oblast vrnila dinastijo Vadijar (z britanskim komisarjem, ki je vladarju svetoval v vseh zadevah). Mladega Tipujevega dediča Fateha Alija so poslali v izgnanstvo. Misorsko kraljestvo je postalo kneževska država v subsidiarnem zavezništvu z Vzhodnoindijsko družbo na delih današnje Kerale in Karnatake, Britancem pa je odstopilo Koimbatur in Dakšina Kanado.

source.title: Fourth Anglo-Mysore War
paragraphs: The Fourth Anglo-Mysore War was a conflict in South India during which the Mysore State fought against the East India Company, Maratha Empire and the Hyderabad State (under the suzerainty of Marathas) in 1798–99.

This was the last of the Anglo-Mysore Wars. Although the Marathas had promised the land of Uttara Kannada to Mysore, they sided with the Company at the last moment which led to the capture of the capital city Mysore by the Company and the death of the ruler Tipu Sultan in the battle. Britain took indirect control of Mysore, restoring the Wadiyar dynasty to power (with a British commissioner to advise him on all issues), along with the Marathas. Tipu Sultan's young heir, Fateh Ali, was sent into exile. The Kingdom of Mysore became a princely state in a subsidiary alliance with the East India Company covering parts of present day Kerala–Karnataka; and ceded Coimbatore and Dakshina Kannada to the British.

Francosko-tajska vojna (oktober 1940 – 28. januar 1941; tajsko: กรณีพิพาทอินโดจีน; francosko: Guerre franco-thaïlandaise) se je bila med Tajsko in Vichyjsko Francijo za nekatera območja Francoske Indokine.

Pogajanja tik pred drugo svetovno vojno so pokazala, da je bila francoska vlada pripravljena meje med Tajsko in Francosko Indokino spremeniti, a le malo. Po padcu Francije leta 1940 je tajski predsednik vlade generalmajor Plaek Phibunsongkhram (ljudsko imenovan »Phibun«) presodil, da je francoski poraz okrepil pogajalski položaj Tajcev, da bi znova pridobili ozemlja vazalnih držav, ki so jih v času vladanja kralja Chulalongkorna odstopili Franciji.
notes: Izpuščena je tajska transliteracija.

source.title: Franco-Thai War
paragraphs: The Franco-Thai War (October 1940 – 28 January 1941, Thai: กรณีพิพาทอินโดจีน, romanized: Karani Phiphat Indochin; French: Guerre franco-thaïlandaise) was fought between Thailand and Vichy France over certain areas of French Indochina.

Negotiations shortly before World War II had shown that the French government was willing to alter the boundaries between Thailand and French Indochina, but only slightly. Following the Fall of France in 1940, Major-General Plaek Phibunsongkhram (popularly known as "Phibun"), the prime minister of Thailand, decided that France's defeat strengthened the Thais' negotiating position to regain the vassal state territories that were ceded to France during King Chulalongkorn's reign.

Funan.headline: Funan
paragraphs: Funan je bil ohlapna mreža starodavnih indijsko obarvanih držav (mandal) v celinski Jugovzhodni Aziji, ki je obsegala dele današnje Kambodže, Tajske in Vietnama in je obstajala od 1. do 7. stoletja n. št. Ležal je jugozahodno od Linjija, kakor so Kitajci imenovali zgodovinsko pokrajino Champa v današnjem osrednjem in južnem Vietnamu. Funan na splošno velja za prvo znano kraljestvo v Jugovzhodni Aziji.

V starih jezikih regije je Funan znan kot Suvarnabhumi, iz sanskrta, kar pomeni »zlata dežela«, v kitajščini pa kot 扶南. Ime Funan se v nobenem krajevnem besedilu iz tistega časa ne pojavlja in ni znano, kako so svojo državo imenovali prebivalci Funana. Pojavlja se v kitajskih zgodovinskih besedilih o kraljestvu, najobsežnejši opisi pa temeljijo predvsem na poročilih dveh kitajskih diplomatov, Kang Taja in Džu Jinga, ki sta zastopala dinastijo Vzhodni Vu in sredi 3. stoletja n. št. bivala v Funanu.
notes: Izpuščen je zapis v pinjinu.

source.title: Funan
paragraphs: Funan was a loose network of ancient Indianized states (mandalas) located in Mainland Southeast Asia, covering parts of present-day Cambodia, Thailand and Vietnam, that existed from the 1st to the 7th century CE. It was located southwest of Linyi, the Chinese designation for the historical region of Champa in present-day central and southern Vietnam. Funan is generally considered the first known kingdom in Southeast Asia.

Funan is known in the ancient languages of the region as Suvarnabhumi, from Sanskrit, meaning "land of gold", and in Chinese as 扶南 (pinyin: Fúnán). However, the name Funan does not appear in any locally produced texts from the period, and it remains unknown what name the people of Funan used for their polity. It appears in Chinese historical texts describing the kingdom, and the most extensive accounts are largely based on reports by two Chinese diplomats, Kang Tai and Zhu Ying, who represented the Eastern Wu dynasty and sojourned in Funan during the mid-3rd century CE.

Gahadavala dynasty.headline: Dinastija Gahadavala
paragraphs: Dinastija Gahadavala (IAST: Gāhaḍavāla), znana tudi kot Gahadavale iz Kannaudža, je bila radžputska dinastija, ki je v 11. in 12. stoletju vladala delom današnjih indijskih zveznih držav Utar Pradeš in Bihar. Njena prestolnica je bila Banaras (danes Varanasi) na Gangeški nižini, za kratek čas pa je nadzorovala tudi Kannaudž.
