Čandradeva, prvi vladar dinastije, je nekaj pred letom 1090, po zatonu moči Kalačurijev, ustanovil suvereno kraljestvo. Vrhunec je kraljestvo doseglo pod njegovim vnukom Govindačandro, ki si je priključil nekaj ozemelj Kalačurijev, odbil gaznavidske vpade in se bojeval tudi s Palami. Leta 1194 je Govindačandrovega vnuka Džajačandro porazila guridska vojska pod vodstvom Kutbudina Ajbaka, kar je dejansko končalo imperialno moč dinastije. Kraljestvo je povsem prenehalo obstajati, ko je Džajačandrove naslednike porazil Iltutmiš (vladal 1211–1236), vladar delhijske mameluške dinastije.

source.title: Gahadavala dynasty
paragraphs: The Gahadavala dynasty (IAST: Gāhaḍavāla), also known as Gahadavalas of Kannauj, was a Rajput dynasty that ruled parts of the present-day Indian states of Uttar Pradesh and Bihar, during 11th and 12th centuries. Their capital was located at Banaras (now Varanasi) in the Gangetic plains, and for a brief period, they also controlled Kannauj.

Chandradeva, the first monarch of the dynasty, established a sovereign kingdom sometime before 1090, after the decline of the Kalachuri power. The kingdom reached its zenith under his grandson Govindachandra who annexed some of the Kalachuri territories, warded off Ghaznavid raids, and also fought the Palas. In 1194, Govindachandra's grandson Jayachandra was defeated by the Ghurid army under Qutbuddin Aibak, which effectively ended the dynasty's imperial power. The kingdom completely ceased to exist when Jayachandra's successors were defeated by the Delhi Sultanate Mamluk dynasty 's ruler Iltutmish (r. 1211–1236).

Gandhāra (kingdom).headline: Gandhara
paragraphs: Gandhara (sanskrtsko: Gandhāra; palijsko: Gandhāra) je bilo indoarijsko kraljestvo železne dobe na severozahodu Južne Azije. Prebivalce Gandhare so imenovali Gandharji. Poznejši palijski budistični viri, kot je Anguttara Nikaja, jo štejejo med šestnajst mahadžanapad.

source.title: Gandhara (kingdom)
paragraphs: Gandhāra (Sanskrit: Gandhāra; Pali: Gandhāra) was an Iron Age Indo-Aryan kingdom of northwestern South Asia. The inhabitants of Gandhāra were called the Gandhārīs. Later Pali Buddhist sources, such as Aṅguttara Nikāya, count it among the sixteen mahajanapadas.

Gauda Kingdom.headline: Kraljestvo Gauda
paragraphs: Kraljestvo Gauda je bilo kraljestvo klasičnega obdobja na Indijski podcelini, ki je nastalo v 4. stoletju n. št. ali morda prej v pokrajini Gauda v Bengalu (današnji Zahodni Bengal in Bangladeš).

source.title: Kingdom of Gauda
paragraphs: The Gauḍa kingdom was a kingdom during the Classical era in the Indian subcontinent, which originated in the Gauda region of Bengal (modern-day West Bengal and Bangladesh) in 4th century CE or possibly earlier.

Georgia.headline: Gruzija
paragraphs: Angleško ime Georgia se najpogosteje nanaša na:
Gruzijo, državo na južnem Kavkazu,
Georgio, zvezno državo na jugovzhodu ZDA.
notes: Zapis je povezan z razločitveno stranjo; prevedeno je kot seznam, kot stoji.

source.title: Georgia
paragraphs: Georgia most commonly refers to:
Georgia (country), in the South Caucasus
Georgia (U.S. state), a state in the Southeastern US

Gruzijska državljanska vojna 1991–1993 (gruzijsko: 1991–1993 წლების ქართული სამოქალაქო ომი) je od leta 1991 do 1993 potekala v južnokavkaški državi Gruziji. Začela se je decembra 1991 z udarom, ki so ga uporniške frakcije gruzijske nacionalne garde in paravojaška skupina Mhedrioni izvedle proti prvemu demokratično izvoljenemu gruzijskemu predsedniku Zviadu Gamsahurdiji. Predsednik Gamsahurdia je zato pobegnil v sosednjo Čečenijo, nato pa je v letih 1992–1993 vodil uporništvo in neuspešno vstajo, da bi znova prišel na oblast.

source.title: Georgian civil war of 1991–1993
paragraphs: The Georgian civil war of 1991–1993 (Georgian: 1991–1993 წლების ქართული სამოქალაქო ომი) lasted from 1991 to 1993 in the South Caucasian country Georgia. It began in December 1991 with the coup against the first democratically-elected President of Georgia, Zviad Gamsakhurdia, by the rebel factions of the Georgian National Guard and the Mkhedrioni paramilitary. It led to President Gamsakhurdia fleeing to neighboring Chechnya, and his subsequent insurgency and unsuccessful uprising to regain power in 1992–1993.

Gruzijsko-osetijski konflikt je etnopolitični spor glede nekdanje gruzijske avtonomne pokrajine Južna Osetija, ki je nastal leta 1989 in v letih 1991–1992 prerasel v vojno. Kljub razglašenemu premirju in številnim mirovnim prizadevanjem je spor, v katerega so vpletene Gruzija, Rusija in samooklicana republika Južna Osetija, ostal nerazrešen. Avgusta 2008 so vojaške napetosti in spopadi prerasli v rusko-gruzijsko vojno. Od tedaj je Južna Osetija de facto pod ruskim nadzorom.

source.title: Georgian–Ossetian conflict
paragraphs: The Georgian–Ossetian conflict is an ethno-political conflict over Georgia's former autonomous region of South Ossetia, which evolved in 1989 and developed into a war in 1991–1992. Despite a declared ceasefire and numerous peace efforts, the conflict, involving Georgia, Russia and self-proclaimed republic of South Ossetia, remained unresolved. In August 2008, military tensions and clashes erupted into the Russo-Georgian War. Since then, South Ossetia has been under de facto Russian control.

Gruzijsko-južnoosetijski konflikt v letih 1918–1920 je bil vrsta vstaj na območjih, poseljenih z Osetinci, v današnji Južni Osetiji, odcepljeni republiki v Gruziji, najprej proti Zakavkaški demokratični federativni republiki, nato pa proti Demokratični republiki Gruziji, v kateri so prevladovali menjševiki.

Menjševiška vlada Gruzije je med kratkim obstojem naletela na resne težave z etničnimi Osetinci, ki so večinoma simpatizirali z boljševiki in Sovjetsko Rusijo. Vzroki za spopad so bili zapleteni. Zapoznela zemljiška reforma in kmečki nemiri na revnih osetinskih območjih so se prepletali z etničnimi razprtijami in bojem za oblast na Kavkazu.

source.title: Georgian–Ossetian conflicts of 1918-1920
paragraphs: The Georgian–Ossetian conflict of 1918–1920 were a series of uprisings, which took place in the Ossetian-inhabited areas of what is now South Ossetia, a breakaway republic in Georgia, against the Transcaucasian Democratic Federative Republic and then the Menshevik-dominated Democratic Republic of Georgia.

During its brief tenure, the Menshevik government of Georgia came across significant problems with ethnic Ossetians who largely sympathized with the Bolsheviks and Soviet Russia. The reasons behind the conflict were complicated. An overdue land reform and agrarian disturbances in the poor Ossetian-populated areas intermingled with ethnic discord and the struggle for power in the Caucasus.

Gorkha Kingdom.headline: Kraljestvo Gorka
paragraphs: Kraljestvo Gorka (nepalsko: गोरखा राज्य) je bilo neodvisno gorsko kraljestvo v osrednji Himalaji, ustanovljeno leta 1559, ko je oblast v pokrajini prevzel princ Dravja Šah iz kraljestva Lamdžung in Kaski. S središčem okoli trdnjave Gorka Durbar na vrhu hriba je bilo sprva eno od neodvisnih kraljestev Čaubisi, ki so nastala po razpadu imperija Khasa-Malla. Pod desetim vladarjem Prithvijem Narajanom Šahom se je od leta 1743 hitro ozemeljsko širilo.

Do leta 1768 so se meje Gorke s premišljenim vojskovanjem in blokadami razširile od prvotnega osrednjega gorskega jedra, tako da so obkrožile dolino Katmandu, na severu segle do meje s Tibetom, na vzhodu do reke Sunkoši in gorovja Mahabharata, na jugu do hribovja Čurija in Makvanpurja ter na zahodu do reke Maršjangdi. Po osvojitvi doline Katmandu so prestolnico preselili v Katmandu, kraljestvo pa so leta 1768 preimenovali v Kraljevino Nepal.
notes: Izpuščena je latinična transliteracija nepalskega imena; podvojeni stavek vira (»Following the conquest of the Kathmandu Valley.«) je izpuščen.

source.title: Gorkha kingdom
paragraphs: The Gorkha Kingdom (Nepali: गोरखा राज्य; Gōrakhā Rājya) was a independent hill kingdom in the central Himalayas established in 1559 CE when the prince Dravya Shah of Lamjung and Kaski Kingdom seized control of the region. Centered around the hilltop fortress of Gorkha Durbar, it was originally one of the Chaubisi independent kingdoms that emerged following the fragmentation of Khasa-Malla Empire. The kingdom embarked on a rapid campaign of territorial expansion under its tenth monarch, Prithvi Narayan Shah, beginning in 1743 CE.

By 1768 CE, through strategic warfare and blockades, Gorkha's borders had expanded outward from its original central hill base to encircle the Kathmandu Valley, reaching the Tibet border to the north, the Sunkoshi River and Mahabharata range to the east, the Churia hills and Makwanpur to the south, and the Marshyangdi River to the west. Following the conquest of the Kathmandu Valley. Following the conquest of the Kathmandu Valley, the capital was sifted to Kathmandu, and the kingdom was renamed to the Kingdom of Nepal in 1768 CE.

Dinastija Pratihara (IAST: Pratīhāra), znana tudi kot Gurdžara-Pratihare, Pratihare iz Kannaudža ali cesarski Pratihare, je bila vidna srednjeveška indijska dinastija, ki je vladala med 8. in 11. stoletjem. Sprva je vladala pokrajini Gurdžara, nato pa je zmagala v tristranskem boju in leta 816 vzpostavila oblast nad Kannaudžem.

source.title: Pratihara dynasty
paragraphs: The Pratihara dynasty (IAST: Pratīhāra), also known as the Gurjara-Pratiharas, the Pratiharas of Kannauj or the Imperial Pratiharas, was a prominent medieval Indian dynasty that ruled between the 8th and 11th centuries. Initially ruling the Gurjara region, it emerged victorious in the Tripartite Struggle and established its rule over Kannauj in 816.

Habbari dynasty.headline: Dinastija Habari
paragraphs: Habariji (arabsko: اﻹﻣﺎرة اﻟﻬﺒﺎرﻳﺔ; sindško: ھباري گھراڻو) so bili arabska dinastija, ki je od leta 854 do 1024 kot polneodvisen emirat vladala velikemu delu Sinda. Z začetkom vladavine Umarja bin Abdula Aziza al-Habarija leta 854 je pokrajina leta 861 postala polneodvisna od Abasidskega kalifata, čeprav je abasidskemu kalifu v Bagdadu še naprej nominalno prisegala zvestobo. Vzpon Habarijev je končal obdobje neposredne vladavine Omajadskega in Abasidskega kalifata nad Sindom, ki se je začelo leta 711.

Habariji so imeli sedež v mestu Mansura in so vladali osrednjemu in južnemu Sindu južno od Arorja, blizu današnjega velemesta Sukkur. Sindu so vladali, dokler jih leta 1026 ni porazil sultan Mahmud Gaznavi, ki je nato uničil staro habarijsko prestolnico Mansuro in pokrajino priključil Gaznavidskemu cesarstvu ter s tem končal arabsko vladavino nad Sindom.
notes: Vir navaja konec vladavine v letu 1024 in poraz leta 1026; prevedeno je, kot stoji.

source.title: Habbari Emirate
paragraphs: The Habbari Dynasty (Arabic: اﻹﻣﺎرة اﻟﻬﺒﺎرﻳﺔ, Sindhi: ھباري گھراڻو) were an Arab dynasty that ruled much of Sindh, as a semi-independent emirate from 854 to 1024. Beginning with the rule of 'Umar bin Abdul Aziz al-Habbari in 854 CE, the region became semi-independent from the Abbasid Caliphate in 861, while continuing to nominally pledge allegiance to the Abbasid Caliph in Baghdad. The Habbari ascension marked the end of a period of direct rule of Sindh by the Umayyad and Abbasid Caliphates, which had begun in 711 CE.

The Habbaris were based in the city of Mansura, and ruled central and southern Sindh south of Aror, near the modern-day metropolis of Sukkur. The Habbaris ruled Sindh until they were defeated by Sultan Mahmud Ghaznavi in 1026, who then went on to destroy the old Habbari capital of Mansura, and annex the region to the Ghaznavid Empire, thereby ending Arab rule of Sindh.

Hanthawaddy Kingdom.headline: Kraljestvo Hanthawaddy
paragraphs: Kraljestvo Hanthawaddy (monsko: ဍုၚ် ဟံသာဝတဳ; burmansko: ဟံသာဝတီ နေပြည်တော်; tudi Hongsawatoi ali preprosto Pegu), s klasičnim imenom Hamsavati (»kraljestvo Hamse«), je bilo glavna državna tvorba, ki je vladala Spodnji Burmi (Mjanmaru) od leta 1287 do 1539 in za kratek čas od leta 1550 do 1552, nato pa je bila cesarska prestolnica burmanske dinastije Taungu.
notes: Izpuščena je izgovarjava (IPA).

source.title: Hanthawaddy kingdom
paragraphs: The Hanthawaddy Kingdom (Mon: ဍုၚ် ဟံသာဝတဳ, [hɔŋsawətɔe]; Burmese: ဟံသာဝတီ နေပြည်တော်; also Hongsawatoi or simply Pegu), classical name Ham̥sāvatī ("Realm of Hamsa"), was the major polity that ruled lower Burma (Myanmar) from 1287 to 1539 and briefly from 1550 to 1552, before serving as the imperial capital of the Burmese Toungoo dynasty.

Haripuñjaya.headline: Haripundžaja
paragraphs: Haripundžaja (monsko: ဟရိဘုဉ္ဇယ; severnotajsko: ᩉᩁᩥᨷᩩᨬᨩᩮᨿ᩠ᨿ; tajsko: หริภุญชัย), zapisana tudi Haribhundžaja, je bila starodavno monsko kraljestvo na območju današnje severne Tajske, ki je obstajalo od 7. ali 8. do 13. stoletja n. št. Prestolnica je bila v Lamphunu, ki so ga tedaj imenovali tudi Haripundžaja. Leta 1292 je mesto oblegal in zavzel Mangraj iz tajskega kraljestva Lan Na. Kronikalno izročilo pripisuje ustanovitev Čamadevi, princesi, ki so jo povabili iz Lava, umetnost in napisi kraljestva pa sodijo v svet dvaravatijskih monskih mestnih držav. Datum ustanovitve je sporen, predlogi segajo od 7. do 12. stoletja.
notes: Izpuščena je tajska transliteracija (RTGS).

source.title: Haripuñjaya
paragraphs: Haripuñjaya (Mon: ဟရိဘုဉ္ဇယ; Northern Thai: ᩉᩁᩥᨷᩩᨬᨩᩮᨿ᩠ᨿ; Thai: หริภุญชัย, RTGS: Hariphunchai), also spelled Haribhuñjaya, was an ancient Mon kingdom in what is now Northern Thailand, existing from the 7th or 8th to 13th century CE. Its capital was at Lamphun, which at the time was also called Haripuñjaya. In 1292 the city was besieged and captured by Mangrai of the Tai kingdom of Lan Na. The chronicle tradition credits the foundation to Camadevi, a princess invited from Lavo, and the kingdom's art and epigraphy are treated as part of the Dvaravati world of the Mon city-states. The date of that foundation is disputed, with proposals running from the seventh century to the twelfth.

Harša ali Haršavardhana (sanskrtsko: हर्षवर्धन; 4. junij 590 – 647) je bil cesar Kannaudža od aprila 606 do smrti leta 647. Bil je kralj Thanesarja, ki je premagal alhonske Hune, mlajši brat Radžjavardhane in sin Prabhakaravardhane, zadnjega kralja Thanesarja. Velja za enega največjih kraljev Kannaudža, ki se je pod njim razširil v obsežno kraljestvo v severni Indiji.

Na vrhuncu Harševe moči je njegovo kraljestvo obsegalo velik del severne in severozahodne Indije, njegova južna meja pa je bila reka Narmada. Za cesarsko prestolnico si je nazadnje izbral Kanjakubdžo (današnji Kannaudž v zvezni državi Utar Pradeš) in vladal do leta 647. Ko je svoje cesarstvo poskušal razširiti na južni del Indijskega polotoka, ga je v bitki ob Narmadi porazil cesar Pulakešin II. iz dinastije Čalukja.

source.title: Harsha
paragraphs: Harshavardhana (Sanskrit: हर्षवर्धन; 4 June 590 – 647) was the emperor of Kannauj from April 606 until his death in 647. He was the king of Thanesar who had defeated the Alchon Huns, and the younger brother of Rajyavardhana, son of Prabhakaravardhana and last king of Thanesar. He is regarded as one of the greatest kings of the Kingdom of Kannauj, which under him expanded into a vast realm in northern India.

At the height of Harsha's power, his realm covered much of northern and northwestern India, with the Narmada River as its southern boundary. He eventually made Kanyakubja (present-day Kannauj, Uttar Pradesh state) his imperial capital, and reigned until 647 CE. Harsha was defeated by the Emperor Pulakeshin II of the Chalukya dynasty in the Battle of Narmada, when he tried to expand his empire into the southern peninsula of India.

Dinastija Harjanka (sanskrtsko: हर्यंक) je bila po budističnem besedilu Mahavamsa vladajoča dinastija Magadhe med letoma 544 in 413 pr. n. št., čeprav nekateri raziskovalci zagovarjajo poznejšo kronologijo (od 5. stoletja do prve polovice 4. stoletja pr. n. št.). Prestolnica je bila sprva v Radžagrihi, med vladavino Udajina pa so jo preselili v Pataliputro blizu današnje Patne v Indiji. Za ustanovitelja dinastije velja Bimbisara.
Po Mahavamsi je Bimbisaro za kralja postavil njegov oče Bhatija, ko je bil star petnajst let. Dinastiji Harjanka je sledila dinastija Šišunaga.
notes: Izpuščena je transliteracija IAST.

source.title: Haryanka dynasty
paragraphs: The Haryanka dynasty (Sanskrit: हर्यंक; IAST: Haryaṅka) was the ruling dynasty of Magadha, according to the Buddhist text Mahavamsa between 544 BC and 413 BC though some scholars favour a later chronology (5th century BCE to first half of 4th century BCE). Initially, the capital was Rajagriha. Later, it was shifted to Pataliputra, near present-day Patna in India during the reign of Udayin. Bimbisara is considered to be the founder of the dynasty.
According to the Mahavamsa, Bimbisara was appointed king by his father, Bhattiya, at the age of fifteen. This dynasty was succeeded by the Shaishunaga dynasty.

Kraljestvo Hojsala, vidna južnoindijska dinastija, je med 11. in 14. stoletjem n. št. vladalo večini današnje Karnatake ter delom Tamil Naduja in jugozahodne Telangane. Prestolnica je bila sprva v Beluru, pozneje pa so jo preselili v Halebidu.

Izvor dinastije Hojsala sega v pokrajino Malnad v Karnataki. Hojsale so sprva služili kot fevdalni podložniki zahodnih Čalukj iz Kaljane. Dinastija se je uveljavila pod kraljem Višnuvardhano, zlasti po porazu Čol v bitki pri Talakadu, ki je utrdila hojsalsko oblast v Dekanu. Hojsale so izkoristili spor med zahodnimi Čalukjami in Kalačuriji iz Kaljanija v 12. stoletju in razširili ozemlje ter nazadnje nadzorovali velik del Karnatake in dele severozahodnega Tamil Naduja in zahodnega Andhra Pradeša (danes Telangana).

source.title: Hoysala Kingdom
paragraphs: The Hoysala Kingdom was a prominent South Indian dynasty that ruled most of what is now Karnataka, as well as parts of Tamil Nadu and southwestern Telangana, between the 11th and 14th centuries CE. The capital was initially located at Belur and was later moved to Halebidu.

The origins of the Hoysala dynasty are traced to the Malnad region of Karnataka. Initially, the Hoysalas served as feudatories of the Western Chalukyas of Kalyana. The dynasty gained prominence under King Vishnuvardhana particularly after the defeat of the Cholas in the Battle of Talakad, which consolidated Hoysala authority in the Deccan. Taking advantage of the conflict between the Western Chalukyas and the Kalachuris of Kalyani in the 12th century, the Hoysalas expanded their domain, eventually controlling large parts of Karnataka, and parts of northwestern Tamil Nadu and western Andhra Pradesh (now Telangana).

Hussain Shahi dynasty.headline: Dinastija Husein Šahi
paragraphs: Dinastija Husein Šahi (srednja bengalščina: হোসেন শাহী খান্দান) je bila arabska sajidska kraljeva rodbina, ki je od leta 1494 do 1538 vladala poznosrednjeveškemu Bengalskemu sultanatu.

source.title: Hussain Shahi dynasty
paragraphs: The Hussain Shahi dynasty (Middle Bengali: হোসেন শাহী খান্দান) was an Arab Sayyid royal family which ruled the late medieval Sultanate of Bengal from 1494 to 1538.

Hajderabad, imenovan tudi Hajderabadski nizamat, je bil kneževska država v Dekanu v južni osrednji Indiji s prestolnico v mestu Hajderabad. Danes je njeno ozemlje razdeljeno med sedanjo zvezno državo Telangana, pokrajino Kaljana-Karnataka v Karnataki in pokrajino Marathvada v Maharaštri v Republiki Indiji.

Državi je od leta 1724 do 1948 vladal nizam, sprva podkralj Mogulskega cesarstva v Dekanu. Postala je tudi protektorat Marathskega imperija, dokler ta leta 1818 ni bil strmoglavljen, in je postopoma kot ena prvih kneževskih držav s podpisom subsidiarne zavezniške pogodbe prišla pod britansko vrhovno oblast. V času Britanske Indije je imela država leta 1901 prihodke v višini 41,7 milijona rupij (kar ustreza 16 milijardam rupij oziroma 170 milijonom ameriških dolarjev leta 2026). Domače prebivalce Hajderabada ne glede na etnični izvor imenujejo »mulki« (rojaki), izraz pa se uporablja še danes. Vladarja države so imenovali tudi Nizam-ul-Mulk (nizam dežele).

source.title: Hyderabad State
paragraphs: Hyderabad State, also referred to as the Nizamate of Hyderabad, was a princely state in the Deccan region of south-central India with its capital at the city of Hyderabad. It is now divided into the present-day state of Telangana, the Kalyana-Karnataka region of Karnataka, and the Marathwada region of Maharashtra in the Republic of India.

The state was ruled from 1724 to 1948 by the Nizam, who was initially a viceroy of the Mughal Empire in the Deccan. It had also become a protectorate under the Maratha Empire, until the empire's overthrow in 1818 and gradually became one of the first princely states to come under British paramountcy by signing a subsidiary alliance agreement. At the time of the British Raj in 1901, the state had a revenue of ₹41.7 million (equivalent to ₹16 billion or US$170 million in 2026). The native inhabitants of Hyderabad State, regardless of ethnic origin, are called "Mulki" (countryman), a term still used today. The ruler of the state was also called as Nizam-ul-Mulk (Nizam of the country).

Prva indijsko-pakistanska vojna (1947–1948), znana tudi kot prva kašmirska vojna, se je od leta 1947 do 1948 bila med Indijo in Pakistanom za kneževsko državo Džamu in Kašmir. Bila je prva od indijsko-pakistanskih vojn med državama, ki sta se pravkar osamosvojili in sta bili obe dominiona v britanski Skupnosti narodov. Pakistan je vojno sprožil nekaj tednov po osamosvojitvi, ko je iz Vaziristana poslal plemenske laškarje (milice), da bi zavzel Kašmir in preprečil, da bi se njegov vladar pridružil Indiji.

source.title: India–Pakistan war of 1947–1948
paragraphs: The India–Pakistan war of 1947–1948, also known as the first Kashmir war, was a war fought between India and Pakistan over the princely state of Jammu and Kashmir from 1947 to 1948. It was the first of the India–Pakistan wars between the two newly independent nations; both were dominions within the British Commonwealth of Nations. Pakistan precipitated the war a few weeks after its independence by launching tribal lashkar (militias) from Waziristan, in an effort to capture Kashmir and to preempt the possibility of its ruler joining India.
Druga indijsko-pakistanska vojna (1965), znana tudi kot druga kašmirska vojna, je bila oborožen spopad med Pakistanom in Indijo, ki je potekal od avgusta do septembra 1965.

source.title: India–Pakistan war of 1965
paragraphs: The India–Pakistan war of 1965, also known as the second Kashmir war, was an armed conflict between Pakistan and India that took place from August 1965 to September 1965.

Indian campaign of Alexander the Great.headline: Indijski pohod Aleksandra Velikega
paragraphs: Indijski pohod Aleksandra Velikega se je začel leta 327 pr. n. št. in trajal do leta 325 pr. n. št. Po osvojitvi Ahemenidskega perzijskega cesarstva se je makedonska vojska odpravila na severozahod Indijske podceline. Aleksander Veliki je v dveh letih Makedonski imperij, helenistično kraljestvo, razširil na Gandharo in dolino Inda (današnji Pandžab in Sind) ter presegel prejšnje meje, ki jih je vzpostavila perzijska ahemenidska osvojitev.

Po priključitvi Gandhare (nekdanje perzijske satrapije) so Aleksander in njegove čete prodrli v Pandžab, kjer se mu je podredil kralj Omfis iz mesta Taksila, spopadel pa se je s Porom, drugim krajevnim kraljem. Leta 326 pr. n. št. je Aleksander v bitki ob Hidaspu porazil Paurave pod vodstvom Pora, čeprav je bil spopad morda najdražja bitka Makedoncev.

source.title: Indian campaign of Alexander the Great
paragraphs: The Indian campaign of Alexander the Great began in 327 BC and lasted until 325 BC. After conquering the Achaemenid Persian Empire, the Macedonian army undertook an expedition into the northwestern Indian subcontinent. Within two years, Alexander the Great expanded the Macedonian Empire, a Hellenistic kingdom, to include Gandhara and the Indus Valley (present-day Punjab and Sindh), surpassing the earlier frontiers established by the Persian Achaemenid conquest.

Following annexation of Gandāra (a former Persian satrapy), Alexander and his troops advanced into Punjab, where he received submission of the king Omphis of the city of Taxila, and confronted Porus, another regional king. In 326 BC, Alexander defeated the Pauravas under Porus in the Battle of the Hydaspes, although the engagement was possibly the Macedonians' most costly battle.

Indijski upor leta 1857 je bil velika vstaja v Indiji v letih 1857–1858 proti vladavini britanske Vzhodnoindijske družbe, ki je delovala kot suverena oblast v imenu britanske krone. Upor se je začel 10. maja 1857 kot upor sipajev v garniziji družbe v Merutu, mestu 64 km severovzhodno od Delhija. Nato so izbruhnili še drugi upori vojakov in civilistov, predvsem na zgornji Gangeški nižini in v osrednji Indiji, posamezni upori pa tudi severneje in vzhodneje. Upor je vojaško ogrožal britansko oblast v regiji in so ga zajezili šele s porazom upornikov pri Gvaliorju 20. junija 1858. Britanci so 1. novembra 1858 pomilostili vse upornike, ki niso bili vpleteni v umore, sovražnosti pa so uradno razglasili za končane šele 8. julija 1859.
Ime upora je sporno; imenujejo ga upor sipajev, indijski upor, velika vstaja, upor leta 1857, indijska vstaja in prva vojna za neodvisnost.
notes: Izpuščena je navedba v miljah.

source.title: Indian Rebellion of 1857
paragraphs: The Indian Rebellion of 1857 was a major uprising in India in 1857–58 against the rule of the British East India Company, which functioned as a sovereign power on behalf of the British Crown. The rebellion began on 10 May 1857 as a mutiny of sepoys of the company's garrison in Meerut, a town 40 miles (64 km) northeast of Delhi. It then erupted into other mutinies and civilian rebellions, chiefly in the upper Gangetic plain and central India, though incidents of revolt also occurred farther north and east. The rebellion posed a military threat to British power in that region, and was contained only with the rebels' defeat in Gwalior on 20 June 1858. On 1 November 1858, the British granted amnesty to all rebels not involved in murder, though they did not declare the hostilities to have formally ended until 8 July 1859.

The name of the revolt is contested, and it is variously described as the Sepoy Mutiny, the Indian Mutiny, the Great Rebellion, the Revolt of 1857, the Indian Insurrection, and the First War of Independence.

Indo-partsko kraljestvo, v starih sanskrtskih besedilih znano tudi kot Pahlave, je bilo sinkretistična država, ki jo je v 1. stoletju n. št. ustanovil Gondofar I. Na vrhuncu je Gondofar vladal območju, ki danes obsega dele vzhodnega Irana in Afganistana, večino Pakistana in dele severozahodne Indije. Indo-Parti so na nekaterih območjih vladali do leta 226 n. št., Paratarādže pa do konca 3. stoletja.

Kraljestvo je nastalo v letih 19/20, ko je upravitelj Drangiane (Sakastana) Gondofar I. razglasil neodvisnost od Partskega cesarstva. Pozneje se je odpravil na pohode proti vzhodu, Indoskitom in Indo-Grkom odvzel ozemlja in tako svoje kraljestvo spremenil v imperij. Ozemlje Indo-Partov se je po vpadih Kušanov v drugi polovici 1. stoletja močno skrčilo. Sakastan so obdržali, dokler ga okoli let 224/5 ni osvojilo Sasanidsko cesarstvo. V Beludžistanu je Paratarādže, krajevna indo-partska dinastija, okoli leta 262 n. št. prišla v orbito Sasanidskega cesarstva.

source.title: Indo-Parthian kingdom
paragraphs: The Indo-Parthian kingdom, also known as Pahlavas in the ancient Sanskrit texts, was a syncretic state founded by Gondophares I in the first century CE. At its zenith, Gondophares ruled an area which today covers parts of eastern Iran, parts of Afghanistan, most of Pakistan and parts of northwestern India. Indo-Parthians continued to rule in some areas until 226 CE, with Paratarajas continuing until late 3rd century.

The kingdom was founded in 19/20 when the governor of Drangiana (Sakastan) Gondophares I declared independence from the Parthian Empire. He would later make expeditions to the east, conquer territory from the Indo-Scythians and Indo-Greeks and thus transforming his kingdom into an empire. The domains of the Indo-Parthians were greatly reduced following the invasions of the Kushans in the second half of the 1st century. They managed to retain control of Sakastan, until its conquest by the Sasanian Empire in c. 224/5. In Baluchistan, the Paratarajas, a local Indo-Parthian dynasty, fell into the orbit of the Sasanian Empire circa 262 CE.

Pogodba o vodah Inda (IWT) je pogodba o razdelitvi vode med Indijo in Pakistanom, ki ureja uporabo vode iz rečnega sistema Inda na ozemlju obeh držav. Indija in Pakistan sta jo izpogajala ob posredovanju Svetovne banke, 19. septembra 1960 pa sta jo v Karačiju podpisala indijski predsednik vlade Džavaharlal Nehru in pakistanski predsednik Ajub kan. Šest velikih rek porečja Inda deli v dve skupini: Indiji daje nadzor nad vodami treh »vzhodnih rek« – Beasa, Ravija in Sutledža – s skupnim povprečnim letnim pretokom 41 milijard m³, Pakistanu pa nadzor nad tremi »zahodnimi rekami« – Indom, Čenabom in Dželumom – s skupnim povprečnim letnim pretokom 167 milijard m³.
notes: Izpuščene so navedbe v akrskih čevljih.

source.title: Indus Waters Treaty
paragraphs: The Indus Waters Treaty (IWT) is a water-distribution treaty between India and Pakistan to use the water available in the Indus River system in the territories of the two countries. The treaty was negotiated by India and Pakistan with the mediation of World Bank, and signed in Karachi on 19 September 1960 by Indian prime minister Jawaharlal Nehru and Pakistani president Ayub Khan. It classifies six major rivers of the Indus Basin into two categories, and gives India control over the waters of the three "Eastern Rivers"—the Beas, Ravi and Sutlej—which have a total mean annual flow of 33 million acre⋅ft (41 billion m3), while control over the three "Western Rivers"—the Indus, Chenab and Jhelum—which have a total mean annual flow of 135 million acre⋅ft (167 billion m3), was given to Pakistan.

Uporništvo v Džamuju in Kašmirju, znano tudi kot kašmirsko uporništvo, je trajajoče islamistično separatistično oboroženo uporništvo proti indijski upravi v Džamuju in Kašmirju, ozemlju, ki obsega jugozahodni del širše geografske regije Kašmir, o kateri se Indija in Pakistan prepirata od leta 1947.

V Džamuju in Kašmirju, dolgo gojišču separatističnih teženj, uporništvo traja od leta 1989. S. Paul Kapur trdi, da je »ljudsko nezadovoljstvo v Kašmirju izviralo predvsem iz kroničnega slabega upravljanja in zlorab indijske osrednje vlade ... [in] ni bilo pakistanska stvaritev. Pakistanci pa so kašmirsko nezadovoljstvo dejavno izkoristili in imeli ključno vlogo pri tem, da se je spontano, decentralizirano nasprotovanje indijski oblasti spremenilo v pravo uporništvo.« Nekatere uporniške skupine v Kašmirju podpirajo popolno neodvisnost, druge pa priključitev regije Pakistanu.

source.title: Insurgency in Jammu and Kashmir
paragraphs: The insurgency in Jammu and Kashmir, also known as the Kashmir insurgency, is an ongoing Islamist separatist militant insurgency against the Indian administration in Jammu and Kashmir, a territory constituting the southwestern portion of the larger geographical region of Kashmir, which has been the subject of a territorial dispute between India and Pakistan since 1947.

Jammu and Kashmir, long a breeding ground of separatist ambitions, has experienced the insurgency since 1989. S. Paul Kapur has argued that "[p]opular discontent in Kashmir resulted largely from chronic mismanagement and malfeasance on the part of the Indian central government... [and] was not a Pakistani creation. The Pakistanis actively capitalized on Kashmiri discontent, however, and played a crucial role in transforming spontaneous, decentralized opposition to Indian rule into a full-fledged insurgency." Some insurgent groups in Kashmir support complete independence, whereas others seek the region's accession to Pakistan.

V pakistanski provinci Hajber Pahtunhva se od leta 2004 bije uporništvo, v katerem sodelujejo islamistične borbene skupine, kot so Tehrik-i-Taliban Pakistan (TTP), Džundalah, Laškar-e-Islam (LeI), Tehreek-e-Nafaz-e-Shariat-e-Mohammadi (TNSM) in Al Kaida, njihovi srednjeazijski zavezniki, kot so Islamska država – provinca Horasan (ISKP), Islamsko gibanje Uzbekistana, Vzhodnoturkestansko gibanje, Džamaat-ul-Ahrar in Itihad-ul-Mudžahidin Pakistan, ter skupine organiziranega kriminala. Preden se je leta 2017 spremenil v uporništvo, je bil spopad vojna.

source.title: Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
paragraphs: Since 2004, an insurgency has been fought in the Pakistani province of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa by Islamist militant groups such as the Tehrik-i-Taliban Pakistan (TTP), Jundallah, Lashkar-e-Islam (LeI), the Tehreek-e-Nafaz-e-Shariat-e-Mohammadi (TNSM), Al-Qaeda, and their Central Asian allies such as the Islamic State – Khorasan Province (ISKP), Islamic Movement of Uzbekistan, East Turkistan Movement, Jamaat-ul-Ahrar, Ittihad-ul-Mujahideen Pakistan, and elements of organised crime. Before being transformed into an insurgency in 2017, the conflict was a war.

Insurgency in Laos.headline: Uporništvo v Laosu
paragraphs: Uporništvo v Laosu je spopad nizke intenzivnosti med Laoško ljudsko demokratično republiko na eni strani ter nekdanjimi pripadniki Skrivne vojske, laoškimi rojalisti, hmonškimi borci in drugimi etničnimi manjšinami laoškega višavja na drugi. Te skupine so bile tarča povračilnih ukrepov Laoške ljudske armade in Vietnamske ljudske armade, ker so podpirale protikomunistične vojaške pohode v Laosu, povezane z Združenimi državami, med laoško državljansko vojno, katere nadaljevanje je to uporništvo. Severni Vietnamci so leta 1958 vdrli v Laos in podpirali komunistični Pathet Lao. Vietnamski komunisti so Pathet Lao podpirali tudi po koncu laoške državljanske vojne in ustanovitvi Laoške ljudske demokratične republike. Zaradi politike laoške vlade je umrlo najmanj 100.000 hmonških civilistov, kar včasih imenujejo hmonški genocid.

source.title: Insurgency in Laos
paragraphs: The insurgency in Laos is a low-intensity conflict between the Lao People's Democratic Republic on one side and former members of the Secret Army, Laotian royalists, Hmong fighters, and other highland Laotian ethnic minorities on the other. These groups have faced reprisals from the Lao People's Army and Vietnam People's Army for their support of the United States-aligned, anti-communist military campaigns in Laos during the Laotian Civil War, which the insurgency is an extension of itself. The North Vietnamese invaded Laos in 1958 and supported the communist Pathet Lao. The Vietnamese communists continued to support the Pathet Lao after the end of the Laotian Civil War and the establishment of the Lao People's Democratic Republic. At least 100,000 Hmong civilians were killed as the result of Laotian governmental policies, in what has sometimes been referred to as the Hmong genocide.

Uporništvo v Severovzhodni Indiji so trajajoči oboroženi spopadi v več severovzhodnih indijskih zveznih državah med indijsko vlado in več borbenimi skupinami z različnimi političnimi ideologijami, med njimi separatizmom, komunizmom in islamizmom.

Severovzhodno Indijo sestavlja osem zveznih držav: sedem sestrskih držav Asam, Meghalaja, Tripura, Arunačal Pradeš, Mizoram, Manipur in Nagaland ter pozneje priključena bratska država Sikim. S preostalo Indijo jih povezuje koridor Siliguri, pas kopnega, ki je ponekod širok le 23 km. Napetosti med uporniki v sedmih sestrskih državah in osrednjo vlado ter med staroselskimi prebivalci in priseljenci iz drugih delov Indije in nezakonitimi priseljenci trajajo že več desetletij.
notes: Izpuščena je navedba v miljah.

source.title: Insurgency in Northeast India
paragraphs: The insurgency in Northeast India is ongoing armed conflicts in a number of India's northeastern states between several militants groups with various political ideologies, including separatism, communism, and Islamism, and the Indian government.

Northeast India consists of eight states: the seven sister states of Assam, Meghalaya, Tripura, Arunachal Pradesh, Mizoram, Manipur, and Nagaland, and the brother state Sikkim included later. These states are connected to the rest of India by the Siliguri Corridor, a strip of land as narrow as 14.29 miles (23.00 km) wide. Tensions have existed between insurgents in the seven sister states and the central government as well as amongst their native indigenous people and migrants from other parts of India and illegal immigrants for many decades now.

Uporništvo na Severnem Kavkazu je bilo oborožen spopad nizke intenzivnosti med Rusijo in borci, povezanimi s Kavkaškim emiratom ter od junija 2015 z Islamsko državo, na Severnem Kavkazu. Sledilo je (od Rusije razglašenemu) uradnemu koncu desetletne druge čečenske vojne 16. aprila 2009. Privabilo je prostovoljce z Bližnjega vzhoda in iz Severne Afrike, zahodne Evrope in Srednje Azije. Ruska zakonodaja drugo čečensko vojno in to uporništvo obravnava kot iste »protiteroristične operacije na ozemlju severnokavkaške regije«.

V poznejših letih je uporništvo razmeroma zamrlo. Na vrhuncu se je nasilje zgoščalo predvsem v severnokavkaških republikah Čečeniji, Dagestanu, Ingušetiji in Kabardino-Balkariji. Občasni incidenti so se zgodili tudi v okoliških regijah, kot so Severna Osetija–Alanija, Karačajevo-Čerkezija, Stavropolski okraj in Volgograjska oblast.

source.title: Insurgency in the North Caucasus
paragraphs: The insurgency in the North Caucasus was a low-level armed conflict between Russia and militants associated with the Caucasus Emirate and, from June 2015, the Islamic State, in the North Caucasus. It followed the (Russian-proclaimed) official end of the decade-long Second Chechen War on 16 April 2009. It attracted volunteers from the MENA region, Western Europe, and Central Asia. The Russian legislation considers the Second Chechen War and the insurgency described in this article as the same "counter-terrorist operations on the territory of the North Caucasus region".

The insurgency became relatively dormant in its later years. During its peak, the violence was mostly concentrated in the North Caucasus republics of Chechnya, Dagestan, Ingushetia and Kabardino-Balkaria. Occasional incidents happened in surrounding regions, such as North Ossetia–Alania, Karachay-Cherkessia, Stavropol Krai, and Volgograd Oblast.

Kraljestvo Jafna (tamilsko: யாழ்ப்பாண அரசு; sinhalsko: යාපනය රාජධානිය; 1215–1619 n. št.), znano tudi kot kraljestvo Arjačakravarti, je bilo zgodovinsko kraljestvo na območju današnje severne Šrilanke. Nastalo je okoli mesta Jafna na Jafnskem polotoku, po izročilu pa naj bi ga ustanovili po vpadu Kalinge Maghe iz Kalinge v Indiji. Kraljestvo, ki se je uveljavilo kot močna sila na severu, severovzhodu in zahodu otoka, je leta 1258 postalo davkoplačniški fevd imperija Pandja v današnji južni Indiji, neodvisnost pa je dobilo, ko je zadnjega pandjanskega vladarja Maduraja v začetku 14. stoletja porazil in pregnal Malik Kafur, general Delhijskega sultanata. Za kratek čas v začetku in sredi 14. stoletja je bilo vodilna sila na Šrilanki, ki so se ji podredila vsa regionalna kraljestva. Okoli leta 1450 pa ga je premagalo tekmeco kraljestvo Kotte, ko je vanj po ukazu Parakramabahuja VI. vdrl princ Sapumal.

source.title: Jaffna kingdom
paragraphs: The Jaffna kingdom (Tamil: யாழ்ப்பாண அரசு, Sinhala: යාපනය රාජධානිය; 1215–1619 CE), also known as Kingdom of Aryachakravarti, was a historical kingdom of what today is northern Sri Lanka. It came into existence around the town of Jaffna on the Jaffna Peninsula and was traditionally thought to have been established after the invasion of Kalinga Magha from Kalinga in India. Established as a powerful force in the north, northeast and west of the island, it eventually became a tribute-paying feudatory of the Pandyan Empire in modern South India in 1258, gaining independence when the last Pandyan ruler of Madurai was defeated and expelled in the early 14th century by Malik Kafur, the army general of the Delhi Sultanate. For a brief period in the early to mid-14th century it was an ascendant power in the island of Sri Lanka, to which all regional kingdoms accepted subordination. However, the kingdom was overpowered by the rival Kotte Kingdom around 1450 when it was invaded by Prince Sapumal under the orders of Parakramabahu VI.

Japanese coup d'état in French Indochina.headline: Japonski državni udar v Francoski Indokini
paragraphs: Japonski državni udar v Francoski Indokini, znan kot Meigō Sakusen (明号作戦, operacija Svetla luna; Minh Hào tác chiến ali Chiến dịch Giăng Sáng), japonska operacija, se je zgodil 9. marca 1945, proti koncu druge svetovne vojne. Ker so japonske sile vojno izgubljale in je grozila zavezniška invazija na Indokino, so se Japonci bali upora francoskih kolonialnih sil proti njim.

Čeprav so Francozi napad pričakovali, so Japonci z vojaškim pohodom udarili po garnizijah po vsej koloniji. Francoze so presenetili in zavzeli vse garnizije, nekateri vojaki pa so morali pobegniti na nacionalistično Kitajsko, kjer so jih strogo internirali. Japonci so zamenjali francoske uradnike in dejansko odpravili francoski nadzor nad Indokino. Nato so lahko ustanovili novo Vietnamsko cesarstvo, Kraljestvo Kampučijo in Kraljestvo Luang Prabang, ki naj bi pod njihovim vodstvom privolila v japonsko vojaško navzočnost in preprečila morebitno zavezniško invazijo.

source.title: Japanese coup d'état in French Indochina
paragraphs: The Japanese coup d'état in French Indochina, known as Meigō Sakusen (明号作戦, Operation Bright Moon; Minh Hào tác chiến or Chiến dịch Giăng Sáng), was a Japanese operation that took place on 9 March 1945, towards the end of World War II. With Japanese forces losing the war and the threat of an Allied invasion of Indochina imminent, the Japanese were concerned about an uprising against them by French colonial forces.

Despite the French having anticipated an attack, the Japanese struck in a military campaign attacking garrisons all over the colony. The French were caught off guard and all of the garrisons were overrun, with some then having to escape to Nationalist China, where they were harshly interned. The Japanese replaced French officials, and effectively dismantled their control of Indochina. The Japanese were then able to install and create a new Empire of Vietnam, Kingdom of Kampuchea and Kingdom of Luang Prabang which under their direction would acquiesce to their military presence and forestall a potential invasion by the Allies.

Japanese invasion of French Indochina.headline: Japonska invazija na Francosko Indokino
paragraphs: Japonska invazija na Francosko Indokino (仏印進駐; francosko: Invasion japonaise de l'Indochine) je bila kratek nenapovedan vojaški spopad med Japonsko in Vichyjsko Francijo na severu Francoske Indokine. Boji so trajali od 22. do 26. septembra 1940, hkrati z bitko v južnem Guangšiju v kitajsko-japonski vojni, ki je bila glavni razlog, da je Japonska tedaj zasedla Vietnam.

Glavni cilj Japoncev je bil preprečiti, da bi Kitajska uvažala orožje in gorivo prek Francoske Indokine po železnici Kunming–Hajfong, ki je vodila iz indokitajskega pristanišča Hajfong prek prestolnice Hanoj do kitajskega mesta Kunming v Junanu.

Čeprav sta se francoska in japonska vlada dogovorili že pred izbruhom bojev, oblasti nekaj dni niso mogle obvladati dogajanja na terenu, dokler čete niso prenehale bojevati. Po prejšnjem dogovoru je Japonska smela zasesti Tonkin na severu Indokine in tako dejansko blokirati Kitajsko.
notes: Izpuščena je japonska transliteracija.

source.title: Japanese invasion of French Indochina
paragraphs: The Japanese invasion of French Indochina (仏印進駐, Futsu-in shinchū) (French: Invasion japonaise de l'Indochine) was a short undeclared military confrontation between Japan and Vichy France in northern French Indochina. Fighting lasted from 22 to 26 September 1940; the same time as the Battle of South Guangxi in the Sino-Japanese War, which was the main objective as to why Japan occupied Vietnam during this time.

The main objective of the Japanese was to prevent China from importing arms and fuel through French Indochina along the Kunming–Haiphong railway, from the Indochinese port of Haiphong, through the capital of Hanoi to the Chinese city of Kunming in Yunnan.

Although an agreement had been reached between the French and Japanese governments prior to the outbreak of fighting, authorities were unable to control events on the ground for several days before the troops stood down. As per the prior agreement, Japan was allowed to occupy Tonkin in northern Indochina, and thus effectively blockade China.

Japanese invasion of Sakhalin.headline: Japonska invazija na Sahalin
paragraphs: Japonska invazija na Sahalin je bila zadnja kopenska bitka rusko-japonske vojne in je potekala od 7. do 31. julija 1905.

source.title: Japanese invasion of Sakhalin
paragraphs: The Japanese invasion of Sakhalin was the last land battle of the Russo-Japanese War, and took place from 7 July to 31 July 1905.

Japanese invasion of Thailand.headline: Japonska invazija na Tajsko
paragraphs: Japonska invazija na Tajsko (tajsko: การบุกครองไทยของญี่ปุ่น; japonsko: 日本軍のタイ進駐) se je zgodila 8. decembra 1941. V kratkem spopadu sta se bojevala Kraljevina Tajska in Japonski imperij. Kljub hudim bojem na jugu Tajske so trajali le pet ur in se končali s premirjem. Tajska in Japonska sta nato sklenili zavezništvo, s katerim je Tajska do konca druge svetovne vojne postala del sil osi. Invazija se je zgodila približno dve uri pred japonskim napadom na Pearl Harbor.
notes: Izpuščeni sta tajska in japonska transliteracija.

source.title: Japanese invasion of Thailand
paragraphs: The Japanese invasion of Thailand (Thai: การบุกครองไทยของญี่ปุ่น, RTGS: Kan Buk Khrong Thai Khong Yipun; Japanese: 日本軍のタイ進駐, romanized: Nihongun no Tai shinchū) occurred on 8 December 1941. It was briefly fought between the Kingdom of Thailand and the Empire of Japan. Despite fierce fighting in southern Thailand, the fighting lasted only five hours before ending in a ceasefire. Thailand and Japan then formed an alliance making Thailand part of the Axis alliance until the end of World War II. It occurred roughly two hours before the Japanese attack on Pearl Harbor.

Jaunpur Sultanate.headline: Džaunpurski sultanat
paragraphs: Džaunpurski sultanat (perzijsko: سلطنتِ جونپور) je bil poznosrednjeveška indijska muslimanska država, ki je med letoma 1394 in 1494 vladala velikemu delu današnjih indijskih zveznih držav Utar Pradeš in Bihar ter južnemu Nepalu. Leta 1394 ga je ustanovil Hvadža-i-Džahan Malik Sarvar, evnuh suženj in nekdanji vezir sultana Nasirudina Mohameda Šaha, sredi razpadanja Delhijskega sultanata pod dinastijo Tughlak. Sultanat s središčem v Džaunpurju je oblast razširil na velik del dvorečja Gangesa in Jamune. Vrhunec je dosegel pod sultanom Ibrahimom Šahom, ki je veliko prispeval tudi k razvoju islamskega izobraževanja v sultanatu. Leta 1494 so sultana Huseina Šaha Šarkija pri Benaresu porazile sile afganistanskega vladarja Bahlula Lodija, sultana delhijske dinastije Lodi, nato pa je Husein pobegnil v Kahalgaon v današnjem Biharju, kjer mu je bengalski sultan dodelil pargano. Tam je smel kovati lasten denar, Bengal pa mu je obljubil pomoč pri vrnitvi kraljestva. Umrl je leta 1505.

source.title: Jaunpur Sultanate
paragraphs: The Jaunpur Sultanate (Persian: سلطنتِ جونپور) was a late medieval Indian Muslim state which ruled over much of what is now the Indian states of Uttar Pradesh and Bihar and southern Nepal between 1394 and 1494. It was founded in 1394 by Khwajah-i-Jahan Malik Sarwar, a eunuch slave and former wazir of Sultan Nasiruddin Muhammad Shah, amidst the disintegration of the Delhi Sultanate under the ruling Tughlaq dynasty. Centred in Jaunpur, the sultanate extended authority over a large part of the Ganges-Yamuna Doab. It reached its greatest height under the rule of Sultan Ibrahim Shah, who also vastly contributed to the development of Islamic education in the Sultanate. In 1494, Sultan Hussain Shah Sharqi was defeated by the forces of the Afghan ruler Bahlul Lodi, sultan of the Lodi dynasty of the Delhi Sultanate at Benares after which Hussain fled to Kahalgaon in modern-day Bihar where the Sultan of Bengal assigned him a pargana. Here he was allowed to mint his own coins and was promised help from Bengal in recovering his kingdom. He died in 1505.

Jin dynasty (1115-1234).headline: Dinastija Džin (1115–1234)
paragraphs: Dinastija Džin (kitajsko: 金朝), uradno Veliki Džin (大金), je bila cesarska dinastija Kitajske pod vodstvom Džurčenov in cesarstvo, ki mu je vladal klan Vanjen, obstajala pa je od leta 1115 do 1234. Po vladajočem ljudstvu jo pogosto imenujejo tudi džurčenska dinastija ali džurčenski Džin. Na vrhuncu je cesarstvo segalo od Zunanje Mandžurije na severu do črte Činling–Huajhe na jugu.

Dinastija Džin je nastala z uporom Vanjena Agude proti dinastiji Ljao (916–1125), ki je obvladovala severno Kitajsko, dokler je mladi Džin ni pregnal v Zahodne pokrajine, kjer je v kitajskem zgodovinopisju znana kot Zahodni Ljao. Po osvojitvi ozemlja Ljaa je Džin začel stoletje dolg pohod proti dinastiji Song (960–1279) s središčem na jugu Kitajske, katere vladarji so bili po narodnosti Hani. Džinski cesarji so se med vladavino prilagodili hanskim šegam in celo utrdili Kitajski zid proti vzpenjajočemu se Mongolskemu cesarstvu. Džin je spodbujal tudi vrsto kulturnih dosežkov v državi, denimo oživitev konfucianizma.
notes: Izpuščen je zapis v pinjinu; kitajska pismenka ostaja.

source.title: Jin dynasty (1115–1234)
paragraphs: The Jin dynasty (Chinese: 金朝; pinyin: Jīn cháo), officially the Great Jin (大金; Dà Jīn), was a Jurchen-led imperial dynasty of China and empire ruled by the Wanyan clan that existed between 1115 and 1234. It is also often called the Jurchen dynasty or the Jurchen Jin after the ruling Jurchen people. At its peak, the empire extended from Outer Manchuria in the north to the Qinling–Huaihe Line in the south.

The Jin dynasty emerged from Wanyan Aguda's rebellion against the Liao dynasty (916–1125), which held sway over northern China until being driven by the nascent Jin to the Western Regions, where they would become known in Chinese historiography as the Western Liao. After conquering the Liao territory, the Jin launched a century-long campaign against the Song dynasty (960–1279) based in southern China, whose rulers were ethnically Han Chinese. Over the course of the Jin's rule, their emperors adapted to Han customs and even fortified the Great Wall against the ascendant Mongol Empire. The Jin also oversaw a number of internal cultural advances, such as the revival of Confucianism.

Kabul Shahi.headline: Kabulski šahi
paragraphs: Izraz Kabulski šahi označuje dve nekdanji nemuslimanski dinastiji s sedežem v Kabulu:
turške šahe (665–822 n. št.),
hindujske šahe (822–1026 n. št.).
notes: Zapis je povezan z razločitveno stranjo; prevedeno je kot seznam, kot stoji.

source.title: Kabul Shahi
paragraphs: Kabul Shahi is a term used to denote two former non-Muslim dynasties based in Kabul:
Turk Shahis (665–822 CE)
Hindu Shahis (822–1026 CE)

Kachin conflict.headline: Kačinski konflikt
paragraphs: Kačinski konflikt ali kačinska vojna je eden od več spopadov, ki jih skupaj imenujejo notranji konflikt v Mjanmaru. Kačinski uporniki se od leta 1961 bojujejo proti tatmadavu (mjanmarskim oboroženim silam), med njimi pa je bilo sklenjeno le eno večje premirje, ki je trajalo od leta 1994 do 2011, skupaj 17 let.

Od ponovnega izbruha sovražnosti leta 2011 je bilo ubitih na tisoče civilistov, več kot 100.000 ljudi pa je bilo razseljenih. Obe strani obtožujejo druga drugo obsežne uporabe protipehotnih min, otrok vojakov, sistematičnega posiljevanja in mučenja.

source.title: Kachin conflict
paragraphs: The Kachin conflict or the Kachin War is one of the multiple conflicts which are collectively referred to as the internal conflict in Myanmar. Kachin insurgents have been fighting against the Tatmadaw (Myanmar Armed Forces) since 1961, with only one major ceasefire being brokered between them, which lasted from 1994 to 2011, a total of 17 years.

Since the resumption of hostilities in 2011, thousands of civilians have been killed, whilst over 100,000 more have been displaced. Widespread use of landmines, child soldiers, systematic rape and torture have been alleged by both sides.

Dinastija Kadamba je bila starodavna kraljeva rodbina iz današnje Karnatake v Indiji, ki je iz Banavasija v današnjem okrožju Utara Kanada vladala severni Karnataki in Konkanu. Kraljestvo je okoli leta 345 ustanovil Majurašarma, pozneje pa je kazalo možnosti, da bi preraslo v imperij. Na cesarske ambicije kažejo naslovi in vzdevki, ki so si jih nadeli vladarji, ter poročne zveze z drugimi kraljestvi in imperiji, denimo z Vakatakami in Guptami iz severne Indije. Majurašarma je morda s pomočjo nekaterih domačih plemen porazil vojske Palav iz Kančija in razglasil suverenost. Moč Kadamb je dosegla vrhunec v času vladanja Kakusthavarme.

source.title: Kadamba dynasty
paragraphs: The Kadamba dynasty were an ancient royal family from modern Karnataka, India, that ruled northern Karnataka and the Konkan from Banavasi in present-day Uttara Kannada district in India. The kingdom was founded by Mayurasharma in c. 345, and at later times showed the potential of developing into imperial proportions. An indication of their imperial ambitions is provided by the titles and epithets assumed by its rulers, and the marital relations they kept with other kingdoms and empires, such as the Vakatakas and Guptas of northern India. Mayurasharma defeated the armies of the Pallavas of Kanchi possibly with the help of some native tribes and claimed sovereignty. The Kadamba power reached its peak during the rule of Kakusthavarma.

Dinastija Kakatija (IAST: Kākatīya) je bila teluška dinastija, ki je med 12. in 14. stoletjem vladala večini vzhodnega Dekana v današnji Indiji. Njeno ozemlje je obsegalo velik del današnje Telangane in Andhra Pradeša, dele vzhodne Karnatake, severnega Tamil Naduja in južne Odiše. Prestolnica je bila Orugallu, danes znan kot Varangal.

source.title: Kakatiya dynasty
paragraphs: The Kakatiya dynasty (IAST: Kākatīya) was a Telugu dynasty that ruled most of eastern Deccan region in present-day India between 12th and 14th centuries. Their territory comprised much of the present day Telangana and Andhra Pradesh, parts of eastern Karnataka, northern Tamil Nadu, and southern Odisha. Their capital was Orugallu, now known as Warangal.

Dinastija Kalabra (imenovana tudi Kaḷabrar, Kaḷappirar, Kallupura ali Kalvar) je bila dinastija vladarjev celotne tamilske pokrajine ali njenih delov nekje med 3. in 6. stoletjem n. št., po starih dinastijah zgodnjih Čol, zgodnjih Pandj in Čer. Podatki o izvoru in vladavini Kalabr so negotovi in skopi. Domnevajo, da so bili nekoč fevdalni podložniki Palav. Profesor M. S. Ramaswami Aiyangar je v knjigi »Studies in South Indian Jainism« (Študije o južnoindijskem džainizmu) iz leta 1922 trdil, da je bilo obdobje Kalabr »avgustovska doba tamilske književnosti«. Opozoril je tudi, da številni palavski in pandjanski zapisi opisujejo, kako so Kalabre porazili Čole, Pandje in Čere ter vzpostavili svojo oblast. Obdobje Kalabr včasih imenujejo »temno obdobje« tamilske zgodovine, podatke o njem pa večinoma sklepajo iz omemb v književnosti in napisih, ki so nastali mnogo stoletij po koncu njihovega obdobja.

source.title: Kalabhra dynasty
paragraphs: The Kalabhra dynasty (also called Kaḷabrar, Kaḷappirar, Kallupura or Kalvar) were rulers of all or parts of Tamil region sometime between the 3rd century and 6th century CE, after the ancient dynasties of the early Cholas, the early Pandyas and Chera. Information about the origin and reign of the Kalabhras is uncertain and scarce. It is believed that they were once the feudatories of the Pallavas. Prof. M. S. Ramaswami Aiyangar, in his 1922 book "Studies in South Indian Jainism" asserted that the Kalabhra period was 'The Augustan age of Tamil literature". He also noted that many Pallava and Pandya records describe how the Kalabhras defeated the Cholas, Pandyas, and Cheras and established their rule. The Kalabhra era is sometimes referred to as the "dark period" of Tamil history, and information about it is generally inferred from any mentions in the literature and inscriptions that are dated many centuries after their era ended.

Kamarupa.headline: Kamarupa
paragraphs: Kamarupa (imenovana tudi Pragdžjotiša ali Pragdžjotiša-Kamarupa), zgodnja država klasičnega obdobja na Indijski podcelini, je bila (skupaj z Davako) prvo zgodovinsko kraljestvo v Asamu. Beseda Kamrupa se prvič pojavi v Samudraguptovem alahabadskem ediktu, pred tem pa je ni zaslediti.

Kamarupa je obstajala od leta 350 do 1140 n. št., Davako pa si je priključila v 5. stoletju n. št. Vladale so ji tri dinastije iz prestolnic v današnjem Guvahatiju, Severnem Guvahatiju in Tezpurju, na vrhuncu pa je obsegala vso dolino Brahmaputre, dele severnega Bengala, Butana in severnega Bangladeša, občasno tudi dele današnjega Zahodnega Bengala, Biharja in Silheta.

source.title: Kamarupa
paragraphs: Kamarupa (also called Pragjyotisha or Pragjyotisha-Kamarupa), an early state during the Classical period on the Indian subcontinent, was (along with Davaka) the first historical kingdom of Assam. The Kamrupa word first appeared in the Samudragupta Allahabad Edict before that there is no mention of existence of this word.

Though Kamarupa prevailed from 350 to 1140 CE, Davaka was absorbed by Kamarupa in the 5th century CE. Ruled by three dynasties from their capitals in present-day Guwahati, North Guwahati and Tezpur, Kamarupa at its height covered the entire Brahmaputra Valley, parts of North Bengal, Bhutan and northern part of Bangladesh, and at times portions of what is now West Bengal, Bihar and Sylhet.

Kambojas.headline: Kamboji
paragraphs: Kamboji so bili jugovzhodno iransko ljudstvo, ki je naseljevalo najbolj severovzhodni del ozemlja iranskih plemen ob meji z indijskimi deželami. Pojavljajo se le v indoarijskih napisih in književnosti, prvič pa so izpričani v poznem vedskem obdobju.

Govorili so jezik, podoben mlajši avestijščini, katerega besede naj bi bile vključene v aramejsko-iransko različico dvojezičnega skalnega napisa iz Kandaharja, ki ga je postavil maurijski cesar Ašoka (vladal 268–232 pr. n. št.). Bili so privrženci zoroastrizma, kar kaže njihovo prepričanje, da je treba ubijati žuželke, kače, črve, žabe in druge male živali, kar omenja avestijski Videvdat.

source.title: Kambojas
paragraphs: The Kambojas were a southeastern Iranian people who inhabited the northeastern most part of the territory populated by Iranian tribes, which bordered the Indian lands. They only appear in Indo-Aryan inscriptions and literature, being first attested during the later part of the Vedic period.

They spoke a language similar to Younger Avestan, whose words are considered to have been incorporated in the Aramao-Iranian version of the Kandahar Bilingual Rock Inscription erected by the Maurya emperor Ashoka (r. 268–232 BCE). They were adherents of Zoroastrianism, as demonstrated by their beliefs that insects, snakes, worms, frogs, and other small animals had to be killed, a practice mentioned in the Avestan Vendidad.

Kraljestvo Kampili je bilo kratkotrajno hindujsko kraljestvo v 14. stoletju n. št. v južni Indiji. Ležalo je blizu Balarija ob reki Tungabhadri na severovzhodu današnje zvezne države Karnataka v Indiji. Uničeno je bilo leta 1327 n. št., ko so ga premagale vojske dinastije Tughlak in so se njegovi branilci ob porazu odločili za džauhar (množični vojni samomor s sežigom). Kraljestvo Kampili v nekaterih zgodovinskih virih imenujejo kraljestvo Basnaga; navdihnilo je hindujski Vidžajanagarski imperij in nazadnje privedlo do njegovega nastanka.

source.title: Kampili kingdom
paragraphs: The Kampili kingdom was a short-lived Hindu kingdom in the 14th century CE in South India. The kingdom existed near Ballari in the Tungabhadra river in the northeastern parts of the present-day Karnataka state, India. It was destroyed after a defeat by the armies of the Tughlaq dynasty and a Jauhar (mass war suicide by immolation) in 1327 CE when it faced a defeat. The Kampili kingdom in some historical accounts is called the Basnaga kingdom, and it is the kingdom which inspired and ultimately led to the Hindu Vijayanagara Empire.

Kannaudž je starodavno mesto v indijski zvezni državi Utar Pradeš in občina (nagar palika) s sedežem uprave istoimenskega okrožja. V starem vedskem obdobju so ga poznali kot Kanjakubdža; bil je zaporedoma prestolnica mahadžanapade Pančala in nato dinastije Ajudha. V stari sanskrtski književnosti iz časa Ramajane se je sprva imenoval Mahodaja in tako tudi pod dinastijo Gurdžara-Pratihara, v poznem srednjem veku pa je bil jedro kraljestva Kannaudž, kateremu so vladale zaporedne kraljeve rodbine ali pa je bilo del večjih imperijev.

Kannaudž, slaven kot »indijska prestolnica parfumov«, je znan po stoletja stari destilaciji dišav in izdelovanju parfumov. Tradicionalni kannaudžski parfum je zaščitena geografska označba in ga izdelujejo z atarjem iz cvetnih listov rož, ki rastejo na tem območju.
notes: Izpuščena je izgovarjava (IPA). Zapis kraljestva Kannaudž je povezan s člankom o mestu.

source.title: Kannauj
paragraphs: Kannauj (Hindustani pronunciation: [kənːɔːd͡ʒ]) is an ancient city in the Indian state of Uttar Pradesh and a municipal board (nagar palika) home to the administrative headquarters of the eponymous district. Known as Kanyakubja during the ancient Vedic period, it was successively the capital city of the Mahajanapada Panchala Kingdom and then of the Ayudha dynasty. Originally known as Mahodaya in ancient Sanskrit literature dating back to the Ramayana era, and later known as Mahodaya under the Gurjara-Pratihara dynasty, in the later medieval era, it formed the core of the Kingdom of Kannauj and was ruled by multiple successive royal families or as part of greater imperial polities.

Famous as "India's perfume capital", Kannauj is known for its centuries old distillation of scents and perfume production. The traditional Kannauj Perfume, is a protected geographical indication and is elaborated with attar, produced with the petals of flowers grown in this area.
Dinastija Kanva ali Kanvavamša je bila vladajoča dinastija Magadhe, ki jo je ustanovil Vasudeva Kanva, potem ko je strmoglavil prejšnjo dinastijo Šunga, vladala pa je od leta 73 do 28 pr. n. št.

Čeprav puranska književnost navaja, da so Kanve vladali iz nekdanje šungovske prestolnice Pataliputre v Magadhi na vzhodu Indije, njihove kovance najdemo predvsem na območju Vidiše v osrednji Indiji, ki je bila tudi prestolnica poznejših šungovskih vladarjev.

Dinastijo Kanva je leta 73 pr. n. št. ustanovil Vasudeva Kanva. Vasudeva je bil sprva minister šungovskega cesarja Devabhutija, ki ga je nato umoril in si prilastil prestol. Kanvski vladar je kraljem dinastije Šunga dovolil, da so v nekem kotu nekdanjih posesti še naprej neopazno vladali. Kanvskih vladarjev je bilo štiri. Po puranah so njihovo dinastijo leta 28 pr. n. št. končali Satavahane.

source.title: Kanva dynasty
paragraphs: The Kanva dynasty or Kanvavamsha was a ruling dynasty of Magadha, established after Vasudeva Kanva overthrew the preceding Shunga dynasty and ruled from 73 BCE to 28 BCE.

Although the Puranic literature indicates that the Kanvas ruled from the former capital of the Shungas in Pataliputra, Magadha in Eastern India, their coins are primarily found in and around the region of Vidisha in Central India, which had also been the capital of later Shunga rulers.

The Kanva dynasty was established by Vasudeva Kanva in 73 BCE. Vasudeva was initially a minister of the Shunga Emperor Devabhuti, who then assassinated the former emperor and usurped the throne. The Kanva ruler allowed the kings of the Shunga dynasty to continue to rule in obscurity in a corner of their former dominions. There were four Kanva rulers. According to the Puranas, their dynasty was brought to an end by the Satavahanas in 28 BCE.

Kargilska vojna, znana tudi kot kargilski konflikt, se je od maja do julija 1999 bila med Indijo in Pakistanom v okrožju Kargil v Ladakhu, tedaj delu zvezne države Džamu in Kašmir pod indijsko upravo, in ob nadzorni črti (LoC). V Indiji spopad imenujejo tudi operacija Vidžaj (dobesedno »zmaga«), kar je bilo kodno ime indijske vojaške operacije v regiji. Indijsko vojno letalstvo je skupaj z indijsko kopensko vojsko pregnalo pakistansko vojsko in paravojaške enote z izpraznjenih indijskih položajev ob LoC v operaciji, imenovani Safed Sagar (dobesedno »belo morje«).

source.title: Kargil War
paragraphs: The Kargil War, also known as the Kargil conflict, was fought between India and Pakistan from May to July 1999 in the Kargil district of Ladakh, then part of the Indian-administered state of Jammu and Kashmir and along the Line of Control (LoC). In India, the conflict is also referred to as Operation Vijay (lit. 'Victory'), which was the codename of the Indian military operation in the region. The Indian Air Force acted jointly with the Indian Army to flush out the Pakistan Army and paramilitary troops from vacated Indian positions along the LoC, in what was designated as Operation Safed Sagar (lit. 'White Sea').

Dinastija Karkota (ok. 625–855 n. št.) je v 7. in 8. stoletju vladala Kašmirski dolini in nekaterim severnim delom Indijske podceline. Njena vladavina je prinesla obdobje političnega širjenja in gospodarske blaginje, Kašmir pa je postal središče kulture in učenosti.

Vladarji dinastije Karkota so v svojih deželah zgradili več svetišč Višnuju, pod njihovo vladavino pa je cvetel tudi budizem. V ruševinah njihove prestolnice so stupe, čaitje in vihare. Sončni tempelj Martand v okrožju Anantnag je dal zgraditi Lalitaditja. To je najstarejši znani sončni tempelj v Indiji in je bil tedaj eden največjih templjev.
Avanti Varman je leta 855 zasedel kašmirski prestol, ustanovil dinastijo Utpala in končal vladavino dinastije Karkota.

source.title: Karkota dynasty
paragraphs: The Karkota dynasty (c. 625 − 855 CE) ruled over the Kashmir valley and some northern parts of the Indian subcontinent during 7th and 8th centuries. Their rule saw a period of political expansion, economic prosperity and emergence of Kashmir as a centre of culture and scholarship.

The Karkota rulers constructed several shrines to Vishnu in their dominions. They however also allowed Buddhism to flourish under them. Stupa, Chaitya and Vihara can be found in the ruins of their capital. Martand Sun Temple in the Anantnag district was built by Lalitaditya. It is the oldest known Sun temple in India and was also one of the biggest temple complexes at the time.
Avanti Varman ascended the throne of Kashmir in 855, establishing the Utpala dynasty and ending the rule of Karkota dynasty.

Kašmir je najsevernejša geografska regija Indijske podceline. Do sredine 19. stoletja je izraz Kašmir označeval le Kašmirsko dolino med Veliko Himalajo in gorovjem Pir Pandžal. Odtlej obsega tudi širše območje nekdanje kneževske države Džamu in Kašmir, ki vključuje ozemlji Džamu in Kašmir ter Ladakh pod indijsko upravo, ozemlji Azad Kašmir in Gilgit-Baltistan pod pakistansko upravo ter ozemlji Aksaj Čin in Transkarakorumski trakt pod kitajsko upravo.
notes: Izpuščen je angleški zapis izgovarjave.

source.title: Kashmir
paragraphs: Kashmir ( KASH-meer or kash-MEER) is the northernmost geographical region of the Indian subcontinent. Until the mid-19th century, the term Kashmir denoted only the Kashmir Valley between the Great Himalayas and the Pir Panjal Range. The term has since also come to encompass a larger area that formerly comprised the princely state of Jammu and Kashmir, and includes the Indian-administered territories of Jammu and Kashmir and Ladakh, the Pakistani-administered territories of Azad Kashmir and Gilgit-Baltistan, and the Chinese-administered territories of Aksai Chin and the Trans-Karakoram Tract.

Kašmirski konflikt je ozemeljski spor o regiji Kašmir, predvsem med Indijo in Pakistanom, v severovzhodnem delu regije pa tudi med Kitajsko in Indijo. Spor se je začel po delitvi Indije leta 1947, saj sta Indija in Pakistan zahtevala celotno nekdanjo kneževsko državo Džamu in Kašmir. Spor o regiji je prerasel v tri vojne med Indijo in Pakistanom in več drugih oboroženih spopadov. Indija nadzoruje približno 55 % površine regije, ki vključuje Džamu, Kašmirsko dolino, večino Ladakha in ledenik Siačen, in 70 % prebivalstva; Pakistan nadzoruje približno 30 % površine, ki vključuje Azad Kašmir in Gilgit-Baltistan; Kitajska pa preostalih 15 % površine, ki vključuje Aksaj Čin, večinoma nenaseljeni Transkarakorumski trakt in del sektorja Demčok.

source.title: Kashmir conflict
paragraphs: The Kashmir conflict is a territorial conflict over the Kashmir region, primarily between India and Pakistan, and also between China and India in the northeastern portion of the region. The conflict started after the partition of India in 1947 as both India and Pakistan claimed the entirety of the former princely state of Jammu and Kashmir. It is a dispute over the region that escalated into three wars between India and Pakistan and several other armed skirmishes. India controls approximately 55% of the land area of the region that includes Jammu, the Kashmir Valley, most of Ladakh, the Siachen Glacier, and 70% of its population; Pakistan controls approximately 30% of the land area that includes Azad Kashmir and Gilgit-Baltistan; and China controls the remaining 15% of the land area that includes the Aksai Chin region, the mostly uninhabited Trans-Karakoram Tract, and part of the Demchok sector.

Kashmir Sultanate.headline: Kašmirski sultanat
paragraphs: Kašmirski sultanat, v zgodovini polatinjen kot Sultanat Cashmere, je bil srednjeveško kraljestvo predvsem v Kašmirski dolini na severu Indijske podceline med začetkom 14. in koncem 16. stoletja. Ustanovil ga je Rinčan Šah, ladaški plemič, ki je z budizma prestopil v islam. Po kratkem medvladju Lohar je Šah Mir, Rinčanov svetovalec, strmoglavil dinastijo Lohara in ustanovil svojo dinastijo. Šah Miriji so vladali od leta 1339, dokler jih leta 1561 niso odstavili vojskovodje in plemiči iz rodu Čak. Čaki so sultanatu vladali do mogulske osvojitve leta 1586 in svoje vdaje leta 1589.

source.title: Kashmir Sultanate
paragraphs: The Kashmir Sultanate, historically Latinised as the Sultanate of Cashmere, was a medieval kingdom primarily based in the Kashmir Valley, in the northern part of the Indian subcontinent, between the early 14th and late 16th centuries. It was established by Rinchan Shah, a Ladakhi noble who had converted from Buddhism to Islam. After a brief interregnum by the Loharas, Shah Mir, a councillor of Rinchan, overthrew the Lohara dynasty and founded his own dynasty. The Shah Miris ruled from 1339 until they were deposed by the Chak warlords and nobles in 1561. The Chaks continued to rule the sultanate until the Mughal conquest in 1586 and their surrender in 1589.
Kaši (palijsko: Kāsī) je bilo starodavno indijsko kraljestvo, katerega obstoj je izpričan v železni dobi.

source.title: Kāśī (kingdom)
paragraphs: Kāśī (Pali: Kāsī) was an ancient kingdom of India whose existence is attested during the Iron Age.

Khadga Dynasty.headline: Dinastija Khadga
paragraphs: Dinastija Khadga je bila budistična dinastija, ki je od leta 625 do 716 n. št. vladala območjema Vanga in Samatata v starem Bengalu. Kronološko se je kot močno bengalsko kraljestvo pojavila med padcem kraljestva Gauda in vzponom imperija Pala. Njenemu vzponu je morda neposredno pred tem predhodilo strmoglavljenje prej vladajoče dinastije Bhadra. Khadge niso prevzeli cesarskih naslovov, so pa ohranili suverenost nad starim kraljestvom Vanga in pozneje osvojili Samatato. Nasledila jo je budistična dinastija Deva iz 8. in 9. stoletja.
notes: Izpuščena je izgovarjava (IPA).

source.title: Khadga dynasty
paragraphs: Khadga dynasty (Bengali: [kʰɔɽɡo rad͡ʒbɔŋʃo]), was a Buddhist dynasty which ruled the areas of Vanga and Samatata in ancient Bengal from 625 CE to 716 CE. Chronologically, the dynasty emerged as a powerful kingdom of Bengal between the fall of Gauda Kingdom and the rise of the Pala Empire. Their ascendancy may have been immediately preceded by the overthrow of a previously ruling Bhadra dynasty. While they did not assume imperial titles, the Khadgas retained sovereignty over the ancient kingdom of Vanga and later conquered Samatata. It was succeeded by the 8th-9th century Buddhist Deva dynasty.

Khalji dynasty.headline: Dinastija Khaldži
paragraphs: Dinastija Khaldži ali Khildži je bila druga vladajoča rodbina Delhijskega sultanata, ki je skoraj tri desetletja, med letoma 1290 in 1320, obvladovala velik del Indijske podceline. Ustanovil jo je Džalal ud-Din Khaldži, najbolj pa je znana po vladavini Alaudina Khaldžija, pod katerim je sultanat dosegel največji obseg in doživel pomembne vojaške, upravne in gospodarske reforme.

source.title: Khalji dynasty
paragraphs: The Khalji or Khilji dynasty was the second ruling house of the Delhi Sultanate, covering large parts of the Indian subcontinent for nearly three decades between 1290 and 1320. Founded by Jalal-ud-Din Khalji, it is best known for the reign of Alauddin Khalji, under whom the Sultanate reached its greatest territorial extent and underwent significant military, administrative, and economic reforms.

Khivan campaign of 1839–1840.headline: Hivski pohod 1839–1840
paragraphs: Hivski pohod 1839–1840 je bil neuspešen ruski poskus osvojitve Hivskega kanata. Vasilij Perovski se je s 5000 možmi odpravil iz Orenburga, naletel na nenavadno mrzlo zimo, izgubil večino kamel in se moral na pol poti vrniti.

Rusi so Hivo napadli štirikrat. Okoli leta 1602 so svobodni kozaki trikrat vdrli v Hivo. Leta 1717 je Hivo napadel Aleksander Bekovič-Čerkaski in bil do kraja poražen, le nekaj mož je pobegnilo, da so lahko povedali, kaj se je zgodilo. Po ruskem porazu v letih 1839–1840 so Rusi Hivo nazadnje osvojili s hivskim pohodom leta 1873.

source.title: Khivan campaign of 1839–1840
paragraphs: The Khivan campaign of 1839–1840 was a failed Russian attempt to conquer the Khanate of Khiva. Vasily Perovsky set out from Orenburg with 5,000 men, met an unusually cold winter, lost most of his camels, and was forced to turn back after going halfway.

Russians attacked Khiva four times. Around 1602, some free Cossacks made three raids on Khiva. In 1717, Alexander Bekovich-Cherkassky attacked Khiva and was soundly defeated, only a few men escaping to tell the tale. After the Russian defeat in 1839–1840, Khiva was finally conquered by the Russians during the Khivan campaign of 1873.

Kmerski imperij je bil imperij v celinski Jugovzhodni Aziji s središčem v hidravličnih mestih na območju današnje severne Kambodže. Prebivalci so ga imenovali Kambudža (starokmersko: កម្វុជ; kmersko: កម្ពុជ); nastal je iz nekdanje civilizacije Čenla in obstajal od leta 802 do 1431. Zgodovinarji to obdobje kamboške zgodovine imenujejo angkorsko obdobje, po najbolj znani prestolnici imperija, Angkorju. Kmerski imperij je vladal ali si podredil večino celinske Jugovzhodne Azije in segal na sever vse do južne Kitajske.

source.title: Khmer Empire
paragraphs: The Khmer Empire was an empire in mainland Southeast Asia, centred on hydraulic cities in what is now northern Cambodia. Known as Kambuja (Old Khmer: កម្វុជ; Khmer: កម្ពុជ) by its inhabitants, it grew out of the former civilisation of Chenla and lasted from 802 to 1431 AD. Historians call this period of Cambodian history the Angkor period, after the empire's most well-known capital, Angkor. The Khmer Empire ruled or vassalised most of Mainland Southeast Asia and stretched as far north as southern China.

Kidarites.headline: Kidariti
paragraphs: Kidariti ali kidarski Huni so bili dinastija, ki je v 4. in 5. stoletju vladala Baktriji in sosednjim delom Srednje Azije in Pakistana. Kidariti so pripadali zapleteni skupini ljudstev, ki so jo v dolini Inda skupaj imenovali Huna, v Evropi pa Hioniti (po iranskih imenih Xwn/Xyon), in jih morda lahko celo enačimo s Hioniti. Bizantinski zgodovinar Prisk iz 5. stoletja jih je imenoval kidaritski Huni oziroma »Huni, ki so Kidariti«. Kitajski anali so jih imenovali Ta Yüeh-chih ali Mali Yüeh-chih. Plemena Huna oziroma Hionitov pogosto, čeprav sporno, povezujejo s Huni, ki so v istem obdobju vdrli v vzhodno Evropo. S Heftaliti, ki so jih zamenjali približno stoletje pozneje, nimajo nič skupnega.

source.title: Kidarites
paragraphs: The Kidarites, or Kidara Huns, were a dynasty that ruled Bactria and adjoining parts of Central Asia and Pakistan in the 4th and 5th centuries. The Kidarites belonged to a complex group of peoples known collectively in the Indus Valley as the Huna, and in Europe as the Chionites (from the Iranian names Xwn/Xyon), and may even be considered as identical to the Chionites. The 5th century Byzantine historian Priscus called them Kidarite Huns, or "Huns who are Kidarites". Chinese annals referred to them as the Ta Yüeh-chih, or Lesser Yüeh-chih. The Huna/Xionite tribes are often linked, albeit controversially, to the Huns who invaded Eastern Europe around the same period. They are entirely different from the Hephthalites, who replaced them about a century later.

Kraljevina Afganistan, znana tudi kot Vzvišena država Afganistan, je bila monarhija z enotno državno ureditvijo v Srednji Aziji, ustanovljena leta 1926 kot naslednica Afganistanskega emirata. Razglasil jo je njen prvi kralj Amanulah kan, sedem let po tem, ko je prišel na prestol. Monarhijo je končal afganistanski državni udar leta 1973.

source.title: Kingdom of Afghanistan
paragraphs: The Kingdom of Afghanistan, also known as the Sublime State of Afghanistan, was a monarchy operating under a unitary state in Central Asia that was established in 1926 as a successor state to the Emirate of Afghanistan. It was proclaimed by its first king, Amanullah Khan, seven years after he acceded to the throne. The monarchy ended in the 1973 Afghan coup d'état.

Kingdom of Ava.headline: Kraljestvo Ava
paragraphs: Kraljestvo Ava (burmansko: အင်းဝပြည်), znano tudi kot kraljestvo Inva, je bilo prevladujoče kraljestvo, ki je od leta 1365 do 1555 vladalo Gornji Burmi (Mjanmaru). Ustanovljeno leta 1365 je bilo naslednik malih kraljestev Mjinsaing, Pinja in Sagaing, ki so osrednji Burmi vladala od propada Paganskega kraljestva konec 13. stoletja.

Tako kot prejšnjim malim kraljestvom so Avi morda vladali poburmanjeni šanski kralji, ki so se imeli za potomce paganskih kraljev. Raziskovalci razpravljajo, ali šanska narodnost avskih kraljev ne izvira iz napačnega prevoda, zlasti zapisa, da so predniki avskih kraljev pred vzponom vladali šanski vasi v osrednji Burmi.
notes: Izpuščena sta izgovarjava (IPA) in angleški zapis izgovarjave.

source.title: Kingdom of Ava
paragraphs: The Ava Kingdom (Burmese: အင်းဝပြည်, pronounced [ʔɪ́ɰ̃wa̰ kʰɪʔ]; INN-wa pyi) also known as Inwa Kingdom or Kingdom of Ava was the dominant kingdom that ruled upper Burma (Myanmar) from 1365 to 1555. Founded in 1365, the kingdom was the successor state to the petty kingdoms of Myinsaing, Pinya and Sagaing that had ruled central Burma since the collapse of the Pagan Kingdom in the late 13th century.

Like the small kingdoms that preceded it, Ava may have been led by Bamarised Shan kings who claimed descent from the kings of Pagan. Scholars debate that the Shan ethnicity of Avan kings comes from mistranslation, particularly from a record of the Avan kings' ancestors ruling a Shan village in central Burma prior to their rise or prominence.

Kingdom of Dambadeniya.headline: Kraljestvo Dambadenija
