paragraphs: Kraljestvo Dambadenija je bilo srednjeveško sinhalsko kraljestvo na območju današnje Šrilanke. Njegovi vladarji so vladali v letih 1220–1345.

source.title: Kingdom of Dambadeniya
paragraphs: The Kingdom of Dambadeniya was a medieval Sinhalese kingdom in what is present-day Sri Lanka. The kingdom's rulers reigned from 1220–1345.

Kraljestvo Kahetija (gruzijsko: კახეთის სამეფო; tudi Kaxet'i ali Kakhetia), poznosrednjeveška in zgodnjenovoveška monarhija v vzhodni Gruziji, je imelo središče v pokrajini Kahetija, prestolnico pa najprej v Gremiju in nato v Telaviju. Nastalo je ob tridelni razdelitvi Kraljestva Gruzije leta 1466 in z več kratkimi prekinitvami obstajalo do leta 1762, ko sta se Kahetija in sosednje gruzijsko kraljestvo Kartli z dinastičnim nasledstvom združila pod kahetijsko vejo dinastije Bagrationi. Večino tega časa je bilo kraljestvo vazal zaporednih iranskih dinastij, krajši čas pa Osmanskega cesarstva, vendar je občasno, zlasti po letu 1747, uživalo večjo neodvisnost.
notes: Izpuščena je latinična transliteracija gruzijskega imena. Vir postavlja tridelno razdelitev Gruzije tu v leto 1466, v povzetku o Kartliju pa v leto 1478; prevedeno je, kot stoji.

source.title: Kingdom of Kakheti
paragraphs: The Kingdom of Kakheti (Georgian: კახეთის სამეფო, romanized: k'akhetis samepo; also spelled Kaxet'i or Kakhetia) was a late medieval and early modern monarchy in eastern Georgia, centered at the province of Kakheti, with its capital first at Gremi and then at Telavi. It emerged in the process of a tripartite division of the Kingdom of Georgia in 1466 and existed, with several brief intermissions, until 1762 when Kakheti and the neighboring Georgian kingdom of Kartli were merged through a dynastic succession under the Kakhetian branch of the Bagrationi dynasty. Through much of this period, the kingdom was a vassal of the successive dynasties of Iran, and to a much shorter period Ottoman Empire, but enjoyed intermittent periods of greater independence, especially after 1747.

Kraljestvo Kartli (gruzijsko: ქართლის სამეფო), poznosrednjeveška in zgodnjenovoveška monarhija v vzhodni Gruziji, je imelo središče v pokrajini Kartli in prestolnico v Tbilisiju. Nastalo je ob tridelni razdelitvi Kraljestva Gruzije leta 1478 in z več kratkimi prekinitvami obstajalo do leta 1762, ko sta se Kartli in sosednje gruzijsko kraljestvo Kahetija z dinastičnim nasledstvom združila pod kahetijsko vejo dinastije Bagrationi. Večino tega časa je bilo kraljestvo vazal zaporednih iranskih dinastij, krajši čas pa Osmanskega cesarstva, vendar je občasno, zlasti po letu 1747, uživalo večjo neodvisnost.
notes: Izpuščena je latinična transliteracija gruzijskega imena.

source.title: Kingdom of Kartli
paragraphs: The Kingdom of Kartli (Georgian: ქართლის სამეფო, romanized: kartlis samepo) was a late medieval and early modern monarchy in eastern Georgia, centred on the province of Kartli, with its capital at Tbilisi. It emerged in the process of a tripartite division of the Kingdom of Georgia in 1478 and existed, with several brief intervals, until 1762 when Kartli and the neighbouring Georgian kingdom of Kakheti were merged through dynastic succession under the Kakhetian branch of the Bagrationi dynasty. Through much of this period, the kingdom was a vassal of the successive dynasties of Iran, and to a much shorter period Ottoman Empire, but enjoyed intermittent periods of greater independence, especially after 1747.

Kingdom of Khotan.headline: Kraljestvo Hotan
paragraphs: Kraljestvo Hotan, imenovano tudi kraljestvo Jutjan (kitajsko: 于闐), je bilo starodavno budistično saško kraljestvo na veji svilne poti, ki je potekala ob južnem robu puščave Taklamakan v Tarimski kotlini (današnji Šinjiang na Kitajskem). Starodavna prestolnica je sprva stala zahodno od današnjega Hotana v Jotkanu. Od dinastije Han vsaj do dinastije Tang so ga Kitajci imenovali Jutjan. To pretežno budistično kraljestvo je obstajalo več kot tisoč let, dokler ga leta 1006 med islamizacijo in turkizacijo Šinjianga ni osvojil muslimanski Karahanidski kanat.

source.title: Kingdom of Khotan
paragraphs: The Kingdom of Khotan, also called the Kingdom of Yutian (Chinese: 于闐), was an ancient Buddhist Saka kingdom located on the branch of the Silk Road that ran along the southern edge of the Taklamakan Desert in the Tarim Basin (modern-day Xinjiang, China). The ancient capital was originally sited to the west of modern-day Hotan at Yotkan. From the Han dynasty until at least the Tang dynasty it was known in Chinese as Yutian. This largely Buddhist kingdom existed for over a thousand years until it was conquered by the Muslim Kara-Khanid Khanate in 1006, during the Islamization and Turkicization of Xinjiang.

Kraljestvo Laos, vlada Laosa od leta 1947 do 1975, je ležalo v Jugovzhodni Aziji v osrčju Indokitajskega polotoka in je na severozahodu mejilo na Burmo in Kitajsko, na vzhodu na Severni Vietnam, na jugovzhodu na Kambodžo, na zahodu in jugozahodu pa na Tajsko. Od neodvisnosti 22. oktobra 1953 je bilo ustavna monarhija. Obstajalo je do 2. decembra 1975, ko se je zadnji kralj Sisavang Vatthana med laoško državljansko vojno odpovedal prestolu v korist Pathet Laa, ki je monarhijo odpravil in vzpostavil marksistično-leninistično državo, Laoško ljudsko demokratično republiko.

source.title: Kingdom of Laos
paragraphs: The Kingdom of Laos was the former government of Laos from 1947 to 1975. Located in Southeast Asia at the heart of the Indochinese Peninsula, it was bordered by Burma and China to the northwest, North Vietnam to the east, Cambodia to the southeast, and Thailand to the west and southwest. The country was governed as a constitutional monarchy beginning with its independence on 22 October 1953. It survived until 2 December 1975, when its last king, Sisavang Vatthana, surrendered the throne to the Pathet Lao during the civil war in Laos, who abolished the monarchy in favour of a Marxist–Leninist state called the Lao People's Democratic Republic.

Kingdom of Mrauk U.headline: Kraljestvo Mrauk U
paragraphs: Kraljestvo Mrauk U (arakansko: မြောက်ဦး ဘုရင့်နိုင်ငံတော်) ali Kraljestvo Arakan je bilo kraljestvo, ki je od leta 1429 do 1785 obstajalo na arakanski obalni ravnici. S prestolnico Mrauk U blizu vzhodne obale Bengalskega zaliva je vladalo današnji zvezni državi Rakhine v Mjanmaru in južnemu delu divizije Čitagong v Bangladešu. Čeprav je bilo od leta 1429 do 1531 protektorat Bengalskega sultanata, je Mrauk U s pomočjo Portugalcev osvojil Čitagong. Dvakrat, v letih 1546–1547 in 1580–1581, je odbil poskuse taungujske Burme, da bi kraljestvo osvojila. Na vrhuncu moči je od leta 1599 do 1603 za kratek čas nadzoroval obalo Bengalskega zaliva od Sundarbanov do Martabanskega zaliva. Leta 1666 je po vojni z Mogulskim cesarstvom izgubil nadzor nad Čitagongom. Obstajal je do leta 1785, ko ga je osvojila burmanska dinastija Konbaung.

source.title: Kingdom of Mrauk U
paragraphs: The Kingdom of Mrauk-U (Arakanese: မြောက်ဦး ဘုရင့်နိုင်ငံတော်) or Kingdom of Arakan was a kingdom that existed on the Arakan coastal plain from 1429 to 1785. Based in the capital Mrauk U, near the eastern coast of the Bay of Bengal, the kingdom ruled over what is now Rakhine State, Myanmar, and the southern part of Chittagong Division, Bangladesh. Though it started out as a protectorate of the Bengal Sultanate from 1429 to 1531, Mrauk-U went on to conquer Chittagong with the help of the Portuguese. It twice fended off the Toungoo Burma's attempts to conquer the kingdom in 1546–1547, and 1580–1581. At its height of power, it briefly controlled the Bay of Bengal coastline from the Sundarbans to the Gulf of Martaban from 1599 to 1603. In 1666, it lost control of Chittagong after a war with the Mughal Empire. Its existence continued until 1785, when it was conquered by the Konbaung dynasty of Burma.

Misorsko kraljestvo je bilo geopolitična tvorba v južni Indiji, ustanovljena okoli leta 1399 v bližini današnjega mesta Mysuru. Obstajalo je do leta 1950, njegove ozemeljske meje in oblika vladavine pa so se v tem času močno spreminjale. Sprva je bilo fevdalni vazal Vidžajanagarskega imperija, od leta 1799 do 1947 pa kneževska država v Britanski Indiji, vmes pa so ga zaznamovale velike politične spremembe.

Kraljestvo, ki so ga ustanovili in mu večinoma vladali Vadijarji, je sprva služilo kot fevdalni vazal Vidžajanagarskega imperija. Ko je imperij postopoma propadal, je Timaradža Vodejar II. v 16. stoletju razglasil neodvisnost. V 17. stoletju se je ozemlje vztrajno širilo in v času vladanja Narasaradže Vodejarja I. in Devaradže Vodejarja II. si je kraljestvo priključilo velik del današnje južne Karnatake in dele Tamil Naduja ter postalo mogočna sila v Dekanu.

source.title: Kingdom of Mysore
paragraphs: The Kingdom of Mysore was a geopolitical realm in southern India founded in around 1399 in the vicinity of the modern-day city of Mysuru. Existing until 1950, the territorial boundaries and the form of government transmuted substantially throughout the kingdom's lifetime. While originally a feudal vassal under the Vijayanagara Empire, it became a princely state in the British Raj from 1799 to 1947, marked in-between by major political changes.

The kingdom, which was founded and ruled for the most part by the Wadiyars, initially served as a feudal vassal under the Vijayanagara Empire. With the gradual decline of the Empire, the 16th-century Timmaraja Wodeyar II declared independence from it. The 17th century saw a steady expansion of its territory and, during the rules of Narasaraja Wodeyar I and Devaraja Wodeyar II, the kingdom annexed large expanses of what is now southern Karnataka and parts of Tamil Nadu, becoming a formidable power in the Deccan.

Konbaung dynasty.headline: Dinastija Konbaung
paragraphs: Dinastija Konbaung (burmansko: ကုန်းဘောင်မင်းဆက်), znana tudi kot tretje burmansko cesarstvo (တတိယမြန်မာနိုင်ငံတော်), je bila zadnja dinastija, ki je vladala Burmi, in sicer od leta 1752 do 1885. Ustvarila je drugi največji imperij v burmanski zgodovini in nadaljevala upravne reforme, ki jih je začela dinastija Taungu, s tem pa postavila temelje sodobne burmanske države. Reforme pa niso zadoščale, da bi zajezile prodor Britanskega imperija, ki je Burmance v šestih desetletjih (1824–1885) porazil v vseh treh angleško-burmanskih vojnah in leta 1885 končal tisočletno burmansko monarhijo.
Pretendenti dinastije se sklicujejo na potomstvo Mjat Phaja Lat, ene od Thibawovih hčera.

Konbaunški kralji so bili osvajalci: vodili so pohode proti hribovju Lušaj, Manipurju, Asamu, Arakanu, monskemu kraljestvu Pegu, Siamu in kitajski dinastiji Čing ter tako vzpostavili tretje burmansko cesarstvo. Sedanje meje Mjanmara izvirajo iz teh dogodkov ter iz poznejših vojn in pogodb z Britanci.

source.title: Konbaung dynasty
paragraphs: The Konbaung dynasty (Burmese: ကုန်းဘောင်မင်းဆက်), also known as the Third Burmese Empire (တတိယမြန်မာနိုင်ငံတော်), was the last dynasty that ruled Burma from 1752 to 1885. It created the second-largest empire in Burmese history and continued the administrative reforms begun by the Toungoo dynasty, laying the foundations of the modern state of Burma. The reforms, however, proved insufficient to stem the advance of the British Empire, which defeated the Burmese in all three Anglo-Burmese Wars over a six-decade span (1824–1885) and ended the millennium-old Burmese monarchy in 1885.
Pretenders to the dynasty claim descent from Myat Phaya Lat, one of Thibaw's daughters.

An expansionist dynasty, the Konbaung kings waged campaigns against the Lushai Hills, Manipur, Assam, Arakan, the Mon kingdom of Pegu, Siam, and the Qing dynasty of China—thus establishing the Third Burmese Empire. Subject to later wars and treaties with the British, the modern state of Myanmar can trace its current borders to these events.

Konfrontacija med Indonezijo in Malezijo (konfrontasi), znana tudi kot bornejska konfrontacija, je bila oborožen spopad v letih 1963–1966, ki je izviral iz indonezijskega nasprotovanja ustanovitvi Malezije. Pomembna predhodnika spopada sta bila indonezijska politika konfrontacije proti Nizozemski Novi Gvineji od marca do avgusta 1962 in brunejski upor decembra 1962, ki ga je podprla Indonezija. Malezija je imela neposredno vojaško podporo Združenega kraljestva, Avstralije in Nove Zelandije. Indonezija je imela posredno podporo Sovjetske zveze in Kitajske, zaradi česar je bil spopad epizoda hladne vojne v Aziji.

source.title: Konfrontasi
paragraphs: The Konfrontasi, also known as the Indonesia–Malaysia confrontation or Borneo confrontation, was an armed conflict from 1963 to 1966 that stemmed from Indonesia's opposition to the creation of the state of Malaysia. Vital precursors to the conflict included Indonesia's policy of confrontation against Dutch New Guinea from March to August 1962 and the Indonesia-backed Brunei revolt in December 1962. Malaysia had direct military support from the United Kingdom, Australia, and New Zealand. Indonesia had indirect support from the Soviet Union and China, thus making it an episode of the Cold War in Asia.

Kosala (sanskrtsko: कोशल), včasih imenovana Utara Kosala (dobesedno »Severna Kosala«), je bila ena od mahadžanapad stare Indije. Nastala je kot majhna država v poznem vedskem obdobju in je bila (skupaj z Magadho) ena prvih držav, ki so iz družbe, temelječe na rodovih, prešle v monarhijo. Do 6. stoletja pr. n. št. se je utrdila kot ena od štirih velikih sil stare severne Indije, poleg Magadhe, Vatse in Avantija.

Kosala je sodila v kulturo severne črne polirane keramike (ok. 700–300 pr. n. št.) in se je kulturno razlikovala od kulture poslikane sive keramike sosednje pokrajine Kuru-Pančala, saj se je samostojno razvijala proti urbanizaciji in uporabi železa. Kosalsko kraljestvo je zaznamoval rod Ikšvakuja, ki ga Rgveda opisuje kot radžo, Atharvaveda pa kot starodavnega junaka; temu rodu naj bi pripadali Rama, Mahavira in Buda.
Eden od dveh velikih indijskih epov, Ramajana, se dogaja v kraljestvu »Kosala-Videha«, v katerem se kosalski princ Rama poroči z videhansko princeso Sito.
notes: Izpuščena je izgovarjava (IPA).

source.title: Kosala
paragraphs: Kosala (IPA: [koːɕɐlɐ], Sanskrit: कोशल, sometimes referred to as Uttara Kosala (lit. 'Northern Kosala') was one of the Mahajanapadas of ancient India. It emerged as a small state during the Late Vedic period and became (along with Magadha) one of the earliest states to transition from a lineage-based society to a monarchy. By the 6th century BCE, it had consolidated into one of the four great powers of ancient northern India, along with Magadha, Vatsa, and Avanti.

Kosala belonged to the Northern Black Polished Ware culture (c. 700–300 BCE) and was culturally distinct from the Painted Grey Ware culture of the neighboring Kuru-Panchala region, following independent development toward urbanisation and the use of iron. The presence of the lineage of Ikshvaku—described as a raja in the Ṛgveda and an ancient hero in the Atharvaveda—to which Rama, Mahavira, and the Buddha are all thought to have belonged—characterized the Kosalan realm.
One of India's two great epics, Ramayana, is set in the "Kosala-Videha" realm in which the Kosalan prince Rama marries the Videhan princess Sita.

Kuru Kingdom.headline: Kraljestvo Kuru
paragraphs: Kraljestvo Kuru, vedska indoarijska plemenska zveza plemen Bharata in Puru v severni Indiji, je nastalo v srednjem vedskem obdobju (ok. 1200 – ok. 900 pr. n. št.) v indijski železni dobi in obsegalo dele današnjih zveznih držav Harjana in Delhi ter nekaj severnih delov zahodnega Utar Pradeša. Bilo je prva zabeležena družba z državno ureditvijo na Indijski podcelini.

Kraljestvo Kuru je postalo prevladujoča politična in kulturna sila v srednjem vedskem obdobju v času vladanja Parikšita in Džanamedžaje, v poznem vedskem obdobju (ok. 900 – ok. 500 pr. n. št.) pa je izgubilo pomen in do obdobja mahadžanapad v 5. stoletju pr. n. št. postalo »nekakšno zakotje«. Izročila in legende o Kurujih pa so se ohranila v povedskem obdobju in postala podlaga za ep Mahabharata.

source.title: Kuru kingdom
paragraphs: The Kuru Kingdom was a Vedic Indo-Aryan tribal union in northern India of the Bharata and Puru tribes. The Kuru kingdom appeared in the Middle Vedic period (c. 1200 – c. 900 BCE) during the Iron age of India, encompassing parts of the modern-day states of Haryana, Delhi, and some North parts of Western Uttar Pradesh. The Kuru Kingdom was the first recorded state-level society in the Indian subcontinent.

The Kuru kingdom became a dominant political and cultural force in the middle Vedic Period during the reigns of Parikshit and Janamejaya, but declined in importance during the late Vedic period (c. 900 – c. 500 BCE) and had become "something of a backwater" by the Mahajanapada period in the 5th century BCE. However, traditions and legends about the Kurus continued into the post-Vedic period, providing the basis for the Mahabharata epic.

Kushano-Sasanian Kingdom.headline: Kušansko-sasanidsko kraljestvo
paragraphs: Kušansko-sasanidsko kraljestvo, znano tudi kot indo-sasanidsko kraljestvo, je Sasanidsko cesarstvo v 3. in 4. stoletju vzpostavilo v Baktriji. Sasanidsko cesarstvo je po vrsti vojn leta 225 n. št. propadajočemu Kušanskemu cesarstvu odvzelo province Sogdijano, Baktrijo in Gandharo. Tamkajšnji sasanidski upravitelji so nato prevzeli naslov kušanšah (v baktrijskem jeziku KΟÞANΟ ÞAΟ ali Koshano Shao), »kralj Kušanov«, in kovali denar. Včasih jih štejejo za »podkraljestvo« znotraj Sasanidskega cesarstva.

Ta uprava je trajala do let 360–370, ko so Kušano-Sasanidi velik del ozemlja izgubili proti Kidaritom, ki so vdrli v deželo, preostanek pa je Sasanidsko cesarstvo priključilo neposredno. Kidarite so pozneje izpodrinili Heftaliti.
Kušanšahe poznamo predvsem po kovancih. Kovali so jih v Kabulu, Balhu, Heratu in Mervu, kar priča o obsegu njihovega kraljestva.

source.title: Kushano-Sasanian Kingdom
paragraphs: The Kushano-Sasanian Kingdom also known as the Indo-Sasanian Kingdom was a polity established by the Sasanian Empire in Bactria during the 3rd and 4th centuries. The Sasanian Empire captured the provinces of Sogdia, Bactria and Gandhara from the declining Kushan Empire following a series of wars in 225 CE. The local Sasanian governors then went on to take the title of Kushanshah (KΟÞANΟ ÞAΟ or Koshano Shao in the Bactrian language) or "King of the Kushans", and to mint coins. They are sometimes considered as forming a "sub-kingdom" inside the Sasanian Empire.

This administration continued until 360–370, when the Kushano-Sasanians lost much of their domains to the invading Kidarites; the remainder was incorporated into the Sasanian Empire proper. Later, the Kidarites were in turn displaced by the Hephthalites.
The Kushanshahs are mainly known through their coins. Their coins were minted at Kabul, Balkh, Herat, and Merv, attesting the extent of their realm.

Lan Na.headline: Lan Na
paragraphs: Kraljestvo Lanna, zapisano tudi Lan Na, je bilo kraljestvo s središčem na območju današnje severne Tajske, ki je obstajalo od 13. do 18. stoletja.

Kulturni razvoj severnih Tajcev se je začel že prej, v kraljestvih pred njim. Lanna je zrasla iz Ngoenjanga in je bila do 15. stoletja dovolj močna, da se je s Kraljestvom Ayutthaya bojevala kot enakovredna nasprotnica. Pozneje je oslabela in leta 1558 postala vazalna država dinastije Taungu. Zvrstili so se vazalni kralji, nekateri z veliko avtonomijo. Burmanski nadzor je popustil in se znova okrepil, ko je dinastija Konbaung razširila svoj vpliv. Leta 1775 so se poglavarji Lanne odpovedali zvestobi Burmi in se priklonili Siamu, kar je sprožilo burmansko-siamsko vojno (1775–1776).
Burmanski nadzor se je končal z umikom te vojske, Siam pod Taksinom iz Kraljestva Tonburi pa je Lanno zavzel leta 1776. Odtlej je bila Lanna vazalna država Siama pod naslednjo dinastijo Čakri.

source.title: Lanna Kingdom
paragraphs: The Lanna Kingdom, also spelled Lan Na, was a kingdom centered in present-day Northern Thailand which existed from the 13th to 18th centuries.

The cultural development of the Northern Thai people began earlier, in the kingdoms that preceded it. Lanna grew out of Ngoenyang and by the 15th century was strong enough to fight the Ayutthaya Kingdom on equal terms. It weakened thereafter and became a vassal state of the Toungoo dynasty in 1558. A succession of vassal kings followed, some of them with considerable autonomy. Burmese control slackened and then tightened again as the Konbaung dynasty extended its reach. In 1775 the Lanna chiefs left Burmese allegiance for Siam, which brought on the Burmese–Siamese War (1775–76).

Burmese control ended with the retreat of that force, and Siam under Taksin of the Thonburi Kingdom took Lanna in 1776. From then on, Lanna became a vassal state of Siam under the succeeding Chakri dynasty.

Lan Xang.headline: Lan Xang
paragraphs: Lan Xang (laoško: ລ້ານຊ້າງ), zapisan tudi Lan Sang, laoško kraljestvo, je od leta 1353 do 1707 obsegal območje današnjega Laosa. Tri stoletja in pol je bil eno največjih kraljestev v Jugovzhodni Aziji. Kraljestvo je temelj laoške narodne zgodovinske in kulturne identitete.

Začetek kraljestva po navadi postavljajo v leto 1353, ko ga je ustanovil Fa Ngum. Prestolnica je bila do leta 1560 Luang Prabang, nato pa Vientiane. Državna vera je bil theravadski budizem, za paladij kraljestva pa so prevzeli kip Phra Bang. Reka Mekong je nosila trgovino kraljestva in določala njegovo politično geografijo, oblast pa se je izvajala prek mueangov, vezanih na kralja, ne prek osrednje upravljanega ozemlja. V 16. stoletju je v Lan Xang vdrla Burma, leta 1707 pa so ga razdelili na kraljestva Luang Prabang, Vientiane in Champasak.
notes: Izpuščena je izgovarjava (IPA).

source.title: Lan Xang
paragraphs: Lan Xang (Lao: ລ້ານຊ້າງ, pronounced [lâːn sâːŋ]), also spelled Lan Sang, was a Lao kingdom that held the area of present-day Laos from 1353 to 1707. For three and a half centuries, Lan Xang was one of the largest kingdoms in Southeast Asia. The kingdom is the basis for Laos's national historic and cultural identity.

The kingdom is conventionally dated from its foundation by Fa Ngum in 1353. Its capital was Luang Prabang until 1560 and Vientiane thereafter. Theravada Buddhism was the state religion, and the Phra Bang was adopted as the kingdom's palladium. The Mekong River carried the kingdom's trade and defined its political geography, and authority was exercised through mueang bound to the king rather than through a centrally administered territory. Lan Xang was invaded by Burma in the sixteenth century and partitioned in 1707 into the kingdoms of Luang Prabang, Vientiane and Champasak.

Lavo Kingdom.headline: Kraljestvo Lavo
paragraphs: Kraljestvo Lavo (tajsko: อาณาจักรละโว้), mandala v spodnjem porečju reke Chao Phraya, je obstajalo od 7. stoletja do leta 1388. Njegovo središče je bila do 1080. let Lavapura, nato pa Ajodhja (Šjan). Ajodhja in Lavo sta v poznih 1200. letih na kitajski dvor pošiljala ločena poslanstva, zato sta morda bili ločeni državi.

Pred 9. stoletjem je bil Lavo eno od nadregionalnih središč mandalskih tvorb Dvaravatija, poleg Si Thepa, Seme, Phimaja in Nakhon Pathoma. Podnebne spremembe in vpadi sosednjih tvorb so več teh središč oslabili, mandale v dolini Menama pa so se nato razdelile v tri skupine. Lavo (današnji Lopburi) je ležal na vzhodu in bil v tesnejšem stiku z angkorskim in predangkorskim svetom; Suphannaphum (današnji Suphanburi) na zahodu, v tesnejšem stiku z monskim in malajskim svetom; severne tvorbe pa so bile po kulturi, narodnosti in jeziku bolj mešane od obeh. Mandale ob rekah Mun in Či so se medtem povezale s Kambudžadešo v porečju Tonle Sapa.

source.title: Lavo Kingdom
paragraphs: The Lavo Kingdom (Thai: อาณาจักรละโว้) was a mandala in the lower Chao Phraya basin from the 7th century until 1388. Its centre was Lavapura until the 1080s, when it moved to Ayodhya (Xiān). Ayodhya and Lavo sent separate embassies to the Chinese court in the late 1200s, so the two may have been distinct states.

Before the 9th century Lavo was one of the supra-regional centres of the mandala-style polities of Dvaravati, with Si Thep, Sema, Phimai and Nakhon Pathom. Climate change and invasion from neighbouring polities reduced several of those centres, and the mandalas of the Menam valley then fell into three groups. Lavo (modern Lopburi) lay to the east, in closer contact with the Angkorian and pre-Angkorian worlds; Suphannaphum (modern Suphanburi) to the west, in closer contact with the Mon and Malay worlds; and the northern polities, more mixed than either in culture, ethnicity and language. Meanwhile, the Mun–Chi mandalas allied with Kambujadesa in the Tonlé Sap basin.

Lazica.headline: Lazika
paragraphs: Kraljestvo Lazika (gruzijsko: ეგრისი; lazijsko: ლაზიკა; starogrško: Λαζική), včasih imenovano Lazijsko cesarstvo, je bilo država na ozemlju zahodne Gruzije v rimskem obdobju, od približno 1. stoletja pr. n. št. Nastalo je, ko je razpadlo kraljestvo Kolhida in so plemenske ozemeljske enote v njem leta 131 n. št. dosegle neodvisnost.
notes: Izpuščene so latinične transliteracije gruzijskega, lazijskega in grškega imena.
Drugi stavek vira nima glavnega glagola; dopolnjen je po smislu. Vir postavlja začetek države v 1. stoletje pr. n. št., njeno nastanje pa v leto 131 n. št.; prevedeno je, kot stoji.

source.title: Lazica
paragraphs: The Kingdom of Lazica (Georgian: ეგრისი, romanized: Egrisi; Laz: ლაზიკა, romanized: Laziǩa; Ancient Greek: Λαζική, romanized: Lazikḗ), sometimes called Lazian Empire, was a state in the territory of west Georgia in the Roman period, from about the 1st century BC. Created as a result of the collapse of the kingdom of Colchis and the gaining of independence by the tribal-territorial units included in it in 131 AD.

Lê dynasty.headline: Dinastija Lê
paragraphs: Dinastija Lê, v zgodovinopisju znana tudi kot pozna dinastija Lê (vietnamsko: Nhà Hậu Lê ali Triều Hậu Lê; chữ Hán: 朝後黎; chữ Nôm: 茹後黎), je bila najdlje vladajoča vietnamska dinastija, ki je Đại Việtu (chữ Hán: 大越) vladala od leta 1428 do 1789, s prekinitvijo med letoma 1527 in 1533. Dinastijo Lê delimo na dve zgodovinski obdobji: na začetno dinastijo Lê (vietnamsko: triều Lê sơ ali nhà Lê Sơ; chữ Hán: 朝黎初; chữ Nôm: 茹黎初; 1428–1527) pred uzurpacijo dinastije Mạc, ko so cesarji vladali sami, in na obnovljeno dinastijo Lê (vietnamsko: triều Lê Trung hưng ali nhà Lê Trung hưng; chữ Hán: 朝黎中興; chữ Nôm: 茹黎中興; 1533–1789), ko so cesarji vladali pod okriljem mogočne rodbine Trịnh. Obnovljeno dinastijo Lê sta zaznamovali dve dolgi državljanski vojni: vojna Lê–Mạc (1533–1592), v kateri sta se dve dinastiji bojevali za legitimnost v severnem Vietnamu, in vojne Trịnh–Nguyễn (1627–1672, 1774–1777) med gospodi Trịnh na severu in gospodi Nguyễn na jugu.

source.title: Lê dynasty
paragraphs: The Lê dynasty, also known in historiography as the Later Lê dynasty (Vietnamese: Nhà Hậu Lê or Triều Hậu Lê, chữ Hán: 朝後黎, chữ Nôm: 茹後黎), was the longest-ruling Vietnamese dynasty, having ruled Đại Việt (chữ Hán: 大越) from 1428 to 1789 with an interregnum between 1527 and 1533. The Lê dynasty is divided into two historical periods: the Initial Lê dynasty (Vietnamese: triều Lê sơ or nhà Lê Sơ, chữ Hán: 朝黎初, chữ Nôm: 茹黎初; 1428–1527) before the usurpation by the Mạc dynasty, in which emperors ruled in their own right, and the Revival Lê dynasty (Vietnamese: triều Lê Trung hưng or nhà Lê Trung hưng, chữ Hán: 朝黎中興, chữ Nôm: 茹黎中興; 1533–1789), in which the emperors were figures who reigned under the auspices of the powerful Trịnh family. The Revival Lê dynasty was marked by two lengthy civil wars: the Lê–Mạc War (1533–1592) in which two dynasties battled for legitimacy in northern Vietnam and the Trịnh–Nguyễn Wars (1627–1672, 1774–1777) between the Trịnh lords in North and the Nguyễn lords of the South.

Lodi dynasty.headline: Dinastija Lodi
paragraphs: Dinastija Lodi je od leta 1451 do 1526 vladala Delhijskemu sultanatu. Bila je peta in zadnja dinastija Delhijskega sultanata s tremi vladarji na prestolu, ustanovil pa jo je Bahlul Lodi, ko je zamenjal dinastijo Sajid.

source.title: Lodi dynasty
paragraphs: The Lodi dynasty was a dynasty that ruled the Sultanate of Delhi from 1451 to 1526. It was the fifth and final dynasty of the Delhi Sultanate, with three rulers ascending to throne, and was founded by Bahlul Lodi when he replaced the Sayyid dynasty.

Lohara dynasty.headline: Dinastija Lohara
paragraphs: Dinastija Lohara je od leta 1003 do približno 1175 vladala Kašmirju in okoliškim območjem na severozahodu Indijske podceline. Zgodnjo zgodovino dinastije opisuje Radžatarangini (»Kronika kraljev«), delo, ki ga je sredi 12. stoletja napisal Kalhana in na katerem temelji veliko raziskav o prvih 150 letih dinastije. Poznejša poročila, ki segajo do konca dinastije in čez, sta zapisala Džonaradža in Šrivara. Poznejše vladarje dinastije so imeli za šibke. V tem obdobju so bili pogosti notranji spori in korupcija, ki so jih le občasno prekinila kratka obdobja stabilnosti. Ti dejavniki so dinastijo naredili ranljivo za širjenje islamskih osvajanj v regiji.

source.title: Lohara dynasty
paragraphs: The Lohara dynasty was a dynasty that ruled over Kashmir and surrounding regions in the northwestern part of the Indian subcontinent between 1003 and approximately 1175. The early history of the dynasty was described in the Rajatarangini (Chronicle of Kings), a work written by Kalhana in the mid-12th century, upon which many studies of the first 150 years of the dynasty depend. Subsequent accounts which provide information up to and beyond the end of the dynasty come from Jonarāja and Śrīvara. The later rulers of the dynasty were perceived as weak. Internal conflicts and instances of corruption were prevalent during this era, occasionally interrupted by short periods of stability. These factors contributed to the dynasty's susceptibility to the expansion of Islamic conquests in the region.

Madurajski Najaki so bili teluško govoreča dinastija balidžskega porekla (bojevniških klanov iz današnjega Andhra Pradeša), ki je med 16. in 18. stoletjem iz prestolnice Madurai vladala velikemu delu današnjega Tamil Naduja v Indiji. Okoli leta 1529 jo je kot podkraljestvo Vidžajanagarskega imperija ustanovil Višvanatha Najak, sin Nagame Najaka. Njihovo vladavino, ki je trajala do leta 1736, so zaznamovali upravna reorganizacija s sistemom palajakararjev, obnova templjev (ki so jih prej oplenili delhijski sultani) in razvoj posebnih arhitekturnih oblik, kot so velike stebriščne dvorane (mandapi) in palačni kompleksi.

Dinastija je imela trinajst vladarjev, med njimi devet kraljev, dve vladajoči kraljici in dva sovladarja. Med njimi sta izstopala Tirumala Najaka (vladal 1623–1659) in regentka rani Mangamal (vladala 1689–1704). Zunanja pomorska trgovina ob Koromandelski in Ribiški obali je potekala predvsem s Portugalci in Nizozemsko vzhodnoindijsko družbo. Trgovali so predvsem s tekstilom, začimbami in biseri iz krajevnega lova.

source.title: Madurai Nayak dynasty
paragraphs: The Madurai Nayaks were a Telugu-speaking dynasty of Balija origin (warrior clans of present-day Andhra Pradesh) that ruled large parts of modern-day Tamil Nadu, India, between the 16th and 18th centuries, with Madurai as their capital. It was founded by Nagama Nayak's son Viswanatha Nayak around 1529 as a viceroyalty under the Vijayanagara Empire. Their tenure that lasted till 1736, was characterised by administrative reorganisation through the palaiyakkarar system, temple reconstruction (previously ransacked by the Delhi Sultans), and the development of distinct architectural forms such as large pillared madapas and palace complexes.

The dynasty comprised thirteen rulers, including nine kings, two queens regnant, and two joint rulers. Prominent among them were Tirumala Nayaka (r. 1623–1659) and the regent Rani Mangammal (r. 1689–1704). External maritime trade along the Coromandel and Fishery coasts was conducted primarily with the Portuguese and the Dutch East India Company. Trade focussed on textiles, spices, and regional pearl fishery.

Magadha je bila pokrajina in kraljestvo v stari Indiji s središčem na vzhodu Gangeške nižine. V obdobju druge urbanizacije je bila ena od šestnajstih mahadžanapad. Pokrajini je vladalo več dinastij, ki so zasenčile, osvojile in si priključile druge mahadžanapade. Magadha je imela pomembno vlogo v razvoju džainizma in budizma in je bila jedro dinastije Harjanka, imperija Nanda, Maurijskega imperija, imperija Šunga in Guptskega imperija.
notes: Izpuščena je izgovarjava (IPA).

source.title: Magadha
paragraphs: Magadha (IPA: [məɡəd̪ʰaː]) was a region and kingdom in ancient India, based in the eastern Ganges Plain. It was one of the sixteen Mahajanapadas during the second urbanisation period. The region was ruled by several dynasties, which overshadowed, conquered, and incorporated the other Mahajanapadas. Magadha played an important role in the development of Jainism and Buddhism and formed the core of the Haryanka dynasty, Nanda Empire, Mauryan Empire, Shunga Empire and Gupta Empire.
Mahadžanapade so bile šestnajst kraljestev in aristokratskih republik, ki so v stari Indiji obstajale od 6. do 4. stoletja pr. n. št., v obdobju druge urbanizacije.

source.title: Mahajanapadas
paragraphs: The Mahājanapadas were sixteen kingdoms and aristocratic republics that existed in ancient India from the sixth to fourth centuries BCE, during the second urbanisation period.

Dinastija Mahameghavahana (IAST: Mahā-Mēgha-Vāhana; od 2. ali 1. stoletja pr. n. št. do začetka 4. stoletja n. št.) je bila starodavna vladajoča dinastija Kalinge po zatonu Maurijskega imperija. V 1. stoletju pr. n. št. je osvojila Kalingo in Kosalo. Med vladavino Kharavele, tretjega kralja dinastije, je Južna Kosala postala sestavni del kraljestva. Kharavela je podpiral džainizem, vendar ni zapostavljal drugih ver. Znan je po napisu v Hathigumphi.

Južno Kosalo je v začetku 2. stoletja n. št. osvojil Gautamiputra Satakarni iz dinastije Satavahana in je ostala v njeni posesti do druge polovice 2. stoletja n. št. V 2. in 3. stoletju n. št. so se Meghe ali Meghavahane vrnili na politično prizorišče in znova pridobili nadoblast nad Južno Kosalo. Samudragupta je na pohodu v Dakšinapatho porazil Mahendro iz Dakšina Kosale, ki je po neki domnevi verjetno pripadal dinastiji Megha. Južna Kosala je zato v 4. stoletju n. št. postala del Guptskega imperija.
notes: Drugi stavek vira nima osebka; dopolnjen je po smislu (dinastija).

source.title: Mahameghavahana dynasty
paragraphs: The Mahameghavahana dynasty (IAST: Mahā-Mēgha-Vāhana) 2nd or 1st century BC to early 4th century CE) was an ancient ruling dynasty of Kalinga after the decline of the Maurya Empire. In the first century B.C. conquered Kalinga and Kosala. During the reign of Kharavela, the third king of Mahameghavahana dynasty, South Kosala became an integral part of the kingdom. He patronised Jainism, but did not discriminate against other religions. He is known by his Hathigumpha inscription.

South Kosala was later conquered by Gautamiputra Satakarni of the Satavahana dynasty in the early part of the 2nd century CE and remained in their possession up to the second half of the 2nd century CE. It was during the second and third century CE, the Meghas or Meghavahanas reappeared in the political scene and regained their suzerainty over South Kosala. Samudragupta during his Dakshinapatha expedition, defeated Mahendra of Dakshina Kosala who probably belonged to the Megha dynasty according to a speculation. As a result, the South Kosala during the fourth century A.D, became a part of the Gupta empire.

Maitraka dynasty.headline: Dinastija Maitraka
paragraphs: Dinastija Maitraka je približno od leta 475 do 776 iz prestolnice Valabhi vladala kraljestvu Valabhi v zahodni Indiji. Razen Dharapatte (petega kralja dinastije), ki ga povezujejo s čaščenjem sonca, so bili privrženci šivaizma.

source.title: Maitraka dynasty
paragraphs: The Maitraka dynasty ruled the Kingdom of Valabhi in western India from approximately 475 to 776 from their capital at Vallabhi. With the sole exception of Dharapaṭṭa (the fifth king in the dynasty), who is associated with sun-worship, they were followers of Shaivism.

Malabar rebellion.headline: Malabarski upor
paragraphs: Malabarski upor leta 1921 (imenovan tudi upor Moplahov ali upor Mapil; malajalamsko: malabār kalāpam) se je začel kot odpor proti Britanski Indiji na nekaterih krajih v južnem delu starega okrožja Malabar v današnji Kerali.
Upor pripisujejo kmečkemu nezadovoljstvu in nenehnim nemirom med Moplahi, ki so se razvili zaradi britanske politike do te skupnosti v Malabarju.

Za Mapile je bil upor predvsem kmečka vstaja proti kolonialni vladi. Uporniki so med vstajo napadali različne simbole in ustanove kolonialne države, denimo telegrafske vode, železniške postaje, sodišča in pošte.

source.title: Malabar rebellion
paragraphs: The Malabar rebellion of 1921 (also called Moplah rebellion, and Mappila rebellion, Malayalam: malabār kalāpam) started as a resistance against the British Raj in certain places in the southern part of old Malabar district of present-day Kerala.
The rebellion has been attributed to agrarian grievances and continued unrest among the Moplahs, which developed in the context of British policies toward the community in Malabar.

For the mappila side, the rebellion was primarily a peasant revolt against the colonial government. During the uprising, the rebels attacked various symbols and institutions of the colonial state, such as telegraph lines, train stations, courts and post offices.

Malajska kriza, znana tudi kot protibritanska narodnoosvobodilna vojna (1948–1960), je bila gverilska vojna v Malaji med komunističnimi borci za neodvisnost Malajske narodnoosvobodilne armade (MNLA) in vojaškimi silami Federacije Malaja in Commonwealtha (Britanskega imperija). MNLA se je bojevala za neodvisnost Malaje od Britanskega imperija in za ustanovitev komunistične države, sile Malajske federacije in Commonwealtha pa za zaščito britanskih gospodarskih in kolonialnih interesov in proti komunizmu. Britanci so spopad imenovali »izredne razmere« (emergency), da ga ne bi bilo treba imenovati vojna, saj londonske zavarovalnice v primeru državljanskih vojn niso izplačevale odškodnin.

source.title: Malayan Emergency
paragraphs: The Malayan Emergency, also known as the Anti–British National Liberation War, (1948–1960) was a guerrilla war fought in Malaya between communist pro-independence fighters of the Malayan National Liberation Army (MNLA) and the military forces of the Federation of Malaya and the Commonwealth (British Empire). The MNLA fought to win Malayan independence from the British Empire and to establish a communist state, while the Malayan Federation and Commonwealth forces fought to protect British economic and colonial interests and combat communism. The term "Emergency" was used by the British to characterise the conflict in order to avoid referring to it as a war, because London-based insurers would not pay out in instances of civil wars.

Malla (tribe).headline: Malla
paragraphs: Malla (prakrtsko: 𑀫𑀮𑁆𑀮𑀈; palijsko: Malla; sanskrtsko: मल्ल) je bilo starodavno indoarijsko pleme severovzhodne Južne Azije, katerega obstoj je izpričan v železni dobi. Prebivalstvo Malle je bilo razdeljeno na dve veji, od katerih je bila vsaka organizirana kot ganasangha (aristokratska oligarhična republika); danes jih imenujemo republiki Malla in sta bili del širše zveze Vadžika.
notes: Izpuščeni sta latinični transliteraciji prakrtskega in sanskrtskega imena.

source.title: Malla (tribe)
paragraphs: Malla (Prakrit languages: 𑀫𑀮𑁆𑀮𑀈, romanized: Mallaī; Pali: Malla; Sanskrit: मल्ल, romanized: Malla) was an ancient Indo-Aryan tribe of north-eastern South Asia whose existence is attested during the Iron Age. The population of Malla was divided into two branches, each organised into a gaṇasaṅgha (an aristocratic oligarchic republic), presently referred to as the Malla Republics, which were part of the larger Vajjika League.

Marathski imperij, imenovan tudi Marathska konfederacija, je bil zgodnjenovoveška državna tvorba na Indijski podcelini. Večino časa so ga sestavljali posesti pešve in štiri večje neodvisne marathske države pod nominalnim vodstvom pešve in v nominalni zvestobi čatrapatijem, Šivadžijevim naslednikom.

source.title: Maratha Empire
paragraphs: The Maratha Empire, also referred to as the Maratha Confederacy, was an early modern polity in the Indian subcontinent. For most of its existence, it comprised the realms of the Peshwa and four major independent Maratha states under the nominal leadership of the former and nominal loyalty to the Chhatrapatis who were successors of Shivaji.

Matsya (tribe).headline: Matsja
paragraphs: Matsja (palijsko: Macchā) je bilo starodavno indoarijsko pleme osrednje Indije, katerega obstoj je izpričan v železni dobi. Pripadniki plemena Matsja so bili organizirani v kraljestvo, imenovano kraljestvo Matsja.

source.title: Matsya (tribe)
paragraphs: Matsya (Pali: Macchā) was an ancient Indo-Aryan tribe of central India whose existence is attested during the Iron Age. The members of the Matsya tribe were organised into a kingdom called the Matsya kingdom.

Maukhari dynasty.headline: Dinastija Maukhari
paragraphs: Dinastija Maukhari (guptska pisava: Mau-kha-ri) je bila poguptska dinastija, ki je skoraj stoletje iz Kannaudža nadzorovala obsežne ravnice med Gango in Jamuno. Najprej so bili Maukhariji vazali Gupt, pozneje pa Harševe dinastije Vardhana. Neodvisnost so si izborili sredi 6. stoletja. Dinastija je vladala velikemu delu Utar Pradeša in Magadhe. Okoli leta 606 n. št. so velik del njihovega ozemlja znova osvojili pozni Gupte. Po Šuanzangu je ozemlje morda prešlo v roke kralja Šašanke iz kraljestva Gauda, ki je okoli leta 600 razglasil neodvisnost.
notes: V viru manjka znak v guptski pisavi; ohranjena je le transliteracija.

source.title: Maukharis of Kannauj
paragraphs: The Maukhari dynasty (Gupta script:, Mau-kha-ri) was a post-Gupta dynasty who controlled the vast plains of Ganga-Yamuna for almost a century from Kannauj. They earlier served as vassals of the Guptas and later of Harsha's Vardhana dynasty. The Maukharis established their independence during the mid-6th century. The dynasty ruled over much of Uttar Pradesh and Magadha. Around 606 CE, a large area of their empire was reconquered by the Later Guptas. According to Xuanzang, the territory may have been lost to King Shashanka of the Gauda Kingdom, who declared independence circa 600CE.

Maurijski imperij je bil geografsko obsežna zgodovinska sila železne dobe v Južni Aziji s središčem moči v Magadhi. Ustanovil ga je Čandragupta Maurja okoli leta 320 pr. n. št., v ohlapni obliki pa je obstajal do leta 185 pr. n. št. Glavni pisni viri za maurijsko obdobje so delni zapisi iz izgubljene Megastenove zgodovine v rimskih besedilih nekaj stoletij pozneje in Ašokovi edikti. Arheološko sodi obdobje maurijske vladavine v Južni Aziji v obdobje severne črne polirane keramike (NBPW).

source.title: Maurya Empire
paragraphs: The Maurya Empire was a geographically extensive Iron Age historical power in South Asia with its power base in Magadha. Founded by Chandragupta Maurya around c. 320 BCE, it existed in loose-knit fashion until 185 BCE. The primary sources for the written records of the Mauryan times are partial records of the lost history of Megasthenes in Roman texts of several centuries later, and the Edicts of Ashoka. Archaeologically, the period of Mauryan rule in South Asia falls into the era of Northern Black Polished Ware (NBPW).

Misl.headline: Sikhovska konfederacija
paragraphs: Sikhovska konfederacija je bila zveza dvanajstih suverenih sikhovskih držav (vsaka se je imenovala misl, iz arabske besede مِثْل, ki pomeni »enak«; včasih zapisano tudi misal), ki so nastale v 18. stoletju v pokrajini Pandžab na severozahodu Indijske podceline. Misli so bili suverene sikhovske kneževine, prvotno ustanovljene za obrambo kompleksa Darbar Sahib v Amritsarju. Upravljali so jih decentralizirano, kot prožno decentralizirano enotnost, v kateri noben vladar ni bil vrhovni ali stalen, temveč je skupno delovanje temeljilo na organizacijski disciplini in skupni legitimnosti.

source.title: Sikh Confederacy
paragraphs: The Sikh Confederacy was a confederation of twelve sovereign Sikh states (each known as a Misl, derived from the Arabic word مِثْل meaning 'equal'; sometimes spelt as Misal) which rose during the 18th century in the Punjab region in the northwestern part of the Indian subcontinent. The misls were sovereign Sikh principalities originally formulated to defend the Darbar Sahib complex of Amritsar. It was governed decentrally, being described as decentralized unity that was flexible, with no single ruler being paramount or permanent and instead collective action being used that was based upon organisational discipline and shared legitimacy.

Moghulistan.headline: Mogulistan
paragraphs: Mogulistan, imenovan tudi Mogulski kanat ali Vzhodni čagatajski kanat, je bil turško-mongolski muslimanski kanat, ki se je odcepil od Čagatajskega kanata, in zgodovinsko geografsko območje severno od gorovja Tengri Tag na meji med Srednjo in Vzhodno Azijo. Območje danes obsega dele Kazahstana, Kirgizistana in severozahodnega Šinjianga. Kanat je temu območju nominalno vladal od sredine 14. do konca 17. stoletja.

Od sredine 14. stoletja je v porečju reke Ili nastal nov kanat v obliki nomadske plemenske konfederacije, ki jo je vodil član Čagatajeve rodbine. Zato velja za nadaljevanje Čagatajskega kanata, imenujejo pa ga tudi Mogulski kanat.

source.title: Moghulistan
paragraphs: Moghulistan, also called the Moghul Khanate or the Eastern Chagatai Khanate, was a Turco-Mongol, Muslim, breakaway khanate of the Chagatai Khanate and a historical geographic area north of the Tengri Tagh mountain range, on the border of Central Asia and East Asia. That area today includes parts of Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, and northwest Xinjiang. The khanate nominally ruled over the area from the mid-14th century until the late 17th century.

Beginning in the mid-14th century a new khanate, in the form of a nomadic tribal confederacy headed by a member of the family of Chagatai, arose in the region of the Ili River. It is therefore considered to be a continuation of the Chagatai Khanate, but it is also referred to as the Moghul Khanate.

Mongol invasion of Central Asia.headline: Mongolski pohodi v Srednji Aziji
paragraphs: Mongolsko cesarstvo je po združitvi mongolskih in turških plemen na Mongolski planoti leta 1206 izvedlo več pohodov v Srednji Aziji. Med manjše vojaške operacije sodita uničenje preživelih Merkitov in Najmanov (ki je vključevalo vpade v Kumanijo) in osvojitev Kara Kitaja. Sledil je velik pohod proti Horezmu. Širjenje v Srednjo Azijo se je začelo leta 1209, ko je Džingis-kan poslal odpravo, da bi zasledovala tekmece, ki so pobegnili v to območje in ogrožali njegovo novo cesarstvo. Ujgursko kraljestvo Kočo in voditelji Karlukov so se Mongolskemu cesarstvu podredili prostovoljno in se poročili v cesarsko družino. Do leta 1218 so Mongoli nadzorovali ves Šinjiang, do leta 1221 pa vsa ozemlja nekdanjega Horezmijskega cesarstva. Leta 1236 so Mongoli porazili vzhodne dele Kumanije in vdrli v vzhodno Evropo.
notes: Naslov »Mongol invasion of Central Asia« preusmeri na članek »Mongol campaigns in Central Asia«.

source.title: Mongol campaigns in Central Asia
paragraphs: The Mongol Empire conducted several campaigns in Central Asia after the unification of the Mongol and Turkic tribes on the Mongolian Plateau in 1206. Smaller military operations included the destruction of surviving Merkit and Naimans (which involved forays into Cumania) and the conquest of Qara Khitai. These were followed by a major campaign against Khwarazm. Expansion into Central Asia began in 1209 as Genghis Khan sent an expedition to pursue rivals who had fled to the region and threatened his new empire. The Uyghur kingdom Qocho and leaders of the Karluks submitted voluntarily to the Mongol Empire and married into the imperial family. By 1218 the Mongols controlled all of Xinjiang and by 1221 all the territories of the former Khwarazmian Empire. In 1236, the Mongols defeated the eastern portions of Cumania and swept into Eastern Europe.

Mongol invasions of India.headline: Mongolski vpadi v Indijo
paragraphs: Mongolsko cesarstvo je od leta 1221 do 1327 izvedlo številne vpade na Indijsko podcelino, mnoge poznejše pohode pa so izvedli Karaunasi mongolskega porekla. Mongoli so dele podceline zasedali več desetletij. Ko so prodrli v notranjost Indije in prišli do predmestij Delhija, je Delhijski sultanat proti njim sprožil pohod, v katerem je mongolska vojska doživela hude poraze.

Uradniki Delhijskega sultanata so vojno z Mongoli imeli za eno glavnih sultanovih dolžnosti. Kronisti sultanata so spopade med tengriističnimi Mongoli in muslimansko skupnostjo opisovali črno-belo, pri čemer je bil Delhijski sultanat otok islamske civilizacije, ki so ga na severu in jugu obdajali hindujci in budisti, vendar so prezrli, da je bilo veliko pripadnikov elite in monarhov sultanata turškega oziroma mongolskega porekla ali je pred tem služilo v njihovih vojskah.

source.title: Mongol invasions of India
paragraphs: The Mongol Empire launched numerous invasions into the Indian subcontinent from 1221 to 1327, with many of the later raids made by the Qara'unas of Mongol origin. The Mongols occupied parts of the subcontinent for decades. As the Mongols progressed into the Indian hinterland and reached the outskirts of Delhi, the Delhi Sultanate of India led a campaign against them in which the Mongol army suffered serious defeats.

Delhi Sultanate officials viewed war with the Mongols as one of the sultan's primary duties. While the sultanate's chroniclers described the conflicts between the Tengrist Mongols and Muslim community in binary terms, with the Delhi Sultanate being an island of Islamic civilization surrounded by Hindus and Buddhist to its north and south, it ignored the fact that a large number of the sultanate's elites and monarchs were of Turkic/Mongol ethnicity or had previously served in their armed contingents.

Mongol invasions of Vietnam.headline: Mongolske invazije na Vietnam
paragraphs: Mongolsko cesarstvo in pozneje dinastija Juan sta v letih 1258, 1282–1284, 1285 in 1287–1288 izvedla štiri velike vojaške pohode proti kraljestvu Đại Việt (današnji severni Vietnam), ki mu je vladala dinastija Trần, in kraljestvu Champa (današnji osrednji Vietnam). Nekateri raziskovalci pohode štejejo za uspeh, ker so z Đại Việtom vzpostavili davčne odnose, čeprav so Mongoli doživeli hude vojaške poraze. Sodobno vietnamsko zgodovinopisje pa vojno šteje za veliko zmago nad tujimi zavojevalci.

source.title: Mongol invasions of Vietnam
paragraphs: Four major military campaigns were launched by the Mongol Empire, and later the Yuan dynasty, against the kingdom of Đại Việt (modern-day northern Vietnam) ruled by the Trần dynasty and the kingdom of Champa (modern-day central Vietnam) in 1258, 1282–1284, 1285, and 1287–1288. The campaigns are treated by a number of scholars as a success due to the establishment of tributary relations with Đại Việt despite the Mongols suffering major military defeats. In contrast, modern Vietnamese historiography regards the war as a major victory against the foreign invaders.
Izraz mongolski kanat se lahko nanaša na:
kanat Hamag Mongol (10. stoletje–1206),
Mongolsko cesarstvo (1206–1368).
notes: Zapis je povezan z razločitveno stranjo; prevedeno je kot seznam, kot stoji.

source.title: Mongol khanate
paragraphs: Mongol khanate or Mongolian khanate can refer to:
Khanate of the Khamag Mongol (10th century–1206)
Mongol Empire (1206-1368)

Mughal–Safavid war (1649–1653).headline: Mogulsko-safavidska vojna (1649–1653)
paragraphs: Mogulsko-safavidska vojna 1649–1653 se je med Mogulskim in Safavidskim cesarstvom bila na ozemlju današnjega Afganistana. Medtem ko so se Moguli vojskovali z džanidskimi Uzbeki, je safavidska vojska zavzela utrjeno mesto Kandahar in druga strateška mesta, ki so obvladovala regijo. Moguli so poskušali mesto znova zavzeti, a so bila njihova prizadevanja neuspešna.

source.title: Mughal–Safavid war (1649–1653)
paragraphs: The Mughal–Safavid war of 1649–1653 was fought between the Mughal and Safavid empires in the territory of modern Afghanistan. While the Mughals were at war with the Janid Uzbeks, the Safavid army captured the fortress city of Kandahar and other strategic cities that controlled the region. The Mughals attempted to regain the city, but their efforts were proven unsuccessful.

Državljanska vojna v Mjanmaru se je začela po vojaškem udaru 1. februarja 2021. Prevzem oblasti je sprožil množične demonstracije proti udaru in nasilno zatiranje tatmadava (mjanmarskih oboroženih sil), kar je močno zaostrilo dolgotrajna uporništva v državi.

Kot odgovor na udar sta vlada narodne enotnosti (NUG) v izgnanstvu in velike etnične oborožene organizacije zavrnili ustavo iz leta 2008 in namesto nje zahtevali demokratično zvezno državo. Vladajoča vojaška hunta, Državni upravni svet (SAC) pod vodstvom Min Aung Hlainga, se je poleg te zveze spopadala tudi z drugimi protirežimskimi silami na območjih pod svojim nadzorom. Uporniki so razdeljeni na več sto oboroženih skupin po vsej državi.

source.title: Myanmar civil war (2021–present)
paragraphs: The Myanmar civil war began following the military coup on 1 February 2021. The seizure of power triggered mass anti-coup demonstrations and a violent crackdown by the Tatmadaw (Myanmar armed forces), which significantly escalated the country's longstanding insurgencies.

In response to the coup, the exiled National Unity Government (NUG) and major ethnic armed organisations repudiated the 2008 Constitution and called instead for a democratic federal state. Besides engaging this alliance, the ruling military junta the State Administration Council (SAC), led by Min Aung Hlaing, contended with other anti-regime forces in areas under its control. The insurgents are apportioned into hundreds of armed groups scattered across the country.

Mjanmar je v oboroženem spopadu od leta 1948, ko je država, tedaj imenovana Burma, dobila neodvisnost od Združenega kraljestva. Spopad je večinoma etnični: etnične oborožene organizacije se za samoodločbo bojujejo proti mjanmarskim oboroženim silam, tatmadavu. Kljub številnim premirjem in ustanovitvi avtonomnih samoupravnih območij leta 2008 oborožene skupine še naprej zahtevajo neodvisnost, večjo avtonomijo, demokracijo ali federalizacijo Mjanmara. To je najdlje trajajoča državljanska vojna na svetu.

source.title: Myanmar conflict
paragraphs: Myanmar has been in armed conflict since 1948, when the country, then known as Burma, gained independence from the United Kingdom. The conflict has largely been ethnic-based, with ethnic armed organisations fighting Myanmar's armed forces, the Tatmadaw, for self-determination. Despite numerous ceasefires and the creation of autonomous self-administered zones in 2008, armed groups continue to call for independence, increased autonomy, democracy, or the federalisation of Myanmar. It is the world's longest-running civil war.

Myinsaing Kingdom.headline: Kraljestvo Mjinsaing
paragraphs: Kraljestvo Mjinsaing (burmansko: မြင်စိုင်းခေတ်) je bilo kraljestvo, ki je od leta 1297 do 1313 vladalo osrednji Burmi (Mjanmaru). Ustanovili so ga trije bratje iz Mjinsainga, Athinkhaja, Jazathingjan in Thihathu, in je bilo eno od številnih malih kraljestev, ki so nastala po propadu Paganskega cesarstva leta 1287. Mjinsaing je v letih 1300–1301 uspešno odbil drugo mongolsko invazijo in nato združil osrednjo Burmo od Tagaunga na severu do Proma (Pjaja) na jugu. Skupno vladanje bratov se je končalo med letoma 1310 in 1313 s smrtjo starejših bratov Athinkhaje in Jazathingjana. Leta 1315 je osrednja burmanska država razpadla na tekmeci državi Pinja in Sagaing. Osrednja Burma se je znova združila šele z vzponom Ave pet desetletij pozneje.
notes: Izpuščena je izgovarjava (IPA).

source.title: Myinsaing Kingdom
paragraphs: The Myinsaing Kingdom (Burmese: မြင်စိုင်းခေတ် [mjɪ̀ɰ̃záɪɰ̃ kʰɪʔ]) was the kingdom that ruled central Burma (Myanmar) from 1297 to 1313. It was founded by three brothers—Athinkhaya, Yazathingyan and Thihathu from Myinsaing— and was one of many small kingdoms that emerged following the collapse of the Pagan Empire in 1287. Myinsaing successfully fended off the second Mongol invasion in 1300–1301, and went on to unify central Burma from Tagaung in the north to Prome (Pyay) in the south. The brothers' co-rule ended between 1310 and 1313, with the death of the two elder brothers Athinkhaya and Yazathingyan. In 1315, the central Burmese state split into two rival states of Pinya and Sagaing. Central Burma would not be reunified until the rise of Ava five decades later.

Nader Shah's invasion of India.headline: Nader Šahov vpad v Indijo
paragraphs: Iranski Nader Šah, ustanovitelj afšaridske dinastije, je maja 1738 vdrl v severno Indijo in marca 1739 nazadnje oplenil Delhi. Njegova vojska je v bitki pri Karnalu zlahka porazila razpadajoče Mogulsko cesarstvo in nato zasedla mogulsko prestolnico.

Zmaga Nader Šaha nad šibkim in razpadajočim Mogulskim cesarstvom na skrajnem vzhodu mu je omogočila, da se je obrnil nazaj in nadaljeval vojno proti največjemu tekmecu Perzije, sosednjemu Osmanskemu cesarstvu, ter začel nove pohode na Severni Kavkaz in v Srednjo Azijo.

source.title: Nader Shah's invasion of India
paragraphs: In May 1738, Nader Shah of Iran, the founder of the Afsharid dynasty, invaded Northern India, eventually sacking Delhi in March 1739. His army easily defeated the crumbling Mughals at the Battle of Karnal and then occupied the Mughal capital.

Nader Shah's victory against the weak and crumbling Mughal Empire in the far east meant that he could afford to turn back and resume war against Persia's archrival, the neighbouring Ottoman Empire, as well as launch further campaigns in the North Caucasus and Central Asia.

Imperij Nanda je bil obsežen imperij, ki je v 4. stoletju pr. n. št. vladal Magadhi in Gangeški nižini z velikim geografskim obsegom na severovzhodu Indije, po nekaterih poročilih pa je obstajal že v 5. stoletju pr. n. št. Nande so nadgradili uspehe svojih predhodnikov iz dinastij Harjanka in Šišunaga in uvedli bolj centralizirano upravo. Stari viri jim pripisujejo veliko bogastvo, ki je bilo verjetno posledica uvedbe novega denarnega in davčnega sistema.

Stara besedila nakazujejo tudi, da so bili Nande med podložniki nepriljubljeni zaradi nizkega rodu, pretiranih davkov in splošno slabega ravnanja. Zadnjega kralja Nande Dhano Nando je strmoglavil Čandragupta Maurja, ustanovitelj Maurijskega imperija.

source.title: Nanda Empire
paragraphs: The Nanda Empire was a vast empire that governed in Magadha and Gangetic plains with an enormous geographical reach in 4th-century BCE northeastern India, with some accounts suggesting existence as far back as the 5th century BCE. The Nandas built on the successes of their Haryanka and Shaishunaga predecessors and installed a more centralised administration. Ancient sources credit them with amassing great wealth, which was probably the result of the introduction of a new currency and taxation system.

Ancient texts also suggest that the Nandas were unpopular among their subjects because of their low-status birth, excessive taxation, and general misconduct. The last Nanda king Dhana Nanda was overthrown by Chandragupta Maurya, founder of the Maurya Empire.

Nanyue.headline: Nanjue
paragraphs: Nanjue (kitajsko: 南越 ali 南粵; dobesedno »južni Jue«; vietnamsko: Nam Việt; džuangško: Namz Yied) je bilo starodavno kraljestvo, ki ga je leta 204 pr. n. št. ustanovil kitajski general Džao Tuo, njegova rodbina (v vietnamščini znana kot dinastija Triệu) pa mu je vladala do leta 111 pr. n. št. Nanjue je obsegal današnje kitajske upravne enote Guangdong, Guangši, Hajnan, Hongkong, Macao in južni Fudžjan ter osrednji in severni Vietnam. Džao Tuo, tedaj poveljnik poveljništva Nanhaj dinastije Čin, je Nanjue ustanovil leta 204 pr. n. št. po propadu dinastije Čin. Sprva so ga sestavljala poveljništva Nanhaj, Guilin in Šjang.
notes: Izpuščena sta zapisa v pinjinu in jutpingu.

source.title: Nanyue
paragraphs: Nanyue (Chinese: 南越 or 南粵; pinyin: Nányuè; Jyutping: Naam4 Jyut6; lit. 'Southern Yue', Vietnamese: Nam Việt, Zhuang: Namz Yied) was an ancient kingdom founded in 204 BC by the Chinese general Zhao Tuo, whose family (known in Vietnamese as the Triệu dynasty) continued to rule until 111 BC. Nanyue's geographical expanse covered the modern Chinese subdivisions of Guangdong, Guangxi, Hainan, Hong Kong, Macau, southern Fujian and central to northern Vietnam. Zhao Tuo, then Commander of Nanhai Commandery of the Qin dynasty, established Nanyue in 204 BC after the collapse of the Qin dynasty. At first, it consisted of the commanderies of Nanhai, Guilin, and Xiang.

Kraljestvo Nandžao (poenostavljeno kitajsko: 南诏; tradicionalno kitajsko: 南詔), zapisano tudi Nančao (dobesedno »južni Džao«; jezik ji: ꂷꏂꌅ), je bilo dinastično kraljestvo, ki je v 8. in 9. stoletju, v sredini in poznem obdobju dinastije Tang, cvetelo na območju današnje jugozahodne Kitajske in severne Jugovzhodne Azije. Središče je imelo v današnjem Junanu na Kitajskem, prestolnice pa v današnjem mestu Dali. Uradno se je kraljestvo od leta 738 do 859 imenovalo Dameng (大蒙), od leta 859 do 877 Dali (大禮), od leta 877 do 902 pa Dafengmin (大封民).
notes: Izpuščena sta zapis v pinjinu in latinični zapis imena v jeziku ji (Mashynzy).

source.title: Nanzhao
paragraphs: Nanzhao (simplified Chinese: 南诏; traditional Chinese: 南詔; pinyin: Nánzhào), also spelled Nanchao (lit. 'Southern Zhao', Yi language: ꂷꏂꌅ, Mashynzy), was a dynastic kingdom that flourished in what is now southwestern China and northern Southeast Asia during the 8th and 9th centuries, during the mid/late Tang dynasty. It was centered on present-day Yunnan in China, with its capitals in modern-day Dali City. The kingdom was officially called Dameng (大蒙) from 738 to 859 AD, Dali (大禮) from 859 to 877 and Dafengmin (大封民) from 877 to 902.

Nawab of Awadh.headline: Navab Avadha
paragraphs: Navab Avadha ali navab Oudha je bil naslov vladarjev kraljestva Avadh (poangleženo Oudh) v severni Indiji v 18. in 19. stoletju. Avadski navabi so pripadali iranski dinastiji sajidskega porekla šiitske veroizpovedi iz Nišapurja v Iranu. Navab Saadat kan je leta 1724 ustanovil kraljestvo Avadh s prestolnicama v Faizabadu in Lakhnauju.

source.title: Nawab of Awadh
paragraphs: The Nawab of Awadh or Nawab of Oudh was the title of the rulers of Kingdom of Awadh (anglicised as Oudh) in northern India during the 18th and 19th centuries. The Nawabs of Awadh belonged to an Iranian dynasty of Sayyid origin of Shia Islam. from Nishapur, Iran. In 1724, Nawab Sa'adat Khan established the Kingdom of Awadh with their capital in Faizabad and Lucknow.

Nawabs of Bengal.headline: Bengalski navabi
paragraphs: Bengalski navabi so bili dedni vladarji subaha Bengal v mogulski Indiji. V začetku 18. stoletja je bil bengalski navab dejansko neodvisen vladar treh provinc, Bengala, Biharja in Orise, zato jih pogosto imenujejo navabi Bengala, Biharja in Orise. Navabi so imeli sedež v Muršidabadu, ki je ležal v osrčju Bengala, Biharja in Orise. Njihov poglavar, nekdanji predsednik vlade, je postal prvi navab. Navabi so še naprej kovali denar v imenu mogulskega cesarja, dejansko pa so vladali kot neodvisni monarhi. Bengal je še vedno prispeval največji delež sredstev v cesarsko mogulsko zakladnico v Delhiju.
Subah Bengal je vrhunec dosegel med vladavino navaba Šudža ud-Dina Mohameda kana.
Navabi, zlasti v 16-letni vladavini Alivardija kana, so se zapletli v številne vojne z Marathi. Proti koncu se je Alivardi posvetil obnovi Bengala.

source.title: Nawabs of Bengal
paragraphs: The nawabs of Bengal were the hereditary rulers of Bengal Subah in Mughal India. In the early 18th century, the Nawab of Bengal was the de facto independent ruler of the three provinces of Bengal, Bihar and Orissa and they are often referred to as the nawabs of Bengal, Bihar and Orissa. The nawabs were based in Murshidabad which was centrally located within Bengal, Bihar, and Orissa. Their chief, a former prime minister, became the first nawab. The nawabs continued to issue coins in the name of the Mughal emperor, but for all practical purposes, the nawabs governed as independent monarchs. Bengal continued to contribute the largest share of funds to the imperial Mughal treasury in Delhi.
The Bengal Subah reached its peak during the reign of Nawab Shuja-ud-Din Muhammad Khan.

The nawabs, especially under the rule of Alivardi Khan of 16 years, were heavily engaged in various wars against the Marathas. Towards the end, he turned his attention to rebuilding and restoring Bengal.

Naxalite–Maoist insurgency.headline: Naksalitsko-maoistično uporništvo
paragraphs: Naksalitsko-maoistično uporništvo je trajajoč spopad med indijsko vlado in komunističnimi skupinami. Naksaliti so skupina komunističnih organizacij, ki sledijo maoističnim političnim nazorom in ideologiji, trdijo, da se bojujejo za revne na podeželju, in proti vladi vodijo ljudsko vojno.

Uporništvo se je začelo po vstaji v Naksalbariju leta 1967 in razcepu Komunistične partije Indije (marksistične), iz katerega je nastala marksistično-leninistična frakcija. Frakcija se je pozneje razcepila na več manjših skupin. Oboroženo krilo naksalitov, Ljudska osvobodilna gverilska armada, je bilo po indijskem zakonu o preprečevanju nezakonitih dejavnosti (1967) razglašeno za teroristično organizacijo in je odgovorno za številne napade, v katerih so bili ubiti in ranjeni civilisti in pripadniki varnostnih sil.

source.title: Naxalite–Maoist insurgency
paragraphs: The Naxalite–Maoist insurgency is an ongoing conflict between the Government of India and communist groups. The Naxalites are a group of communist organisations following Maoist political sentiment and ideology, and claim to be fighting for rural poor and wage a people's war against the government.

The insurgency started after the 1967 Naxalbari uprising and the subsequent split of the Communist Party of India (Marxist) leading to the creation of a Marxist–Leninist faction. The faction later splintered into various smaller groups. The Naxalites' armed wing, the People's Liberation Guerrilla Army, was declared a terrorist organisation under the Unlawful Activities (Prevention) Act of India (1967), and has been responsible for numerous attacks causing several deaths and injuries to civilians and security personnel.

Nepalese Civil War.headline: Nepalska državljanska vojna
paragraphs: Nepalska državljanska vojna (1996–2006) je bila dolgotrajen oborožen spopad po vsej tedanji Kraljevini Nepal med vladarji kraljevine in Komunistično partijo Nepala (maoistično), ki se je močno opirala na gverilsko vojskovanje. Začela se je 13. februarja 1996, ko je KPN(M) sprožila uporništvo z deklariranim namenom strmoglaviti nepalsko monarhijo in ustanoviti ljudsko republiko. Končala se je s podpisom celovitega mirovnega sporazuma 21. novembra 2006.

Spopad so zaznamovali številni zločini proti človečnosti, med njimi umori, čistke, ugrabitve in posilstva. V spopadu je umrlo več kot 17.000 ljudi (civilistov in pripadnikov oboroženih sil), med njimi več kot 4000 Nepalcev, ki so jih od leta 1996 do 2005 ubili maoisti, in več kot 8200 Nepalcev, ki so jih od leta 1996 do 2005 ubile vladne sile. Komisija za preiskavo prisilnih izginotij je prejela 3093 pritožb.

source.title: Nepalese Civil War
paragraphs: The Nepalese Civil War (1996–2006) was a protracted and countrywide armed conflict in the then Kingdom of Nepal between the Kingdom's rulers and the Communist Party of Nepal (Maoist), with the latter making significant use of guerrilla warfare. It began on 13 February 1996, when the CPN(M) initiated an insurgency with the stated purpose of overthrowing the Nepali monarchy and establishing a people's republic. It ended with the signing of the Comprehensive Peace Accord on 21 November 2006.

The conflict was characterized by numerous crimes against humanity, including murders, purges, kidnappings, and rapes. More than 17,000 people (including both civilians and armed forces) were killed during the conflict, including over 4,000 Nepalese killed by Maoists from 1996 to 2005, and over 8,200 Nepalese killed by government forces from 1996 to 2005. The Commission for Investigation of Enforced Disappearances has received 3,093 complaints.

Ngô dynasty.headline: Dinastija Ngô
paragraphs: Dinastija Ngô (vietnamsko: Nhà Ngô; chữ Nôm: 茹吳), uradno Tĩnh Hải quân (chữ Hán: 靜海軍), je bila polneodvisna vietnamska dinastija od leta 939 do 968. Ustanovil jo je Ngô Quyền, ki je leta 938 vodil vietnamske sile v bitki na reki Bạch Đằng proti kitajski dinastiji Južni Han.

source.title: Ngô dynasty
paragraphs: The Ngô dynasty (Vietnamese: Nhà Ngô; Chữ Nôm: 茹吳), officially Tĩnh Hải quân (chữ Hán: 靜海軍), was a semi-independent Vietnamese dynasty from 939 to 968. The dynasty was founded by Ngô Quyền, who led the Vietnamese forces in the Battle of Bạch Đằng River against the Chinese Southern Han dynasty in 938.

Nguyễn lords.headline: Gospodje Nguyễn
paragraphs: Gospodje Nguyễn (vietnamsko: Chúa Nguyễn; chữ Hán: 主阮; 1558–1777, 1780–1802), znani tudi kot klan Nguyễn (vietnamsko: Nguyễn thị; chữ Hán: 阮氏), so bili predhodniki dinastije Nguyễn in fevdalni plemiški klan, ki je v času obnovljene dinastije Lê vladal južnemu Đại Việtu. Gospodje Nguyễn so bili člani rodbine Nguyễn Phúc. Ozemlje, ki so mu vladali, so tedaj imenovali Đàng Trong (notranje kraljestvo), z eksonimi pa kraljestvo Kočinčina in kraljestvo Quảng Nam (vietnamsko: Quảng Nam Quốc; chữ Hán: 廣南國), v nasprotju z gospodi Trịnh, ki so severnemu Đại Việtu vladali kot Đàng Ngoài (zunanje kraljestvo), ki so ga Evropejci imenovali »kraljestvo Tonkin«, cesarska Kitajska pa v dvostranski diplomaciji »kraljestvo An Nam« (vietnamsko: An Nam Quốc; chữ Hán: 安南國). Uradni naslov Nguyễn Vương (chữ Hán: 阮王) so dobili leta 1744, ko se je gospod Nguyễn Phúc Khoát sam razglasil zanj, da bi se položajno izenačil z naslovom gospodov Trịnh, Trịnh Vương (vietnamsko: Trịnh Vương; chữ Hán: 鄭王). Klana Nguyễn in Trịnh sta bila de iure podrejena in fevda dinastije Lê. De iure podrejenost gospodov Nguyễn gospodom Trịnh se je končala leta 1627 in sprožila vojno med njima.

source.title: Nguyễn lords
paragraphs: The Nguyễn lords (Vietnamese: Chúa Nguyễn, chữ Hán: 主阮; 1558–1777, 1780–1802), also known as the Nguyễn clan (Vietnamese: Nguyễn thị; chữ Hán: 阮氏), were Nguyễn dynasty's forerunner and a feudal noble clan ruling southern Đại Việt in the Revival Lê dynasty. The Nguyễn lords were members of the House of Nguyễn Phúc. The territory they ruled was known contemporarily as Đàng Trong (Inner Realm) and by the exonyms the Kingdom of Cochinchina and the Kingdom of Quảng Nam (Vietnamese: Quảng Nam Quốc; chữ Hán: 廣南國), in opposition to the Trịnh lords, who ruled northern Đại Việt as Đàng Ngoài (Outer Realm), known as the "Kingdom of Tonkin" by Europeans and "Kingdom of An Nam" (Vietnamese: An Nam Quốc; chữ Hán: 安南國) by Imperial China in bilateral diplomacy. They were officially entitled, in Sino-Vietnamese, the Nguyễn Vương (chữ Hán: 阮王) in 1744 when lord Nguyễn Phúc Khoát self-proclaimed himself to elevate his status equally to Trịnh lords's title known as the Trịnh Vương (Vietnamese: Trịnh Vương; chữ Hán: 鄭王). Both Nguyễn and Trịnh clans were de jure subordinates and fief of the Lê dynasty. However, the de jure submission of the Nguyễn lords to the Trịnh lords ended in 1627 sparked the war between them.

Severni Juan je bil dinastična država, ki ji je vladal mongolski klan Bordžigin s središčem na Mongolski planoti. Obstajal je kot okrnjena država po propadu dinastije Juan leta 1368 in trajal do leta 1635, ko ga je osvojila pozna dinastija Džin pod vodstvom Džurčenov, pozneje preimenovana v dinastijo Čing. Dinastija Severni Juan se je začela z umikom juanskega cesarskega dvora pod vodstvom Togona Temürja (cesarja Huejcunga iz dinastije Juan) v mongolsko stepo. Obdobje so zaznamovali boji med frakcijami in pogosto le nominalna vloga velikega kana.

source.title: Northern Yuan
paragraphs: The Northern Yuan was a dynastic state ruled by the Mongol Borjigin clan based in the Mongolian Plateau. It existed as a rump state after the collapse of the Yuan dynasty in 1368 and lasted until its conquest by the Jurchen-led Later Jin dynasty in 1635, which was later renamed as the Qing dynasty. The Northern Yuan dynasty began with the retreat of the Yuan imperial court led by Toghon Temür (Emperor Huizong of Yuan) to the Mongolian steppe. This period featured factional struggles and the often only nominal role of the Great Khan.

Oghuz Khagan.headline: Oguz kagan
paragraphs: Oguz kagan ali Oguz kan (turško: Oğuz Kağan ali Oğuz Han; azerbajdžansko: Oğuz Xan ali Oğuz Xaqan; turkmensko: Oguz Han) je legendarni kan turških ljudstev in eponimni prednik oguških Turkov. Nekatere turške kulture z legendo o Oguz kanu opisujejo svoj etnični in plemenski izvor. Različice pripovedi, ohranjene v številnih rokopisih, so izšle v mnogih jezikih. Pripovedi o njem pogosto nosijo naslov Oguzname; obstaja več izročil, ki opisujejo njegove številne podvige in osvajanja, nekatera pa se prekrivajo z drugimi turškimi epskimi izročili, kot sta Seldžukname in Knjiga Dede Korkuta. Oguz kan je izhajal iz plemena Balga, bil je sin Kara Beja (Oguz Beja) in je pozneje postal kan.
notes: Izpuščena je napotitev na seznam virov (»as listed in the references below«).

source.title: Oghuz Khagan
paragraphs: Oghuz Khagan or Oğuz Khan (Turkish: Oğuz Kağan or Oğuz Han; Azerbaijani: Oğuz Xan or Oğuz Xaqan; Turkmen: Oguz Han) is a legendary khan of the Turkic people and an eponymous ancestor of the Oghuz Turks. Some Turkic cultures use the legend of Oghuz Khan to describe their ethnic and tribal origins. The various versions of the narrative preserved in many different manuscripts have been published in numerous languages, as listed in the references below. The narratives about him are often entitled Oghuzname, of which there are several traditions describing his many feats and conquests; some of these tend to overlap with other Turkic epic traditions, such as the Seljukname and The Book of Dede Korkut. Oğuz Khan was from the Balga tribe, the son of Qara Bey (Oğuz Bey), and later became a khan.

Oirat Confederation.headline: Ojratska konfederacija
paragraphs: Ojratska konfederacija ali Štirje Ojrati (pisna ojratščina: ᡑᡈᠷᡋᡈᠨᡆᡕᡅᠷᠠᡑ; mongolsko: Дөрвөн Ойрад; kitajsko: 四衛拉特), nekoč znana kot Elevti, je bila konfederacija ojratskih plemen, s katero so se v zgodovini Mongolske planote povzpeli zahodni Mongoli.

Čeprav vzhodni Mongoli in Ojrati izraz »Štirje Ojrati« splošno uporabljajo in so ga zgodovinarji že večkrat razlagali, o tem, katera so bila prvotna štiri plemena, ni soglasja. Splošno velja, da izraz označuje plemena Čoros, Torgut, Dörbet in Hošut, po eni od teorij pa Ojrati niso bili krvno sorodne enote, temveč politično-etnične enote iz številnih rodov po moški liniji. V zgodnjem obdobju je konfederaciji pripadalo tudi pleme Kergüd.
notes: Izpuščeni so latinični zapisi ojratskega in mongolskega imena ter izgovarjava (IPA).

source.title: Oirat Confederation
paragraphs: The Four Oirats (Written Oirat: ᡑᡈᠷᡋᡈᠨᡆᡕᡅᠷᠠᡑ, Dörbön Oyirad; Mongolian: Дөрвөн Ойрад, romanized: Dörvön Oirad, pronounced [ˈtɵrw̜ʊ̈ɴ ˈɞe̯ɾ(ə)t]; Chinese: 四衛拉特) or Oirat Confederation, formerly known as the Eleuths, was the confederation of the Oirat tribes which marked the rise of the Western Mongols in the history of the Mongolian Plateau.

Despite the universal currency of the term "Four Oirat" among Eastern Mongols, Oirats, and numerous explanations by historians, no consensus has been reached on the identity of the original four tribes. While it is believed that the term Four Oirats refers to the Choros, Torghut, Dörbet, and Khoshut tribes, there is a theory that the Oirats were not consanguineous units, but political-ethnic units composed of many patrilineages. In the early period, the Kergüd tribe also belonged to the confederation.

Operation Achilles.headline: Operacija Ahil
paragraphs: Operacija Ahil je bila Natova operacija v okviru vojne v Afganistanu. Njen cilj je bil očistiti provinco Helmand talibanov. Operacija se je začela 6. marca 2007. Ofenziva je bila do tedaj največja Natova operacija v Afganistanu. Natovi uradniki so poročali, da so se talibski borci v nasprotju s prejšnjimi operacijami izogibali neposrednim spopadom in raje uporabljali gverilsko taktiko.

Vodile so jo britanske sile ISAF, osredotočala pa se je na jez Kadžaki in mesta na tem območju; jez je pomemben vir električne energije za Afganistan, ki več let ni deloval. Del naloge je bila operacija Vulkan, v kateri so britanski kraljevi marinci uspešno očistili velik talibanski kompleks blizu jezu Kadžaki, ter operacija Kriptonit, v kateri so zavezniške sile očistile sam jez.

source.title: Operation Achilles
paragraphs: Operation Achilles was a NATO operation, part of the War in Afghanistan. Its objective was to clear Helmand province of the Taliban. The operation began on March 6, 2007. The offensive is the largest NATO-based operation in Afghanistan to date. NATO officials reported that, contrary to previous operations, Taliban fighters were avoiding direct confrontation in favor of guerilla tactics.

It was led by British ISAF forces and focused on the Kajakai Dam and the towns in the area, which is a major power source for Afghanistan that had not been functioning for a number of years. One part of the mission was Operation Volcano, where British Royal Marines successfully cleared a large Taliban complex near the Kajakai Dam, as well as Operation Kryptonite which actually saw the clearing of the dam by allied forces.

Operation Babylift.headline: Operacija Babylift
paragraphs: Operacija Babylift je bila množična evakuacija otrok iz Južnega Vietnama v Združene države in druge zahodne države ob koncu vietnamske vojne aprila 1975. Po zraku so prepeljali več kot 3300 dojenčkov in otrok, čeprav se dejansko število v poročilih razlikuje.

source.title: Operation Babylift
paragraphs: Operation Babylift was a mass evacuation of children from South Vietnam to the United States and other Western countries at the end of the Vietnam War, in April 1975. Over 3,300 infants and children were airlifted, although the actual number has been variously reported.

Operation Cedar Falls.headline: Operacija Cedar Falls
paragraphs: Operacija Cedar Falls je bila vojaška operacija vietnamske vojne, ki so jo predvsem ameriške sile izvedle od 8. do 26. januarja 1967. Cilj obsežne operacije iskanja in uničenja je bil izkoreniniti Železni trikotnik, območje severozahodno od Saigona, ki je postalo glavno oporišče Vietkonga (VC).

To je bila največja ameriška kopenska operacija vietnamske vojne: sodelovali sta dve diviziji kopenske vojske, ena pehotna in ena padalska brigada ter en oklepni konjeniški polk. Skupaj je sodelovalo 30.000 ameriških in južnovietnamskih vojakov. VC pa se je obsežni vojaški sili izognil z begom čez mejo v Kambodžo ali skrivanjem v zapletenem sistemu predorov. Zavezniške sile so vseeno odkrile in uničile nekaj sistemov predorov ter velike zaloge VC. Med operacijo so uvedli tako imenovane predorske podgane, ki so prodirale v predorske sisteme Vietkonga.

source.title: Operation Cedar Falls
paragraphs: Operation Cedar Falls was a military operation of the Vietnam War conducted primarily by US forces that took place from 8 to 26 January 1967.
