paragraphs: Obleganje Lal Masdžida (urdujsko: لال مسجد محاصرہ; kodno ime operacija Sončni vzhod, prvotno operacija Tišina) je bilo oborožen spopad julija 2007 med islamistično fundamentalistično zasebno milico in pakistansko vlado pod vodstvom predsednika Perveza Mušarafa in predsednika vlade Šaukata Aziza. Središči operacije sta bili Lal Masdžid (»Rdeča mošeja«) in kompleks medrese Džamia Hafsa v Islamabadu v Pakistanu.

source.title: Siege of Lal Masjid
paragraphs: The siege of Lal Masjid (Urdu: لال مسجد محاصرہ; code-named Operation Sunrise initially code-named as Operation Silence) was an armed confrontation in July 2007 between a Islamist fundamentalist private militia and the government of Pakistan, led by president Pervez Musharraf and prime minister Shaukat Aziz. The focal points of the operation were the Lal Masjid ("Red Mosque") and the Jamia Hafsa madrasah complex in Islamabad, Pakistan.

Siege of Lucknow.headline: Obleganje Lakhnauja
paragraphs: Med obleganjem Lakhnauja so med indijskim uporom leta 1857 v mestu Lakhnau dolgo branili britansko rezidenco pred upornimi sipaji (indijskimi vojaki v vojski britanske Vzhodnoindijske družbe). Ko sta do mesta prišla dva zaporedna reševalna poskusa, so branilce in civiliste evakuirali iz rezidence, ki so jo nato zapustili.

source.title: Siege of Lucknow
paragraphs: The siege of Lucknow was the prolonged defence of the British Residency within the city of Lucknow from rebel sepoys (Indian soldiers in the British East India Company's Army) during the Indian Rebellion of 1857. After two successive relief attempts had reached the city, the defenders and civilians were evacuated from the Residency, which was then abandoned.

Obleganje Malakanda je bilo obleganje britanske garnizije v pokrajini Malakand v Severozahodni obmejni provinci kolonialne Britanske Indije od 26. julija do 2. avgusta 1897. Britanci so se spopadli s paštunskimi plemeni, katerih plemenske dežele je presekala Durandova črta, 2445 km dolga meja med Afganistanom in Britansko Indijo, ki so jo začrtali ob koncu angleško-afganistanskih vojn, da bi zajezili širjenje vpliva Ruskega imperija proti Indijski podcelini, ki so se ga bali Britanci.

Nemiri zaradi te razdelitve paštunskih dežel Afganije so privedli do vzpona Saidulaha, paštunskega fakirja, ki je proti britanski garniziji v Malakandu povedel veliko vojsko najmanj 10.000 pripadnikov krajevnih plemen Jusufzaj, Mohmand, Uthmankhel, Bunerval, Svati in drugih. Čeprav so bile britanske sile razdeljene na več slabo branjenih položajev, sta se majhna garnizija v taboru Južni Malakand in majhna utrdba v Čakdari šest dni upirali precej večji paštunski vojski.
notes: Izpuščena je navedba v miljah.

source.title: Siege of Malakand
paragraphs: The siege of Malakand was the 26 July – 2 August 1897 siege of the British garrison in the Malakand region of colonial British India's North West Frontier Province. The British faced a force of Pashtun tribesmen whose tribal lands had been bisected by the Durand Line, the 1,519 mile (2,445 km) border between Afghanistan and British India drawn up at the end of the Anglo-Afghan wars to help hold back what the British feared to be the Russian Empire's spread of influence towards the Indian subcontinent.

The unrest caused by this division of the Pashtun lands of Afghania led to the rise of Saidullah, a Pashtun faqir who led a great army of at least 10,000 tribesmen of the regional Yusufzai, Mohmand, Uthmankhel, Bunerwal, Swati tribes among others against the British garrison in Malakand. Although the British forces were divided among a number of poorly defended positions, the small garrison at the camp of Malakand South and the small fort at Chakdara were both able to hold out for six days against the much larger Pashtun army.

Siege of Petropavlovsk.headline: Obleganje Petropavlovska
paragraphs: Med obleganjem Petropavlovska, vojaško operacijo na pacifiškem bojišču krimske vojne, so britanske in francoske pomorske sile neuspešno poskušale zavzeti rusko pristanišče Petropavlovsk na polotoku Kamčatka. Ruske izgube ocenjujejo na 115 ubitih in hudo ranjenih vojakov in mornarjev, Britanci so imeli 105 žrtev, Francozi pa 104 (po uradnih ocenah zaveznikov).

source.title: Siege of Petropavlovsk
paragraphs: The Siege of Petropavlovsk was a military operation in the Pacific theatre of the Crimean War in which British and French naval forces unsuccessfully attempted to capture the Russian port of Petropavlovsk on the Kamchatka peninsula. The Russian casualties are estimated at 115 soldiers and sailors killed and seriously wounded, whilst the British suffered 105 casualties and the French 104 (by official estimates of the Allies).

Siege of Seringapatam (1799).headline: Obleganje Seringapatama (1799)
paragraphs: Obleganje Seringapatama (5. april – 4. maj 1799) je bilo zadnji spopad četrte angleško-misorske vojne med britansko Vzhodnoindijsko družbo in Misorskim kraljestvom, ki mu je po očetovi smrti vladal Tipu Sultan. Britanci so z zavezniki, Nizamom Alijem kanom, 2. hajderabadskim nizamom, in Marathskim imperijem, dosegli odločilno zmago, ko so prebili obzidje trdnjave Seringapatam in naskočili citadelo.

Vojna se je končala s porazom in smrtjo Tipuja Sultana v bitki. Britanci so po zmagi s pogodbo o subsidiarnem zavezništvu na oblast vrnili dinastijo Vadijar in Krišnaradža Vodejar III. je bil kronan za misorskega kralja. Posredni nadzor (britansko vrhovno oblast) nad zunanjimi zadevami kraljestva pa so obdržali.

source.title: Siege of Seringapatam (1799)
paragraphs: The siege of Seringapatam (5 April – 4 May 1799) was the final confrontation of the Fourth Anglo-Mysore War between the British East India Company and the Kingdom of Mysore led by Tipu Sultan who ruled after the death of his father. The British, with the allied Nizam Ali Khan, 2nd Nizam of Hyderabad and Maratha Empire, achieved a decisive victory after breaching the walls of the fortress at Seringapatam and storming the citadel.

The war came to an end with the defeat and death of Tipu Sultan in the battle. The British restored the Wadiyar dynasty back to power after the victory through a treaty of subsidiary alliance and Krishnaraja Wodeyar III was crowned the King of Mysore. However, they retained indirect control (British paramountcy) of the kingdom's external affairs.

Siege of the Sogdian Rock.headline: Obleganje Sogdijske skale
paragraphs: Sogdijsko skalo ali Ariamazovo skalo, trdnjavo severno od Baktrije v Sogdijani (blizu Samarkanda), ki ji je vladal Arimaz, so sile Aleksandra Velikega zgodaj spomladi leta 327 pr. n. št. zavzele med osvajanjem Ahemenidskega cesarstva.

source.title: Siege of the Sogdian Rock
paragraphs: The Sogdian Rock or Rock of Ariamazes, a fortress located north of Bactria in Sogdiana (near Samarkand), ruled by Arimazes, was captured by the forces of Alexander the Great in the early spring of 327 BC as part of his conquest of the Achaemenid Empire.

Simla Agreement.headline: Sporazum iz Šimle
paragraphs: Sporazum iz Šimle (tudi Simle) je dvostranska mirovna pogodba in okvirni sporazum, ki sta ga Indija in Pakistan podpisala 2. julija 1972 v Šimli, prestolnici indijske zvezne države Himačal Pradeš. Sledil je pakistanskemu porazu v indijsko-pakistanski vojni leta 1971, ki se je začela, ko je Indija v bangladeški osvobodilni vojni v Vzhodnem Pakistanu posredovala na strani Mukti Bahini proti pakistanskim oboroženim silam.

Uradni namen pogodbe je, da bi obe državi »končali spopade in soočenja, ki so doslej kvarili njune odnose«, in zasnovali korake za nadaljnjo normalizacijo indijsko-pakistanskih odnosov, hkrati pa določili načela, po katerih naj bi se ravnali v prihodnje.

S pogodbo je Indija Pakistanu vrnila več kot 13.000 km² ozemlja, ki ga je indijska vojska med vojno zasedla v Pakistanu, obdržala pa je nekaj strateških območij, med njimi Turtuk, Dhothang, Tjakši (prej Tiaqsi) in Čalunko v dolini Čorbat, skupaj več kot 883 km².

source.title: Simla Agreement
paragraphs: The Simla Agreement, also spelled Shimla Agreement, is a bilateral peace treaty and framework agreement signed between India and Pakistan on 2 July 1972 in Shimla, the capital of the Indian state of Himachal Pradesh. It followed Pakistan's defeat in the India–Pakistan war of 1971, which began after India intervened in the Bangladesh Liberation War in East Pakistan on Mukti Bahini's side against Pakistan Armed Forces.

The treaty's official purpose is stated to serve as a way for both countries to "put an end to the conflict and confrontation that have hitherto marred their relations" and to conceive the steps to be taken for further normalization of India–Pakistan relations while also laying down the principles that should govern their future interactions.

The treaty gave back more than 13,000 km2 of land that the Indian Army had seized in Pakistan during the war, though India retained a few strategic areas, including Turtuk, Dhothang, Tyakshi (earlier called Tiaqsi) and Chalunka in the Chorbat Valley,, comprising more than 883 km2.

Sino-Burmese War.headline: Kitajsko-burmanska vojna
paragraphs: Kitajsko-burmanska vojna (kitajsko: 清緬戰爭; burmansko: တရုတ်-မြန်မာ စစ်ပွဲများ), znana tudi kot čingovske invazije na Burmo ali mjanmarski pohod dinastije Čing, je bila vojna med kitajsko dinastijo Čing in burmansko (mjanmarsko) dinastijo Konbaung. Čingi so pod cesarjem Čjanlungom med letoma 1765 in 1769 štirikrat vdrli v Burmo, kar so šteli za enega od njegovih desetih velikih pohodov. Vojno, ki je terjala življenja več kot 70.000 čingovskih vojakov in štirih poveljnikov, pa včasih opisujejo kot »najbolj katastrofalno obmejno vojno, kar jih je dinastija Čing kdaj vodila«, in kot vojno, ki je »zagotovila burmansko neodvisnost«. Uspešna burmanska obramba je postavila temelje sedanje meje med državama.

source.title: Sino-Burmese War
paragraphs: The Sino-Burmese War (Chinese: 清緬戰爭; Burmese: တရုတ်-မြန်မာ စစ်ပွဲများ), also known as the Qing invasions of Burma or the Myanmar campaign of the Qing dynasty, was a war fought between the Qing dynasty of China and the Konbaung dynasty of Burma (Myanmar). The Qing under the Qianlong Emperor launched four invasions of Burma between 1765 and 1769, which were considered one of his Ten Great Campaigns. Nonetheless, the war, which claimed the lives of over 70,000 Qing soldiers and four commanders, is sometimes described as "the most disastrous frontier war that the Qing dynasty had ever waged", and one that "assured Burmese independence". Burma's successful defense laid the foundation for the present-day boundary between the two countries.

Kitajsko-indijska vojna, znana tudi kot indijsko-kitajska vojna, je bila oborožen spopad med Kitajsko in Indijo, ki je potekal od oktobra do novembra 1962. Bila je vojaška zaostritev kitajsko-indijskega mejnega spora. Boji so se zgoščali na dveh krajih ob indijsko-kitajski meji, v Severovzhodni obmejni agenciji (NESA) in na območju Aksaj Čin, ki sta bila približno 1000 km narazen. Spopad je nastal zaradi kitajskih zahtev po Aksaj Činu in NESA, pri čemer sta se državi sklicevali na različne zgodovinske mejne dogovore. Indija je priznavala Johnsonovo črto na zahodu in McMahonovo črto na vzhodu, Kitajska pa ju ni priznavala.
notes: Izpuščena je pretvorba v milje. Glosarsko ime (Indijsko-kirajska vojna) ima tipkarsko napako in je popravljeno.

source.title: Sino-Indian War
paragraphs: The Sino-Indian War, also known as the China–India War or the Indo-China War, was an armed conflict between China and India that took place from October to November 1962. It was a military escalation of the Sino-Indian border dispute. The fighting was concentrated in two locations along the India-China border, the North-East Frontier Agency (NESA), and the Aksai Chin region, which were roughly 1,000 km (620 mi) apart. The conflict arose due to China's claims over the Aksai Chin and NESA, with both countries relying on different historical border agreements. India recognised the Johnson Line in the west and the McMahon Line in the east, while China did not recognise them.

Kitajsko-vietnamska vojna (znana tudi pod drugimi imeni) je bila vojna med Kitajsko in Vietnamom v začetku leta 1979. Kitajska je sprožila ofenzivo, domnevno kot odgovor na vietnamsko invazijo in zasedbo Kambodže leta 1978, ki je končala vladavino Rdečih Kmerov. Spopad je trajal približno mesec dni, Kitajska pa je marca 1979 umaknila svoje čete.

source.title: Sino-Vietnamese War
paragraphs: The Sino-Vietnamese War (also known by other names) was a war which occurred in early 1979 between China and Vietnam. China launched an offensive ostensibly in response to Vietnam's invasion and occupation of Cambodia in 1978, which ended the rule of the Khmer Rouge. The conflict lasted for about a month, with China withdrawing its troops in March 1979.

Vojna v Južni Osetiji 1991–1992 (znana tudi kot prva južnoosetijska vojna) se je bila med gruzijskimi vladnimi silami in etničnimi gruzijskimi milicami na eni strani ter silami južnoosetijskih separatistov in Rusijo na drugi. Končala se je s sporazumom iz Dagomisa, podpisanim 24. junija 1992, ki je vzpostavil skupne mirovne sile, Južna Osetija pa je ostala razdeljena med tekmujoči oblasti.

source.title: South Ossetia war (1991–1992)
paragraphs: The 1991–1992 South Ossetia War (also known as the First South Ossetia War) was fought between Georgian government forces and ethnic Georgian militias on one side and the forces of South Ossetian separatists and Russia on the other. The war ended with a Dagomys Agreement, signed on 24 June 1992, which established a joint peacekeeping force and left South Ossetia divided between the rival authorities.

Južni Han (kitajsko: 南漢; 917–971), uradno Han (kitajsko: 漢), sprva Jue (kitajsko: 越), je bil dinastična država Kitajske in eno od desetih kraljestev iz obdobja petih dinastij in desetih kraljestev. Ležal je na južni obali Kitajske in nadzoroval današnji Guangdong in Guangši. Dinastija je močno razširila svojo prestolnico Šingvang Fu (kitajsko: 興王府; današnji Guangdžov). Neuspešno je poskušala priključiti avtonomno tvorbo Džinghaj, ki so jo nadzorovali Vietnamci.
notes: Izpuščeni so zapisi v pinjinu in jutpingu.

source.title: Southern Han
paragraphs: Southern Han (Chinese: 南漢; pinyin: Nán Hàn; Jyutping: Naam4 Hon3; 917–971), officially Han (Chinese: 漢; Jyutping: Hon3), originally Yue (Chinese: 越; Jyutping: Jyut6), was a dynastic state of China and one of the Ten Kingdoms that existed during the Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms period. It was located on China's southern coast, controlling modern Guangdong and Guangxi. The dynasty greatly expanded its capital Xingwang Fu (Chinese: 興王府; pinyin: Xìngwáng Fǔ; Jyutping: Hing1 Wong4 Fu2, present-day Guangzhou). It attempted but failed to annex the autonomous polity of Jinghai, which was controlled by the Vietnamese.

Southern Ming.headline: Južni Ming
paragraphs: Južni Ming, v zgodovinopisju znan tudi kot Pozni Ming, uradno Veliki Ming, je bil cesarska dinastija Kitajske in vrsta okrnjenih držav dinastije Ming, ki so nastale po incidentu Džjašen leta 1644. Kmečki uporniki pod vodstvom Li Dzičenga, ki je ustanovil kratkotrajno dinastijo Šun, so zavzeli Peking, cesar Čongdžen pa si je vzel življenje. Mingovski general Vu Sangui je nato vrata prelaza Šanhaj na vzhodnem delu Kitajskega zidu odprl čingovskim praporom, v upanju, da bo z njihovo pomočjo uničil sile Šuna. Mingovski zvestobniki so pobegnili v Nanking, kjer so Džu Jousonga ustoličili za cesarja Hongguanga, s čimer se je začel Južni Ming. Nankinški režim je trajal do leta 1645, ko so čingovske sile zavzele Nanking. Džu je pobegnil, preden je mesto padlo, vendar so ga kmalu zatem ujeli in usmrtili. Poznejši vladarji so imeli dvor v različnih mestih južne Kitajske, čeprav so jih Čingi imeli za pretendente.

source.title: Southern Ming
paragraphs: The Southern Ming, also known in historiography as the Later Ming, officially the Great Ming, was an imperial dynasty of China and a series of rump states of the Ming dynasty that came into existence following the Jiashen Incident of 1644. Peasant rebels led by Li Zicheng who founded the short-lived Shun dynasty captured Beijing and the Chongzhen Emperor committed suicide. The Ming general Wu Sangui then opened the gates of the Shanhai Pass in the eastern section of the Great Wall to the Qing banners, in hope of using them to annihilate the Shun forces. Ming loyalists fled to Nanjing, where they enthroned Zhu Yousong as the Hongguang Emperor, marking the start of the Southern Ming. The Nanjing regime lasted until 1645, when Qing forces captured Nanjing. Zhu fled before the city fell, but was captured and executed shortly thereafter. Later figures continued to hold court in various southern Chinese cities, although the Qing considered them to be pretenders.

Soviet invasion of Azerbaijan.headline: Sovjetska invazija na Azerbajdžan
paragraphs: Invazija Rdeče armade na Azerbajdžan, znana tudi kot sovjetizacija ali sovjetska invazija na Azerbajdžan, je potekala aprila 1920. Bila je vojaški pohod 11. armade Sovjetske Rusije, katerega cilj je bil v Azerbajdžanski demokratični republiki vzpostaviti sovjetsko vlado. Invazija je sovpadla s protivladno vstajo, ki so jo v prestolnici Baku organizirali tamkajšnji azerbajdžanski boljševiki. Azerbajdžanska demokratična republika je zato razpadla, namesto nje pa so ustanovili Azerbajdžansko sovjetsko socialistično republiko.

V letih 1919–1920 je Azerbajdžan zajela huda politična ter družbena in gospodarska kriza, notranje razmere pa so bile nestabilne. Po vsej državi so izbruhali oboroženi spopadi med različnimi političnimi in družbenimi frakcijami. Po propadu republikanske oblasti leta 1918 so delovale podtalne organizacije različnih političnih strank in socialističnih skupin. Februarja 1920 so se te frakcije združile z Azerbajdžansko komunistično partijo (boljševikov), da bi uskladile politične cilje.

source.title: Soviet invasion of Azerbaijan
paragraphs: The Red Army invasion of Azerbaijan, also known as the Sovietization or Soviet invasion of Azerbaijan, took place in April 1920. It was a military campaign conducted by the 11th Army of the Soviet Russia aimed at installing a Soviet government in the Azerbaijan Democratic Republic. The invasion coincided with an anti-government insurrection organized by local Azerbaijani Bolsheviks in the capital city of Baku. As a result, the Azerbaijan Democratic Republic was dissolved, and the Azerbaijan Soviet Socialist Republic was established.

During 1919–1920, Azerbaijan experienced severe political and socio-economic crises, with volatile internal conditions. Armed conflicts occurred between various political and social factions across the country. Since the collapse of Republican Power in 1918, underground organizations consisting of different political parties and socialist groups were active. These factions united with the AC(b)P in February 1920 to coordinate their political objectives.

Soviet invasion of Georgia.headline: Sovjetska invazija na Gruzijo
paragraphs: Sovjetska invazija na Gruzijo (12. februar – 17. marec 1921), znana tudi kot gruzijsko-sovjetska vojna ali invazija Rdeče armade na Gruzijo, je bila vojaški pohod ruske sovjetske Rdeče armade, katerega cilj je bil strmoglaviti socialdemokratsko (menjševiško) vlado Demokratične republike Gruzije (DRG) in v državi vzpostaviti boljševiški režim (Komunistično partijo Gruzije). Spopad je bil posledica ekspanzionistične politike boljševikov, ki so hoteli nadzorovati čim več dežel, ki so do burnih dogodkov prve svetovne vojne pripadale nekdanjemu Ruskemu imperiju, in revolucionarnih prizadevanj gruzijskih boljševikov, ki so večinoma delovali v Rusiji in v domovini niso imeli dovolj podpore, da bi brez posredovanja od zunaj prevzeli oblast.

source.title: Soviet invasion of Georgia
paragraphs: The Soviet invasion of Georgia (12 February – 17 March 1921), also known as the Georgian–Soviet War or the Red Army invasion of Georgia, was a military campaign by the Russian Soviet Red Army aimed at overthrowing the Social Democratic (Menshevik) government of the Democratic Republic of Georgia (DRG) and installing a Bolshevik regime (Communist Party of Georgia) in the country. The conflict was a result of expansionist policy by the Bolsheviks, who aimed to control as much as possible of the lands which had been part of the former Russian Empire until the turbulent events of the First World War, as well as the revolutionary efforts of mostly Russian-based Georgian Bolsheviks, who did not have sufficient support in their native country to seize power without external intervention.

Soviet invasion of South Sakhalin.headline: Sovjetska invazija na Južni Sahalin
paragraphs: Sovjetska zveza je vdrla v japonski del otoka Sahalin, znan tudi kot prefektura Karafuto. Invazija je bila del sovjetsko-japonske vojne, manjšega pohoda na azijskem bojišču druge svetovne vojne.

source.title: Soviet invasion of South Sakhalin
paragraphs: The Soviet Union invaded the Japanese portion of Sakhalin Island, also known as Karafuto Prefecture. The invasion was part of the Soviet–Japanese War, a minor campaign in the Asian theatre during World War II.

Šrilanška državljanska vojna je bila oborožen spopad na Šrilanki od leta 1983 do 2009. Od 23. julija 1983 so Osvobodilni tigri tamilskega Eelama (LTTE, znani tudi kot tamilski tigri) pod vodstvom Velupilaja Prabhakarana s presledki vodili uporništvo proti vladi. LTTE se je bojeval za neodvisno tamilsko državo Tamil Eelam na severovzhodu otoka kot odgovor na nenehno diskriminacijo in nasilno preganjanje, ki ju je nad šrilanškimi Tamilci izvajala pretežno sinhalska šrilanška vlada.

Nasilno preganjanje je izbruhnilo v protitamilskih pogromih v letih 1956, 1958, 1977, 1981 in 1983 ter v požigu javne knjižnice v Jafni leta 1981. Izvajale so jih sinhalske večinske tolpe, pogosto z državno podporo, v letih po osamosvojitvi Šrilanke od Britanskega imperija leta 1948. Kmalu po osamosvojitvi je bila sinhalščina priznana za edini uradni jezik države. Po 26-letnem vojaškem pohodu je šrilanška vojska maja 2009 porazila tamilske tigre in končala državljansko vojno.

source.title: Sri Lankan civil war
paragraphs: The Sri Lankan civil war was an armed conflict fought in Sri Lanka from 1983 to 2009. Beginning on 23 July 1983, it was an intermittent insurgency against the government by the Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam (LTTE, also known as the Tamil Tigers) led by Velupillai Prabhakaran. The LTTE fought to create an independent Tamil state called Tamil Eelam in the north-east of the island in response to continuous discrimination and violent persecution against Sri Lankan Tamils by the predominantly Sinhalese government of Sri Lanka.

Violent persecution erupted in the form of the 1956, 1958, 1977, 1981 and 1983 anti-Tamil pogroms, as well as the 1981 burning of the Jaffna Public Library. These were carried out by the majority Sinhalese mobs, often with state support, in the years following Sri Lanka's independence from the British Empire in 1948. Shortly after gaining independence, Sinhalese was recognised as the sole official language of the nation. After a 26-year military campaign, the Sri Lankan military defeated the Tamil Tigers in May 2009, bringing the civil war to an end.

Srividžaja, zapisana tudi Sri Vijaya ali Sriwijaya, je bila budistični talasokratski imperij s središčem na otoku Sumatra (v današnji Indoneziji), ki je vplival na velik del Jugovzhodne Azije. Srividžaja je bila od 7. do 11. stoletja pomembno središče širjenja budizma. Bila je prva tvorba, ki je obvladovala velik del zahodne pomorske Jugovzhodne Azije. Njeno gospodarstvo je bilo vse bolj odvisno od cvetoče trgovine v regiji, tako da je postalo gospodarstvo, ki je temeljilo na prestižnem blagu.

Najstarejša omemba sega v 7. stoletje: kitajski menih iz dinastije Tang I Džing je zapisal, da je leta 671 n. št. šest mesecev bival v Srividžaji. Iz 7. stoletja je tudi najstarejši znani napis z imenom Srividžaja, napis iz Kedukan Bukita, najden blizu Palembanga na Sumatri in datiran 16. junija 682. Med koncem 7. in začetkom 11. stoletja se je Srividžaja povzpela v hegemona Jugovzhodne Azije.

source.title: Srivijaya
paragraphs: Srivijaya, also spelled Sri Vijaya or Sriwijaya, was a Buddhist thalassocratic empire based on the island of Sumatra (in modern-day Indonesia) that influenced much of Southeast Asia. Srivijaya was an important centre for the expansion of Buddhism from the 7th to 11th century. Srivijaya was the first polity to dominate much of western Maritime Southeast Asia. Its economy became progressively reliant on the booming trade in the region, thus transforming it into a prestige goods-based economy.

The earliest reference to it dates from the 7th century. A Tang dynasty Chinese monk, Yijing, wrote that he visited Srivijaya for six months in 671 AD. The earliest known inscription in which the name Srivijaya appears also dates from the 7th century in the Kedukan Bukit inscription found near Palembang, Sumatra, dated 16 June 682. Between the late 7th and early 11th century, Srivijaya rose to become a hegemon in Southeast Asia.

Dinastija Suj je bila kitajska cesarska dinastija, ki je vladala od leta 581 do 618. Ponovna združitev osrednje Kitajske pod Suji je končala obdobje severnih in južnih dinastij in z njim dolgo politično razdrobljenost, ki je trajala od vojne osmih princev. Suji so si prizadevali obnoviti državo, ponovno vzpostavili in preoblikovali številne cesarske ustanove ter tako postavili velik del temeljev za poznejšo dinastijo Tang, ki je po strmoglavljenju Sujev vladala novi zlati dobi kitajske zgodovine. Dinastijo Suj pogosto primerjajo z dinastijo Čin (221–206 pr. n. št.): tudi Suji so Kitajsko združili po dolgem obdobju razdrobljenosti, izvedli obsežne reforme in gradnje, da bi utrdili državno oblast, in po kratkem času propadli.
notes: Izpuščen je angleški zapis izgovarjave.

source.title: Sui dynasty
paragraphs: The Sui dynasty ( SWAY) was a Chinese imperial dynasty that ruled from 581 to 618 AD. The re-unification of China proper under the Sui brought the Northern and Southern dynasties era to a close, ending a prolonged period of political division since the War of the Eight Princes. The Sui endeavoured to rebuild the state, re-establishing and reforming many imperial institutions; in so doing, the Sui laid much of the foundation for the subsequent Tang dynasty, which after toppling the Sui would ultimately preside over a new golden age in Chinese history. Often compared to the Qin dynasty (221–206 BC), the Sui likewise unified China after a prolonged period of division, undertook wide-ranging reforms and construction projects to consolidate state power, and collapsed after a brief period.

Sukhothai Kingdom.headline: Kraljestvo Sukhothai
paragraphs: Kraljestvo Sukhothai je bilo postklasično siamsko kraljestvo (mandala) v celinski Jugovzhodni Aziji okoli stare prestolnice Sukhothai na območju današnje severne osrednje Tajske. Ustanovil ga je Si Inthrathit leta 1238, kot samostojna tvorba pa je obstajalo do leta 1438, ko je po smrti Borommapana (Maha Thammaracha IV.) prišlo pod vpliv sosednje Ayutthaye.

Sukhothai je bil sprva trgovsko središče v Lavu, ki je bil sam pod nadoblastjo Kmerskega imperija, ko so se osrednji Tajci pod vodstvom krajevnega voditelja Pho Khun Bang Klang Haa uprli in si izborili neodvisnost. Bang Klang Hao je prevzel vladarsko ime Si Inthrathit in postal prvi monarh dinastije Phra Ruang.

source.title: Sukhothai Kingdom
paragraphs: The Sukhothai Kingdom was a post-classical Siamese kingdom (maṇḍala) in Mainland Southeast Asia surrounding the ancient capital city of Sukhothai in present-day north-central Thailand. The kingdom was founded by Si Inthrathit in 1238 and existed as an independent polity until 1438, when it fell under the influence of the neighboring Ayutthaya after the death of Borommapan (Maha Thammaracha IV).

Sukhothai was originally a trade center in Lavo—itself under the suzerainty of the Khmer Empire—when Central Thai people led by Pho Khun Bang Klang Hao, a local leader, revolted and gained their independence. Bang Klang Hao took the regnal name of Si Inthrathit and became the first monarch of the Phra Ruang dynasty.

Sur Empire.headline: Imperij Sur
paragraphs: Imperij Sur je bil imperij, ki mu je dinastija Sur afganistanskega porekla vladala v severni Indiji skoraj 16 ali 18 let, med letom 1538 oziroma 1540 in letom 1556, s prestolnico v Sasaramu (v današnjem Biharju). Ustanovil ga je Šer Šah Suri.

Dinastija Sur je nadzorovala skoraj vsa tedanja ozemlja Mogulskega cesarstva na Indogangeški nižini, od vzhodnega Beludžistana zahodno od Inda do današnjega Rakhina v Mjanmaru na vzhodu. Čeprav je Šer Šah Suri utrjeval oblast nad severno Indijo, je za sedež moči Surov še vedno veljala vzhodna Indija, kar dokazuje, da je bilo 8 od 16 mest s srebrnimi kovnicami, ki jih je ustanovil Šer Šah, na območju med Čunarjem in Fathabadom.

source.title: Sur Empire
paragraphs: The Sur Empire was an empire ruled by the Afghan-origin Sur dynasty in northern India for nearly 16 or 18 years, between 1538/1540 and 1556, with Sasaram (in modern-day Bihar) serving as its capital. It was founded by Sher Shah Suri.

The Sur dynasty held control of nearly all the then-territories of Mughal Empire along the Indo-Gangetic Plain, from eastern Balochistan in the west of Indus River to modern-day Rakhine, Myanmar in the east. Even as Sher Shah Suri consolidated his power over northern India, eastern India was still considered to be the seat of Sur power, evident by the fact that 8 of the 16 silver mint cities Sher Shah established were in the region between Chunar and Fathabad.

Kraljestvo Surasena (IAST: Śūrasena; sanskrtsko: शूरसेन) je bilo starodavno indijsko območje, ki ustreza današnji pokrajini Bradž v Utar Pradešu, s prestolnico Mathura. Po budističnem besedilu Anguttara Nikaja je bila Surasena v 6. stoletju pr. n. št. ena od šestnajstih mahadžanapad (dobesedno »velikih kraljestev«). Omenja jo tudi hindujski ep Ramajana. Starogrški pisci (denimo Megasten) omenjajo Sourasenoje in njihova mesta Methoro in Kleisobro oziroma Kleisoboro.

source.title: Surasena
paragraphs: The kingdom of Surasena (IAST: Śūrasena, Sanskrit: शूरसेन) was an ancient Indian region corresponding to the present-day Braj region in Uttar Pradesh, with Mathura as its capital city. According to the Buddhist text Anguttara Nikaya, Surasena was one of the sixteen Mahajanapadas (lit. 'great realms') in the 6th century BCE. Also, it is mentioned in the Hindu epic poem Ramayana. The ancient Greek writers (e.g., Megasthenes) refer to the Sourasenoi and its cities, Methora and Cleisobra/Kleisobora.

Swedish invasion of Russia.headline: Švedska invazija na Rusijo
paragraphs: Švedska invazija na Rusijo, znana tudi kot ruski pohod ali poltavski pohod švedskega kralja Karla XII., je potekala od januarja 1708 do julija 1709 med veliko severno vojno. Pohod se je začel 1. januarja 1708, ko je Karel prečkal Vislo, dejansko pa se je končal s švedskim porazom v bitki pri Poltavi 8. julija 1709, ki mu je 11. julija 1709 sledila švedska vdaja pri Perevoločni. Čeprav je Karel pod zaščito Osmanskega cesarstva še več let vojaško ogrožal Rusijo, je bil 18-mesečni pohod prelomnica vse vojne.

source.title: Swedish invasion of Russia
paragraphs: The Swedish invasion of Russia, also known as the Russian campaign, or Poltava campaign of Charles XII of Sweden, was undertaken from January 1708 to July 1709 during the Great Northern War. The campaign began with Charles's crossing of the Vistula on 1 January 1708, and effectively ended with the Swedish defeat in the Battle of Poltava on 8 July 1709, after which the Swedish surrender at Perevolochna occurred on 11 July 1709. Though Charles continued to pose a military threat to Russia for several years while under the protection of the Ottoman Empire, the 18-month campaign was a turning point in the overall war.

Tadžikistanska državljanska vojna je bila oborožen spopad v Tadžikistanu, ki se je začel maja 1992 in končal junija 1997. Regionalne skupine iz tadžikistanskih pokrajin Garm in Gorski Badahšan so se uprle novi vladi predsednika Rahmona Nabijeva, v kateri so prevladovali ljudje iz pokrajin Hudžand in Kulob. Uporniške skupine so vodili liberalno-demokratični reformatorji in islamisti, ki so se pozneje združili v Združeno tadžikistansko opozicijo. Vlado so podpirali ruska vojska in mejni stražarji.

source.title: Tajikistani Civil War
paragraphs: The Tajikistani Civil War was an armed conflict in Tajikistan that began in May 1992 and ended in June 1997. Regional groups from the Garm and Gorno-Badakhshan regions of Tajikistan rose up against the newly formed government of President Rahmon Nabiyev, which was dominated by people from the Khujand and Kulob regions. The rebel groups were led by a combination of liberal democratic reformers and Islamists, who would later organize under the banner of the United Tajik Opposition. The government was supported by Russian military and border guards.

Talibansko uporništvo se je začelo, potem ko je skupina med vojno v Afganistanu leta 2001 izgubila oblast. Talibanske sile so se bojevale proti afganistanski vladi pod vodstvom predsednika Hamida Karzaja, pozneje predsednika Ašrafa Ganija, in proti koaliciji pod vodstvom Združenih držav, v kateri so bile vse članice Nata; talibanska ofenziva leta 2021 je povzročila zlom vlade Ašrafa Ganija. Pakistan je talibanom dajal finančno in vojaško pomoč.

Uporništvo se je deloma razširilo čez mejo v sosednji Pakistan, zlasti v Hajber Pahtunhvo. Talibani so se bojevali proti afganistanskim narodnim varnostnim silam in njihovim Natovim zaveznikom ter napadali civilne cilje. Države v regiji, zlasti Pakistan, Iran, Kitajsko in Rusijo, so pogosto obtoževali, da financirajo in podpirajo uporniške skupine.
Del talibanskega uporništva so bili tudi zavezniška mreža Hakani, Hezb-e Islami Gulbudin (do leta 2016) in manjše skupine Al Kaide.

source.title: Taliban insurgency
paragraphs: The Taliban insurgency began after the group's fall from power during the 2001 war in Afghanistan. The Taliban forces fought against the Afghan government, led by President Hamid Karzai, and later by President Ashraf Ghani, and against a United States-led coalition of forces that has included all members of NATO; the 2021 Taliban offensive resulted in the collapse of the government of Ashraf Ghani. Pakistan extended financial and military aid to the Taliban.

The insurgency had spread to some degree over the border to neighboring Pakistan, in particular Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. The Taliban conducted warfare against Afghan National Security Forces and their NATO allies, as well as against civilian targets. Regional countries, particularly Pakistan, Iran, China and Russia, were often accused of funding and supporting the insurgent groups.
The allied Haqqani Network, Hezb-e Islami Gulbuddin (until 2016), and smaller al-Qaeda groups had also been part of the Taliban insurgency.

Talpur dynasty.headline: Dinastija Talpur
paragraphs: Dinastija Talpur, v domačem jeziku imenovana Čaujari (sindško: چؤياري), je bila sindška dinastija s šiitskim islamom kot uradno vero, ki jo je leta 1783 ustanovil Mir Fateh Ali kan, potem ko je v bitki pri Halaniju strmoglavil dinastijo Kalhora; pred tem je Mian Sarfaraz Kalhora ukazal usmrtiti talpurskega voditelja Mir Bahrama kana in njegovega sina Mir Sobdarja kana. Pod talpursko vladavino je bil Sind razdeljen na več polavtonomnih držav, med njimi Hajderabad, Khairpur, Mirpur Khas in Tando Muhammad Khan, dinastija pa je vladala s sistemom razdeljene oblasti med različne veje rodbine. Talpursko obdobje je bilo pomembna faza v arhitekturni zgodovini Sinda: zgradili so trdnjavo Kot Diji in palačo Faiz Mahal ter obnovili zgodovinsko trdnjavo Ranikot, znano tudi kot Sindski zid.
Večino vladavine so bili Talpurji podrejeni Duranskemu imperiju in so mu plačevali davek.

source.title: Talpur dynasty
paragraphs: The Talpur dynasty natively called Chauyari (Sindhi: چؤياري) was a Sindh dynasty that adopted Shia Islam as its official religion established by Mir Fateh Ali Khan in 1783, after he overthrew the Kalhora dynasty in the Battle of Halani following the execution of the Talpur leader Mir Bahram Khan and his son Mir Sobdar Khan ordered by Mian Sarfaraz Kalhora. Under Talpur rule, Sindh was divided into several semi-autonomous states including Hyderabad, Khairpur, Mirpur Khas, and Tando Muhammad Khan, and the dynasty governed through a system of divided authority among different branches of the family. The Talpur period marked an important phase in Sindh’s architectural history, during which Kot Diji Fort and Faiz Mahal were constructed, and the historical Ranikot Fort also known as the Great Wall of Sindh was reconstructed.
For most of their rule, they were subordinate or subject to the Durrani Empire and paid tribute to them.

Tashkent Declaration.headline: Taškentska deklaracija
paragraphs: Taškentsko deklaracijo sta Indija in Pakistan podpisala 10. januarja 1966, da bi razrešila drugo indijsko-pakistansko vojno (1965). Mir so dosegli 23. septembra s posredovanjem Sovjetske zveze in Združenih držav, ki sta sprti državi potisnili k premirju, da bi preprečili zaostritev, v katero bi se lahko vpletle še druge sile.

source.title: Tashkent Declaration
paragraphs: The Tashkent Declaration was signed between India and Pakistan on 10 January 1966 to resolve the Indo-Pakistani War of 1965. Peace was achieved on 23 September through interventions by the Soviet Union and the United States, both of which pushed the two warring countries towards a ceasefire in an attempt to avoid any escalation that could draw in other powers.

Tây Sơn dynasty.headline: Dinastija Tây Sơn
paragraphs: Dinastija Tây Sơn (vietnamsko: Nhà Tây Sơn ali Triều Tây Sơn; chữ Hán: 朝西山; chữ Nôm: 茹西山), uradno Đại Việt (大越), je bila cesarska dinastija Vietnama. Izvira iz upora, ki so ga vodili trije kmečki bratje s priimkom Nguyễn proti dinastiji Lê, gospodom Trịnh in gospodom Nguyễn (s katerimi niso bili v sorodu). Dinastijo Tây Sơn je pozneje nasledila dinastija Nguyễn.
notes: Izpuščena je izgovarjava (IPA).

source.title: Tây Sơn dynasty
paragraphs: The Tây Sơn dynasty (Vietnamese: [təj ʂəːn]; Vietnamese: Nhà Tây Sơn or Triều Tây Sơn; chữ Hán: 朝西山; Chữ Nôm: 茹西山), officially Đại Việt (大越), was an imperial dynasty of Vietnam. It originated in a revolt led by three peasant brothers with the surname Nguyễn, rebelling against the Lê dynasty, Trịnh lords and Nguyễn lords (no relation). The Tây Sơn would later be succeeded by the Nguyễn dynasty.

Telangana Rebellion.headline: Telanganski upor
paragraphs: Telanganski upor v letih 1946–1951 je bil kmečka vstaja pod komunističnim vodstvom proti kneževski državi Hajderabad v pokrajini Telangana, ki je prerasla iz nemirov v letih 1944–1946.

Hajderabad je bil fevdalna monarhija, v kateri je bila v Telangani večina zemlje v rokah zemljiških aristokratov, imenovanih »durre« ali »dore«. Fevdalno izkoriščanje je bilo v regiji hujše kot drugod v Indiji; durre so imeli nad kmeti popolno oblast in so jih lahko podvrgli kmetijskemu suženjstvu. Razmere so se v 1930. letih poslabšale zaradi velike gospodarske krize in prehoda na tržne kulture. V 1940. letih so se kmetje začeli obračati h komunizmu, se organizirali v Andhra Mahasabhi in začeli gibanje za pravice. Gibanje, ki ga je pospešila prehranska kriza po koncu druge svetovne vojne, je preraslo v upor, ko sta ga uprava in durre poskušali zatreti.

source.title: Telangana Rebellion
paragraphs: The Telangana Rebellion of 1946–1951 was a communist-led insurrection of peasants against the princely state of Hyderabad in the region of Telangana that escalated out of agitations in 1944–1946.

Hyderabad was a feudal monarchy where most of the land was concentrated in the hands of landed aristocrats known as "Durras" or "Doras" in Telangana. Feudal exploitation in the region was more severe compared to others of India; the Durras had complete power over the peasants and could subject them to agricultural slavery. Conditions worsened during the 1930s due to the Great Depression and a transition towards commercial crops. In the 1940s, the peasants started turning towards communism, organised themselves through the Andhra Mahasabha and began a rights movement. Catalysed by a food crisis that affected the region following the end of the Second World War, the movement escalated into a rebellion after the administration and the durras attempted to suppress it.

Tet Offensive.headline: Ofenziva Tet
paragraphs: Ofenziva Tet je bila velika zaostritev vietnamske vojne in eden največjih vojaških pohodov v njej. Severnovietnamska Vietnamska ljudska armada (PAVN) in Vietkong (VC) sta 30. in 31. januarja 1968 izvedla presenetljiv napad na sile južnovietnamske Vojske Republike Vietnam (ARVN), oboroženih sil Združenih držav in njihovih zaveznikov ter na vojaška in civilna poveljniška središča po vsem Južnem Vietnamu. Ime je skrajšana oblika vietnamskega imena praznika lunarnega novega leta, Tết Nguyên Đán, ko je bila večina pripadnikov ARVN na dopustu. Severnovietnamski politbiro in voditelj Lê Duẩn sta hotela povzročiti politično nestabilnost in sta upala, da bodo množični oboroženi napadi na mesta sprožili prebege in vstaje.

source.title: Tet Offensive
paragraphs: The Tet Offensive was both a major escalation and one of the largest military campaigns of the Vietnam War. The North Vietnamese People's Army of Vietnam (PAVN) and the Viet Cong (VC) launched a surprise attack on 30 and 31 January 1968 against the forces of the South Vietnamese Army of the Republic of Vietnam (ARVN), the United States Armed Forces and their allies, targeting military and civilian command and control centers throughout South Vietnam. The name is the truncated version of the Lunar New Year festival name in Vietnamese, Tết Nguyên Đán, a holiday period when most ARVN personnel were on leave. The North Vietnamese Politburo and leader Lê Duẩn intended to trigger political instability and hoped that mass armed assaults on urban centers would trigger defections and uprisings.

Tandžavursko marathsko kraljestvo, južnoindijska monarhija pod dinastijo Bhonsle, je od leta 1675 do 1855 vladalo delti reke Kaveri. Ustanovil ga je marathski general Ekodži I. (Vjankodži Bhosale) s prestolnico v Tandžavurju. Kraljevi dvor je podpiral umetnost in književnost, tandžavurska marathščina pa se je razvila kot narečje upravne elite.

source.title: Thanjavur Maratha kingdom
paragraphs: The Thanjavur Maratha kingdom, ruled by the Bhonsle dynasty, was a South Indian Monarchy that governed the Kaveri delta from 1675 to 1855. It was established by Maratha general Ekoji I (Vyankoji Bhosale), with its capital at Thanjavur. The royal court patronized art and literature, with Thanjavur Marathi developing as the dialect of the administrative elite.

Tandžavurska dinastija Najakov, ki jo je okoli leta 1532 ustanovil Sevapa Najaka, je bila vladarska rodbina, ki je v 16. in 17. stoletju vladala Tandžavurju. Najaki balidžskega teluškega porekla so jih v začetku 16. stoletja vidžajanagarski cesarji imenovali za pokrajinske upravitelje, poleg upraviteljstev s sedežem v Maduraju in Džindžiju. Po zatonu osrednje vidžajanagarske oblasti po letu 1565 so vladali vse bolj samostojno. Znani so postali po obsežnem podpiranju arhitekture in književnosti v tamilščini, teluščini in sanskrtu.

source.title: Thanjavur Nayak kingdom
paragraphs: The Thanjavur Nayak Dynasty, established by Sevappa Nayaka around 1532, was a ruling lineage that governed Thanjavur between 16th and 17th centuries. Hailing from Telugu Balijas ancestry, the Nayaks were initially appointed as provincial governors by the Vijayanagara Emperor in the early 16th century, alongside governorships based at Madurai, and Gingee. They governed with increasing autonomy following the decline of central Vijayanagara authority after 1565. They became known for their extensive architectural and literary patronage in Tamil, Telugu and Sanskrit.

Tretja angleško-afganistanska vojna, znana tudi kot tretja afganistanska vojna, britansko-afganistanska vojna leta 1919, v Afganistanu pa kot osvobodilna vojna, je bila kratka vojna, ki se je začela 3. maja in končala 8. avgusta 1919. Novi emir Afganistanskega emirata Amanulah kan je Britancem napovedal sveto vojno, džihad, v upanju, da bo razglasil popolno neodvisnost in utrdil lastno legitimnost. Amanulahove sile so izkoristile nemire v Indiji in na treh frontah vdrle v Britansko Indijo, da bi zavzele stare afganistanske province zahodno od Inda.

source.title: Third Anglo-Afghan War
paragraphs: The Third Anglo-Afghan War, also known as the Third Afghan War, the British-Afghan War of 1919, and in Afghanistan as the War of Liberation, was a short war which began on 3 May and ended on 8 August 1919. The new Emir of the Emirate of Afghanistan Amanullah Khan declared the holy war of Jihad against the British in the hope to proclaim full independence, as well as to strengthen his own legitimacy. Amanullah's forces invaded British India on three fronts taking advantage of the unrest in India, in an effort to seize the old Afghan provinces west of the Indus River.

Third Anglo-Burmese War.headline: Tretja angleško-burmanska vojna
paragraphs: Tretja angleško-burmanska vojna (burmansko: တတိယအင်္ဂလိပ်–မြန်မာစစ်), znana tudi kot tretja burmanska vojna (7.–29. novembra 1885, posamezni odpor pa je trajal do leta 1887), je bila zadnja od treh vojn med Burmanci in Britanci v 19. stoletju. V njej je neodvisna Burma pod dinastijo Konbaung izgubila suverenost; njena oblast je bila že prej omejena na ozemlje, znano kot Gornja Burma, saj so si Britanci Spodnjo Burmo priključili leta 1853 po drugi angleško-burmanski vojni.

Po vojni je Burma prišla pod oblast Britanske Indije kot ena njenih provinc. Uradna vojna je trajala od 7. do 29. novembra 1885, protibritanske vstaje pa so trajale še desetletje. Od leta 1937 so Britanci Burmo upravljali kot ločeno kolonijo, dokler ni Burma leta 1948 kot republika dobila neodvisnosti.
notes: Izpuščena je latinična transliteracija burmanskega imena.

source.title: Third Anglo-Burmese War
paragraphs: The Third Anglo-Burmese War (Burmese: တတိယအင်္ဂလိပ်–မြန်မာစစ်, romanized: Tatiya Ingaleik–Myanma Sit), also known as the Third Burma War (7–29 November 1885, with sporadic resistance continuing into 1887), was the final of three wars fought in the 19th century between the Burmese and the British. The war saw the loss of sovereignty of an independent Burma under the Konbaung dynasty, whose rule had already been reduced to the territory known as Upper Burma, the region of Lower Burma having been annexed by the British in 1853, following the Second Anglo-Burmese War.

Following the war, Burma came under the rule of the British Raj as one of its provinces. While the official war lasted from 7–29 November 1885, anti-British uprisings would last for another decade. From 1937, the British governed Burma as a separate colony until Burma achieved independence as a republic in 1948.

Tretja angleško-marathska vojna (1817–1819) je bila zadnji in odločilni spopad med britansko Vzhodnoindijsko družbo in Marathskim imperijem. Po vojni je imela družba v rokah večino Indije. Začela se je z vdorom čet Vzhodnoindijske družbe na marathsko ozemlje; čeprav so bili Britanci številčno šibkejši, je bila marathska vojska zdesetkana. Čete je vodil generalni guverner Hastings, podpirala pa jih je vojska pod poveljstvom generala Thomasa Hislopa. Operacije so se začele proti Pindarijem, skupini krajevnih plačancev in Marathov iz osrednje Indije.
notes: Glosarsko ime (Tretja angleško-maratska vojna) je usklajeno z obliko marathski, ki jo uporabljajo drugi povzetki.

source.title: Third Anglo-Maratha War
paragraphs: The Third Anglo-Maratha War (1817–1819) was the final and decisive conflict between the British East India Company and the Maratha Empire. The war left the Company in control of most of India. It began with an invasion of Maratha territory by East India Company troops, and although the British were outnumbered, the Maratha army was decimated. The troops were led by Governor General Hastings, supported by a force under General Thomas Hislop. Operations began against the Pindaris, a band of local mercenaries and Marathas from central India.

Tretja angleško-misorska vojna (1789–1792) je bila vojaški spopad v južni Indiji med Misorskim sultanatom na eni strani ter Vzhodnoindijsko družbo, Marathskim imperijem, Kraljestvom Travankor in hajderabadskim nizamom na drugi. Bila je tretja od štirih angleško-misorskih vojn.

source.title: Third Anglo-Mysore War
paragraphs: The Third Anglo-Mysore War (1789–1792) was a military conflict in Southern India between the Sultanate of Mysore and the East India Company, Maratha Empire, Kingdom of Travancore and the Nizam of Hyderabad. It was the third of four Anglo-Mysore Wars.

Third Battle of Panipat.headline: Tretja bitka pri Panipatu
paragraphs: Tretja bitka pri Panipatu se je 14. januarja 1761 bila med Marathskim imperijem in vdirajočo vojsko Duranskega imperija. Potekala je v mestu Panipat in okolici, približno 97 kilometrov severno od Delhija. Afganistance so podpirali trije ključni zavezniki v Indiji: Nadžib ud-Daula, ki je pridobil podporo rohilskih poglavarjev, deli propadajočega Mogulskega cesarstva in, najdragocenejši, država Oudh pod Šudžo ud-Daulo. Marathsko vojsko je vodil Sadašivrao Bhau, tretji najvišji predstavnik oblasti v Marathski konfederaciji za čatrapatijem in pešvo. Glavnina marathske vojske je bila s pešvo nameščena na Dekanski planoti.
notes: Izpuščena je pretvorba v milje.

source.title: Third Battle of Panipat
paragraphs: The Third Battle of Panipat took place on 14 January 1761 between the Maratha Empire and the invading army of the Durrani Empire. The battle took place in and around the city of Panipat, approximately 97 kilometres (60 mi) north of Delhi. The Afghans were supported by three key allies in India: Najib-ud-Daula who persuaded the support of the Rohilla chiefs, elements of the declining Mughal Empire, and most prized the Oudh State under Shuja-ud-Daula. The Maratha army was led by Sadashivrao Bhau, who was third-highest authority of the Maratha Confederacy after the Chhatrapati and the Peshwa. The bulk of the Maratha army was stationed in the Deccan Plateau with the Peshwa.

Kraljestvo Tonburi je bilo pomembno siamsko kraljestvo v Jugovzhodni Aziji, ki je od leta 1767 do 1782 obstajalo s središčem v mestu Thonburi v Siamu, današnji Tajski. Ustanovil ga je Taksin, ki je Siam znova združil po propadu Kraljestva Ayutthaya, po katerem je država razpadla na pet sprtih regionalnih držav. Kraljestvo Tonburi je hitro znova združilo Siam in ga obnovilo kot vodilno vojaško silo v celinski Jugovzhodni Aziji; država je dosegla največji obseg dotlej in v siamsko vplivno območje vključila Lan Na, laoška kraljestva (Luang Prabang, Vientiane, Champasak) in Kambodžo.

V času Kraljestva Tonburi se je utrdila in še naprej rasla trgovina s čingovsko Kitajsko, ki se je nadaljevala iz poznega obdobja Ayutthaye (1688–1767), povečal pa se je tudi vpliv kitajske skupnosti v Siamu, saj so bili Taksin in poznejši monarhi s kitajsko-siamsko skupnostjo tesno povezani, tudi sorodstveno.

source.title: Thonburi Kingdom
paragraphs: The Thonburi Kingdom was a major Siamese kingdom which existed in Southeast Asia from 1767 to 1782, centred on the city of Thonburi, in Siam or present-day Thailand. The kingdom was founded by Taksin, who reunited Siam following the collapse of the Ayutthaya Kingdom, which saw the country separate into five warring regional states. The Thonburi Kingdom oversaw the rapid reunification and reestablishment of Siam as a preeminient military power within mainland Southeast Asia, overseeing the country's expansion to its greatest territorial extent up to that point in its history, incorporating Lan Na, the Laotian kingdoms (Luang Phrabang, Vientiane, Champasak), and Cambodia under the Siamese sphere of influence.

The Thonburi Kingdom saw the consolidation and continued growth of Chinese trade from Qing China, a continuation from the late Ayutthaya period (1688-1767), and the increased influence of the Chinese community in Siam, with Taksin and later monarchs sharing close connections and close family ties with the Sino-Siamese community.

Tibetanski imperij (tibetansko: བོད་ཆེན་པོ, dobesedno »Veliki Tibet«) je imel središče na Tibetanski planoti in je nastal v 7. stoletju z osvajanji pod Songcenom Gampom, 33. kraljem dinastije Jarlung. Še bolj se je razširil pod Trisongom Decenom, največji obseg pa je dosegel pod Tricugom Decenom, ko je segal na vzhodu do Čang'ana, na zahodu čez današnji Afganistan, na jugu pa v današnjo Indijo in do Bengalskega zaliva. Kitajski viri ga imenujejo Tufan ali Tubo (吐蕃).
notes: Izpuščena je transliteracija po Wylieju.

source.title: Tibetan Empire
paragraphs: The Tibetan Empire (Tibetan: བོད་ཆེན་པོ, Wylie: bod chen po, lit. 'Great Tibet') was centered on the Tibetan Plateau and formed as a result of expansions under the Yarlung dynasty's 33rd king, Songtsen Gampo, in the 7th century. It expanded further under Trisong Detsen and reached its greatest extent under Tritsuk Detsen, stretching east to Chang'an, west beyond modern Afghanistan, south into modern India and the Bay of Bengal. It is referred to as Tufan or Tubo (吐蕃) in Chinese sources.

Tibetanci (tibetansko: བོད་པ་) so vzhodnoazijska etnična skupina, doma v Tibetu. Njihovo število sedanje ocene postavljajo na približno 7,7 milijona. Večina živi v Tibetanski avtonomni pokrajini na Kitajskem, precej Tibetancev pa živi tudi v kitajskih provincah Gansu, Čingaj, Sečuan in Junan ter v Indiji, Nepalu in Butanu.

Tibetski jeziki so veja tibetsko-burmanske jezikovne družine. Po tradicionalni oziroma mitološki razlagi izvora so Tibetanci potomci človeka Pha Trelgen Čangčup Sempa in skalne velikanke Ma Drag Sinmo. Večina govorcev tibetsko-burmanskih jezikov na jugozahodu Kitajske, tudi Tibetanci, naj bi bila neposredni potomci starodavnega ljudstva Čjang.
notes: Izpuščena sta zapisa po Wylieju in THL.

source.title: Tibetans
paragraphs: Tibetans (Tibetan: བོད་པ་, Wylie: bod pa, THL: bö pa) are an East Asian ethnic group native to Tibet. Their current population is estimated to be around 7.7 million. In addition to the majority living in the Tibet Autonomous Region of China, significant numbers of Tibetans live in the Chinese provinces of Gansu, Qinghai, Sichuan, and Yunnan, as well as in India, Nepal, and Bhutan.

The Tibetic languages are a branch of the Tibeto-Burman language family. The traditional or mythological explanation of the Tibetan people's origin is that they are the descendants of the human Pha Trelgen Changchup Sempa and rock ogress Ma Drag Sinmo. Most Tibeto-Burman speakers in southwest China, including Tibetans, are thought to be direct descendants of the ancient Qiang people.

Treaty of Aigun.headline: Ajgunska pogodba
paragraphs: Ajgunska pogodba je bila pogodba med Ruskim imperijem in kitajsko dinastijo Čing iz leta 1858. V imenu Činga jo je podpisal čingovski uradnik Jišan. Določila je velik del današnje meje med ruskim Daljnim vzhodom in Kitajsko, saj je Kitajska z njo odstopila velik del Mandžurije (pradomovine Mandžurov), danes znane kot Severovzhodna Kitajska. Pogajanja so se začela, ko je generalni guverner Daljnega vzhoda Nikolaj Muravjov Kitajski zagrozil z vojno na drugi fronti, medtem ko je ta zatirala tajpinški upor. Pogodba je razveljavila mir v Nerčinsku (1689), saj je ozemlje med gorovjem Stanovoj in reko Amur prenesla z dinastije Čing na Ruski imperij. Rusija je dobila več kot 600.000 kvadratnih kilometrov ozemlja, ki so ga začeli imenovati Zunanja Mandžurija. Čingovska vlada sprva ni hotela priznati veljavnosti pogodbe, vendar so ruske pridobitve iz Ajgunske pogodbe potrdili s kitajsko-rusko pekinško konvencijo leta 1860.
notes: Izpuščena je pretvorba v kvadratne milje.

source.title: Treaty of Aigun
paragraphs: The Treaty of Aigun was an 1858 treaty between the Russian Empire and Qing dynasty of China. Yishan, official of the Qing, signed it on behalf of the Qing. It established much of the modern border between the Russian Far East and China by ceding much of Manchuria (the ancestral homeland of the Manchu people), now known as Northeast China. Negotiations began after China was threatened with war on a second front by Governor-General of the Far East Nikolay Muraviev when China was suppressing the Taiping Rebellion. It reversed the Treaty of Nerchinsk (1689) by transferring the land between the Stanovoy Range and the Amur River from the Qing dynasty to the Russian Empire. Russia received over 600,000 square kilometers (231,660 sq mi) of what became known as Outer Manchuria. While the Qing government initially refused to recognize the validity of the treaty, the Russian gains under the Treaty of Aigun were affirmed as part of the 1860 Sino-Russian Convention of Peking.

Treaty of Allahabad.headline: Alahabadska pogodba
paragraphs: Alahabadsko pogodbo sta 16. avgusta 1765 po bitki pri Buksarju 22. oktobra 1764 podpisala mogulski cesar Šah Alam II., sin pokojnega cesarja Alamgirja II., in Robert Clive iz Vzhodnoindijske družbe. Pogodbo je na roko napisal I'tisam-ud-Din, bengalski muslimanski pisar in diplomat v službi Mogulskega cesarstva.

source.title: Treaty of Allahabad
paragraphs: The Treaty of Allahabad was signed on 16 August 1765, between the Mughal Emperor Shah Alam II, son of the late Emperor Alamgir II, and Robert Clive, of the East India Company, in the aftermath of the Battle of Buxar of 22 October 1764. The treaty was handwritten by I'tisam-ud-Din, a Bengali Muslim scribe and diplomat to the Mughal Empire.

Treaty of Gandamak.headline: Mir v Gandamaku
paragraphs: Mir v Gandamaku je uradno končal prvo fazo druge angleško-afganistanske vojne. Afganistanski emir Mohamed Jakub kan je Britanski Indiji odstopil več obmejnih območij in nadzor nad afganistanskimi zunanjimi zadevami.

Podpisala sta ga 26. maja 1879 afganistanski kralj Mohamed Jakub kan in sir Louis Cavagnari iz britanske vlade Indije v britanskem vojaškem taboru pri vasi Gandamak, približno 110 km vzhodno od Kabula. Podkralj Indije lord Edward Robert Bulwer-Lytton ga je ratificiral 30. maja 1879.

Večina zgodovinskih del mir v Gandamaku šteje za uvod v drugo fazo druge angleško-afganistanske vojne v letih 1879–1880. Po britanski zmagi v bitki pri Kandaharju leta 1880 so pogodbo znova potrdili, Britanci pa so za afganistanskega emirja postavili Abdur Rahmana, britanskega nasprotnika. Abdur Rahman je med vladavino Britancem nenehno nasprotoval in jih prisilil, da so popustili in ga podpirali v zunanji politiki in notranji vladavini.
notes: Izpuščena je navedba v miljah.

source.title: Treaty of Gandamak
paragraphs: The Treaty of Gandamak officially ended the first phase of the Second Anglo-Afghan War. The Afghan emir Mohammad Yaqub Khan ceded various frontier areas as well as Afghanistan's control of its foreign affairs to the British Raj.

It was signed on 26 May 1879 by King Mohammad Yaqub Khan of Afghanistan and Sir Louis Cavagnari of the British Government of India at a British army camp near the village of Gandamak, about 70 miles (110 km) east of Kabul. The treaty was ratified by Lord Edward Robert Bulwer-Lytton, Viceroy of India, on 30 May 1879.

Most historical writings consider the Treaty of Gandamak as the prelude to the second phase of the Second Anglo-Afghan War, 1879–1880. As result of the British victory at the Battle of Kandahar in 1880 the treaty was reaffirmed and the British appointed Abdur Rahman, a British opponent, as Emir of Afghanistan. Later during Abdur Rahman's reign, he constantly opposed the British and forced them to concede and support him in his foreign policy and internal rule.

Treaty of Huế (1883).headline: Pogodba iz Huếja (1883)
paragraphs: Pogodba iz Huếja (vietnamsko: Hòa ước Harmand, Hòa ước Quý Mùi), sklenjena 25. avgusta 1883 med Vietnamom (dinastijo Nguyễn) in Francijo, je priznala francoski protektorat nad Vietnamom, razdeljenim na Annam in Tonkin. Vietnamcem jo je narekoval francoski upravitelj François-Jules Harmand po tem, ko je francoska vojska zavzela utrdbe Thuận An, zato jo pogosto imenujejo »Harmandova pogodba«. V francoskih diplomatskih krogih so jo imeli za prestrogo, zato je Francija nikoli ni ratificirala, 6. junija 1884 pa jo je nadomestil nekoliko milejši »Patenôtrov sporazum« ali »pogodba o protektoratu«, ki je bil podlaga francoske vladavine v Vietnamu do elizejskih sporazumov, ki sta jih leta 1949 podpisala Francija in cesar Bảo Đại.

source.title: Treaty of Huế (1883)
paragraphs: The Treaty of Huế, (Vietnamese: Hòa ước Harmand, Hòa ước Quý Mùi) concluded on 25 August 1883 between Vietnam (Nguyễn dynasty) and France, recognising a French protectorate over Vietnam being divided into Annam and Tonkin. Dictated to the Vietnamese by the French administrator François-Jules Harmand in the wake of the French military seizure of the Thuận An forts, the treaty is often known as the 'Harmand Treaty'. Considered overly harsh in French diplomatic circles, the treaty was never ratified in France, and was replaced on 6 June 1884 with the slightly milder 'Patenôtre Accords' or 'Treaty of Protectorate', which formed the basis for French rule in Vietnam until the 1949 Élysée Accords signed between France and emperor Bảo Đại.

Treaty of Huế (1884).headline: Pogodba iz Huếja (1884)
paragraphs: Pogodba iz Huếja ali pogodba o protektoratu (vietnamsko: Hòa ước Giáp Thân 1884, Hòa ước Patenotre ali Hòa ước Patơnốt) je bila sklenjena 6. junija 1884 med Francijo in Đại Namom (Vietnamom oziroma dinastijo Nguyễn). Povzela je glavna določila kaznovalne Harmandove pogodbe s 25. avgusta 1883, vendar je omilila nekatera njena strožja določila. Pogodba je ustanovila protektorata Annam (osrednji Vietnam) in Tonkin (severni Vietnam). Bila je podlaga francoske kolonialne vladavine v Vietnamu naslednjih sedem desetletij, izpogajal pa jo je Jules Patenôtre, francoski minister na Kitajskem, zato jo pogosto imenujejo Patenôtrova pogodba. Na vietnamski strani sta jo podpisala Phạm Thận Duật in Tôn Thất Phan, predstavnika dvora cesarja Tự Đứca. S pogodbo je dinastija Nguyễn drugič sprejela francoski protektorat nad osrednjim in severnim Vietnamom, razveljavili pa so jo s podpisom elizejskih sporazumov 8. marca 1949.

source.title: Treaty of Huế (1884)
paragraphs: The Treaty of Huế or Protectorate Treaty (Vietnamese: Hòa ước Giáp Thân 1884, or Hòa ước Patenotre, or Hòa ước Patơnốt) was concluded on 6 June 1884 between France and Đại Nam (Vietnam/Nguyễn dynasty). It restated the main tenets of the punitive Harmand Treaty of 25 August 1883, but softened some of the harsher provisions of this treaty. The treaty created the protectorates of Annam (central Vietnam) and Tonkin (northern Vietnam). It formed the basis of French colonial rule in Vietnam during the next seven decades and was negotiated by Jules Patenôtre, France's minister to China; it is often known as the Patenôtre Treaty. The treaty was signed on the Vietnamese side by Phạm Thận Duật and Tôn Thất Phan, representatives of the emperor Tự Đức’s court. The treaty marked the Nguyễn dynasty's second acceptance of French protectorate in central and northern Vietnam, but it was canceled when the Élysée Accords was signed on 8 March 1949.

Treaty of Kyakhta (1727).headline: Kjahtinska pogodba (1727)
paragraphs: Kjahtinska pogodba (tudi Kiakhta) je skupaj z mirom v Nerčinsku (1689) do sredine 19. stoletja urejala odnose med carsko Rusijo in čingovskim cesarstvom Kitajske. Podpisala sta jo Tulišen in grof Sava Lukič Raguzinski-Vladislavič 23. avgusta 1727 v obmejnem mestu Kjahta.

source.title: Treaty of Kyakhta (1727)
paragraphs: The Treaty of Kyakhta (or Kiakhta), along with the Treaty of Nerchinsk (1689), regulated the relations between Imperial Russia and the Qing Empire of China until the mid-19th century. It was signed by Tulišen and Count Sava Lukich Raguzinskii-Vladislavich at the border city of Kyakhta on 23 August 1727.

Treaty of Kyakhta (1915).headline: Kjahtinska pogodba (1915)
paragraphs: Kjahtinska pogodba (mongolsko: Хиагтын гэрээ; rusko: Кяхтинский договор; kitajsko: 中俄蒙協約) je bila tristranska pogodba, ki so jo 25. maja 1915 podpisale Rusija, Mongolija in Kitajska.

Rusija in Kitajska sta priznali avtonomijo Zunanje Mongolije (kot dela kitajskega ozemlja), Mongolija je priznala kitajsko suzerenost, z drugimi državami pa ni smela sklepati mednarodnih pogodb o političnih in ozemeljskih vprašanjih.

Mongolski predstavnik, predsednik vlade Tögs-Očirijn Namnansüren, je bil odločen avtonomijo razširiti v dejansko neodvisnost in Kitajcem priznati le nejasna, neučinkovita suzerenska pooblastila. Kitajci so si prizadevali mongolsko avtonomijo čim bolj omejiti, če ne celo odpraviti.

source.title: Treaty of Kyakhta (1915)
paragraphs: The Treaty of Kyakhta (Mongolian: Хиагтын гэрээ; Russian: Кяхтинский договор; Chinese: 中俄蒙協約) was a tri-party treaty signed on 25 May 1915 among Russia, Mongolia, and China.

Russia and China recognized Outer Mongolia's autonomy (as part of Chinese territory); Mongolia recognized China's suzerainty; Mongolia could not conclude international treaties with foreign countries regarding political and territorial questions.

The Mongolian representative, Prime Minister Tögs-Ochiryn Namnansüren, was determined to stretch autonomy into de facto independence, and to deny the Chinese anything more than vague, ineffectual suzerain powers. The Chinese sought to minimize, if not to end, Mongolian autonomy.

Treaty of Nerchinsk.headline: Mir v Nerčinsku
paragraphs: Mir v Nerčinsku je bil mirovni sporazum med Ruskim carstvom in dinastijo Čing, sklenjen po ruskem porazu pri obleganju Albazina. Podpisala sta ga 27. avgusta 1689 Songgotu v imenu cesarja Kangšija in Fjodor Golovin v imenu ruskih carjev Petra I. in Ivana V.; to je bila prva uradna pogodba, ki jo je Kitajska kdaj sklenila z zahodno silo. Da bi se izognili težavam s prevodi in napačnim razlagam, so veljavno različico napisali v latinščini, drugotna prevoda pa v ruščini in mandžurščini. Uradnega kitajskega besedila še dve stoletji ni bilo, so pa mejnike popisali v kitajščini, mandžurščini, ruščini in latinščini.

source.title: Treaty of Nerchinsk
paragraphs: The Treaty of Nerchinsk was a peace treaty signed between the Tsardom of Russia and the Qing dynasty following Russia's defeat at the Siege of Albazin. Signed on 27 August 1689 by Songgotu on behalf of the Kangxi Emperor and Fyodor Golovin for Russian Tsars Peter I and Ivan V, it was the first formal treaty China ever signed with a Western power. To bypass translation issues and avoid misinterpretation, the authoritative version was written in Latin, with secondary translations made into Russian and Manchu. While no official Chinese text existed for another two centuries, physical border markers were inscribed in Chinese, Manchu, Russian, and Latin.

Treaty of Saigon (1862).headline: Mir v Saigonu (1862)
paragraphs: Mir v Saigonu (francosko: Traité de Saïgon; vietnamsko: Hòa ước Nhâm Tuất, po letu »vodnega psa« v šestdesetletnem ciklu) so 5. junija 1862 podpisali predstavniki kolonialnih sil Francije in Španije ter zadnji predkolonialni cesar dinastije Nguyễn Tự Đức po invaziji koalicije med kampanjo v Kočinčini. Podpisniki so bili Louis Adolphe Bonard (Francija), Carlos Palanca Gutiérrez (Španija) in Phan Thanh Giản (Vietnam). Po določilih sporazuma je Tự Đức Francozom odstopil Saigon, otok Poulo Condor in tri južne province poznejše Kočinčine (Bien Hoa, Gia Dinh in Dinh Tuong). Pogodbo je potrdila pogodba iz Huếja, podpisana 14. aprila 1863.

source.title: Treaty of Saigon (1862)
paragraphs: The Treaty of Saigon (French: Traité de Saïgon, Vietnamese: Hòa ước Nhâm Tuất, referring to the year of "Water Dog" in the sexagenary cycle) was signed on 5 June 1862 between representatives of the colonial powers, France and Spain, and the last precolonial emperor of the Nguyễn dynasty, Emperor Tự Đức after the coalition's invasion during the Cochinchina campaign. The signatories were Louis Adolphe Bonard (France), Carlos Palanca Gutiérrez (Spain) and Phan Thanh Giản (Vietnam). Based on the terms of the accord, Tự Đức ceded Saigon, the island of Poulo Condor and three southern provinces of what was to become known as Cochinchina (Bien Hoa, Gia Dinh, and Dinh Tuong) to the French. The treaty was confirmed by the Treaty of Huế signed on 14 April 1863.

Treaty of Salbai.headline: Mir v Salbaiju
paragraphs: Mir v Salbaiju so 17. maja 1782 po dolgih pogajanjih o izidu prve angleško-marathske vojne podpisali predstavniki Marathske konfederacije in britanske Vzhodnoindijske družbe; podpisan je bil med Warrenom
notes: Povzetek vira se konča sredi stavka (»it was signed between Warren«); prevedeno je, kot stoji.

source.title: Treaty of Salbai
paragraphs: The Treaty of Salbai was signed on 17 May 1782, by representatives of the Maratha Confederacy and the British East India Company after long negotiations to settle the outcome of the First Anglo-Maratha War it was signed between Warren

Treaty of Yandabo.headline: Mir v Jandabu
paragraphs: Mir v Jandabu (burmansko: ရန္တပိုစာချုပ်) je bil mirovni sporazum, s katerim se je končala prva angleško-burmanska vojna. Podpisala sta ga 24. februarja 1826, skoraj dve leti po formalnem izbruhu vojne 5. marca 1824, general sir Archibald Campbell na britanski strani in upravitelj Legainga Maha Min Hla Kjaw Htin na burmanski strani, brez dovoljenja in soglasja kraljestva Ahom, kraljestva Kačari ali drugih ozemelj, ki jih je pogodba zadevala. Ker je bila britanska vojska v vasi Jandabo le 80 km od prestolnice Ava, so morali Burmanci britanske pogoje sprejeti brez razprave.
Po pogodbi so Burmanci privolili, da:
Britancem odstopijo Asam, Manipur, Rakhine (Arakan) in obalo Tanintharji (Tenaserim).
notes: Izpuščeni sta izgovarjava (IPA) in navedba v miljah. Seznam določil se v povzetku konča po prvi točki.

source.title: Treaty of Yandabo
paragraphs: The Treaty of Yandabo (Burmese: ရန္တပိုစာချုပ် [jàɰ̃dəbò sàdʑoʊʔ]) was the peace treaty that ended the First Anglo-Burmese War. The treaty was signed on 24 February 1826, nearly two years after the war formally broke out on 5 March 1824, by General Sir Archibald Campbell on the British side, and the Governor of Legaing Maha Min Hla Kyaw Htin from the Burmese side, without any due permission and consent of the Ahom kingdom, Kachari kingdo, m or the other territories covered in the treaty. With the British army at Yandabo village, only 80 km (50 mi) from the capital Ava, the Burmese were forced to accept the British terms without discussion.
According to the treaty, the Burmese agreed to:
Cede to the British Assam, Manipur, Rakhine (Arakan), and the Tanintharyi (Tenasserim) coast.

Trịnh lords.headline: Gospodje Trịnh
paragraphs: Gospodje Trịnh (vietnamsko: Chúa Trịnh; chữ Hán: 主鄭; 1545–1787), z uradnim naslovom podkralji Trịnh (vietnamsko: Trịnh Vương; chữ Hán: 鄭王), znani tudi kot rodbina Trịnh ali klan Trịnh (Trịnh thị; 鄭氏), so bili fevdalni plemiški klan, ki je vladal Đàng Ngoàiju (znanemu tudi z eksonimom Tonkin) v času obnovljene dinastije Lê. Gospodje Trịnh so bili de iure podrejeni cesarjem dinastije Lê, de facto pa so vladali severnemu Vietnamu.

Klan Trịnh in njegove tekmece, klan Nguyễn, so podložniki imenovali »Chúa« (主, gospod); prvi so nadzorovali severni, drugi južni Vietnam, cesarji pozne dinastije Lê pa so bili vladarji le po imenu. Iz klana Trịnh je izšlo 12 gospodov, ki so obvladovali dvor pozne dinastije Lê in več kot dve stoletji vladali severnemu Vietnamu.

source.title: Trịnh lords
paragraphs: The Trịnh lords (Vietnamese: Chúa Trịnh; Chữ Hán: 主鄭; 1545–1787), formally titled as Viceroy of Trịnh (Vietnamese: Trịnh Vương; chữ Hán: 鄭王), also known as the House of Trịnh or the Trịnh clan (Trịnh thị; 鄭氏), were a feudal noble clan that ruled Đàng Ngoài (known by the exonym Tonkin) during the Revival Lê dynasty. The Trịnh lords were de jure subordinates of the Lê dynasty emperors but were in actuality the de facto rulers of northern Vietnam.

The Trịnh clan and their rivals, the Nguyễn clan, were called "Chúa" (主, Lord) by their subjects and controlled northern and southern Vietnam respectively, leaving the Later Lê emperors as rulers in name only. The Trịnh clan produced 12 lords who dominated the royal court of the Later Lê dynasty and ruled northern Vietnam for more than two centuries.

Tughlaq dynasty.headline: Dinastija Tughlak
paragraphs: Dinastija Tughlak je bila tretja dinastija, ki je vladala Delhijskemu sultanatu na srednjeveški Indijski podcelini. Na oblast je prišla leta 1320, ko je Gazi Malik pod imenom Gijas al-Din Tughluk zasedel prestol v Delhiju, končala pa se je leta 1413.

Dinastija Tughlak je ozemeljski vrhunec dosegla z vojaškimi pohodi Mohameda bin Tughluka med letoma 1330 in 1335. Večini Indijske podceline je vladala do zatona konec 14. stoletja. Po uničujočem Timurjevem vpadu v letih 1398–1399 je zadnjega sultana iz dinastije Tughlak nazadnje odstavil Hizr kan, ki je nato ustanovil dinastijo Sajid.

source.title: Tughlaq dynasty
paragraphs: The Tughlaq dynasty was the third dynasty to rule over the Delhi Sultanate in the medieval Indian subcontinent. The dynasty came to power in 1320 when Ghazi Malik assumed the throne in Delhi under the title of Ghiyath al-Din Tughluq, and ended in 1413.

The Tughlaq dynasty reached its territorial zenith through the military campaigns led by Muhammad bin Tughluq between 1330 and 1335. It ruled most of the Indian subcontinent until its decline in the late 14th-century. After the disastrous invasion of Timur in 1398–99, the last Tughlaq sultan was eventually deposed by Khizr Khan, who went on to establish Sayyid dynasty.

Tulip Revolution.headline: Tulipanova revolucija
paragraphs: Tulipanova revolucija, znana tudi kot prva kirgiška revolucija, je privedla do padca tedanjega kirgiškega predsednika Askarja Akajeva. Revolucija se je začela po parlamentarnih volitvah 27. februarja in 13. marca 2005. Revolucionarji so Akajeva, njegovo družino in privržence obtoževali korupcije in avtoritarnosti. Akajev je pobegnil v Kazahstan in nato v Rusijo. Na kirgiškem veleposlaništvu v Moskvi je 4. aprila 2005 v navzočnosti delegacije kirgiškega parlamenta podpisal odstopno izjavo. Kirgiški začasni parlament je odstop potrdil 11. aprila 2005.

source.title: Tulip Revolution
paragraphs: The Tulip Revolution, also known as the First Kyrgyz Revolution, led to Kyrgyzstan's then-President Askar Akayev's fall from power. The revolution began after parliamentary elections on 27 February and 13 March 2005. The revolutionaries alleged corruption and authoritarianism by Akayev, his family and supporters. Akayev fled to Kazakhstan and then to Russia. On 4 April 2005, at the Kyrgyz embassy in Moscow, Akayev signed his resignation statement in the presence of a Kyrgyz parliamentary delegation. The resignation was ratified by the Kyrgyz interim parliament on 11 April 2005.

Tumed.headline: Tümedi
paragraphs: Tümedi so mongolska podskupina. Živijo predvsem na območju okoli mesta Hohhot, denimo v praporih Levi Tumed in Desni Tumed (v Baotouju) na Kitajskem. Večinoma se ukvarjajo s stalnim poljedelstvom v mešanih skupnostih. Druga skupina Tümedov živi v Čaojangu v provinci Liaoning. Manjše število Tümedov živi v ajmagu Ömnögovi v Mongoliji.

Od začetka 9. do začetka 13. stoletja so Hori-Tümedi živeli ob zahodni strani Bajkalskega jezera, na območju današnje južne Irkutske oblasti, v delih Tuve in na jugozahodu Burjatije. Džingis-kan je leta 1207 po osvojitvi Hori-Tümedov sklenil nekatere od teh skupin preseliti na jug, kjer so se nazadnje naselili v južnih delih velike puščave Gobi.

source.title: Tumed
paragraphs: The Tümed are a Mongol subgroup. Tümed Mongols mainly live in the region around the city of Hohhot, such as Tumed Left Banner and Tumed Right Banner (in Baotou) in China. Most engage in sedentary agriculture in mixed communities. Another Tümed group live in Chaoyang, Liaoning. There are a small number of Tümeds in Ömnögovi Aimag, Mongolia.

From the beginning of the 9th century to the beginning of the 13th century, the Khori-Tumed lived near the western side of Lake Baikal. They lived in what is now southern Irkutsk Oblast, in some parts of Tuva and in southwestern Buryatia. In 1207, Genghis Khan, after conquering the Khori-Tumed, decided to move some of these groups south and these people eventually settled in the southern parts of the Great Gobi Desert.

Turk.headline: Turki
paragraphs: Turk ali Turki se lahko nanaša na:
notes: Zapis je povezan z razločitveno stranjo; seznam pomenov v povzetku ni ohranjen.

source.title: Turk
paragraphs: Turk or Turks may refer to:

Turško-armenska vojna ali turška invazija na Armenijo, v Turčiji znana kot vzhodna fronta (turško: Doğu cephesi) turške vojne za neodvisnost, je bila spopad med novoustanovljeno Prvo republiko Armenijo in turškim nacionalnim gibanjem po podpisu Sevreške mirovne pogodbe leta 1920. Pogodba je Armeniji dodelila velik del vzhodne Anatolije, ki je pripadal Osmanskemu cesarstvu, vključno z mesti Trabzon, Erzurum in Van. Odposlanci osmanske vlade so pogodbo po porazu v prvi svetovni vojni nejevoljno podpisali, poslanci osmanskega parlamenta pa je niso hoteli ratificirati. Pogodba je močno razjezila turške nacionaliste pod vodstvom Mustafe Kemala paše, ki je niso hoteli priznati. Septembra 1920 so ostanki XV. korpusa osmanske vojske pod poveljstvom Kâzıma Karabekirja napadli Zahodno Armenijo z neposrednim ukazom Mustafe Kemala (Atatürka), naj »Armenijo fizično in politično odstranijo«.

source.title: Turkish invasion of Armenia
paragraphs: The Turkish invasion of Armenia, also known as the Turkish–Armenian War and known in Turkey as the Eastern Front (Turkish: Doğu cephesi) of the Turkish War of Independence, was a conflict fought between the recently established First Republic of Armenia and the Turkish National Movement, following the signing of the Treaty of Sèvres in 1920. The treaty transferred vast portions of eastern Anatolia from the Ottoman Empire to Armenia, including the towns of Trabzon, Erzurum and Van. While delegates of the Ottoman government reluctantly signed the treaty following their defeat in World War I, members of the Ottoman parliament refused to ratify it. The treaty greatly angered the Turkish Nationalists, led by Mustafa Kemal Pasha, who refused to recognize it. In September 1920, remnants of the Ottoman Army's XV Corps under the command of Kâzım Karabekir, attacked Western Armenia with direct orders from Mustafa Kemal (Atatürk) to "eliminate Armenia physically and politically".

Umayyad campaigns in India.headline: Omajadski pohodi v Indijo
paragraphs: V prvi polovici 8. stoletja se je na Indijski podcelini zvrstila vrsta bitk med Omajadskim kalifatom in indijskimi kraljestvi vzhodno od Inda, začenši z arabsko osvojitvijo Sinda (današnji Pakistan) v letih 711–713.

Rašidunski kalifat (632–661) je izvedel nekaj vpadov v Indijo, večjega pohoda pa ni bilo. Drugi val vojaškega širjenja Omajadskega kalifata je trajal od leta 692 do 718. V času vladanja al-Valida I. (705–715) so Omajadi v komaj desetih letih dosegli najveličastnejša osvajanja: Arabci so si podredili in osvojili Severno Afriko, Hispanijo, Transoksanijo in Sind. Sind, ki mu je vladal kralj Dahir iz brahmanske dinastije Čač, je zavzel omajadski general Mohamed ibn al-Kasim; postal je provinca kalifata druge ravni (iklim) in primerno oporišče za pohode v Indijo, vendar so po Ibn al-Kasimovem odhodu leta 715 indijski kralji večino njegovih osvojenih ozemelj znova zavzeli.

source.title: Umayyad campaigns in India
