paragraphs: During the first half of the 8th century, a series of battles took place in the Indian subcontinent between the Umayyad Caliphate and Indian kingdoms situated to the east of the Indus River, beginning with the Arab conquest of Sindh (present day Pakistan) during 711–713.

The Rashidun Caliphate (632–661) launched a few raids into India, but no larger campaign took place. The second wave of military expansion of the Umayyad Caliphate lasted from 692 to 718. The reign of Al-Walid I (705–715) saw the most dramatic Umayyad conquests in a period of barely ten years; North Africa, Hispania, Transoxiana, and Sindh were subdued and conquered by the Arabs. Sindh, ruled by King Dahir of the Brahmin Chach dynasty, was captured by the Umayyad general Muhammad ibn al-Qasim, which became a second-level province of the Caliphate (iqlim) and a suitable base for excursions into India, but, after Ibn al-Qasim's departure in 715 most of his captured territories were recaptured by Indian kings.

Utpala dynasty.headline: Dinastija Utpala
paragraphs: Dinastija Utpala je bila srednjeveška kašmirska hindujska dinastija, ki je Kašmirju vladala od 9. do 10. stoletja. Ustanovil jo je Avantivarman leta 855, nadomestila pa je dinastijo Karkota. Nastala je na severu Indijske podceline. Med njeno vladavino so ustanovili mesti Avantipur (Avantipora) in Sujapur (Sopore) ter zgradili številne hindujske templje, posvečene Višnuju in Šivi, in budistične samostane, med katerimi izstopata templja Avantišvara in Avantisvami.

source.title: Utpala dynasty
paragraphs: The Utpala Dynasty was a medieval Kashmiri Hindu dynasty that ruled over Kashmir from the 9th to 10th centuries. Founded by Avantivarman in 855, it replaced the Karkota dynasty. It came into existence in the northern region of the Indian subcontinent. The cities of Avantipur (Awantipora) and Suyapur (Sopore) were founded during the reign, and many Hindu temples dedicated to both Vishnu and Shiva, and Buddhist monasteries were built, notable of which is the Avantiswara and Avantiswami temples.

Vadžika (palijsko: Vajjika) ali Vridžika (IAST: Vṛjika), zveza, konfederacija ali sangha, imenovana tudi preprosto Vadži (palijsko: Vajji) ali Vridži (IAST: Vṛji), je bila starodavna indoarijska plemenska zveza, ki je obstajala v pozni železni dobi na severovzhodu Indije.

source.title: Vajjika League
paragraphs: The Vajjika (Pāli: Vajjika) or Vrijika (IAST: Vṛjika) League, Confederacy, or Sangha, also called simply Vajji (Pāli: Vajji) or Vriji (IAST: Vṛji), was an ancient Indo-Aryan tribal league which existed during the later Iron Age period in north-east India.

Vakataka dynasty.headline: Dinastija Vakataka
paragraphs: Dinastija Vakataka (IAST: Vākāṭaka) je bila starodavna indijska dinastija, ki je nastala v Dekanu sredi 3. stoletja n. št. Njena država je po domnevah segala od južnih robov Malve in Gudžarata na severu do reke Tungabhadra na jugu ter od Arabskega morja na zahodu do robov Čatisgarha na vzhodu. Vakatake so bili najpomembnejši nasledniki Satavahan v Dekanu in sodobniki Gupt v severni Indiji.

source.title: Vakataka dynasty
paragraphs: The Vakataka dynasty (IAST: Vākāṭaka) was an ancient Indian dynasty that originated from the Deccan in the mid-3rd century CE. Their state is believed to have extended from the southern edges of Malwa and Gujarat in the north to the Tungabhadra River in the south as well as from the Arabian Sea in the west to the edges of Chhattisgarh in the east. They were the most important successors of the Satavahanas in the Deccan and contemporaneous with the Guptas in northern India.

Vatsa.headline: Vatsa
paragraphs: Vatsa ali Vamsa (palijsko in ardhamagadhijsko: Vaccha, dobesedno »tele«) je bila ena od šestnajstih mahadžanapad (velikih kraljestev) Utarapathe v stari Indiji, ki jih omenja Anguttara Nikaja.
notes: Izpuščena je izgovarjava (IPA).

source.title: Vatsa
paragraphs: Vatsa or Vamsa (IPA: [ʋɐt̪sɐ], Pali and Ardhamagadhi: Vaccha, IPA: [ʋɐtːʃʰɐ], literally "calf") was one of the sixteen Mahajanapadas (great kingdoms) of Uttarapatha of ancient India mentioned in the Aṅguttara Nikāya.

Vidžajanagarski imperij, znan tudi kot Karnatski imperij, je bil poznosrednjeveški hindujski imperij, ki je vladal velikemu delu južne Indije. Leta 1336 sta ga ustanovila brata Harihara I. in Bukka Raja I. iz dinastije Sangama.

Imperij se je povzpel po pretresih, ki so jih v začetku 14. stoletja povzročili vpadi Delhijskega sultanata v Dekan. Na ozemeljskem vrhuncu pod Krišnadevarajo (vladal 1509–1529) je prevladoval na vsem polotoku, dekanske sultanate je potisnil severno od dvorečja Tungabhadre in Krišne ter si priključil obalna ozemlja Gadžapatijev do reke Krišne. Na največjem obsegu je obsegal današnjo Karnatako, Andhra Pradeš, Tamil Nadu, Goo, južno Keralo ter dele Telangane in južne Maharaštre.

source.title: Vijayanagara Empire
paragraphs: The Vijayanagara Empire, also known as the Karnāta Empire, was a late medieval Hindu empire that ruled much of Southern India. It was established in 1336 by the brothers Harihara I and Bukka Raya I of the Sangama dynasty.

The empire rose to prominence following the disruption caused by the Delhi Sultanate incursions into the Deccan during the early 14th century. At its territorial peak under Krishnadevaraya (r. 1509–1529), it held primacy across the peninsula, pushing the Deccan sultanates north of the Tungabhadra–Krishna doab and annexing coastal Gajapati territories up to the Krishna River. At its greatest extent, its domain encompassed moddern Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh, Tamil Nadu, Goa, southern Kerala and some parts of Telangana and southern Maharashtra.

Vojna v Afganistanu je bila dolgotrajen oborožen spopad od leta 2001 do 2021. Začela se je z invazijo koalicije pod vodstvom Združenih držav z imenom operacija Trajna svoboda kot odgovor na napade 11. septembra (9/11), ki jih je izvedla s talibani povezana Al Kaida s sedežem v Afganistanu. Sile pod ameriškim vodstvom, ki so podpirale protitalibansko Severno zavezništvo, so talibane pregnale iz večjih mest in s tem strmoglavile talibanski Islamski emirat. Leta 2004 je bila ustanovljena Islamska republika, ki so jo podpirale ZDA, vendar so se talibani pod vodstvom ustanovitelja mule Omarja tedaj že reorganizirali in začeli uporništvo proti afganistanski vladi in koalicijskim silam. Spopad se je končal, ko je talibanska ofenziva leta 2021 znova vzpostavila Islamski emirat. Bila je najdaljša vojna v vojaški zgodovini Združenih držav, saj je vietnamsko vojno presegla za šest mesecev.

source.title: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021)
paragraphs: The war in Afghanistan was a prolonged armed conflict from 2001 to 2021. It began with an invasion by a United States–led coalition under the name Operation Enduring Freedom in response to the September 11 attacks (9/11) carried out by the Taliban-allied and Afghanistan-based al-Qaeda. The Taliban were expelled from major population centers by American-led forces supporting the anti-Taliban Northern Alliance, thus toppling the Taliban-ruled Islamic Emirate. In 2004, the U.S.-backed Islamic Republic was established, but by then, the Taliban, led by founder Mullah Omar, had reorganized and begun an insurgency against the Afghan government and coalition forces. The conflict ended as the 2021 Taliban offensive reestablished the Islamic Emirate. It was the longest war in United States military history, surpassing the Vietnam War by six months.

War in southern Vietnam (1945–1946).headline: Vojna v južnem Vietnamu (1945–1946)
paragraphs: Vojna v južnem Vietnamu 1945–1946, ki so jo Britanci imenovali operacija Masterdom, Vietnamci pa južna odporniška vojna (vietnamsko: Nam Bộ kháng chiến), je bila oborožen spopad v Vietnamu južno od 16. vzporednika, v katerem so britansko-indijske in francoske sile zatirale vietnamska osamosvojitvena gibanja, med njimi nekomunistične nacionaliste, trockiste in stalinistično frontno organizacijo Viet Minh, da bi prevzele nadzor nad južno polovico države. Začela se je kmalu po koncu druge svetovne vojne, natančneje po brezpogojni vdaji Japonske.

source.title: War in southern Vietnam (1945–1946)
paragraphs: The 1945–1946 War in Southern Vietnam, codenamed Operation Masterdom by the British, and also known as the Southern Resistance War (Vietnamese: Nam Bộ kháng chiến) by the Vietnamese, was an armed conflict in Vietnam south of the 16th parallel during which British-Indian and French forces fought to suppress Vietnamese independence movements, which included non-communist nationalists, Trotskyists, and the Stalinist-front Viet Minh, to take control of the southern half of the country. It began shortly after the end of World War II, specifically the unconditional surrender of Japan.

War of the Heavenly Horses.headline: Vojna za nebeške konje
paragraphs: Vojna za nebeške konje (poenostavljeno kitajsko: 天马之战; tradicionalno kitajsko: 天馬之戰) ali hansko-dajuanska vojna (poenostavljeno kitajsko: 汉宛战争; tradicionalno kitajsko: 漢宛戰爭) je bila vojaški spopad, ki se je v letih 104 in 102 pr. n. št. bil med kitajsko dinastijo Han in kraljestvom Dajuan v Ferganski dolini na skrajnem vzhodnem robu nekdanjega Aleksandrovega imperija (med današnjim Uzbekistanom, Kirgizistanom in Tadžikistanom). Vojno naj bi sprožili trgovinski spori, ki jih je zaostrila širša geopolitika hansko-šiungnujskih vojn; dinastija Han je poslala dva pohoda, ki sta se končala s hansko zmago, zato je lahko svojo prevlado razširila globoko v Srednjo Azijo (Kitajci so jo tedaj imenovali Zahodne pokrajine).
notes: Izpuščen je zapis v pinjinu.

source.title: War of the Heavenly Horses
paragraphs: The War of the Heavenly Horses (simplified Chinese: 天马之战; traditional Chinese: 天馬之戰; pinyin: Tiānmǎ zhī Zhàn) or the Han–Dayuan War (simplified Chinese: 汉宛战争; traditional Chinese: 漢宛戰爭; pinyin: Hàn Yuān Zhànzhēng) was a military conflict fought in 104 BC and 102 BC between the Chinese Han dynasty and the kingdom of Dayuan, in the Ferghana Valley at the easternmost end of the former Alexander's empire (between modern-day Uzbekistan, Kyrgyzstan and Tajikistan). The war was allegedly instigated by trade disputes compounded by the extended geopolitics surrounding the Han-Xiongnu Wars, resulting in two Han expeditions that ended in a Han victory, allowing the Han dynasty to expand its hegemony deep into Central Asia (then known to the Chinese as the Western Regions).

Zahodni Čalukje so med 10. in 12. stoletjem vladali večini zahodnega Dekana v južni Indiji. To kanadsko dinastijo včasih imenujejo kaljanijski Čalukje po prestolnici Kaljani, današnjem Basavakaljanu v okrožju Bidar v zvezni državi Karnataka, ali pozni Čalukje zaradi domnevne povezave z dinastijo Čalukja iz Badamija iz 6. stoletja. Dinastijo imenujejo zahodni Čalukje, da bi jo ločili od sočasnih vzhodnih Čalukj iz Vengija, ki so bili samostojna dinastija. Pred vzponom teh Čalukj je imperij Raštrakuta iz Manjakhete več kot dve stoletji nadzoroval večino Dekanske planote in osrednje Indije. Leta 973, ko je v imperiju Raštrakuta po uspešnem napadu vladarja dinastije Paramara iz Malve na prestolnico zavladala zmeda, je Tailapa II., fevdalni podložnik Raštrakut, ki je vladal na območju Bidžapurja, porazil svoje gospodarje in Manjakheto naredil za svojo prestolnico. Dinastija se je hitro okrepila in se pod Someśvaro I., ki je prestolnico preselil v Kaljani, razrasla v imperij.
notes: Izpuščen je angleški zapis izgovarjave.

source.title: Western Chalukya Empire
paragraphs: The Western Chalukya Empire ( chə-LOO-kyə) ruled most of the western Deccan, South India, between the 10th and 12th centuries. This Kannada dynasty is sometimes called the Kalyani Chalukya after its regal capital at Kalyani, today's Basavakalyan in the modern Bidar district of Karnataka state, and alternatively the Later Chalukya from its theoretical relationship to the 6th-century Chalukya dynasty of Badami. The dynasty is called Western Chalukyas to differentiate from the contemporaneous Eastern Chalukyas of Vengi, a separate dynasty. Before the rise of these Chalukyas, the Rashtrakuta Empire of Manyakheta controlled most of the Deccan Plateau and Central India for over two centuries. In 973, seeing confusion in the Rashtrakuta empire after a successful invasion of their capital by the ruler of the Paramara dynasty of Malwa, Tailapa II, a feudatory of the Rashtrakuta dynasty ruling from Bijapur region defeated his overlords and made Manyakheta his capital. The dynasty quickly rose to power and grew into an empire under Someshvara I who moved the capital to Kalyani.

Zahodne satrapije ali zahodni kšatrapi (brahmi: Mahakṣatrapa, »veliki satrapi«) so bili indoskitski (saški) vladarji zahodnega in osrednjega dela Indije (od Sauraštre na jugu in Malve na vzhodu, na območju današnjih zveznih držav Sind, Gudžarat, Maharaštra, Radžastan in Madhja Pradeš) med letoma 35 in 415 n. št. Bili so sodobniki Kušanov, ki so vladali severnemu delu Indijske podceline, in morda njihovi vazali. Bili so tudi sodobniki Satavahan, ki so vladali v osrednji Indiji. V sodobnem zgodovinopisju jih imenujejo »zahodni satrapi«, da bi jih ločili od »severnih satrapov«, ki so do 2. stoletja n. št. vladali v Pandžabu in Mathuri.

Moč zahodnih satrapov je začela pojemati v 2. stoletju n. št., ko je saške vladarje porazil cesar Gautamiputra Satakarni iz dinastije Satavahana. Saško kraljestvo se je nato obnovilo, a ga je v 4. stoletju n. št. dokončno porazil Čandragupta II. iz Guptskega imperija.
notes: V viru manjka zapis v pisavi brahmi; ohranjena je le transliteracija.

source.title: Western Satraps
paragraphs: The Western Satraps, or Western Kshatrapas (Brahmi:, Mahakṣatrapa, "Great Satraps") were Indo-Scythian (Saka) rulers of the western and central parts of India (extending from Saurashtra in the south and Malwa in the east, covering modern-day Sindh, Gujarat, Maharashtra, Rajasthan and Madhya Pradesh states), between 35 and 415 CE. The Western Satraps were contemporaneous with the Kushans who ruled the northern part of the Indian subcontinent, and were possibly vassals of the Kushans. They were also contemporaneous with the Satavahana who ruled in Central India. They are called "Western Satraps" in modern historiography in order to differentiate them from the "Northern Satraps", who ruled in Punjab and Mathura until the 2nd century CE.

The power of the Western Satraps started to decline in the 2nd century CE after the Saka rulers were defeated by the Emperor Gautamiputra Satakarni of the Satavahana dynasty. After this, the Saka kingdom revived, but was ultimately defeated by Chandragupta II of the Gupta Empire in the 4th century CE.

Wusun.headline: Usuni
paragraphs: Usuni so bili starodavno polnomadsko stepsko ljudstvo, ki ga kitajski zapisi omenjajo od 2. stoletja pr. n. št. do 5. stoletja n. št.

Usuni so sprva živeli med gorovjem Čilian in Dunhuangom (Gansu) v bližini Jüedžijev. Okoli leta 176 pr. n. št. je ljudstvo Šiungnu napadlo dežele Jüedžijev, ti pa so nato napadli Usune, ubili njihovega kralja in jim vzeli zemljo. Šiungnu so posvojili preživelega usunskega princa in ga postavili za enega svojih generalov in voditelja Usunov. Okoli leta 162 pr. n. št. so bili Jüedžiji pregnani v dolino reke Ili v Žetisuju, Džungariji in Tjanšanu, kjer so prej živeli Saki. Usuni so se nato kot vazali ljudstva Šiungnu znova naselili v Gansuju. V letih 133–132 pr. n. št. so Usuni pregnali Jüedžije iz doline Ili in se tam naselili.

Usuni so nato postali tesni zavezniki dinastije Han in več stoletij ostali močna sila v regiji. Kitajci jih nazadnje omenjajo v 5. stoletju n. št., ko so se zaradi pritiska Rouranov naselili v Pamirju. Morda so se pozneje vključili med Heftalite.
notes: Izpuščen je angleški zapis izgovarjave.

source.title: Wusun
paragraphs: The Wusun ( WOO-sun) were an ancient semi-nomadic steppe people mentioned in Chinese records from the 2nd century BC to the 5th century AD.

The Wusun originally lived between the Qilian Mountains and Dunhuang (Gansu) near the Yuezhi. Around 176 BC the Xiongnu raided the lands of the Yuezhi, who subsequently attacked the Wusun, killing their king and seizing their land. The Xiongnu adopted the surviving Wusun prince and made him one of their generals and leader of the Wusun. Around 162 BC the Yuezhi were driven into the Ili River Valley in Zhetysu, Dzungaria and Tian Shan, which had formerly been inhabited by the Saka. The Wusun then resettled in Gansu as vassals of the Xiongnu. In 133–132 BC, the Wusun drove the Yuezhi out of the Ili Valley and settled the area.

The Wusun then became close allies of the Han dynasty and remained a powerful force in the region for several centuries. The Wusun are last mentioned by the Chinese as having settled in the Pamir Mountains in the 5th century AD due to pressure from the Rouran. They possibly became subsumed into the later Hephthalites.

Seune, Sevune ali Jadave iz Devagirija (IAST: Seuṇa, ok. 1187–1317) so bili srednjeveška indijska dinastija, ki je na vrhuncu vladala kraljestvu od reke Narmade na severu do reke Tungabhadre na jugu, v zahodnem delu Dekana. Njeno ozemlje je obsegalo današnjo Maharaštro, severno Karnatako in dele Madhja Pradeša, prestolnica pa je bila Devagiri (današnji Daulatabad v okrožju Čatrapati Sambhadžinagar v Maharaštri).

Jadave so sprva vladali kot fevdalni podložniki zahodnih Čalukj. Okoli sredine 12. stoletja, ko je moč Čalukj pojemala, je jadavski kralj Bhilama V. razglasil neodvisnost. Jadave so vrhunec dosegli pod Simhano II. in cveteli do začetka 14. stoletja, ko jih je leta 1308 priključila dinastija Khaldži Delhijskega sultanata.

source.title: Seuna dynasty
paragraphs: The Seuna, Sevuna, or Yadavas of Devagiri (IAST: Seuṇa, c. 1187–1317) was a medieval Indian dynasty, which at its peak ruled a realm stretching from the Narmada river in the north to the Tungabhadra river in the south, in the western part of the Deccan region. Its territory included present-day Maharashtra, northern Karnataka and parts of Madhya Pradesh, from its capital at Devagiri (present-day Daulatabad in modern Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar district, Maharashtra).

The Yadavas initially ruled as feudatories of the Western Chalukyas. Around the middle of the 12th century, as the Chalukya power waned, the Yadava king Bhillama V declared independence. The Yadavas reached their peak under Simhana II, and flourished until the early 14th century, when it was annexed by the Khalji dynasty of the Delhi Sultanate in 1308 CE.

Yaudheya.headline: Jaudheja
paragraphs: Jaudheja (pisava brahmi: 𑀬𑁅𑀥𑁂𑀬) ali Jaudheja Ganasangha (republika Jaudheja) je bila starodavna indijska vojaška ganasangha (republika) na vzhodu Sapta Sindhuja, v današnji Harjani. Beseda Jaudheja izhaja iz besede jodha, ki pomeni bojevnike, po Paniniju pa je pripona »-ja« označevala bojevniška plemena, kar potrjuje njihov odpor proti imperijem, ki so vdirali v deželo, denimo Kušanskemu cesarstvu in Indoskitom. Rudradaman I. iz zahodnih satrapij v napisu na skali v Džunagadhu navaja, da so bili Jaudheje »junaki med vsemi kšatrijami« in »se niso radi vdajali«. Znani so bili po republikanski ureditvi, s katero so se razlikovali od drugih džanapad, ki so imele monarhije.

source.title: Yaudheya
paragraphs: Yaudheya (Brahmi script: 𑀬𑁅𑀥𑁂𑀬) or Yaudheya Gaṇasaṅgha (Yaudheya Republic) was an ancient Indian military ganasangha (republic) based in the Eastern region of the Sapta Sindhu, in modern day Haryana. The word Yaudheya is a derivative of the word from yodha meaning warriors and according to Pāṇini, the suffix '-ya', was significant of warrior tribes, which is supported by their resistance to invading empires such as the Kushan Empire and the Indo-Scythians. Rudradaman I of the Western Satraps notes in his Junagadh rock inscription that the Yaudheyas were 'heroes among all Kshatriya' and 'were loath to surrender'. They were noted as having a republic form of government, unique from other Janapadas which instead maintained monarchies.

Dinastija Juan, uradno Veliki Juan, je bila cesarska dinastija Kitajske pod vodstvom Mongolov in naslednica Mongolskega cesarstva po njegovi razdelitvi. Ustanovil jo je Kublaj (cesar Šidzu ali Secen kan), peti kagan-cesar Mongolskega cesarstva iz klana Bordžigin, trajala pa je od leta 1271 do 1368 n. št. V kitajski zgodovini je dinastija Juan sledila dinastiji Song in bila predhodnica dinastije Ming.

source.title: Yuan dynasty
paragraphs: The Yuan dynasty, officially the Great Yuan, was a Mongol-led imperial dynasty of China and a successor state to the Mongol Empire after its division. It was established by Kublai (Emperor Shizu or Setsen Khan), the fifth khagan-emperor of the Mongol Empire from the Borjigin clan, and lasted from 1271 to 1368 CE. In Chinese history, the Yuan dynasty followed the Song dynasty and preceded the Ming dynasty.

Yuezhi.headline: Jüedžiji
paragraphs: Jüedžiji so bili starodavno ljudstvo, ki ga kitajske kronike v 1. tisočletju pr. n. št. prvič opisujejo kot nomadske pastirje na sušnem travnatem območju v zahodnem delu današnje kitajske province Gansu. Po hudem porazu proti ljudstvu Šiungnu leta 176 pr. n. št. so se razdelili v dve skupini, ki sta se selili v različne smeri: Velike Jüedžije in Male Jüedžije. S tem se je začel zapleten domino učinek, ki se je širil na vse strani in za stoletja zaznamoval zgodovino velikega dela Azije.

source.title: Yuezhi
paragraphs: The Yuezhi were an ancient people first described in Chinese histories as nomadic pastoralists living in an arid grassland area in the western part of the modern Chinese province of Gansu, during the 1st millennium BC. After a major defeat at the hands of the Xiongnu in 176 BC, the Yuezhi split into two groups migrating in different directions: the Greater Yuezhi and Lesser Yuezhi. This started a complex domino effect that radiated in all directions and, in the process, set the course of history for much of Asia for centuries to come.
